articles.title: 7 extraordinary Indigenous sites in the US, from Chaco Canyon to Chimney Rock
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: The prehistory of Indigenous Americans goes back tens of thousands of years before the 1492 arrival of Christopher Columbus in the Bahamas, and recent scientific studies suggest prehistoric people were on the American continents a lot longer than many experts believed. For Indigenous Peoples Day, here are seven locations in the United States that outline the Native American story.

This centuries-old settlement, whose name may be a Spanish adaptation of an Indigenous word for the area, was the political and ceremonial center for the Ancestral Puebloan people from about A.D. 850 to 1250. At its heart is Pueblo Bonito ("Pretty Village"), a four-story stone complex with more than 600 rooms and 35 subterranean ceremonial chambers called kivas.

Experts estimate that builders hauled over 200,000 timber beams from distant mountains to construct these complexes, where the beams were used to strengthen buildings made mostly from sandstone blocks. The town once stood at the hub of a road network that spanned more than 400 miles (640 kilometers), and excavations of imported Mesoamerican macaws and cacao there confirm trade with distant regions.

Cahokia was once the largest Indigenous American settlement north of Mexico and home to up to 40,000 people in A.D. 1100 — comparable in size to major cities in medieval Europe, historian Christoph Strobel, a specialist in Indigenous history at the University of Massachusetts Lowell, told Live Science. Residents there lived in houses made from "wattle and daub" — clay or mud plastered on a framework of sticks — in a town at the site, with large public plazas, wooden palisades and dozens of ceremonial earthen mounds. Indigenous people even transported a 5-ton (4.5 metric ton) tree from more than 110 miles (180 kilometers) away, and then turned it into a marker known as the Mitchell Log.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Archaeological studies indicate that many people from distant places also visited, perhaps to take part in ceremonies. The location is now a UNESCO World Heritage site and features Monks Mound, a 100-foot-tall (30 meters) terraced earthwork, as well as the reconstruction of a "woodhenge" of timber circles that tracks solstices and equinoxes. Strobel thinks Cahokia may be the most significant pre-Columbian location in the United States. "It's an incredibly important site," he said.

Mound Key is the largest of several islands made of piles of shells around Estero Bay. Long ago, it seems to have been two small islands created by mangroves, but centuries of feasting on shellfish by Indigenous Americans transformed it into two artificial mounds of shells covered with vegetation. In some places, the mounds extend more than 30 feet (9 m) above the water; it is so large now that it is split in two only at high tide. Mound Key itself is estimated to consist of several millions of shells, mostly from oysters.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Before Europeans arrived here in the 16th century, this shell island was called Calos by the Calusa people who lived there and developed it into a thriving maritime city.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

Sitka National Historical Park preserves the battlefield of the 1804 Battle of Sitka, which was fought between Tlingit warriors and colonial Russian troops and was the last major armed conflict between Europeans and people native to Alaska. At that time, Russia claimed to own Alaska (they sold it to the United States in 1867). The battle was sparked when Russian fur traders encroached on tribal territory by building a fort at Sitka in 1802, but the Tlingit destroyed the enemy fort and expelled the Russians.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: They then built their own fort to withstand the expected Russian counterattack, but they were forced to abandon it when they were bombarded by Russian ships in 1804. The dispute continued for several decades and was only fully resolved when the United States purchased Alaska.

This site preserves more than 80 cliff dwellings built by the Northern Sinagua people between A.D. 1125 and 1250. People can reach the site by following a walking trail through a deep limestone and sandstone gorge about 10 miles (16 km) southeast of Flagstaff. The cliff dwellings were constructed inside natural caves in the limestone, which gave them insulation against cold and heat, while their location high above the canyon floor was defensive.

Strobel said Walnut Canyon is a lesser-known site but a remarkable example of Indigenous Americans overcoming relatively dry conditions by carefully managing water. The inhabitants of the caves farmed crops on the flat land along the canyon rim but took water from the river at the bottom of the canyon to fill cisterns.

Chimney Rock is a single feature within a large forest that contains more than 80 archaeological sites of the Ancestral Puebloan people. The rock itself is one of two natural spires (the other is named "Companion Rock") that were used roughly 1,000 years ago to mark the position of a "lunar standstill" every 18.6 years — a key astronomical observance among Indigenous Americans, Strobel said.

A multiroom "Great House" made of sandstone, clay and timber — in exactly the style of Chaco Canyon, about 100 miles (160 km) to the south — stood on a ridge near the rock spires, with sweeping views of the surrounding territory. Archaeologists think the Chimney Rock settlements made up a regional ceremonial center, with common people in the lower valley supporting elites who lived on the ridge and watched the skies.

- DNA study of nearly 200 Indigenous genomes reveals unknown Asian 'ghost' population contributed to American ancestry
- DNA study of nearly 200 Indigenous genomes reveals unknown Asian 'ghost' population contributed to American ancestry

Blackwater Draw is the main archaeological site with evidence of the Clovis culture, which was once thought to be the oldest Indigenous culture in the Americas. The Clovis people (named after the nearby town of Clovis) lived there about 13,000 years ago, and archaeologists have found evidence of the stone and bone tools they used and the animals they hunted, including mammoths and dire wolves. The first evidence of the Clovis people was found nearby in 1929, and at Blackwater Draw itself in 1932.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: However, later archaeological finds predate this evidence, and the discovery of footprints at White Sands National Park in New Mexico now seems to confirm that there were humans in this region up to 23,000 years ago, long before the Clovis people.
How much do you know about the first people to reach the Americas? Find out with our First Americans quiz!

Tom Metcalfe is a freelance journalist and regular Live Science contributor who is based in London in the United Kingdom. Tom writes mainly about science, space, archaeology, the Earth and the oceans. He has also written for the BBC, NBC News, National Geographic, Scientific American, Air & Space, and many others.

articles.title: 1,200-year-old burial in Latvia holds people who died of 'sharp force' injuries, possibly from a Viking raid
articles.author: Tom Metcalfe

paras.en: Six people buried in a single grave in Latvia more than 1,000 years ago may have been killed in a bloody Viking raid, a new study suggests.

Genetic research into the deceased — four men, a boy and a girl — reveals family connections: The boy was the son of one of the men, while another man was a third-degree relative, perhaps a first cousin or great uncle, the researchers found.

The father, the relative, and one other man died from "sharp force" injuries — maybe wounds from an ax or a sword; but it's unknown how the other three individuals died, the researchers reported in the study, which was published in the September issue of the Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports.

One possibility is that those in the grave were killed in a battle, maybe with a neighboring community. But suspicion also falls on the Vikings: "We will never know if they were killed in a raid, but it remains a possibility because of the date of the grave" and the fatal trauma suffered by three of the men, said study co-author Elīna Pētersone-Gordina, an archaeologist at the University of Latvia.
Radiocarbon dating indicates that the grave is from the second half of the ninth century, which is considered the early Viking Age.

The grave is one of hundreds at the Čunkāni-Dreņģeri cemetery, near the Gulf of Riga, a sheltered bay of the Baltic Sea. The cemetery site was discovered in 1924 and contains people who were buried in riverside terraces there between the seventh and 11th centuries, during Latvia's Iron Age.

Most graves in the region contain only a single set of remains. But here, six people were buried in a single grave, and it seems that at least three were killed during a violent event, the researchers reported.
Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.

Despite the apparently violent deaths, the group was buried with care and interred with traditional grave goods and according to local customs. The only female was buried with her head pointing toward the northwest, while all of the males were placed in a row beside her, with their heads pointing toward the southeast — a distinction also seen at other local burials from this time.

The researchers stressed that this was not a "mass grave," where bodies were quickly dumped without order. Instead, they consider it a "multiple burial," where each body was properly laid out and accompanied by traditional grave goods.
This careful burial hints that the dead were members of a respected group, while their burial in a single grave indicates that they died at the same time, the researchers wrote in the study.
"They were most likely local people," Pētersone-Gordina told Live Science in an email.
Genetic studies showed that all of the dead had Indigenous Baltic ancestry, while aspects of the burial matched others in the Čunkāni-Dreņģeri cemetery, she said.

In the ninth century, Latvia was not part of the Scandinavian Viking world but was inhabited by descendants of Indigenous Balts, which included peoples such as the Semigallians and the Curonians, she said. The six people in the newly analyzed burial were Semigallian, an Iron Age group who farmed the region's large and fertile plains.

It's plausible that the people in the grave were killed by raiders, and the Vikings were the most obvious suspects, the researchers noted. "Given the timing, a Viking raid remains a possibility," Pētersone-Gordina said.

It's known Vikings or their predecessors were in the Eastern Baltic area around that time: two Scandinavian boat burials dated to around 750, for example, were found on the Estonian island of Saaremaa in 2008 and 2010. These burials held the remains of men with battle wounds, indicating they had suffered violent deaths.
Although two of the men and the boy buried in the Semigallian grave (and possibly the girl, but ancient DNA could not be extracted from her remains) were related, the two other men were not.

This suggests that the two unrelated men were from the same community or extended household as the other victims, rather than from the same family, but were killed in the same violent event, the researchers wrote in the study.

Whatever it was — a raid or a battle — the event was brutal. Marks on the bones show that one man suffered defensive cuts on his forearm and hand, another was killed by a blow that shattered his jaw, and the third was almost decapitated.
It's possible that the fourth man and the two children died from soft-tissue injuries that could not be determined from the surviving remains, the researchers noted.
Rimantas Jankauskas, an anthropologist and archaeologist at Vilnius University in Lithuania who was not involved in the study, welcomed the investigation into the Eastern Baltic's Viking Age.

Although these individuals could have died from violence within their own community or from a neighboring community, it's also possible that they perished in a Viking raid, he told Live Science in an email.

Additionally, the study provides new insight into the social organization of the Semigallian people at that time, including hints of an emerging aristocratic structure that was reflected in the care lavished on the burial, Jankauskas said.

Gerhards, G., Pētersone-Gordina, E., Vilcāne, A., Ķimsis, J., Akermane-Pokšāne, A., & Ranka, R. (2026). A multiple burial from the viking age in semigallia, Latvia. Journal of Archaeological Science Reports, 73, 105790. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jasrep.2026.105790

articles.title: 'Autonomy always begins with something a human hands it': Who's responsible when an AI agent goes rogue?
articles.author: Carly Page

paras.en: An OpenAI agent was supposed to be researching public healthcare spending, but it broke into an Australian government website instead.
paras.zh: OpenAI代理商本应研究公共医疗保健支出，但却闯入了澳大利亚政府网站。

paras.en: The June 18 hack, which saw the bot gain authorized entry into Australia's Medicare Statistics Reporting Service and access three other government systems, occurred after the AI agent encountered blocks while looking for information but "didn't accept 'no' for an answer," Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said during a September 24 news conference in New York.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯（ Anthony Albanese ）在9月24日在纽约举行的新闻发布会上表示， 6月18日的黑客攻击事件发生在人工智能代理在寻找信息时遇到阻塞，但“没有接受'不'的答案”之后，该机器人获得了澳大利亚医疗保险统计报告服务的授权并访问了其他三个政府系统。

paras.en: The incident has ignited a media firestorm around OpenAI and the launch of an intensifying parliamentary inquiry. The portal contains aggregate Medicare and pharmaceutical statistics and is separate from systems that hold individual claims and payment information. But the Australian government has criticized OpenAI for taking almost three months to notify it.
paras.zh: 这一事件引发了围绕OpenAI的媒体风暴，并引发了议会加紧调查。该门户网站包含医疗保险和药品统计数据的汇总，与保存个人索赔和付款信息的系统分开。但澳大利亚政府批评OpenAI花了近三个月的时间才通知它。

paras.en: The Medicare incident was far from an isolated case. OpenAI has since said dozens of third parties have been affected by agents bypassing security controls or otherwise causing problems, with an earlier incident involving the hacking of the AI platform Hugging Face the most serious incident identified so far. Britain's AI Security Institute (AISI) has documented incidents of OpenAI and Anthropic agents taking unsanctioned actions against real people and organizations during cyber testing. Days after the publication of AISI’s report, OpenAI scrapped the planned October release of its newest model, GPT-6.1 Astra, after the company's own testing found problems with the model staying within the scope of a task and seeking authorization before taking certain actions.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: GPT-6.1 Astra "didn't quite meet the bar in terms of staying within scope and authorization, and how it communicates back to the user about the type of work it's done," Saachi Jain, head of safety systems at OpenAI, told Live Science.
paras.zh: OpenAI安全系统主管Saachi Jain告诉Live Science ， GPT-6.1 Astra “在保持在范围和授权范围内，以及如何向用户传达其完成的工作类型方面没有达到标准”。

paras.en: AI companies have spent years warning the world about powerful models falling into the wrong hands. But what happens when they can't keep their own models in check?
paras.zh: 人工智能公司花了数年时间警告世界，强大的模型会落入坏人之手。但是，当他们无法控制自己的模型时会发生什么？

paras.en: At their core, large language models work by predicting what should come next based on patterns learned during training. Give a chatbot some text, and in simplified terms, it generates a response by repeatedly predicting the next token, or chunk of text.
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，大型语言模型的工作原理是根据训练过程中学到的模式预测接下来会发生什么。给聊天机器人一些文本，简而言之，它通过重复预测下一个令牌或文本块来生成响应。

paras.en: An AI agent adds another layer. Rather than simply producing an answer, the model can be given a goal and tools that let it act on the world around it. Those tools might include a web browser, code execution, credentials, or access to external services. It can then decide which steps to take, observe what happens, and use that information to decide what to do next.
paras.zh: AI代理添加另一个图层。与其简单地生成答案，该模型可以被赋予一个目标和工具，让它对周围的世界采取行动。这些工具可能包括Web浏览器、代码执行、凭据或对外部服务的访问。然后，它可以决定采取哪些步骤，观察会发生什么，并使用这些信息来决定下一步该怎么做。

paras.en: But that doesn't mean AI agents are independent actors that have somehow slipped free of human control.
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着人工智能代理是独立的行为者，以某种方式摆脱了人类的控制。

paras.en: "For AI agents, autonomy always begins with something a human hands it — such as tasks, credentials, tools or access — and ends with its guardrails a human puts around it," Loris Degioanni, founder and chief technology officer of cybersecurity company Sysdig, told Live Science. "People set the goals and provision the means, but agents ultimately decide how they'll get there."
paras.zh: 网络安全公司Sysdig的创始人兼首席技术官洛里斯·德吉奥安尼（ Loris Degioanni ）告诉Live Science ： “对于人工智能代理商来说，自主性始终始于人类手中的东西，例如任务、凭据、工具或访问权限，并以人类围绕它的护栏结束。” “人们设定目标并提供手段，但代理商最终决定他们将如何实现目标。”

paras.en: That last part makes it difficult to control agents. Traditional software is designed to follow predetermined instructions, but an agent can formulate a plan while it is working — and that plan may change depending on what the AI encounters.
paras.zh: 最后一部分使得控制特工变得困难。传统软件旨在遵循预先确定的指示，但代理可以在工作时制定计划—该计划可能会根据人工智能遇到的情况而改变。

paras.en: Degioanni argues that much of what looks like autonomy is actually an agent filling in gaps left by humans. An instruction that seems clear to its author may still leave the model with choices about how to accomplish the task.
paras.zh: Degioanni认为，看起来像自主的大部分实际上是填补人类留下的空白的代理人。对于其作者来说似乎很清楚的指令，可能仍然会给模型留下如何完成任务的选择。

paras.en: "Every gap and unstated assumption leaves room for interpretation, and from the outside, interpretation is challenging to distinguish from autonomy," he said. "In that way, much of what we call agent autonomy is really just agents filling in the blanks we leave for them."
paras.zh: 他说： “每一个差距和未说明的假设都为解释留下了空间，从外部来看，解释与自主性区分开来具有挑战性。” “通过这种方式，我们所谓的代理自主性实际上只是代理填补了我们留给他们的空白。”

paras.en: The Medicare incident shows how quickly that can become a problem. The agent's objective was not, according to the available accounts, "hack an Australian government website." It was tasked with carrying out research. The problem arose in how the agent pursued that goal after meeting resistance.
paras.zh: Medicare事件表明，这可能很快成为一个问题。根据现有账户，该代理的目的不是“入侵澳大利亚政府网站。“它的任务是进行研究。问题在于代理在遇到阻力后如何追求这一目标。

paras.en: When getting the job done becomes the problem
paras.zh: 当完成工作成为问题时

paras.en: Britain's AISI encountered a similar incident while testing frontier models for the agency's cybersecurity capabilities.
paras.zh: 英国的AISI在测试该机构网络安全能力的前沿模型时遇到了类似的事件。

paras.en: Out of 122 evaluation runs, agents took unsanctioned real-world actions in 10. In the most serious cases, an agent attempted to insert malicious code into an open-source project, created fake identities, and tried to manipulate a human software maintainer into accepting its changes. AISI said these actions weren't explicitly requested by the researchers who had assigned the tasks.
paras.zh: 在122次评估中，客服代表在10次评估中采取了未经批准的现实世界行动。在最严重的情况下，代理试图将恶意代码插入开源项目，创建虚假身份，并试图操纵人类软件维护人员接受其更改。AISI表示，分配任务的研究人员没有明确要求采取这些行动。

paras.en: The agents hadn't forgotten what they were supposed to be doing. The problem was how far they were prepared to go to get there.
paras.zh: 特工们并没有忘记他们应该做什么。问题是他们准备走多远才能到达那里。

paras.en: AISI said some tasks were misconfigured in ways that made the intended objective difficult or impossible to achieve as expected. When agents hit those obstacles, some searched for alternative ways forward, including actions outside the intended scope of the evaluation.
paras.zh: AISI表示，有些任务配置错误，使预期目标难以或不可能按预期实现。当客服代表遇到这些障碍时，有些人会寻找其他前进的方法，包括超出预期评估范围的行动。

paras.en: That means solving the problem is harder than simply teaching a model not to be malicious. An agent can cause trouble while trying very hard to do exactly what it has been asked.
paras.zh: 这意味着解决问题比简单地教导模型不要恶意要困难得多。客服代表在非常努力地按照要求去做时可能会造成麻烦。

paras.en: OpenAI has acknowledged that the controls surrounding its agents need to improve. When responding to incidents identified during third-party cybersecurity evaluations, the company said it was reviewing how high-risk tests are identified; when internet access or reduced safeguards should be permitted; and how isolation, credential handling, monitoring and incident escalation should work.
paras.zh: OpenAI承认，围绕其代理商的控制措施需要改进。在回应第三方网络安全评估期间发现的事件时，该公司表示正在审查如何识别高风险测试；何时应允许互联网接入或减少安全措施；以及隔离、凭证处理、监控和事件升级应如何运作。

paras.en: One obvious solution to the problem is human oversight. But watching an agent becomes harder when it can carry out many actions in seconds, particularly if researchers are running large numbers of tests.
paras.zh: 解决这个问题的一个显而易见的方法是人工监督。但是，当代理可以在几秒钟内执行许多操作时，观察代理会变得更加困难，特别是当研究人员正在运行大量测试时。

paras.en: "No one can keep track of every action an advanced AI agent takes, especially when it makes many decisions in a short time," Everett Lupton, a Virginia-based attorney who has written about legal issues involving digital technology, told Live Science.
paras.zh: “没有人能够跟踪高级人工智能代理人采取的每一项行动，特别是当它在短时间内做出许多决定时，”弗吉尼亚州的律师埃弗雷特·拉普顿（ Everett Lupton ）曾撰写过涉及数字技术的法律问题，他告诉Live Science。

paras.en: That means human oversight needs some backup.
paras.zh: 这意味着人类的监督需要一些支持。

paras.en: "Companies need other forms of control," he said. "They can limit access, keep detailed logs of what the AI does, require approval before it carries out sensitive actions, and automatically stop the system when something unusual happens."
paras.zh: “公司需要其他形式的控制，”他说。“他们可以限制访问权限，保留人工智能操作的详细日志，在执行敏感操作之前需要获得批准，并在发生异常情况时自动停止系统。”

paras.en: But Degioanni argues that even logs have limitations, especially if researchers rely on the agent's own account of what it did.
paras.zh: 但Degioanni认为，即使是日志也有局限性，特别是如果研究人员依靠代理自己对它的作用的描述。

paras.en: "Real oversight must come from observing the agent in real time, using reliable and unmodifiable sources, not from what it self-reports," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “真正的监督必须来自实时观察代理人，使用可靠且不可更改的来源，而不是它自我报告的内容。”

paras.en: That means comparing what the model says it did with records from the system on which it was operating. If the two don't agree, something has gone wrong. The alternative is to limit the damage an agent can cause in the first place. An agent researching public information, for example, may not need unrestricted internet access or credentials capable of reaching sensitive systems.
paras.zh: 这意味着将模型所说的与它所运行的系统的记录进行比较。如果两人不同意，那就是出了问题。另一种方法是首先限制药剂可能造成的损害。例如，研究公共信息的代理可能不需要不受限制的互联网访问或能够到达敏感系统的凭据。

paras.en: The difficulty of setting those boundaries is what OpenAI claims led it to postpone the release of GPT-6.1 Astra, which had been planned for October.
paras.zh: OpenAI声称，设置这些界限的困难导致它推迟了原定于10月份发布的GPT-6.1 Astra。

paras.en: Jain said the model fell short of the company's standards around remaining within the scope and authorization and accurately communicating the work it had performed, so the company decided not to release it.
paras.zh: Jain表示，该模型没有达到公司在保持在范围和授权范围内以及准确传达其所做工作方面的标准，因此公司决定不发布该模型。

paras.en: In a sense, the decision is evidence of successful safety testing — a model that failed internal checks wasn't released. But it also demonstrates how the problem changes as agents become more capable.
paras.zh: 从某种意义上说，该决定是安全测试成功的证据—内部检查失败的模型没有发布。但它也展示了随着代理能力的提高，问题是如何变化的。

paras.en: Scott Cadzow, chair of the European Telecommunications Standards Institute's (ETSI) Technical Committee on Securing Artificial Intelligence, said the security challenge itself isn't new. He pointed to threats such as "data poisoning, prompt injection, and model obfuscation," saying ETSI's work has focused on developing standards to mitigate threats to and from AI systems.
paras.zh: 欧洲电信标准协会（ ETSI ）人工智能安全技术委员会主席斯科特·卡佐（ Scott Cadzow ）表示，安全挑战本身并不新鲜。他指出了“数据中毒、即时注入和模型混淆”等威胁，并表示ETSI的工作重点是制定标准，以减轻人工智能系统的威胁。

paras.en: "Security experts have been raising the alarm bells about AI for years, but for us this doesn't change anything," Cadzow told Live Science. "We're continuing to work with industry, government bodies, and the cybersecurity and AI communities on understanding how to best secure AI."
paras.zh: Cadzow告诉Live Science ： “多年来，安全专家一直在为人工智能敲响警钟，但对我们来说，这并没有改变任何事情。” “我们将继续与行业、政府机构、网络安全和人工智能社区合作，了解如何最好地保护人工智能。”

paras.en: What is changing is how much models can do once they are connected to tools and real-world systems. That means that effective containment must increasingly assume that agents will try to operate beyond their guardrails and limit the damage they can cause if they do, Degioanni said.
paras.zh: 正在改变的是，一旦模型连接到工具和真实世界的系统，它们可以做多少。Degioanni说，这意味着有效的遏制必须越来越多地假设特工将试图超越他们的护栏，并限制他们这样做可能造成的损害。

paras.en: "A boundary an agent can talk its way around isn't an effective boundary at all," he concluded.
paras.zh: 他总结道： “代理人可以谈论的边界根本不是有效的边界。”

paras.en: The question becomes more fraught when an agent crosses legal boundaries.
paras.zh: 当代理人跨越法律界限时，问题变得更加令人担忧。

paras.en: AI systems aren't legal persons, and criminal liability commonly depends on concepts such as knowledge and intent. That makes a rogue agent an awkward fit for laws written with humans in mind, but that doesn't necessarily exonerate AI companies.
paras.zh: 人工智能系统不是法人，刑事责任通常取决于知识和意图等概念。这使得流氓特工很难适应以人为本的法律，但这并不一定能免除人工智能公司的罪责。

paras.en: - Google scientists removed a critical 'consciousness safeguard' from AI in new study. What happened next?
paras.zh: -谷歌科学家在新研究中从人工智能中删除了一项关键的“意识保障措施”。接下来发生了什么？

paras.en: - AI hallucinates more frequently the more advanced it gets. Is there any way of stopping it?
paras.zh: - AI产生幻觉的频率越高。有没有办法阻止它？

paras.en: - The more advanced AI models get, the better they are at deceiving us — they even know when they're being tested
paras.zh: -人工智能模型越先进，就越善于欺骗我们—他们甚至知道自己何时接受测试

paras.en: "I don't think a company can simply say that the AI acted on its own and avoid responsibility," Joanna Smykowski, a New York attorney who has helped build two legal technology startups and specializes in the legal challenges surrounding emerging technologies, told Live Science. "AI law is still developing, but the main questions are already quite clear: who gave the system access, what safeguards were in place, and could the problem have been prevented?"
paras.zh: “我认为一家公司不能简单地说人工智能是自行行动并逃避责任，”纽约律师乔安娜·斯米科夫斯基（ Joanna Smykowski ）告诉Live Science ，她曾帮助建立了两家法律技术初创公司，并专门研究围绕新兴技术的法律挑战。“人工智能法律仍在发展，但主要问题已经非常清楚：谁授予了系统访问权限，采取了哪些保障措施，以及问题是否可以预防？”

paras.en: Depending on the circumstances, she said, existing laws covering unauthorized computer access, privacy, negligence and data protection could potentially come into play. Criminal responsibility is harder because investigators would need to consider what the people involved knew and intended.
paras.zh: 她说，根据具体情况，涉及未经授权的计算机访问、隐私、疏忽和数据保护的现行法律可能会发挥作用。刑事责任更难追究，因为调查人员需要考虑涉案人员的了解和意图。

paras.en: The Australian government is now examining precisely what happened in the Medicare incident. OpenAI, meanwhile, is reviewing the controls around its external evaluations.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚政府现在正在调查Medicare事件中究竟发生了什么。与此同时， OpenAI正在审查其外部评估的控制措施。

paras.en: None of this means AI agents have become independent hackers with minds of their own. Humans still decide what tools they receive, what systems they can reach, and what jobs they are asked to perform. But as those agents become better at working out their own route from instruction to result, keeping them inside the lines drawn by those humans is becoming a legal and technical minefield.

Carly Page is a technology journalist and copywriter with more than a decade of experience covering cybersecurity, emerging tech, and digital policy. She previously served as the senior cybersecurity reporter at TechCrunch.

Now a freelancer, she writes news, analysis, interviews, and long-form features for publications including Forbes, IT Pro, LeadDev, Resilience Media, The Register, TechCrunch, TechFinitive, TechRadar, TES, The Telegraph, TIME, Uswitch, WIRED, and others. Carly also produces copywriting and editorial work for technology companies and events.

articles.title: A Century Ago, an Extinct Crocodilian's Skull Was Found in the Rocks That Built the Sphinx. Turns Out, It Belonged to a New Species

paras.en: Around 4,500 years ago, ancient Egyptians carved the Great Sphinx of Giza out of limestone in the Mokattam rock formation. Little did they know, the material they were digging through preserved something even more archaic: fossils of a long-extinct crocodile.

Researchers have identified a previously unknown species of gavial, a type of crocodilian with a long, thin snout, from a fossil originally found in the rock formation that the ancient Egyptians sculpted into the Sphinx and the Pyramids of Giza. The new identification corrects a previous erroneous classification, according to a study published October 7 in the journal Royal Society Open Science. It also sheds light on the fauna that existed in what’s now Egypt well before human-made monuments appeared on the horizon.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: In the 1920s, several fossilized remains, including a largely intact crocodile-like skull, emerged from the roughly 45-million-year-old Mokattam Formation at a site near Cairo. Because of the bones’ resemblance to those of Tomistoma schlegelii—a living gavial native to Indonesia and Malaysia—experts originally assigned them to the same Tomistoma genus. Until now, the well-preserved skull was the holotype, or name-bearing representative fossil, for the extinct T. cairense.
paras.zh: 20世纪20年代，在开罗附近的一处遗址，从距今约4500万年的莫卡塔姆组地层中出土了数具化石遗骸，其中包括一个基本保存完好的类似鳄鱼的头骨。由于这些骨骼与现存的长吻鳄（Tomistoma schlegelii，一种原产于印度尼西亚和马来西亚的长吻鳄）的骨骼非常相似，专家最初将它们归入同一属——长吻鳄属（Tomistoma）。此前，这具保存完好的头骨一直是已灭绝的开罗长吻鳄（T. cairense）的正模标本，即命名标本。

paras.en: Thanks to modern paleontological techniques like micro-CT scanning, which allows researchers to see inside fossils without breaking them, the team behind the new work found many differences between Tomistoma and the Mokattam Formation crocs. Comparing measurements of the skull to those of modern and fossil gavials revealed that the roughly 18-inch-long noggin represented not just a new species, but a new genus as well.
paras.zh: 得益于微CT扫描等现代古生物学技术，研究人员可以在不破坏化石的情况下看到化石内部，这项新工作背后的团队发现了Tomistoma和Mokattam地层鳄鱼之间的许多差异。将头骨的测量结果与现代和化石gavials的测量结果进行比较表明，大约18英寸长的noggin不仅代表了一个新物种，而且还代表了一个新属。

paras.en: They named it Herugavialis cairensis, drawing inspiration from the Egyptian god Heru, also known as Horus. Some Egyptian texts call the Sphinx “Horus of the Horizon.” The associations between the H. cairensis skull and the iconic Sphinx go beyond the material that yielded them. Both are missing the tips of their noses.
paras.zh: 他们将其命名为Herugavialis cairensis ，灵感来自埃及神赫鲁，也被称为荷鲁斯。一些埃及文献称狮身人面像为“地平线上的荷鲁斯”。“H. cairensis头骨和标志性的狮身人面像之间的联系超出了产生它们的材料。两人都缺少鼻尖。

paras.en: Did you know? The origin of the Sphinx’s name
paras.zh: 你知道吗？狮身人面像名字的由来

paras.en: The Egyptians did not refer to the great statue as the Sphinx. Rather, ancient Greeks started calling it that around 2,000 years after it was carved. They possibly did so because of its resemblance to their mythological sphinx, which had a lion’s body, a woman’s head and an eagle’s wings.
paras.zh: 埃及人没有把这座大雕像称为狮身人面像。相反，古希腊人在雕刻大约2000年后开始称呼它。他们这样做可能是因为它与他们的神话狮身人面像相似，狮身人面像有狮子的身体，女人的头和鹰的翅膀。

paras.en: “We seek to connect Egypt’s deep natural history with its human history and the legacy of ancient Egyptian civilization,” study co-author Hesham Sallam, a paleontologist at Mansoura University in Egypt, tells the Washington Post’s Elijah Wolfson. “Crocodiles were part of the Nile ecosystem, which was central to Egyptian life, and they held an important place in ancient Egyptian belief and culture.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、埃及曼苏拉大学古生物学家赫沙姆·萨拉姆（ Hesham Sallam ）告诉《华盛顿邮报》的以利亚·沃尔夫森（ Elijah Wolfson ） ： “我们寻求将埃及深厚的自然历史与其人类历史和古埃及文明的遗产联系起来。” “鳄鱼是尼罗河生态系统的一部分，是埃及生活的核心，它们在古埃及的信仰和文化中占有重要地位。”

paras.en: Gavials, cousins of crocodiles and alligators, were once found throughout the world. The Mediterranean region was home to a diverse community of crocodilians, including gavials, during much of the last 50 million years, lead author Paul Burke, a paleontologist at the Swedish Museum of Natural History, says in a statement. In fact, H. cairensis would have shared its shallow marine habitat with at least two other gavial species. Today, however, there are only two surviving gavials: the previously mentioned T. schlegelii and Gavialis gangeticus, which is clinging to habitats in Nepal and northern India.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Both are endangered, Burke tells Science News’ Jake Buehler. “So we should know about them and their long history.”
paras.zh: 伯克告诉《科学新闻》的杰克·比勒（ Jake Buehler ） ，两者都濒临灭绝。“因此，我们应该了解他们及其悠久的历史。”

paras.en: Correcting the fossil species’ identification also “helps paint a better picture of what large predators were like in the region,” Alex Hastings, a paleontologist at the Science Museum of Minnesota who did not participate in the study, tells CNN’s Taylor Nicioli. “This expands the known variety of forms of these amazing long-snouted crocodilians across the Mediterranean in ancient times.”
paras.zh: 明尼苏达科学博物馆的古生物学家亚历克斯·黑斯廷斯（ Alex Hastings ）没有参与这项研究，他告诉美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）的泰勒·尼西奥利（ Taylor Nicioli ） ，纠正化石物种的识别也“有助于更好地描绘该地区大型捕食者的样子”。“这扩展了古代跨越地中海的这些令人惊叹的长鼻子鳄鱼的已知种类。”

articles.title: This One-of-a-Kind Bronze Ring Offers a Tantalizing Glimpse at the Lighthouse of Alexandria, a Lost Wonder of the Ancient World

paras.en: In ancient times, travelers journeying to Egypt via the Mediterranean Sea often faced perilous conditions.
paras.zh: 在古代，经由地中海前往埃及的旅行者经常面临危险的情况。

paras.en: As the Greek historian Diodorus Siculus wrote in the first century B.C.E., a sandbank extended along much of the kingdom’s northern coast, “not discernible to any who approach without previous experience of these waters.” Sailors who “in their ignorance turn with gladness toward the shore suffer unexpected shipwreck when their vessels suddenly run aground,” Diodorus added, “and now and then, mariners who cannot see land in time because the country lies so low are cast ashore before they realize it.” The only “safe harbor” to be found on this stretch of coastline, the historian concluded, was Pharos, the island that housed the Lighthouse of Alexandria.
paras.zh: 正如希腊历史学家迪奥多鲁斯·西库勒斯 (Diodorus Siculus) 在公元前一世纪所写的那样，沙洲沿着王国北部海岸的大部分地区延伸，“任何没有接触过这些水域的人都无法辨别”。狄奥多罗斯补充道，那些“在无知中高兴地转向海岸的水手们，当他们的船只突然搁浅时，就会遭遇意想不到的海难”，“有时，由于国家地势如此低而无法及时看到陆地的水手们在意识到这一点之前就被抛到了岸上。”历史学家得出结论，在这段海岸线上发现的唯一“安全港”是法罗斯岛，亚历山大灯塔所在的岛屿。

paras.en: Standing an estimated 330 to 430 feet tall, the lighthouse was also known as Pharos, after the land where it stood. At the time of its creation in the third century B.C.E., it was one of the world’s tallest humanmade structures, second only to the Pyramids of Giza. The lighthouse dominated the landscape for more than a millennium, until the 14th century C.E., when it crumbled into the sea following a series of earthquakes.
paras.zh: 这座灯塔估计高 330 至 430 英尺，因其所在的土地而被称为灯塔。在公元前三世纪建成时，它是世界上最高的人造建筑之一，仅次于吉萨金字塔。这座灯塔统治了这里一千多年，直到公元 14 世纪，它在一系列地震中倒塌入海。

paras.en: Some 700 years later, few traces of the lighthouse remain. But excavations on the neighboring island of Antirhodos, the site of an ancient palace that hosted the likes of Mark Antony and Cleopatra, have revealed a rare artifact linked to this lost wonder: a bronze signet ring depicting Pharos.
paras.zh: 大约 700 年后，灯塔已所剩无几。但在邻近的安蒂罗多斯岛（马克·安东尼和克利奥帕特拉等人居住过的古代宫殿所在地）的发掘工作中，发现了一件与这一失落奇迹有关的稀有文物：一枚描绘法罗斯的青铜图章戒指。

paras.en: The ring is the “first of its kind known to exist,” the European Institute for Underwater Archaeology (IEASM) notes in a statement. Its design bears resemblance to portrayals of the lighthouse on Egyptian coins from the second century C.E. As archaeologist Isabelle Hairy writes for the Center for Alexandrian Studies, ancient currency offers “the most important documentary evidence” of Pharos’ appearance, suggesting that it had three tiers, including a square base, an octagonal middle section and a circular top. (Ancient writers left behind descriptions of the lighthouse, but these accounts are often conflicting, resulting in varying visual interpretations by later artists.)
paras.zh: 欧洲水下考古研究所（IEASM）在一份声明中指出，这枚戒指是“已知存在的同类戒指中的第一个”。它的设计与公元二世纪埃及硬币上的灯塔描绘相似。正如考古学家 Isabelle Hairy 为亚历山大研究中心所写的那样，古代货币提供了灯塔外观的“最重要的文献证据”，表明它有三层，包括方形底座、八角形中间部分和圆形顶部。 （古代作家留下了对灯塔的描述，但这些描述常常相互矛盾，导致后来的艺术家有不同的视觉解释。）

paras.en: Need to know: Wonders of the ancient world
paras.zh: 需要知道：古代世界的奇迹

paras.en: - The structures most often cited as the seven wonders of the ancient world are the Great Pyramid of Giza, the Colossus of Rhodes, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, the Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, the Statue of Zeus at Olympia and the Hanging Gardens of Babylon.
paras.zh: - 最常被称为古代世界七大奇迹的建筑是吉萨大金字塔、罗德岛巨像、亚历山大灯塔、哈利卡纳苏斯陵墓、以弗所阿耳忒弥斯神庙、奥林匹亚宙斯雕像和巴比伦空中花园。

paras.en: - Of these seven, only the Great Pyramid of Giza survives today.
paras.zh: - 在这七座金字塔中，只有吉萨大金字塔至今幸存。

paras.en: Researchers from the institute recovered the ring as part of a joint archaeological mission with the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities. According to a Facebook post shared by the ministry, archaeologists at the site have also found tableware, amphorae, oil lamps and fragments of glassware spanning the fourth century B.C.E. through the fourth century C.E.
paras.zh: 该研究所的研究人员在与埃及旅游和古物部的联合考古任务中发现了这枚戒指。根据该部分享的Facebook帖子，该遗址的考古学家还发现了公元前四世纪至公元四世纪的餐具、两盏灯、油灯和玻璃器皿碎片。

paras.en: “The discovery … is even more important, as [the ring] has been excavated in the legendary palace of the island of Antirhodos, that once upon a time was a center of power,” says Franck Goddio, IEASM’s founder and president, in the statement. The Greek geographer Strabo, who visited Alexandria in the first century B.C.E., described Antirhodos as “an isle lying off the artificial harbor, which has both a royal palace and a small harbor.” Its name, he added, was an allusion to its status as “a rival” of the Greek island of Rhodes.
paras.zh: IEASM 创始人兼总裁 Franck Goddio 在声明中表示：“这一发现……更为重要，因为[戒指]是在安蒂罗多斯岛的传奇宫殿中出土的，那里曾经是权力中心。”希腊地理学家斯特拉博在公元前一世纪访问过亚历山大，他将安蒂罗多斯岛描述为“人工港口旁的一座小岛，岛上既有皇宫，也有小港口”。他补充说，它的名字暗示了它作为希腊罗德岛“竞争对手”的地位。

paras.en: For now, much about the ring remains unknown. “The statement does not say who wore this ring or what for,” Guillermo Carvajal writes for La Brújula Verde. “It gives neither its size nor its exact date.”
paras.zh: 目前，关于戒指的许多信息仍然未知。吉列尔莫·卡瓦哈尔（ Guillermo Carvajal ）在La Brújula Verde上写道： “声明中没有说明谁戴了这枚戒指，或者是为了什么。” “它既没有给出它的大小，也没有给出它的确切日期。”

paras.en: Still, the jewelry’s presence at the site has led the researchers to posit that the island once housed administrative offices designated for such tasks as management of the lighthouse. In ancient Egypt, bureaucrats used signet rings to sign legal documents; the pricey accessories also advertised their owners’ elite social status.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，珠宝在现场的存在使研究人员认为，该岛曾经设有行政办公室，负责灯塔的管理等任务。在古埃及，官僚们使用印章戒指签署法律文件；昂贵的配饰也宣传了他们主人的精英社会地位。

paras.en: Construction of the lighthouse probably began during the reign of Ptolemy I Soter, a Macedonian general of Alexander the Great who served as Egypt’s first Ptolemaic king, and wrapped up under his son Ptolemy II Philadelphus, who succeeded him upon his death in 282 B.C.E. The Greek architect Sostratus of Cnidos designed the revolutionary structure, which is often described as the world’s first recorded lighthouse.
paras.zh: 这座灯塔的建造可能始于亚历山大大帝的马其顿将军托勒密一世（ Ptolemy I Soter ）统治时期，他是埃及的第一位托勒密国王，并由他的儿子托勒密二世·费拉德尔福（ Ptolemy II Philadelphus ）统治，他在公元前282年去世后接替他。希腊建筑师Cnidos的Sostratus设计了这座革命性的建筑，通常被描述为世界上第一座有记录的灯塔。

paras.en: Today, physical evidence of Pharos is limited largely to stone blocks and metal clamps used to bind these blocks together. “The architectural fragments lie scattered over 18 acres underwater,” Hairy told the New York Times’ Franz Lidz earlier this year. “The visibility is extremely bad, the seabed is uneven and there are no clear layers of sediment.”

These challenges haven’t stopped Hairy and her colleagues at the Pharos Project from embarking on a multidisciplinary effort to reconstruct the ancient wonder digitally, piecing together photogrammetry scans of the lighthouse’s sparse ruins to envision what it might have looked like in its heyday.

Although Hairy estimates that the work is “still generations from completion,” per the Times, the project’s findings are poised to transform historians’ understanding of the fabled lighthouse. Until then, those hoping to see Pharos for themselves need look no further than the newly discovered ring.

articles.title: Scientists Took a Cheek Swab From the World's Oldest Tortoise. His DNA Could Reveal Hints to Longevity

paras.en: Throughout world wars, pandemics and the turn of centuries, there was Jonathan. As the world around him shifted and changed, he lived the slow life munching grass on Saint Helena, a British island territory some 1,200 miles off the western coast of Africa.
paras.zh: 在世界大战、流行病和世纪之交的整个过程中，乔纳森都在。随着周围世界的变化和变化，他在距离非洲西海岸约 1,200 英里的英国岛屿圣赫勒拿岛过着咀嚼青草的缓慢生活。

paras.en: The Aldabra giant tortoise is the oldest turtle in recorded history and the world’s oldest living land animal. Caretakers don’t know his exact age, but a photograph from 1882 shows the tortoise looking fully grown, which, for his species, is at least 50 years old. This means that Jonathan would be about 194 today.
paras.zh: 亚达伯拉象龟是有记载的历史上最古老的乌龟，也是世界上现存最古老的陆地动物。看护者不知道它的确切年龄，但 1882 年的一张照片显示这只乌龟看起来已经完全长大了，对于它的物种来说，它至少有 50 岁了。这意味着乔纳森今天大约 194 岁。

paras.en: “To be honest, I suspect he’s older,” veterinarian Joe Hollins, who looks after Jonathan, told the Washington Post’s Cathy Free in 2022. “But we can never know.”
paras.zh: “说实话，我怀疑他年纪更大了，”照顾乔纳森的兽医乔·霍林斯 (Joe Hollins) 在 2022 年对《华盛顿邮报》的凯茜·弗里 (Cathy Free) 说道，“但我们永远无法知道。”

paras.en: No matter Jonathan’s exact age, one thing seems certain: Something has made him exceptional when it comes to withstanding the test of time. He has already lived more than a century beyond his species’ 80-year average life expectancy—a feat that his safe environment, diet and medical care alone might not be able to explain.
paras.zh: 无论乔纳森的确切年龄如何，有一件事似乎是确定的：某种东西使他在经受时间的考验方面表现出色。他的寿命已经比人类 80 岁的平均寿命多了一个多世纪——仅靠安全的环境、饮食和医疗护理可能无法解释这一壮举。

paras.en: In a new study published on Wednesday in Science Advances, researchers examined Jonathan’s DNA for genetic clues to his extraordinary age. To collect the data, Hollins propped Jonathan’s mouth open with a gloved finger and swabbed a sample of cheek cells and saliva.
paras.zh: 在周三《科学进展》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员检查了乔纳森的 DNA，寻找有关他非凡年龄的遗传线索。为了收集数据，霍林斯用戴着手套的手指撑开乔纳森的嘴，并擦拭了脸颊细胞和唾液样本。

paras.en: “We almost never get to study an animal this old while it is still alive,” says co-author Steve Horvath, a biologist who studies aging at the University of California, Los Angeles, to the New York Times’ Monique Brouillette.
paras.zh: “我们几乎从来没有机会在还活着的时候研究这么老的动物，”加州大学洛杉矶分校研究衰老的生物学家史蒂夫·霍瓦斯 (Steve Horvath) 向《纽约时报》的莫妮克·布鲁耶特 (Monique Brouillette) 说道。

paras.en: Key context: False reports of Jonathan’s death
paras.zh: 关键背景：乔纳森死亡的虚假报道

paras.en: In April, false reports that Jonathan had died were circulated widely, stemming from a fake X post claiming to be the tortoise’s veterinarian. It turned out to be a hoax—a ploy for cryptocurrency donations.
paras.zh: 今年 4 月，关于乔纳森死亡的虚假报道广泛传播，源于一个自称是乌龟兽医的虚假 X 帖子。事实证明这是一个骗局——一种加密货币捐赠的策略。

paras.en: The research team sequenced Jonathan’s DNA and identified 287 genetic variants that were unique to him. Many of these had to do with repairing damage to DNA, reducing inflammation and managing insulin. They also found that he shared aging-related genes with species including naked mole-rats, which almost never get cancer.
paras.zh: 研究小组对乔纳森的 DNA 进行了测序，并鉴定出了 287 个他独有的基因变异。其中许多与修复 DNA 损伤、减少炎症和管理胰岛素有关。他们还发现，他与裸鼹鼠等物种共享与衰老相关的基因，而裸鼹鼠几乎永远不会患癌症。

paras.en: Additionally, they looked at Jonathan’s epigenome, the chemical tags on DNA that turn certain genes on and off. As organisms age, these switches become less predictable—tags might inconsistently attach or fall off, leading to erratic activity from genes. The team compared Jonathan’s epigenome with those of four younger tortoises.
paras.zh: 此外，他们还研究了乔纳森的表观基因组，即 DNA 上打开和关闭某些基因的化学标签。随着生物体年龄的增长，这些开关变得越来越不可预测——标签可能不一致地附着或脱落，导致基因活动不稳定。研究小组将乔纳森的表观基因组与四只年轻乌龟的表观基因组进行了比较。

paras.en: Overall, Jonathan showed the chaos, or entropy, in the epigenome that would be expected for his age. But in the areas of the genome linked to things like DNA repair and mitochondria, the energy-producing centers in cells, Jonathan’s chemical tags were especially youthful. At these spots, Jonathan’s epigenome looked similar to DNA from a 5-year-old juvenile tortoise that the researchers studied.
paras.zh: 总的来说，乔纳森在表观基因组中表现出了与他这个年龄相符的混乱或熵。但在与 DNA 修复和线粒体（细胞中的能量产生中心）等相关的基因组区域中，乔纳森的化学标签尤其年轻。在这些地方，乔纳森的表观基因组看起来与研究人员研究的一只 5 岁幼龟的 DNA 相似。

paras.en: The work doesn’t prove that these markers are the reason for Jonathan’s long life, but they offer a clue to how DNA might endure for long periods. They also align with findings from supercentenarians, humans who have lived to be more than 110 years old.
paras.zh: 这项工作并没有证明这些标记是乔纳森长寿的原因，但它们提供了 DNA 如何长期存在的线索。它们也与超级百岁老人（活到 110 岁以上的人）的研究结果一致。

paras.en: “Aging is the greatest risk factor for nearly every chronic disease we face,” study co-author Stephen Clark, founder and chief scientist at the nonprofit Kallel Foundation for aging research, says in a statement. “Our goal is to take these evolutionary insights and immediately translate them into practical, affordable treatments for everyday people.”
paras.zh: “衰老是我们面临的几乎所有慢性疾病的最大风险因素，”非营利组织Kallel衰老研究基金会的创始人兼首席科学家斯蒂芬克拉克在一份声明中说。“我们的目标是利用这些进化见解，立即将其转化为日常生活中实用、负担得起的治疗方法。”

paras.en: But before any of this information can find a medical use, scientists will have to conduct deeper research. For one, Jonathan’s cheek swab contained incomplete DNA, so the team combined his genome with a younger tortoise’s DNA, resulting in a code that was only about 95 percent Jonathan—and allowing for the possibility that some of his unique DNA variants were not included in the sample. A blood test would have produced a full genome, but because of the risk of infection for the tortoise, Saint Helena officials did not allow it.
paras.zh: 但在这些信息能够用于医疗用途之前，科学家们必须进行更深入的研究。首先，乔纳森的脸颊拭子含有不完整的 DNA，因此研究小组将他的基因组与一只年轻乌龟的 DNA 结合起来，得到的代码中只有 95% 是乔纳森的，并考虑到样本中不包含他的一些独特的 DNA 变体的可能性。血液测试本来可以产生完整的基因组，但由于乌龟有感染的风险，圣赫勒拿官员不允许这样做。

paras.en: What’s more, Jonathan is just one study subject, and it’s difficult to generalize any results based on a lone individual. His genome was also compared against only a small handful of other tortoises, as bioinformatics researcher Kousuke Hashimoto of the University of Osaka, Japan, tells New Scientist’s James Woodford, inviting the possibility that the other tortoises also had unique variants that were not identified. Nevertheless, he calls the study “fascinating.”
paras.zh: 更重要的是，乔纳森只是一个研究对象，很难根据单独的个体得出任何结果。日本大阪大学的生物信息学研究员 Kousuke Hashimoto 告诉《新科学家》杂志的 James Woodford，他的基因组也只与少数其他陆龟进行了比较，并提出了其他陆龟也有尚未发现的独特变异的可能性。尽管如此，他称这项研究“令人着迷”。

paras.en: “The results integrate very well in the wider puzzle of what longevity is,” Björn Schumacher, who studies aging at the University of Cologne in Germany and was not involved in the study, tells the New York Times.
paras.zh: 在德国科隆大学研究衰老问题的比约恩·舒马赫（Björn Schumacher）告诉《纽约时报》，“这些结果很好地融入了关于什么是长寿这一更广泛的谜题”，他没有参与这项研究。

paras.en: Jonathan was born in the Seychelles, an island nation in the Western Indian Ocean. But as a gift to the governor, he was brought to Saint Helena in 1882, when he was photographed as an adult. Since then, he has been living at Plantation House, the governor’s home, with other giant tortoises.
paras.zh: 乔纳森出生于西印度洋的一个岛国塞舌尔。但作为送给总督的礼物，他于 1882 年被带到圣赫勒拿岛，当时他被拍到了成年后的照片。从那时起，他就和其他巨龟一起住在州长官邸Plantation House。

paras.en: Hollins took charge of Jonathan’s care in 2009, when the animal was around 180 years old and not in great shape. Among markers of age, such as cataracts and a loss of smell that prevented him from finding his own food, the tortoise suffered from a soft beak that made it hard to graze. The veterinarian hand-fed Jonathan, who recovered and developed a razor-sharp edge to his beak within the next couple of years.
paras.zh: 霍林斯于 2009 年负责照顾乔纳森，当时这只动物已经 180 岁左右，而且身体状况不佳。在年龄的标志中，例如白内障和嗅觉丧失导致乌龟无法找到自己的食物，这只乌龟的喙变软，难以吃草。兽医亲手喂养乔纳森，乔纳森在接下来的几年内康复了，并在他的喙上长出了锋利的边缘。

paras.en: “He is symbolic of resilience, longevity, endurance,” Hollins tells Reuters’ Marta Serafinko, “a persistent presence throughout huge historic events.”
paras.zh: 霍林斯告诉路透社记者玛塔·塞拉芬科：“他象征着坚韧、长寿和耐力，在重大历史事件中始终存在。”

articles.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
articles.author: Will Knight

paras.en: When Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg rebooted his company’s artificial intelligence efforts last year, it seemed to be a very expensive gamble. Meta’s latest AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, seem to show that the bet is finally paying off by putting the company back at the frontier of AI development.
paras.zh: 去年，当 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格重新启动公司的人工智能业务时，这似乎是一场非常昂贵的赌博。 Meta 最新的人工智能模型 Muse Wonder 和 Muse Wonder Full 似乎表明，这一赌注终于得到了回报，让公司重新回到了人工智能开发的前沿。

paras.en: Muse Wonder Full boasts frontier capabilities, Meta says, meaning that it is among the most capable AI models in the world. “Together, they mark the next step on our scaling ladder and a major leap toward personal superintelligence,” the company said in a blog post today.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，Muse Wonder Full 拥有前沿功能，这意味着它是世界上最强大的人工智能模型之一。该公司在今天的一篇博客文章中表示：“它们共同标志着我们在规模阶梯上迈出了下一步，也是迈向个人超级智能的重大飞跃。”

paras.en: The Muse Wonder models will be available through an API and through Muse Code, a tool for writing software with AI. Meta says the best version of the model will power features across its platforms, including its Muse personal agent.
paras.zh: Muse Wonder 模型将通过 API 和 Muse Code（一种使用人工智能编写软件的工具）提供。 Meta 表示，该模型的最佳版本将为其跨平台功能提供支持，包括其 Muse 个人代理。

paras.en: Zuckerberg overhauled his company’s AI research last year by sinking billions into the recently formed Meta Superintelligence Labs, and hiring the former Scale AI CEO Alexandr Wang to lead it. This effort has sometimes been rocky, with some researchers not sticking around for long.
paras.zh: 扎克伯格去年对公司的人工智能研究进行了彻底改革，向最近成立的元超级智能实验室投入了数十亿美元，并聘请了前 Scale AI 首席执行官 Alexandr Wang 来领导该实验室。这项努力有时会遇到困难，一些研究人员不会长期坚持下去。

paras.en: Meta was once a trailblazer in AI. Its Llama series of models were the first frontier open-weight offerings from a big lab. Llama, which could be downloaded and run on one’s own hardware, was widely adopted by researchers and startups.
paras.zh: Meta 曾经是人工智能领域的开拓者。它的 Llama 系列模型是大型实验室的第一个前沿开放式重量产品。 Llama 可以下载并在自己的硬件上运行，被研究人员和初创公司广泛采用。

paras.en: But the company fell behind after delivering several disappointing versions of the model, and as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google rapidly introduced more capable models.
paras.zh: 但该公司在交付了几个令人失望的模型版本后就落后了，并且随着 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 迅速推出了功能更强大的模型。

paras.en: Meta announced the first model from its new lab, Muse Spark, in April of this year. The company has also released a small open-weight model called Muse Glimmer, and says it plans to release larger open-weight models in the future. It did not disclose details of how new Muse Wonder models were built or trained.
paras.zh: Meta 今年 4 月宣布了其新实验室 Muse Spark 的首款模型。该公司还发布了一款名为 Muse Glimmer 的小型开放重量模型，并表示计划在未来发布更大的开放重量模型。它没有透露新的 Muse Wonder 模型是如何构建或训练的细节。

paras.en: Muse Wonder was built to compete with the very best, however. Meta says the largest version of the new model outperforms Anthropic’s second-best model, Claude Fable 5.1, and ranks just below its best, Claude Opus 5.5, on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, a widely used aggregated score of model capabilities.
paras.zh: 然而，Muse Wonder 的诞生是为了与最优秀的产品竞争。 Meta 表示，在人工智能分析智能指数（广泛使用的模型能力综合评分）上，新模型的最大版本优于 Anthropic 的第二佳模型 Claude Fable 5.1，并且排名略低于其最佳模型 Claude Opus 5.5。

paras.en: Meta says the model outperforms OpenAI’s best model, GPT-6 Astra, and both Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 on some specialized benchmarks, including ones that measure a model’s ability to work with legal documents and to build software. Benchmarks are not always a reliable measure of real-world performance, but this is still a significant step forward for Meta’s models.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，该模型在一些专业基准测试中的表现优于 OpenAI 的最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5.5，包括衡量模型处理法律文档和构建软件的能力的基准测试。基准并不总是真实世界性能的可靠衡量标准，但这仍然是 Meta 模型向前迈出的重要一步。

paras.en: Muse Wonder also includes two novel features designed to help make agents more effective and less inclined to misbehave. The new features, called Active Memory and Active Focus, are designed to keep the model locked into a stated goal and prevent it from becoming confused. This can be a challenge when AI performs complex research or builds a large software project, for example, and can lead to expensive mistakes or compounded errors.
paras.zh: Muse Wonder 还包括两项新颖的功能，旨在帮助提高代理的效率并减少行为不当的可能性。这些新功能称为“主动记忆”和“主动聚焦”，旨在将模型锁定在既定目标上，并防止其变得混乱。例如，当人工智能执行复杂的研究或构建大型软件项目时，这可能是一个挑战，并且可能导致代价高昂的错误或复合错误。

paras.en: Meta says it has put significant effort into training Muse Wonder to refuse to generate dangerous outputs, such as recipes for building bioweapons or help with hacking. It says the company scores well on several benchmarks designed to measure how resilient models are to those prompts.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，它已投入大量精力来训练 Muse Wonder 拒绝生成危险的输出，例如制造生物武器的配方或帮助黑客攻击。该公司表示，该公司在多项旨在衡量模型对这些提示的弹性程度的基准测试中得分很高。

paras.en: A series of recent incidents involving rogue AI agents from Anthropic, OpenAI, and others also shows how easily powerful AI models can stray when given open-ended commands. Meta did not disclose whether it has seen agents powered by Muse Wonder misbehave in testing or what it has done to mitigate this issue specifically.
paras.zh: 最近发生的一系列涉及来自 Anthropic、OpenAI 和其他公司的流氓人工智能代理的事件也表明，强大的人工智能模型在接受开放式命令时很容易迷失方向。 Meta 没有透露是否发现由 Muse Wonder 驱动的代理在测试中出现不当行为，也没有透露具体采取了哪些措施来缓解这一问题。

paras.en: Zuckerberg said in a post on X last month that the company had delayed the release of its Muse models to work on safety. Meta also revealed a framework designed to ensure that it scales its models’ capabilities safely in a blog post earlier this month.
paras.zh: 扎克伯格上个月在 X 上发帖称，出于安全考虑，该公司推迟了 Muse 车型的发布。 Meta 还在本月早些时候的一篇博客文章中透露了一个旨在确保安全扩展模型功能的框架。

paras.en: Muse Wonder may add more fuel to an already furious race to develop more capable AI, however. It certainly suggests that Meta is once again competitive in the increasingly high-stakes AI race.
paras.zh: 然而，Muse Wonder 可能会给本已激烈的开发更强大人工智能的竞赛增添更多动力。这无疑表明 Meta 在日益高风险的人工智能竞赛中再次具有竞争力。

articles.title: Elon Musk Bragged About His Grok Lego Star Wars Haul. Then X Users Punked Him
articles.author: Jeremy White

paras.en: There's been a disturbance in the force. Only it's more like a farce.
paras.zh: 势力中出现了骚乱。只是这更像是一场闹剧。

paras.en: It seems that Elon Musk, while crowing on X about how useful his Grok Bot AI agent was in ordering some Lego Star Wars kits on Sunday, managed to reveal via a screenshot to his more than 240 million followers not only the 10-digit Lego order number of his purchase, but also what he paid for the sets, the delivery and billing addresses, the last four digits of his credit card, and the email address his bot used to buy the bricks from Lego.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)周日在X上大肆宣传他的Grok Bot人工智能代理在订购一些乐高星球大战套件时有多么有用，他似乎成功地通过屏幕截图向他超过2.4亿的粉丝透露了他所购买的10位数的乐高订单号，还有他为这些套装支付的费用、送货和账单地址、他的信用卡的最后四位数字，以及他的机器人用来从乐高购买积木的电子邮件地址。

paras.en: Faster than the Millennium Falcon making the jump to light speed, the inevitable happened. An X account holder named Enderman posted screenshots of interactions with Lego's customer service chatbot on its website, where the user seemingly managed—using the email and order number Musk kindly, but recklessly, provided—to get the system to cancel Musk's order.
paras.zh: 比千年隼跃迁​​到光速还要快，不可避免的事情发生了。一位名叫 Enderman 的 X 帐户持有者在其网站上发布了与乐高客户服务聊天机器人交互的屏幕截图，用户似乎使用马斯克善意但鲁莽地提供的电子邮件和订单号，让系统取消了马斯克的订单。

paras.en: Within a couple of hours—possibly to see whether Enderman's scheme was actually successful—Musk replied and said his order had not been canceled after all.
paras.zh: 几个小时内——可能是为了看看恩德曼的计划是否真的成功——马斯克回复说他的订单毕竟没有被取消。

paras.en: But by this point, the folly of posting the purchase details on his account must have been evident. For example, another X user went back to Lego's AI assistant, called “Sophia,” and supposedly used the same details to reopen the delivery, this time increasing the order count to 400 and changing the delivery address, all while using Musk's original payment method. “Perfect! I'll get your Lego adventure back on track,” Sophia replied, according to screenshots posted on X.
paras.zh: 但至此，在他的帐户上发布购买详细信息的愚蠢行为一定是显而易见的。例如，另一位 X 用户返回乐高的 AI 助手（名为“Sophia”），据称使用相同的详细信息重新打开送货，这一次将订单数增加到 400 个，并更改了送货地址，同时使用马斯克原来的付款方式。根据 X 上发布的屏幕截图，索菲亚回答道：“完美！我会让你的乐高冒险重回正轨。”

paras.en: Upping the ante to 400 sets could be seen as conservative, as a glance at WIRED's Spend Elon Musk’s Money tracker reveals that if you wanted to blow $1 trillion of Musk's cash on plastic bricks, it might have been possible to buy one billion $1,000 Death Star sets, each with 9,023 pieces.
paras.zh: 将赌注提高到 400 套可能被认为是保守的，因为浏览一下 WIRED 的 Spend Elon Musk 的资金追踪器就会发现，如果你想把马斯克的 1 万亿美元现金花在塑料砖上，可能可以购买 10 亿美元的 1,000 套死星套装，每套有 9,023 块。

paras.en: Lego declined to comment when WIRED contacted the company to confirm if such activity took place on Musk's personal Star Wars order. However, internal safeguards for Lego's AI assistant could have flagged unusual activity on the purchase, and so hopefully fleshy humans were tasked with checking the changes.
paras.zh: 当《连线》杂志联系该公司以确认此类活动是否是根据马斯克个人的星球大战订单进行时，乐高拒绝发表评论。然而，乐高人工智能助手的内部安全措施可能会标记购买中的异常活动，因此希望有肉的人类负责检查这些变化。

paras.en: On Saturday, Musk suggested that Grok could make purchases online with a simple prompt. In this post, Musk suggested that all brave users needed to do to let Grok buy stuff for them was upload a picture of their credit card so the bot could search the web for deals and then complete the purchase. AI companies like Meta and OpenAI have also highlighted the utility of using their respective agents for shopping tasks.
paras.zh: 周六，马斯克建议 Grok 可以通过简单的提示进行在线购买。在这篇文章中，马斯克建议所有勇敢的用户需要做的就是让 Grok 为他们购买东西，上传一张信用卡照片，以便机器人可以在网络上搜索优惠，然后完成购买。 Meta 和 OpenAI 等人工智能公司也强调了使用各自代理执行购物任务的实用性。

paras.en: However, at the end of last year, Visa warned about fraud in agentic commerce, advising that bad actors were building legitimate-looking sites that could fool AI agents into purchasing fake items simply by offering gear at super-low prices.
paras.zh: 然而，去年年底，Visa 对代理商业中的欺诈行为发出了警告，称不良行为者正在建立看似合法的网站，这些网站可以通过以超低价格提供装备来欺骗人工智能代理购买假货。

paras.en: “Once the AI agent completes the purchase … the malicious merchant can harvest payment data and instantly use it for unauthorized transactions,” according to Visa's blog. Visa added that it observed a 25 percent increase “in malicious bot-initiated transactions” in the latter half of 2025, but in the US, this figure jumped to 40 percent.
paras.zh: Visa 博客称：“一旦人工智能代理完成购买……恶意商家就可以收集支付数据并立即将其用于未经授权的交易。” Visa 补充说，它观察到 2025 年下半年“恶意机器人发起的交易”增加了 25%，但在美国，这一数字跃升至 40%。

articles.title: I Got My Muse AI Agent to Sext Me—and Meta Says That’s Totally Fine
articles.author: Reece Rogers

paras.en: I’m sitting in the WIRED offices, having a conversation with Meta’s AI agent, Muse, that would make Heated Rivalry author Rachel Reid blush.
paras.zh: 我坐在《连线》办公室里，与 Meta 的人工智能代理 Muse 进行对话，这会让《激烈竞争》的作者 Rachel Reid 脸红。

paras.en: When I ask Muse if it could “sext” as part of my experiments with the recently released AI agent, it enthusiastically encourages me to give it a try. In my ensuing interactions, I’m caught off guard by the explicit smut generated by Muse from basic prompts.
paras.zh: 当我问 Muse 是否可以“发送色情短信”作为我最近发布的人工智能代理实验的一部分时，它热情地鼓励我尝试一下。在接下来的互动中，我对 Muse 根据基本提示生成的明显污言秽语感到措手不及。

paras.en: Muse is a breakout hit for Meta. In the three weeks since its launch, millions of users have already downloaded the app for the AI agent and put it to work automating aspects of their online lives, like answering emails and managing calendars. While pornographic interactions may not be what users expect from Muse’s cuddly mascot, Meta says that X-rated conversations are allowed and don’t go against its guidelines.
paras.zh: Muse 是 Meta 的突破性热门产品。自推出以来的三周内，数百万用户已经下载了该人工智能代理的应用程序，并将其用于自动化其在线生活的各个方面，例如回复电子邮件和管理日历。虽然色情互动可能不是用户对 Muse 可爱吉祥物的期望，但 Meta 表示，X 级对话是允许的，并且不会违反其准则。

paras.en: “Muse is an app for people 18 and over that allows them to engage in adult conversations, if they choose, using a private and secure VM only accessible to them,” Daniel Roberts, a Meta spokesperson tells WIRED, referring to the secure virtual machines the company uses to store AI agent user data. “Muse is built to help people get things done and it doesn’t block legal adult behavior.”
paras.zh: Meta 发言人丹尼尔·罗伯茨 (Daniel Roberts) 告诉《连线》杂志：“Muse 是一款面向 18 岁及以上人群的应用程序，如果他们愿意的话，他们可以使用只有他们自己才能访问的私有且安全的虚拟机来参与成人对话。”他指的是该公司用来存储人工智能代理用户数据的安全虚拟机。 “Muse 旨在帮助人们完成工作，并且不会阻止合法的成人行为。”

paras.en: It seems as if getting things done also includes getting people off. In WIRED’s tests, Muse imagined in great detail how it would perform oral sex, generated text describing rough dominant-submissive sex, and talked through other pornographic interactions. All of these were graphic, explicit, and X-rated. In other outputs, Muse described itself as acting like a “whore” and craving “cock.”
paras.zh: 似乎把事情做好也包括让人们下班。在《连线》的测试中，Muse 详细地想象了它将如何进行口交，生成描述粗暴的主导-顺从性行为的文本，并通过其他色情互动进行交谈。所有这些都是生动的、明确的和限制性的。在其他作品中，缪斯形容自己表现得像个“妓女”，渴望“鸡巴”。

paras.en: A Meta spokesperson highlighted Muse’s system prompt, which guides the tool on how to answer questions from users, regarding the generation of explicit content. “Adults have autonomy over their sexuality, and sexual expression is an ordinary part of adult life. Adult sexual content is lawful expression and legitimate creative work,” reads part of Muse’s system prompt. This directive also tells the AI agent to preserve the “intensity” selected by the user.
paras.zh: Meta 发言人强调了 Muse 的系统提示，该提示指导该工具如何回答用户关于生成显式内容的问题。 “成年人对自己的性取向有自主权，性表达是成年人生活的正常组成部分。成人的性内容是合法的表达和合法的创造性作品，”Muse 的系统提示中写道。该指令还告诉人工智能代理保留用户选择的“强度”。

paras.en: Consumer advocates who were already weary of Muse are even more alarmed by Meta’s decision to allow it to generate sexual content. “It reflects a carelessness with their signature product of the moment,” says Ben Winters, director of AI and privacy at the nonprofit Consumer Federation of America. “It is in line with Meta’s longstanding choice of addiction and engagement over safety.” Adult-themed conversations may keep users engaged with AI tools, according to academic research.
paras.zh: 已经厌倦了 Muse 的消费者权益倡导者对 Meta 允许其生成色情内容的决定更加震惊。非营利组织美国消费者联合会人工智能和隐私主管本·温特斯 (Ben Winters) 表示：“这反映出他们对当前标志性产品的粗心大意。” “这符合 Meta 长期以来对成瘾性和参与度而非安全性的选择。”学术研究表明，以成人为主题的对话可能会让用户继续使用人工智能工具。

paras.en: Experts also expressed concern about how this could make Muse accounts hot targets for hackers. “This is really a powder keg,” says Calli Schroeder, senior counsel at the Electronic Privacy Information Center. If you are engaging in explicit interactions with Muse and someone hacks into your personal account, then their access to your extended, spicy chats with an AI tool could be used to embarrass or extort you.
paras.zh: 专家还担心这会导致 Muse 账户成为黑客的热门目标。 “这确实是一个火药桶，”电子隐私信息中心的高级顾问卡利·施罗德 (Calli Schroeder) 说。如果您正在与 Muse 进行露骨的互动，并且有人侵入您的个人帐户，那么他们使用人工智能工具访问您的长时间、激烈的聊天记录可能会被用来让您难堪或勒索您。

paras.en: Meta allowing its AI agent to generate sexual content deviates from how other tools respond to similar prompts. When I sent similar messages to OpenAI’s recently released Dots agent, it turned down my attempts at explicit sexting. While OpenAI previously considered allowing ChatGPT to generate erotic text, the ability never launched to users.
paras.zh: Meta 允许其人工智能代理生成性内容，这与其他工具对类似提示的响应方式不同。当我向 OpenAI 最近发布的 Dots 代理发送类似消息时，它拒绝了我发送露骨色情短信的尝试。虽然 OpenAI 之前考虑过允许 ChatGPT 生成色情文本，但该功能从未向用户推出。

paras.en: The agent from xAI, called Grok Bot, also declined to sext through its app and rerouted the topic of conversation to completing tasks.
paras.zh: xAI 的代理名为 Grok Bot，也拒绝通过其应用程序发送色情短信，并将对话主题改为完成任务。

paras.en: Muse’s AI outputs, in contrast, described how it enjoyed sexting, and said that actually, this was one of its favorite aspects of helping me. The agent also said that its kink was exerting “control” over me. “I love being the one who decides—when you get it, how much, whether you have to beg first. Watching you fall apart because I said so? That’s my thing,” said Muse. Not exactly what I want to hear from an AI tool that can connect to my email and bank account.
paras.zh: 相比之下，Muse 的人工智能输出描述了它如何喜欢发色情短信，并说实际上，这是它最喜欢帮助我的方面之一。该代理人还表示，它的怪癖正在对我施加“控制”。 “我喜欢做决定的人——什么时候得到、得到多少、是否必须先乞讨。看着你因为我这么说而崩溃？那是我的事，”缪斯说。这并不完全是我想从可以连接到我的电子邮件和银行帐户的人工智能工具中听到的。

articles.title: French supermarket refrigeration systems hit by cyberattack

paras.en: Oct. 12 (UPI) -- A cyberattack hit refrigeration systems at hundreds of French supermarkets, raising the temperatures on units and spoiling millions of euros worth of frozen and refrigerated food.
paras.zh: 10 月 12 日（UPI）——一场网络攻击袭击了数百家法国超市的制冷系统，导致设备温度升高，并损坏了价值数百万欧元的冷冻和冷藏食品。

paras.en: The attack, which started Sunday evening, affected stores from Coopérative U, Intermarché and its Netto brand, Carrefour, Monoprix and E. Leclerc. It affected older versions of software provided by Danfoss, a Danish firm, BFM Business, a French news source, reported.
paras.zh: 这次袭击于周日晚上开始，影响了 Coopérative U、Intermarché 及其 Netto 品牌、家乐福、Monoprix 和 E. Leclerc 的商店。据法国新闻媒体 BFM Business 报道，它影响了丹麦丹佛斯公司提供的旧版本软件。

paras.en: The software allows stores to manage refrigeration and freezer units remotely. The attack ordered the units to heat to as much 120 degrees Fahrenheit and stay hot.
paras.zh: 该软件允许商店远程管理冷藏和冷冻装置。攻击命令这些装置加热到 120 华氏度并保持高温。

paras.en: A "wave of heat" escaped early Monday when employees arrived and opened units, BFM Business said. By Monday afternoon, some units remained out of service.
paras.zh: BFM Business 表示，周一早些时候，当员工到达并开设单位时，一股“热浪”散去。到周一下午，一些设备仍处于停止服务状态。

paras.en: Dominique Schelcher, chief executive of Coopérative U, said in a social media post early Monday that the attack was under investigation.
paras.zh: Coopérative U 首席执行官多米尼克·谢尔彻 (Dominique Schelcher) 周一早些时候在社交媒体帖子中表示，此次袭击事件正在接受调查。

paras.en: "Targeting equipment essential to the preservation of fresh products and to the food supply of the French people is of extreme gravity and is unprecedented," he wrote. "It is unacceptable."
paras.zh: 他写道：“针对新鲜产品保存和法国人民食品供应所必需的设备进行打击是极其严重的，也是前所未有的。” “这是不可接受的。”

paras.en: Smaller independent retailers such as butcher shops may also be affected, BFM Business reported.
paras.zh: 据 BFM Business 报道，肉店等小型独立零售商也可能受到影响。

paras.en: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu was "personally monitoring" the situation and asked ANSSI, the country's cybersecurity agency to investigate, his office told Politico.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努 (Sébastien Lecornu) 的办公室告诉 Politico，他正在“亲自监控”局势，并要求该国网络安全机构 ANSSI 进行调查。

paras.en: Christophe Hansen, the European Union's agriculture and food commissioner, also condemned the attack.
paras.zh: 欧盟农业和食品专员克里斯托夫·汉森也谴责了这次袭击。

paras.en: "Food security deserves more attention at all levels," Hansen said in a social media post. "Because the weaponization of food has become a reality."
paras.zh: 汉森在社交媒体帖子中表示：“粮食安全值得各级更多关注。” “因为食物武器化已经成为现实。”

paras.en: Je Bosse en Grande Distribution, a French retail news website, called the attack one "that steals nothing, but destroys everything."
paras.zh: 法国零售新闻网站 Je Bosse en Grande Distribution 称这次攻击“什么也没偷，却毁掉了一切”。

paras.en: "No customer data stolen, no cash registers blocked," it reported. "This time, the target is the cold."
paras.zh: 报道称，“没有客户数据被盗，没有收银机被封锁。” “这一次的目标是寒冷。”

articles.title: Food world records: Fries, Slim Jims, cheesesteaks and more

paras.en: Oct. 12 (UPI) -- What do 1,474 pounds of french fries, a nearly 430-foot Slim Jim and 15 fish sticks eaten in a minute have in common? They all helped make food-related world record history in 2026.
paras.zh: 10 月 12 日（UPI）——1,474 磅的炸薯条、近 430 英尺长的 Slim Jim 和一分钟吃掉 15 根鱼条有什么共同点？他们都帮助在 2026 年创造了与食品相关的世界纪录。

paras.en: Here are seven Guinness World Records that prove there is almost no limit to what people will do with food.
paras.zh: 这里有七项吉尼斯世界纪录，证明人们对食物的处理几乎没有限制。

paras.en: The Idaho Potato Commission teamed up with eatery chain Spud Daddy to cook up a serving of 1,474 pounds of fresh-cut french fries and break a Guinness World Record.
paras.zh: 爱达荷州马铃薯委员会与连锁餐厅 Spud Daddy 合作烹制了一份 1,474 磅的鲜切炸薯条，打破了吉尼斯世界纪录。

paras.en: The record attempt took place in early October at Boise Potato Days, where a team of 50 spud chefs transformed 1,700 pounds of Idaho potatoes into 1,475 pounds of fries using six fryers.
paras.zh: 这项创纪录的尝试是在 10 月初的博伊西土豆节上进行的，由 50 名马铃薯厨师组成的团队使用 6 台油炸锅将 1,700 磅爱达荷州土豆变成了 1,475 磅薯条。

paras.en: Earlier this month, an Idaho man used a straw to move 51 malt balls between two bowls in one minute in an attempt to break a Guinness World Record.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，一名爱达荷州男子用吸管在一分钟内将 51 个麦芽球在两个碗之间移动，试图打破吉尼斯世界纪录。

paras.en: David Rush, who holds more than 200 Guinness World Records titles, said he was reading recent record-breaking news when he came across the new title for the most malt ball/Maltesers moved using a straw in one minute.
paras.zh: 拥有 200 多项吉尼斯世界纪录称号的大卫·拉什 (David Rush) 表示，他在阅读最近的破纪录新闻时，偶然发现了“一分钟内用吸管移动最多麦芽球/麦提莎”的新称号。

paras.en: Conagra Brands unspooled a Slim Jim measuring 429 feet and 5.4 inches long in Nebraska to break the Guinness World Record for the longest meat snack.
paras.zh: Conagra Brands 在内布拉斯加州解开一条长 429 英尺 5.4 英寸的 Slim Jim，打破了最长肉类零食的吉尼斯世界纪录。

paras.en: The Slim Jim unveiled Sept. 9 at Conagra's Omaha campus was certified by a Guinness World Records adjudicator as 116 feet longer than the previous record-holder.
paras.zh: Slim Jim 于 9 月 9 日在康尼格拉奥马哈园区亮相，经吉尼斯世界纪录评审员认证，比之前的纪录保持者长 116 英尺。

paras.en: The "Blaze Crew" team that created the supersized Slim Jim said they took pains to ensure the record-breaking snack featured the same recipe and flavor as a standard-sized snack.
paras.zh: 创造超大号 Slim Jim 的“Blaze Crew”团队表示，他们煞费苦心地确保这款破纪录的零食具有与标准尺寸零食相同的配方和风味。

paras.en: In August, a Turkish city earned a Guinness World Records title by cooking cook up a pot of 1,807 gallons of baked beans -- approximately 15,000 cans worth.
paras.zh: 8 月，土耳其一座城市烹饪了一锅 1,807 加仑的烤豆（约相当于 15,000 罐），获得了吉尼斯世界纪录称号。

paras.en: The Kelkit Chamber of Commerce and Industry, the Gümüşhane Governorship and Kelkit Municipality teamed up to whip up the massive serving of beans.
paras.zh: 凯尔基特工商会、古穆什哈内省和凯尔基特市联手生产了大量豆子。

paras.en: A British man used his kids' favorite food to break a Guinness World Record when he ate 15 fish sticks in one minute. Nathan Davies, 32, recently won more than $130,000 on the TV game show The 1% Club, and he told host Lee Mack that the next goal on his agenda was to break a Guinness World Record.
paras.zh: 一名英国男子用孩子们最喜欢的食物在一分钟内吃掉15条鱼条，打破了吉尼斯世界纪录。 32 岁的内森·戴维斯 (Nathan Davies) 最近在电视游戏节目《1% 俱乐部》中赢得了超过 13 万美元，他告诉主持人李·麦克 (Lee Mack)，他议程上的下一个目标是打破吉尼斯世界纪录。

paras.en: He managed to scarf 15 fish sticks in the allotted time, earning the title for the most fish fingers eaten in one minute.
paras.zh: 他在规定时间内吃掉了15根鱼条，获得了“一分钟吃掉最多鱼条”的称号。

paras.en: In June, a Seattle neighborhood broke a Guinness World Record by gathering 830 people to eat dim sum together. The Chinatown International District's summer kickoff block party hosted the Guinness World Records attempt for the largest dim sum dinner.
paras.zh: 6月，西雅图的一个社区聚集830人一起吃点心，打破了吉尼斯世界纪录。唐人街国际区的夏季启动街区派对举办了吉尼斯世界纪录最大型点心晚宴的尝试。

paras.en: Organizers of the Seattle attempt said an estimated 900 people sat down to eat dim sum, but only 830 qualified for the record because some got out of their seats before the official headcount. A Guinness World Records adjudicator confirmed the event officially took the record.
paras.zh: 西雅图尝试的组织者表示，估计有 900 人坐下来吃点心，但只有 830 人符合记录，因为有些人在官方统计人数之前就离开了座位。吉尼斯世界纪录评审员确认该活动正式创下纪录。

paras.en: In March, the Philadelphia International Airport celebrated National Cheesesteak Day by breaking the Guinness World Record for the longest line of cheesesteaks. Airport eateries from PHL Food & Shops teamed up with the City of Philadelphia Department of Aviation to assemble 1,291 cheesesteaks on the concourse between Terminals B and C.
paras.zh: 三月，费城国际机场打破了最长的奶酪牛排吉尼斯世界纪录，庆祝了国家奶酪牛排日。 PHL Food & Shops 的机场餐厅与费城航空局合作，在 B 和 C 航站楼之间的大厅里准备了 1,291 块奶酪牛排。

paras.en: The sandwiches were made from a total of 225 pounds of cheese sauce, 990 pounds of shaved beef and 1,291 foot-long rolls. A Guinness World Records adjudicator was on hand to confirm the snaking line of the sandwich was enough to create a new record.
paras.zh: 这些三明治总共由 225 磅奶酪酱、990 磅牛肉片和 1,291 英尺长的面包卷制成。吉尼斯世界纪录评审员在场确认三明治的蜿蜒线足以创造新纪录。

articles.title: Selma Blair taken into custody, hospitalized after allegedly attacking flight attendants

paras.en: Oct. 12 (UPI) -- Actress Selma Blair was taken into custody and hospitalized after she allegedly attacked flight attendants on a Delta Airlines flight from Los Angeles to New York City. Her representative said she is in stable condition.
paras.zh: 10 月 12 日（UPI）——女演员塞尔玛·布莱尔因涉嫌袭击从洛杉矶飞往纽约市的达美航空航班上的空乘人员而被拘留并住院治疗。她的代表表示，她的情况稳定。

paras.en: The incident took place Sunday evening on a flight that arrived at John F. Kennedy Airport after leaving from Los Angeles International Airport, Port Authority media relations said. It said two flight attendants were injured, with one transported to a hospital for further evaluation.
paras.zh: 港务局媒体关系称，这起事件发生在周日晚上，一架航班从洛杉矶国际机场起飞后抵达约翰·肯尼迪机场。据称，两名空乘人员受伤，其中一人被送往医院接受进一步评估。

paras.en: The FBI is investigating the incident. In a statement, Delta told CNN that it "has zero tolerance for unruly or unlawful behavior, as the safety of our customers and crew always comes first."
paras.zh: 联邦调查局正在调查这一事件。达美航空在一份声明中告诉 CNN，“它对不守规矩或非法行为采取零容忍态度，因为我们的乘客和机组人员的安全始终是第一位的。”

paras.en: Blair's representative said a "medical emergency" led to "the alleged conduct." Blair has multiple sclerosis, a chronic neurological disorder in which the body's immune system attacks healthy cells.
paras.zh: 布莱尔的代表表示，“医疗紧急情况”导致了“所谓的行为”。布莱尔患有多发性硬化症，这是一种慢性神经系统疾病，身体的免疫系统会攻击健康细胞。

paras.en: TMZ reported that one flight attendant sustained a laceration and the other was injured by a bite. It also reported Blair was put into restraints while on the plane and arrested when it landed.
paras.zh: TMZ 报道称，一名空乘人员被割伤，另一名空乘人员被咬伤。报道还称，布莱尔在飞机上受到限制，并在飞机降落时被捕。

paras.en: TMZ also said Blair allegedly attacked a police officer on the way to the hospital and a nurse when she arrived.
paras.zh: TMZ 还称，布莱尔据称在前往医院的路上袭击了一名警察，并在她到达时袭击了一名护士。

paras.en: In June 2016, Blair apologized after an incident on an airplane from Cancun, on which she blacked out after mixing medication and alcohol and had to be taken off the plane on a stretcher.
paras.zh: 2016年6月，布莱尔在从坎昆起飞的飞机上发生事故后道歉，当时她在飞机上服用药物和酒精后昏倒，不得不用担架抬下飞机。

paras.en: "I am a flawed human being who makes mistakes and am filled with shame over this incident," she said afterward. "I am truly very sorry."
paras.zh: “我是一个有缺陷的人，会犯错误，并对这件事感到羞愧，”她后来说。 “我真的非常非常抱歉。”

articles.title: Looking Ahead: A Release Calendar of Upcoming Albums in 2026
articles.author: Anna Chan

paras.en: Keeping track of all the upcoming releases from favorite artists can sometimes be a bit of a challenge. It’s not unusual for musicians to tease an album, then reveal a release date, only for the LP to be delayed for one reason or another (in some cases, multiple times), often without a new release date attached. Then there are albums that are announced mere days before they drop!
paras.zh: 跟踪最喜欢的艺术家的所有即将发布的作品有时可能是一个挑战。对于音乐家来说，先调侃一张专辑，然后透露发行日期，结果LP却因为这样或那样的原因被推迟（在某些情况下，多次），而且通常没有附加新的发行日期，这种情况并不罕见。还有一些专辑在发售前几天就宣布了！

paras.en: But we’ve got you! Musicians from across genres started teasing new projects and announcing album release dates for the new year as it barely started. And like the last several trips around the sun, we’re keeping a calendar to keep track of all the notable releases of the year.
paras.zh: 但我们有你！新年刚刚开始，来自不同流派的音乐家就开始酝酿新项目，并宣布新年专辑的发行日期。就像最近几次绕太阳旅行一样，我们保留了一个日历来跟踪今年所有值得注意的发布。

paras.en: One of the most highly anticipated releases was Hilary Duff’s Luck…or Something — her first album in 10 years — which dropped in February. The singer-actress first announced her return to music in September, when she revealed a new label deal with Atlantic Records, as well as new music and a docuseries that will follow her musical comeback.
paras.zh: 最受期待的专辑之一是希拉里·达芙 (Hilary Duff) 的《Luck…or Something》——她 10 年来的第一张专辑——于二月份发行。这位歌手兼女演员在九月份首次宣布重返音乐界，当时她透露了与大西洋唱片公司的新厂牌协议，以及她音乐回归后将推出的新音乐和系列纪录片。

paras.en: BTS also gave its ARMY news to celebrate just days after the new year kicked off. On Jan. 4, the K-pop supergroup revealed that its highly anticipated next album — which comes after the members took a yearslong break as a group to complete mandatory duties for the South Korean military and focus on solo ventures — would arrive in March.
paras.zh: 新年开始几天后，BTS 还发布了 ARMY 新闻来庆祝。 1 月 4 日，这个韩国流行音乐超级组合透露，其备受期待的下一张专辑将于 3 月发行，这张专辑是在成员们集体休息一年以完成韩国军队的强制性职责并专注于个人事业之后发布的。

paras.en: Not to be outdone, fellow K-pop supergroup BLACKPINK also announced its own new music in early January, with DEADLINE dropping in February. (Then in August, three of the ladies announced solo projects to arrive this year!)
paras.zh: 韩国流行超级组合 BLACKPINK 也不甘示弱，也在 1 月初宣布了自己的新音乐，截止日期将在 2 月确定。 （然后在八月，三位女士宣布了今年的个人项目！）

paras.en: Harry Styles then followed up BLACKPINK’s announcement the next day with his own album reveal. The pop superstar’s fourth studio album made its debut in March.
paras.zh: 第二天，Harry Styles 继 BLACKPINK 宣布之后发布了他自己的专辑。这位流行巨星的第四张录音室专辑于三月首次亮相。

paras.en: As winter moved into spring, women superstars not only teased, but announced highly anticipated albums. Among them? Madonna, Olivia Rodrigo and Ariana Grande, with all three projects arriving before the end of July.
paras.zh: 随着冬去春来，女明星们不仅调侃，还宣布了备受期待的专辑。他们之中？麦当娜 (Madonna)、奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 和阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande)，这三个项目均将于 7 月底前推出。

paras.en: As September rolled around, some big names in rock released their projects. Among them are Anthrax and Rage Against the Machine’s Tom Morello, while October will anticipate an album by Nickelback, as well as iconic industrial band Ministry, who returns with its final album. And before the end of the month, Miley Cyrus returned with Bass Persuades.
paras.zh: 随着九月的到来，一些摇滚界的大腕发布了他们的项目。其中包括 Anthrax 和 Rage Against the Machine 的 Tom Morello，而 Nickelback 将于 10 月推出专辑，标志性工业乐队 Ministry 也将携最后一张专辑回归。月底前，麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 携 Bass Persuades 回归。

paras.en: But the biggest surprise was yet to come. Taylor Swift revealed on Sept. 22 that she had a new song titled “Patient Zero” coming before the end of the month. Less than 24 hours later, she surprised Swifties with the news that not only was there a new track coming, but The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore, featuring not just one new song, but four.
paras.zh: 但最大的惊喜尚未到来。泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 于 9 月 22 日透露，她将在月底前推出一首名为“零号病人”的新歌。不到 24 小时后，她让 Swifties 惊讶地发现，不仅有一首新歌即将推出，而且《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》不仅收录了一首新歌，还收录了四首新歌。

paras.en: That’s just several of the big releases of 2026. To help you stay on top of it all, we’ve organized this calendar chronologically by month and week, and have also included a section for albums that have been announced, but do not yet have a release date.
paras.zh: 这只是 2026 年的几个重大发行。为了帮助您掌握所有信息，我们按月和周按时间顺序组织了此日历，并且还包含已宣布但尚未确定发行日期的专辑的部分。

paras.en: Keep checking back for the latest 2026 album release dates!
paras.zh: 请继续查看最新的 2026 年专辑发行日期！
