paras.zh: Ilayda Edali，iedali@worldspaceweek.org（荷兰）

articles.title: Announcing the finalists for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: The SpaceNews Icon Awards celebrate the year’s most iconic achievements in shaping the future of the space industry. Today, we’re proud to announce the shortlist for 2026 — a selection of individuals, organizations, and missions that exemplify excellence in innovation, exploration and sustainability.
paras.zh: 太空新闻偶像奖旨在表彰今年在塑造航天工业未来方面最具标志性的成就。今天，我们很自豪地宣布 2026 年入围名单，其中包括在创新、探索和可持续发展方面表现卓越的个人、组织和使命。

paras.en: This year’s honorees represent a range of accomplishments — from returning astronauts to the vicinity of the moon and expanding the capacity to run AI on orbit to accelerating the realization of on-orbit servicing and advancing scale through partnerships and acquisitions. These finalists reflect the creativity and ambition propelling today’s growth.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者代表了一系列成就——从让宇航员重返月球附近、扩大在轨道上运行人工智能的能力，到加速实现在轨服务以及通过合作和收购扩大规模。这些决赛入围者反映了推动当今发展的创造力和雄心。

paras.en: Winners will be announced at the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards on Dec. 1 in Washington D.C., where we’ll celebrate their contributions and share the stories behind their successes.
paras.zh: 获奖者名单将于 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖上公布，届时我们将庆祝他们的贡献并分享他们成功背后的故事。

paras.en: Tickets are available now – register by Oct. 31 to take advantage of our early bird rate.
paras.zh: 门票现已发售——请在 10 月 31 日之前注册，以享受我们的早鸟价。

paras.en: Honoring individuals whose leadership and vision have left a lasting impact on the space industry, shaping exploration, national security and commercial growth for generations.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和远见对航天工业产生持久影响、影响几代人的探索、国家安全和商业增长的个人。

paras.en: Mark Dankberg. A satellite communications pioneer who co-founded Viasat and spent decades advancing high-capacity satellite broadband, helping reshape how satellite technology connects consumers, governments and businesses.
paras.zh: 马克·丹克伯格。卫星通信先驱，Viasat 的联合创始人，花费数十年时间推进高容量卫星宽带的发展，帮助重塑卫星技术连接消费者、政府和企业的方式。

paras.en: Jean-Yves Le Gall. One of Europe’s most influential space leaders, with decades of leadership at CNES and Arianespace that helped strengthen Europe’s launch capabilities, international partnerships and position in the global space economy.
paras.zh: 让-伊夫·勒加尔。欧洲最具影响力的太空领导者之一，在法国国家空间研究中心和阿丽亚娜航天公司拥有数十年的领导地位，帮助加强了欧洲的发射能力、国际合作伙伴关系以及在全球太空经济中的地位。

paras.en: Chris Scolese. Capped a career spanning NASA and national security space after nearly seven years as director of the National Reconnaissance Office, where he oversaw a transformation of the agency’s architecture and growing integration of commercial capabilities. Scolese previously served as NASA’s chief engineer and director of Goddard Space Flight Center.
paras.zh: 克里斯·斯科莱斯。在担任国家侦察办公室主任近七年后，他在美国宇航局和国家安全领域的职业生涯结束了，在那里他监督了该机构架构的转型和商业能力的不断整合。斯科莱斯此前曾担任美国宇航局总工程师和戈达德太空飞行中心主任。

paras.en: Karen St. Germain. Helped shape NASA’s Earth science enterprise through senior leadership roles overseeing missions, research and the use of satellite observations to better understand Earth’s climate and environment.
paras.zh: 凯伦·圣日耳曼。通过监督任务、研究和卫星观测使用的高级领导角色，帮助塑造美国宇航局的地球科学事业，以更好地了解地球的气候和环境。

paras.en: Coyote Smith. A longtime military space leader and educator whose career has helped shape thinking about spacepower, national security space strategy and the development of the next generation of space professionals.
paras.zh: 郊狼·史密斯。一位长期的军事太空领导者和教育家，其职业生涯帮助塑造了对太空力量、国家安全太空战略和下一代太空专业人员发展的思考。

paras.en: Recognizing partnerships that bring together organizations and nations to advance space exploration, science and commerce.
paras.zh: 认可将组织和国家聚集在一起推动太空探索、科学和商业的伙伴关系。

paras.en: Clay Mowry. Now chief executive of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA), he has worked across industry, government and professional organizations to build connections within an increasingly international and multidisciplinary space community.
paras.zh: 克莱·莫里。他现任美国航空航天学会 (AIAA) 首席执行官，曾在行业、政府和专业组织中工作，在日益国际化和多学科的太空社区中建立联系。

paras.en: Loft Orbital–Marlan Space. U.S.-French and Emirati capabilities joined in a major international space initiative, including plans for the 50-satellite Altair-Next Gen constellation combining Earth observation, onboard computing and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 阁楼轨道——马兰空间。美国、法国和阿联酋联合参与了一项重大国际太空计划，其中包括由 50 颗卫星组成的 Altair-Next Gen 星座计划，该星座结合了地球观测、机载计算和人工智能。

paras.en: K2 Space–SES. Paired K2 Space’s high-power satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads for meoSphere, a next-generation MEO network beginning with 28 spacecraft and designed to serve commercial and defense customers.
paras.zh: K2 空间——SES。将 K2 Space 的高功率卫星平台与 SES 软件定义的 meoSphere 有效载荷配对，meoSphere 是下一代 MEO 网络，从 28 颗航天器开始，旨在为商业和国防客户提供服务。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. Brought together NASA, ESA, JAXA, France’s CNES, Germany’s Max Planck Institute for Astronomy and institutions across the scientific community to develop a next-generation observatory for studying dark energy, exoplanets and the evolution of the universe. Roman launched Aug. 30, beginning a new chapter in international space science.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜。美国宇航局、欧空局、日本宇宙航空研究开发机构、法国国家空间研究中心、德国马克斯·普朗克天文研究所以及整个科学界的机构聚集在一起，开发下一代天文台，用于研究暗能量、系外行星和宇宙演化。 Roman 于 8 月 30 日发射升空，开启了国际空间科学的新篇章。

paras.en: SMILE. The Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer brought ESA and the Chinese Academy of Sciences together for the first mission jointly designed, implemented, launched and operated by Europe and China. The spacecraft launched May 19 to study the interaction between the solar wind and Earth’s magnetosphere.
paras.zh: 微笑。太阳风磁层电离层链接探测器将欧空局和中国科学院联合起来，执行欧洲和中国联合设计、实施、发射和运营的首次任务。该航天器于 5 月 19 日发射升空，旨在研究太阳风与地球磁层之间的相互作用。

paras.en: Recognizing new or rapidly growing companies driving innovation and opening new markets in the space economy.
paras.zh: 认可在太空经济中推动创新和开辟新市场的新公司或快速成长的公司。

paras.en: Benoît Deper / Aerospacelab. Built Aerospacelab into a rapidly expanding European satellite manufacturer and operator, pursuing vertically integrated spacecraft production and constellation development from Europe and the United States.
paras.zh: 伯努瓦·德佩 / 航空航天实验室。将航空航天实验室打造成一家快速扩张的欧洲卫星制造商和运营商，追求欧洲和美国垂直整合的航天器生产和星座开发。

paras.en: Lux Aeterna. Emerged from stealth with plans to develop reusable satellites capable of returning payloads to Earth, raising $10 million in 2026 as it works toward its first reentry demonstration mission.
paras.zh: 永恒之光。该公司计划开发能够将有效载荷返回地球的可重复使用卫星，并在 2026 年筹集 1000 万美元，以实现首次再入演示任务。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies. Pushed commercial satellite servicing into new territory with LINK, a rapidly developed robotic spacecraft sent to attempt the rescue of NASA’s Swift observatory, while expanding into GEO servicing, deorbiting and other robotic space operations.
paras.zh: 催化剂空间技术。 LINK 是一种快速开发的机器人航天器，被派去尝试救援 NASA 的雨燕天文台，将商业卫星服务推向新领域，同时扩展到 GEO 服务、离轨和其他机器人太空操作。

paras.en: Skyroot Aerospace. Advanced India’s growing private launch sector with Vikram-1, India’s first privately developed orbital-class launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 天根航空航天公司。 Vikram-1 是印度第一个私人开发的轨道级运载火箭，推动印度不断发展的私人发射领域。

paras.en: Recognizing technologies that push the boundaries of engineering and create new capabilities for space operations.
paras.zh: 认识到突破工程界限并为太空作战创造新能力的技术。

paras.en: Cailabs. Advanced laser communications from individual optical ground stations toward shared infrastructure, launching an optical-ground-station-as-a-service model with plans for an international network of roughly 15 stations.
paras.zh: 凯拉布斯。从单个光学地面站到共享基础设施的先进激光通信，推出了光学地面站即服务模型，并计划建立一个由大约 15 个站组成的国际网络。

paras.en: D-Orbit. Continued expanding the capabilities of its ION orbital transfer vehicle beyond satellite deployment into hosted payloads, orbital transportation, cloud computing and other in-space logistics services.
paras.zh: D 轨道。继续将 ION 轨道传输飞行器的功能扩展到卫星部署之外，扩展到托管有效载荷、轨道运输、云计算和其他太空物流服务。

paras.en: Xona Space Systems. Advanced a commercial alternative to traditional GPS with Pulsar, a low Earth orbit positioning, navigation and timing architecture designed to provide more precise, resilient navigation services from a new generation of satellites.
paras.zh: 希纳空间系统公司。 Pulsar 是一种低地球轨道定位、导航和授时架构，旨在通过新一代卫星提供更精确、更有弹性的导航服务，从而推出传统 GPS 的商业替代品。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals whose leadership and innovation have set new benchmarks for excellence and inspired progress across the space community.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和创新能力为卓越树立新基准并激励整个航天界进步的个人。

paras.en: Steve Altemus, Intuitive Machines. Continued expanding Intuitive Machines from lunar transportation into a broader space infrastructure company, including the $800 million acquisition of Lanteris Space Systems and investments in communications, navigation and data services.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·阿尔特穆斯，《直觉机器》。继续将 Intuitive Machines 从月球运输扩展到更广泛的空间基础设施公司，包括以 8 亿美元收购 Lanteris Space Systems 以及对通信、导航和数据服务的投资。

paras.en: Ian Cinnamon, Apex. Helped establish a new model for satellite manufacturing at Apex, emphasizing standardized spacecraft platforms, faster production and an approach designed to bring mass-production economics to the satellite industry.
paras.zh: 伊恩·肉桂，Apex。帮助 Apex 建立卫星制造的新模式，强调标准化航天器平台、更快的生产以及旨在为卫星行业带来大规模生产经济效益的方法。

paras.en: Rafal Modrzewski, ICEYE. Led ICEYE’s continued expansion of the world’s largest commercial synthetic aperture radar satellite fleet, combining commercial services with increasingly important sovereign intelligence capabilities for governments around the world.
paras.zh: 拉法尔·莫杰夫斯基，ICEYE。领导 ICEYE 持续扩大全球最大的商业合成孔径雷达卫星群，将商业服务与对世界各国政府日益重要的主权情报能力结合起来。

paras.en: Shey Sabripour, CesiumAstro. Built CesiumAstro around advanced active phased-array communications technology, helping move high-throughput, software-defined connectivity from a promising technology toward operational space systems.
paras.zh: Shey Saripour，CesiumAstro。围绕先进的有源相控阵通信技术构建 CesiumAstro，帮助将高吞吐量、软件定义的连接从有前景的技术转向可操作的空间系统。

paras.en: Recognizing transactions and investments that reshape markets, create new competitors or alter the trajectory of the space industry.
paras.zh: 认可重塑市场、创造新竞争对手或改变航天工业轨迹的交易和投资。

paras.en: AE Industrial Partners–Rocketdyne. AE Industrial agreed to acquire a controlling interest in L3Harris’ Space Propulsion and Power Systems business, reviving the Rocketdyne name for a company whose propulsion heritage stretches back more than six decades.
paras.zh: AE 工业合作伙伴——Rocketdyne。 AE Industrial 同意收购 L3Harris 太空推进和动力系统业务的控股权，从而为一家其推进历史可追溯至六十多年前的公司重新启用 Rocketdyne 名称。

paras.en: EQT–Exolaunch. EQT agreed to acquire Exolaunch, giving the previously self-funded German launch integration and deployment company its first outside investment and resources to expand internationally and develop new services.
paras.zh: EQT-Exolaunch。 EQT 同意收购 Exolaunch，为这家之前自筹资金的德国发射集成和部署公司提供了第一笔外部投资和资源，以进行国际扩张和开发新服务。

paras.en: Intuitive Machines–Lanteris Space Systems. Intuitive Machines completed its $800 million acquisition of the former Maxar Space Systems, adding decades of satellite manufacturing experience as it seeks to become a vertically integrated space prime.
paras.zh: 直观机器——兰特里斯空间系统。 Intuitive Machines 完成了对前 Maxar Space Systems 的 8 亿美元收购，在其寻求成为垂直整合的太空巨头的过程中，增加了数十年的卫星制造经验。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies–NASA. NASA turned to Katalyst for an unusually rapid commercial servicing mission designed to rendezvous with and raise the orbit of the agency’s Swift observatory, testing a new model for acquiring time-sensitive in-space services.
paras.zh: Katalyst 空间技术——美国宇航局。 NASA 向 Katalyst 寻求一项异常快速的商业服务任务，旨在与该机构的雨燕天文台交会并提升其轨道，测试一种获取时间敏感的太空服务的新模型。

paras.en: SpaceX IPO. SpaceX’s long-awaited public offering brought one of the world’s most valuable private companies to public markets in a landmark transaction for the commercial space sector.
paras.zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股。 SpaceX 期待已久的公开发行将世界上最有价值的私营公司之一带到了公开市场，这是商业航天领域具有里程碑意义的交易。

paras.en: Recognizing advances that harness artificial intelligence and high-performance computing to transform spacecraft, space data and operations.
paras.zh: 认识到利用人工智能和高性能计算来改变航天器、空间数据和操作的进步。

paras.en: Aethero. Launched its Phobos spacecraft with an NVIDIA-powered edge-computing module, demonstrating a platform designed for continuous onboard processing and compute-as-a-service applications.
paras.zh: 埃泰罗。推出了配备 NVIDIA 驱动的边缘计算模块的 Phobos 航天器，展示了一个专为连续机载处理和计算即服务应用程序而设计的平台。

paras.en: Alex Greenberg, Loft Orbital. Helped drive Loft Orbital’s push to bring artificial intelligence and high-performance computing directly into orbit, enabling satellites to process increasingly large volumes of data before sending actionable information to the ground.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·格林伯格，阁楼轨道。帮助推动 Loft Orbital 推动人工智能和高性能计算直接进入轨道，使卫星能够在向地面发送可操作信息之前处理越来越多的数据。

paras.en: Starcloud. Advanced the emerging concept of space-based data centers by developing high-performance orbital computing infrastructure intended to run increasingly demanding AI workloads in space.
paras.zh: 星云。通过开发旨在在太空中运行要求日益严格的人工智能工作负载的高性能轨道计算基础设施，推进新兴的天基数据中心概念。

paras.en: Recognizing companies and missions that have advanced commercial space capabilities and contributed to the growth of the space economy.
paras.zh: 表彰具有先进商业航天能力并为航天经济增长做出贡献的公司和任务。

paras.en: ICEYE. Expanded its synthetic aperture radar network while deploying a new generation of spacecraft capable of imagery down to 16-centimeter resolution and supporting both commercial and sovereign missions worldwide.
paras.zh: 冰眼。扩大其合成孔径雷达网络，同时部署能够将图像分辨率低至 16 厘米的新一代航天器，并支持全球商业和主权任务。

paras.en: Impulse Space and Starfish Space. Demonstrated autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations using Impulse Space’s Mira spacecraft and Starfish Space technology, advancing commercial capabilities needed for future satellite servicing and other in-space operations.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间和海星空间。使用 Impulse Space 的 Mira 航天器和 Starfish Space 技术展示了自主交会和邻近操作，提高了未来卫星服务和其他太空操作所需的商业能力。

paras.en: SEOPS and Exolaunch. Expanded launch integration and rideshare services at a time of growing demand for alternatives in the commercial launch market, helping satellite operators secure access to orbit across a broader range of launch vehicles.
paras.zh: SEOPS 和 Exolaunch。在商业发射市场对替代品的需求不断增长之际，扩大了发射集成和乘车共享服务，帮助卫星运营商确保更广泛的运载火箭进入轨道。

paras.en: Recognizing leadership in using space technology to protect Earth and advancing more sustainable operations in space.
paras.zh: 认可在利用空间技术保护地球和推进更可持续的太空运营方面的领导地位。

paras.en: Hydrosat. Expanded the use of thermal infrared satellite data for water, agriculture and climate applications while unveiling Osiris, a next-generation constellation designed to combine 25-meter thermal imagery with broad-area coverage and daily revisit.
paras.zh: 海德萨特。扩大了热红外卫星数据在水、农业和气候应用中的使用，同时推出了 Osiris，这是一个下一代星座，旨在将 25 米热图像与大面积覆盖和每日重访相结合。

paras.en: Space Data Association. Continued bringing satellite operators together to share operational data and promote collision avoidance, responsible operations and sustainable use of increasingly congested orbital environments.
paras.zh: 空间数据协会。继续将卫星运营商聚集在一起，共享运行数据并促进避免碰撞、负责任的运行和可持续利用日益拥挤的轨道环境。

paras.en: Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Began issuing real-time scientific alerts in February, creating a system expected to eventually generate millions of alerts each night about changing objects and events ranging from asteroids to supernovae.
paras.zh: 维拉·C·鲁宾天文台。从二月份开始发布实时科学警报，创建了一个系统，预计最终将在每晚生成数百万个关于从小行星到超新星等物体和事件变化的警报。

paras.en: Celebrating breakthroughs in exploration, science and public-sector space missions.
paras.zh: 庆祝探索、科学和公共部门太空任务方面的突破。

paras.en: Artemis 2 Team. Returned astronauts to the vicinity of the moon for the first time in more than half a century, carrying NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen on a nearly 10-day flight around the moon aboard Orion. The April mission brought together NASA, international partners and a vast industrial team supporting Orion, the Space Launch System and ground systems.
paras.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯2小队。半个多世纪以来，宇航员首次返回月球附近，美国宇航局宇航员里德·怀斯曼、维克多·格洛弗、克里斯蒂娜·科赫以及加拿大宇航员杰里米·汉森乘坐猎户座飞船进行了近 10 天的绕月飞行。四月份的任务汇集了美国宇航局、国际合作伙伴以及支持猎户座、太空发射系统和地面系统的庞大工业团队。

paras.en: Copernicus Sentinel-1D Team. Brought Sentinel-1D into full operations in May, restoring and strengthening Europe’s flagship radar Earth observation capability and continuing more than a decade of global environmental monitoring through Copernicus.
paras.zh: 哥白尼哨兵-1D 团队。 Sentinel-1D 于 5 月全面投入运行，恢复和加强了欧洲旗舰雷达地球观测能力，并通过哥白尼继续进行了十多年的全球环境监测。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Team. Successfully launched NASA’s next flagship astrophysics observatory Aug. 30, beginning a mission designed to survey the universe far faster than Hubble while investigating dark energy, exoplanets and some of astronomy’s biggest unanswered questions.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜团队。 8 月 30 日成功发射了 NASA 的下一个旗舰天体物理观测站，开始了一项旨在以比哈勃望远镜快得多的速度观测宇宙的任务，同时研究暗能量、系外行星和一些天文学上尚未解答的最大问题。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals, organizations and missions making significant contributions to national security space capabilities.
paras.zh: 表彰对国家安全太空能力做出重大贡献的个人、组织和任务。

paras.en: Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo. Took leadership of the Space Development Agency while also becoming the Space Force’s portfolio acquisition executive for missile warning and tracking, overseeing deployment of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture and its growing constellation of military satellites.
paras.zh: 古尔帕塔普·“GP”·桑胡。领导太空发展局，同时还成为太空部队负责导弹预警和跟踪的采购主管，监督扩散战士太空架构及其不断增长的军事卫星群的部署。

paras.en: Impulse Space. Expanded its national security role with a $28 million Space Force contract for a future space domain awareness mission using its highly maneuverable Mira spacecraft in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间。通过一份价值 2800 万美元的太空部队合同，扩大了其在国家安全方面的作用，该合同将使用其高度机动的 Mira 航天器在近地轨道上执行未来的太空领域感知任务。

paras.en: SpaceWERX. Continued using the Space Force’s small-business innovation programs to move emerging commercial technologies toward military applications and broaden the pool of companies contributing to national security space.
paras.zh: SpaceWERX。继续利用太空军的小型企业创新计划，将新兴商业技术推向军事应用，并扩大为国家安全领域做出贡献的公司群体。

paras.en: VICTUS HAZE Team. Demonstrated the Space Force’s most advanced tactically responsive space mission to date, with Rocket Lab and True Anomaly spacecraft supporting realistic rendezvous and proximity operations and space domain awareness scenarios after a rapid-response launch campaign.
paras.zh: VICTUS HAZE 团队。展示了太空军迄今为止最先进的战术响应太空任务，火箭实验室和真实异常航天器在快速响应发射活动后支持现实的交会和接近操作以及空间域感知场景。

paras.en: Join us for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards in Washington, D.C., on Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 请与我们一起参加 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖。

articles.title: Jena-Optronik is proud to partner with MDA Space for its first ASTRO HP mission.
articles.author: Jena-Optronik

paras.en: MDA Space, a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, space exploration and infrastructure, will utilize Jena-Optronik’s ASTRO HP star sensor on a LEO mission. This milestone underscores our ability to provide cutting-edge technology that meets the demands of international space missions.
paras.zh: MDA Space 是通信卫星、地球和空间观测、太空探索和基础设施领域的全球领导者，将在低地球轨道任务中使用 Jena-Optronik 的 ASTRO HP 星传感器。这一里程碑强调了我们提供满足国际太空任务需求的尖端技术的能力。

paras.en: In a market that moves fast, the ASTRO HP optical head provides the perfect balance: high performance thanks to the radiation-hard Faintstar2 detector, the very fast optics in a compact, lightweight design optimized for small and medium-sized, high-performance satellites.
paras.zh: 在快速变化的市场中，ASTRO HP 光学头提供了完美的平衡：高性能得益于抗辐射 Faintstar2 探测器，非常快速的光学器件采用紧凑、轻量的设计，针对中小型高性能卫星进行了优化。

paras.en: The new sensor leverages the proven heritage of Jena Optronik technologies: combining the precision and agility of the ASTRO APS3 with the flight-proven electronics and software of the ASTRO CL, all unified by our easy-to-integrate ASTROlib software.
paras.zh: 新型传感器利用了 Jena Optronik 技术的成熟传统：将 ASTRO APS3 的精度和敏捷性与经过飞行验证的 ASTRO CL 电子设备和软件相结合，所有这些都通过我们易于集成的 ASTROlib 软件进行统一。

paras.en: The ASTRO HP optical head delivers next-level attitude accuracy and rate capabilities without forcing you to redesign your platform. This modular approach provides unique flexibility to tailor performance and cost directly to your mission specific needs.
paras.zh: ASTRO HP 光学头可提供更高水平的姿态精度和速率功能，而无需迫使您重新设计平台。这种模块化方法提供了独特的灵活性，可以直接根据您的任务特定需求定制性能和成本。

paras.en: Furthermore, the advanced ASTROlib enables specialized SSA capabilities. The first flight ready version will be rolled out for this particular program.
paras.zh: 此外，先进的 ASTROlib 还支持专门的 SSA 功能。第一个飞行就绪版本将针对该特定计划推出。

articles.title: NASA Seeks US Industry Plans for Commercial Space Stations
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 正在进一步推进美国在太空领域的领导地位，迈向未来商业空间站在近地轨道上处于领先地位的未来。周五，该机构发布了最终的征求建议书，邀请业界提交下一代商业空间站的计划。

paras.en: “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “We will continue to need a place to conduct research, develop technologies, train crews, and prepare for missions to the Moon and Mars. Commercial space stations may provide that capability while creating new opportunities for American industry and allowing NASA to concentrate more of our resources on the near-impossible missions ahead.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示：“根据总统的国家太空政策，美国宇航局致力于在国际空间站退役后很长一段时间内维持美国在近地轨道上的持续存在。” “我们将继续需要一个地方来进行研究、开发技术、培训人员以及为月球和火星任务做准备。商业空间站可以提供这种能力，同时为美国工业创造新的机会，并使美国宇航局能够将更多的资源集中在未来几乎不可能的任务上。”

paras.en: Building on the agency’s Ignition event earlier this year, NASA regularly has engaged with private industry to shape the agency’s future direction in low Earth orbit. This included publishing two Requests for Information in March to gather industry’s perspective on low Earth orbit destinations and transportation. The agency also published a draft Request for Proposals in July, followed by an industry day and one-on-one meetings that allowed interested companies to review and comment on the planned acquisition approach.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候该机构的点火事件的基础上，美国宇航局定期与私营企业合作，以塑造该机构在近地轨道的未来方向。其中包括在三月份发布两份信息请求，以收集业界对低地球轨道目的地和运输的看法。该机构还在 7 月份发布了征求建议书草案，随后举行了行业日和一对一会议，让感兴趣的公司对计划中的收购方式进行审查和评论。

paras.en: “We’ve made it clear that NASA will never give up its presence in low Earth orbit,” said Isaacman. “Since Ignition, we have spent a lot of time listening to industry and working through what it will take to make this transition successful. The opportunity is significant, but the economics ultimately have to work. We want to see credible plans, strong technical execution, and companies prepared to invest in destinations that can serve NASA while developing additional customers and markets of their own.”
paras.zh: “我们已经明确表示，美国宇航局永远不会放弃其在近地轨道的存在，”艾萨克曼说。 “自 Ignition 以来，我们花了很多时间倾听业界的声音，并研究如何使这一转变成功。机会是巨大的，但经济最终必须发挥作用。我们希望看到可靠的计划、强大的技术执行力以及准备投资可以为 NASA 服务的目的地的公司，同时开发更多自己的客户和市场。”

paras.en: Proposals are due Tuesday, Dec. 8, with contract awards expected in spring 2027.
paras.zh: 提案将于 12 月 8 日星期二提交，合同预计将于 2027 年春季授予。

paras.en: Under the solicitation, NASA outlines requirements for companies interested in designing, building, testing, certifying, and operating commercial low Earth orbit destinations capable of providing end-to-end destination and transportation services for human spaceflight use.
paras.zh: 根据招标，美国宇航局概述了对设计、建造、测试、认证和运营商业近地轨道目的地感兴趣的公司的要求，这些目的地能够为载人航天用途提供端到端目的地和运输服务。

paras.en: NASA intends to award firm-fixed-price, multi-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contracts supporting development, certification, and services for continued low Earth orbit research and exploration. This will allow NASA to select two or more contractors through early development, followed by a competitive task order for final design, test, and evaluation, as well as certification and services from one or more contractors.
paras.zh: NASA 打算授予固定价格、多次授予、无限期交付/无限数量的合同，支持持续低地球轨道研究和探索的开发、认证和服务。这将使美国宇航局能够通过早期开发选择两个或更多承包商，然后为最终设计、测试和评估以及一个或多个承包商的认证和服务提供竞争性任务订单。

paras.en: Learn more about NASA’s missions on the agency’s website:
paras.zh: 在该机构的网站上了解有关 NASA 任务的更多信息：

paras.en: george.c.alderman@nasa.gov / joshua.a.finch@nasa.gov
paras.zh: george.c.alderman@nasa.gov / joshua.a.finch@nasa.gov

articles.title: Antarctic Sea Ice Grows to Its 2026 Maximum

paras.en: This story is an update to the Antarctic sea ice feature in our World of Change series tracking long-term change on Earth's surface through satellite imagery.
paras.zh: 这个故事是我们的“变化​​世界”系列中南极海冰特征的更新，该系列通过卫星图像跟踪地球表面的长期变化。

paras.en: Unlike the Arctic—an ocean basin surrounded by land—the Antarctic is a large continent surrounded by an ocean. Because of this geography, sea ice has more room to expand during the winter. However, that ice also stretches into warmer latitudes, leading to more melting in the summer. Antarctic sea ice usually peaks in September, around the end of the Southern Hemisphere’s winter, and retreats to a minimum in February.
paras.zh: 与北极（一个被陆地包围的海洋盆地）不同，南极洲是一个被海洋包围的大大陆。由于这种地理位置，海冰在冬季有更大的扩展空间。然而，这些冰也会延伸到温暖的纬度，导致夏季更多的融化。南极海冰通常在九月（南半球冬季结束前后）达到顶峰，并在二月降至最低点。

paras.en: According to NASA and the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC), Antarctic sea ice in 2026 likely reached its annual maximum extent on September 14 (above). On that date, the ice covered an estimated 17.59 million square kilometers (6.79 million square miles), making it the third-lowest maximum on record.
paras.zh: 根据 NASA 和国家冰雪数据中心 (NSIDC) 的数据，2026 年南极海冰可能会在 9 月 14 日达到年度最大范围（上图）。当天，冰层覆盖面积估计为 1,759 万平方公里（679 万平方英里），是有记录以来第三低的最大面积。

paras.en: The maps below show the average concentration of Antarctic sea ice for the month of September (left) and the following February (right) from 1990 to 2026. Opaque white areas indicate the highest concentrations, and dark blue areas are open water. The images include only areas where ice concentration was at least 15 percent, a threshold scientists commonly use to count an area as ice-covered in satellite data. Scientists refer to the total area of these regions as the “sea ice extent.”
paras.zh: 下图显示了 1990 年至 2026 年 9 月（左）和次年 2 月（右）南极海冰的平均浓度。不透明的白色区域表示浓度最高，深蓝色区域是开放水域。这些图像仅包含冰浓度至少为 15% 的区域，这是科学家通常用来在卫星数据中计算某个区域被冰覆盖的阈值。科学家将这些区域的总面积称为“海冰范围”。

paras.en: From 1979 until 2014, total Antarctic sea ice increased by about 1 percent per decade. Whether the increase was a sign of meaningful change is uncertain because ice extents vary considerably from year to year around Antarctica. For three consecutive years, from 2012 to 2014, satellites observed new record highs for winter sea ice extent. These highs occurred while Arctic ice was in steep decline.
paras.zh: 从 1979 年到 2014 年，南极海冰总量每十年增加约 1%。这种增加是否是有意义的变化的迹象尚不确定，因为南极洲周围的冰面积每年都有很大变化。从2012年到2014年，卫星连续三年观测到冬季海冰范围再创新高。这些高点发生时北极冰层急剧减少。

paras.en: The climb came to an end in 2015, and significant decreases in sea ice around Antarctica started to occur in 2016. There have since been years with small rebounds, but overall, Antarctic sea ice coverage has largely remained lower than normal. Both the record low minimum and record low maximum occurred in 2023. Scientists will continue to observe the area each year to find out if the decline is part of a long-term change or a statistical fluctuation.
paras.zh: 爬升运动于 2015 年结束，南极洲周围的海冰在 2016 年开始显着减少。此后的几年里出现了小幅反弹，但总体而言，南极海冰覆盖范围基本上仍低于正常水平。历史最低最低值和最高纪录最低值都出现在 2023 年。科学家们将继续每年观察该地区，以查明这种下降是长期变化的一部分还是统计波动的一部分。

paras.en: To determine sea ice extent, scientists rely on satellites with passive microwave sensors that measure the microwave energy Earth naturally emits. Sea ice emits more of this energy than open water, so it stands out in microwave images. Because microwaves pass through clouds, the satellites can observe sea ice regularly, regardless of weather.
paras.zh: 为了确定海冰的范围，科学家依靠带有无源微波传感器的卫星来测量地球自然发射的微波能量。海冰比开放水域释放更多的能量，因此它在微波图像中脱颖而出。由于微波穿过云层，因此无论天气如何，卫星都可以定期观测海冰。

paras.en: The record began in late 1978 with data collected by NASA’s Nimbus-7, followed by Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP) satellites starting in 1987, and by NASA’s Aqua satellite between 2002 and 2011. In 2025, scientists began using observations from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency’s GCOM-W satellite.
paras.zh: 该记录始于 1978 年底，由 NASA 的 Nimbus-7 收集数据，随后从 1987 年开始由国防气象卫星计划 (DMSP) 卫星收集，并在 2002 年至 2011 年间由 NASA 的 Aqua 卫星收集数据。2025 年，科学家开始使用日本宇宙航空研究开发机构的 GCOM-W 卫星的观测数据。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Michala Garrison, using data from the National Snow and Ice Data Center.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局地球观测站的图像由米查拉·加里森 (Michala Garrison) 使用国家冰雪数据中心的数据拍摄。

paras.zh: - NASA 地球数据（2026 年 10 月）海冰。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 8 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Observatory (2026, October 6) World of Change: Antarctic Sea Ice. Accessed October 8, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球观测站（2026 年，10 月 6 日）变化的世界：南极海冰。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 8 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Observatory (2016, September 16) Sea Ice. Accessed October 8, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球观测站（2016 年 9 月 16 日）海冰。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 8 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Science (2026, September 23) Arctic Sea Ice Reaches 2026 Annual Minimum Extent. Accessed October 8, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球科学（2026 年，9 月 23 日）北极海冰达到 2026 年年度最小范围。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 8 日。

paras.zh: - 国家冰雪数据中心（2026年，9月23日）北极海冰已达到2026年的最小范围；南极海冰也很可能达到最大值。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 8 日。

articles.title: NASA’s SpaceX CRS-35 Mission to Launch Health Research

paras.en: NASA experiments focused on human and plant health and drug-resistant organisms will travel to the International Space Station aboard SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission for the agency from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, advancing research that benefits life on Earth and future exploration.
paras.zh: NASA 专注于人类和植物健康以及耐药生物体的实验将搭乘 SpaceX 为该机构执行的第 35 次商业补给服务任务，从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站前往国际空间站，推进有利于地球生命和未来探索的研究。

paras.en: This research supports astronaut health during long-duration missions through four investigations from the agency’s Biological and Physical Sciences division, including 3D models of the human brain, a crop disease study, a faster way to assess astronaut health, and an analysis of antibiotic-resistant bacteria aboard the space station.
paras.zh: 这项研究通过该机构生物和物理科学部门的四项调查来支持宇航员在长期任务期间的健康，包括人脑 3D 模型、作物疾病研究、评估宇航员健康的更快方法以及对空间站上抗生素耐药细菌的分析。

paras.en: A new precision health investigation helps address a key question: What happens to the human brain in space?
paras.zh: 一项新的精确健康调查有助于解决一个关键问题：人脑在太空中会发生什么？

paras.en: The experiment sends small, lab-grown models of the human brain to the orbiting laboratory for five weeks. Researchers compare tissue models that traveled to space with identical ones kept on Earth to determine how a short spaceflight affects the human brain at the cellular level.
paras.zh: 该实验将实验室培育的小型人脑模型发送到轨道实验室，为期五周。研究人员将前往太空的组织模型与保存在地球上的相同组织模型进行比较，以确定短途太空飞行如何在细胞水平上影响人脑。

paras.en: The effort could deepen our understanding of how the human brain responds to stress and help lay the groundwork for methods that counter risks to brain health that astronauts may face on future missions to the Moon and beyond.
paras.zh: 这项工作可以加深我们对人类大脑如何应对压力的理解，并有助于为应对宇航员在未来登月及其他任务中可能面临的大脑健康风险的方法奠定基础。

paras.en: A space crops investigation tests whether crop diseases develop faster and more severely in microgravity.
paras.zh: 太空作物调查测试了作物病害在微重力下是否发展得更快、更严重。

paras.en: The experiment compares molecular and structural changes between Earth-grown and space station-grown plants infected with a disease-causing fungus. The findings could guide plant breeding on Earth to produce disease-resistant crops and help minimize yield losses in future space agriculture systems.
paras.zh: 该实验比较了感染致病真菌的地球种植和空间站种植的植物之间的分子和结构变化。这些发现可以指导地球上的植物育种以生产抗病作物，并有助于最大限度地减少未来太空农业系统的产量损失。

paras.en: Space crops provide nutrition, increase dietary variety, and offer psychological benefits for astronauts during extended missions. They also absorb carbon dioxide, produce oxygen, and recycle water, which will become increasingly important as human missions extend farther from Earth.
paras.zh: 太空作物为宇航员在长期任务期间提供营养、增加饮食多样性并提供心理益处。它们还吸收​​二氧化碳、产生氧气并回收水，随着人类任务延伸到距离地球更远的地方，这将变得越来越重要。

paras.en: The spacecraft also carries the first test of a compact microplate reader that arrived aboard the space station earlier this year.
paras.zh: 该航天器还携带了今年早些时候抵达空间站的紧凑型酶标仪的首次测试。

paras.en: The Commercially Enabled Rapid Space Science initiative experiment tests the device’s ability to detect and measure certain biomarkers such as antibodies, antigens, and proteins.
paras.zh: 商业化快速空间科学计划实验测试了该设备检测和测量某些生物标记物（例如抗体、抗原和蛋白质）的能力。

paras.en: Use of the plate reader would allow scientists to analyze samples aboard the space station and obtain data quickly, rather than wait for the samples to return to Earth for analysis.
paras.zh: 使用读板器将使科学家能够分析空间站上的样本并快速获取数据，而不是等待样本返回地球进行分析。

paras.en: Ultimately, the research aims to support the timely detection of infections and other health issues in astronauts while expanding science capabilities in remote exploration locations where resupply will be more difficult.
paras.zh: 最终，该研究的目的是支持及时发现宇航员的感染和其他健康问题，同时扩大补给更加困难的偏远探索地点的科学能力。

paras.en: A precision health investigation returns for its fourth and final planned stay aboard the space station to study how antibiotic-resistant bacteria survive and evolve in microgravity.
paras.zh: 一项精确的健康调查返回了第四次也是最后一次计划在空间站停留，以研究抗生素抗性细菌如何在微重力下生存和进化。

paras.en: As part of the investigation, astronauts repeatedly sample surfaces throughout the space station to monitor for drug-resistant organisms.
paras.zh: 作为调查的一部分，宇航员反复对整个空间站的表面进行采样，以监测耐药生物体。

paras.en: The work could help develop ways to protect astronauts against bacterial infections during long-duration missions. On Earth, the findings could provide insight into how superbugs develop from the overuse of antibiotics.
paras.zh: 这项工作可能有助于开发保护宇航员在长期任务期间免受细菌感染的方法。在地球上，这些发现可以让我们深入了解超级细菌是如何因过度使用抗生素而产生的。

paras.en: To learn more about NASA’s biological and physical research in space, visit: https://science.nasa.gov/biological-physical/
paras.zh: 要了解有关 NASA 太空生物和物理研究的更多信息，请访问：https://science.nasa.gov/biological-physical/

articles.title: Rise in poverty is ‘a wake-up call for the world’, UN development chief says

paras.en: Rise in poverty is ‘a wake-up call for the world’, UN development chief says
paras.zh: 联合国发展负责人表示，贫困人口的增加“给世界敲响了警钟”

paras.en: The finding comes in the 2026 update of the global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and Oxford University, which measures overlapping hardship across health, education and standard of living.
paras.zh: 这一发现来自联合国开发计划署 (UNDP) 和牛津大学发布的 2026 年全球多维贫困指数 (MPI) 更新，该指数衡量健康、教育和生活水平方面的重叠困难。

paras.en: The 1.2 billion figure represents 51.5 million more people than in the 2025 update. Of this number, more than half are children – 617 million – and 83 per cent live in rural areas.
paras.zh: 12 亿的数字意味着比 2025 年更新的人数增加了 5150 万人。其中，一半以上是儿童（6.17 亿），83% 生活在农村地区。

paras.en: “The rise in poverty should be a wake-up call for the world,” said UNDP Administrator Alexander De Croo.
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署署长亚历山大·德克罗表示：“贫困人口的增加应该给世界敲响警钟。”

paras.en: “Behind these figures are 1.2 billion people facing hardships that reinforce one another: hunger, missed schooling and a lack of clean water or electricity. This is unacceptable.”
paras.zh: “这些数字的背后是 12 亿人面临着相互加剧的困难：饥饿、失学以及缺乏清洁水或电力。这是不可接受的。”

paras.en: The index was developed in 2010 to measure poverty beyond what people earn.
paras.zh: 该指数于 2010 年制定，旨在衡量人们收入之外的贫困程度。

paras.en: It examines 10 indicators of health, education and standard of living, such as nutrition and child mortality, years of schooling, and access to electricity, drinking water and sanitation.
paras.zh: 它审查了健康、教育和生活水平的 10 项指标，例如营养和儿童死亡率、受教育年限以及电力、饮用水和卫生设施的获得情况。

paras.en: A person is considered “multidimensionally poor” if they are deprived in one-third or more of the indicators.
paras.zh: 如果一个人在三分之一或更多的指标上被剥夺，则被认为是“多维贫困”。

paras.en: Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia account for the overwhelming majority of deprivations across every indicator.
paras.zh: 就各项指标而言，撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚地区的贫困人口占绝大多数。

paras.en: The 2026 update – which covers 108 countries, representing some 78 per cent of the global population – reveals that the increase in poverty is partly due to population growth outpacing efforts to improve living standards.
paras.zh: 2026 年的更新涵盖 108 个国家，约占全球人口的 78%，显示贫困增加的部分原因是人口增长超过了提高生活水平的努力。

paras.en: In 95 countries where no new survey data was available, updated population estimates increased the number of people counted as poor by nearly 16 million.
paras.zh: 在没有新调查数据的 95 个国家中，更新的人口估计数使贫困人口增加了近 1600 万。

paras.en: The remainder of the increase comes from 13 countries where data was gathered, reflecting the genuine change in poverty incidence and the associated demographic change, as well as differences in indicator coverage.
paras.zh: 其余的增长来自收集数据的 13 个国家，反映了贫困发生率和相关人口变化的真正变化，以及指标覆盖范围的差异。

paras.en: The updated surveys also revealed a mixed picture on the ground. Five of these countries – Egypt, Nepal, Tajikistan, Angola and Zambia – have reduced the share of people living in multidimensional poverty, however population growth outpaced poverty reduction in both Angola and Zambia, meaning that the total number of people living in poverty still increased.
paras.zh: 最新的调查还显示，实际情况好坏参半。其中埃及、尼泊尔、塔吉克斯坦、安哥拉和赞比亚等五个国家减少了多维贫困人口比例，但安哥拉和赞比亚的人口增长速度超过了减贫速度，这意味着贫困人口总数仍在增加。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Nigeria provides an example of how fragile progress in tackling poverty can be. Although the country made significant reductions in multidimensional poverty in the 2010s, both the poverty rate and the number of people struggling to make ends meet have increased.
paras.zh: 与此同时，尼日利亚提供了一个例子，说明解决贫困问题的进展是多么脆弱。尽管2010年代中国多维贫困大幅减少，但贫困率和入不敷出的人口数量均有所增加。

paras.en: The international community has pledged to reduce the proportion of people living in poverty by at least half before the end of this decade, in line with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
paras.zh: 国际社会承诺根据可持续发展目标（SDG），在本十年结束前将贫困人口比例减少至少一半。

paras.en: The authors of the 2026 MPI update believe that this target is achievable.
paras.zh: 2026 年 MPI 更新的作者相信这一目标是可以实现的。

paras.en: “We know progress is possible,” Mr. De Croo insisted. “Countries that have tackled these challenges together, rather than in isolation, have shown what determined action can achieve.”
paras.zh: “我们知道取得进展是可能的，”德克鲁先生坚持说。 “共同应对这些挑战而不是孤立地应对这些挑战的国家已经展示了坚决行动可以取得的成果。”

paras.en: UNDP reported that 33 countries have halved their MPI value in fewer than 15 years, including six in sub-Saharan Africa. In Eswatini, the share of people living in multidimensional poverty has fallen from nearly 39 per cent to eight per cent.
paras.zh: 开发计划署报告称，33 个国家的 MPI 值在不到 15 年的时间里减半，其中 6 个国家位于撒哈拉以南非洲。在斯威士兰，生活在多维贫困中的人口比例已从近 39% 下降至 8%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, China recorded the fastest reduction among countries with available data by halving its MPI value from 9.5 per cent to 4.2 per cent in just four years (2010-2014).
paras.zh: 与此同时，中国的MPI值在短短四年内（2010年至2014年）从9.5%减半至4.2%，是有可用数据的国家中降幅最快的。

paras.en: The shows that many countries continue to make progress, with some reducing poverty rapidly and at scale, underscoring both the urgency of renewed action and the possibility of success, the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，这些结果表明许多国家继续取得进展，其中一些国家迅速大规模地减少了贫困，这凸显了采取新行动的紧迫性和成功的可能性。

articles.title: ‘Efficiency has limits’: UNHCR chief warns refugee protection is buckling under cuts

paras.en: ‘Efficiency has limits’: UNHCR chief warns refugee protection is buckling under cuts
paras.zh: “效率是有限度的”：难民署负责人警告难民保护因削减而陷入困境

paras.en: The money is running out faster than needs are growing: with 117 million men, women and children now forced from their homes, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) has received just $3 billion of the $8.5 billion it needs this year – and its chief, Barham Salih, warns that the global support system for asylum-seekers risks buckling.
paras.zh: 资金耗尽的速度快于需求增长的速度：目前有 1.17 亿男人、女人和儿童被迫离开家园，联合国难民署 (UNHCR) 仅收到了今年所需的 85 亿美元中的 30 亿美元 — — 其负责人巴勒姆·萨利赫 (Barham Salih) 警告说，全球寻求庇护者支持系统面临崩溃的风险。

paras.en: UNHCR was created after the Second World War with the pledge that people fleeing persecution should be protected and not sent back to places where they might be in danger. Today, that pledge is under strain as deep funding cuts take effect.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署是在第二次世界大战后成立的，其承诺应保护逃离迫害的人们，而不是将他们送回可能面临危险的地方。如今，随着资金大幅削减的生效，这一承诺面临压力。

paras.en: In his first keynote address to UNHCR’s Executive Committee meeting in Geneva on Monday, Mr. Salih stressed that the world’s most vulnerable are going without the help they need.
paras.zh: 萨利赫先生周一在日内瓦联合国难民署执行委员会会议上发表首次主旨演讲时强调，世界上最弱势的群体正在得不到他们所需的帮助。

paras.en: “There is…a difference between doing more with less and being asked to do the impossible,” he said, while also highlighting the “exceptionally difficult year” at the agency, marked by the departure of 8,000 staff since 2024.
paras.zh: “用更少的资源做更多的事情和被要求做不可能的事情之间是有区别的，”他说，同时也强调了该机构“异常困难的一年”，自 2024 年以来有 8,000 名员工离职。

paras.en: He added: “In Sudan, insufficient funding threatens specialised medical care, legal assistance and psychological support for more than 50,000 survivors of conflict-related sexual violence. In Chad, services for thousands of unaccompanied and separated children and children with specific protection needs are at risk.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“在苏丹，资金不足威胁到超过 50,000 名冲突相关性暴力幸存者的专门医疗服务、法律援助和心理支持。在乍得，为数千名无人陪伴和失散儿童以及有特殊保护需求的儿童提供的服务面临风险。”

paras.en: In Ethiopia, meanwhile, refugee registration has been halted for tens of thousands of people arriving from South Sudan and Eritrea, while hundreds of thousands more are awaiting verification and integration into the national identification system.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在埃塞俄比亚，数万名来自南苏丹和厄立特里亚的难民登记已被暂停，另有数十万人正在等待核查并纳入国家身份识别系统。

paras.en: Conflicts are uprooting people faster than governments and aid agencies can help them.
paras.zh: 冲突导致人们背井离乡的速度快于政府和援助机构所能提供的帮助。

paras.en: So far in 2026, UNHCR has responded to 22 emergencies in 18 countries, from Yemen to the Horn of Africa and from Sudan to the Sahel.
paras.zh: 2026年迄今，难民署已对18个国家的22起紧急情况做出了反应，从也门到非洲之角，从苏丹到萨赫勒地区。

paras.en: Despite growing humanitarian needs, the agency has received less than one third of its funding requirement for this year.
paras.zh: 尽管人道主义需求不断增长，但该机构今年收到的资金需求还不到三分之一。

paras.en: Mr. Salih warned that countries that have hosted refugees for decades are frustrated at the lack of international solidarity, while refugees themselves are increasingly afraid for their safety, amid deep cuts to assistance.
paras.zh: 萨利赫警告说，数十年来收容难民的国家因缺乏国际团结而感到沮丧，而在援助大幅削减的情况下，难民本身也越来越担心自己的安全。

paras.en: The result is that women and girls are more exposed to violence and exploitation, children are losing years of education and persons with disabilities face protection barriers, the High Commissioner said, in an appeal for greater support.
paras.zh: 高级专员在呼吁提供更多支持时表示，其结果是，妇女和女童更容易遭受暴力和剥削，儿童失去多年的教育机会，残疾人面临保护障碍。

paras.en: “Efficiency has limits. There comes a point when greater efficiency cannot compensate for fewer resources. When funding falls below that point, the consequences are not abstract, they are borne by people who depend on it,” he insisted.
paras.zh: “效率是有限度的。总有一天，更高的效率无法弥补更少的资源。当资金低于这一点时，后果就不是抽象的，而是由依赖它的人承担，”他坚持说。

paras.en: At the end of last month, Mr. Salih – a former Kurdish politician and President of Iraq – told the Security Council that the situation for refugees today was “genuinely, truly, inhumane”.
paras.zh: 上个月底，前库尔德政治家、伊拉克总统萨利赫向安理会表示，当今难民的处境“真正、真正、不人道”。

paras.en: Speaking in Geneva, the UNHCR chief highlighted an initiative launched earlier this year that aims to halve the number of refugees living in protracted displacement and depending on humanitarian assistance by 2035.
paras.zh: 这位联合国难民署负责人在日内瓦发表讲话时强调了今年早些时候发起的一项倡议，该倡议旨在到 2035 年将长期流离失所并依赖人道主义援助的难民人数减少一半。

paras.en: Nearly 14.5 million refugees in low and middle-income countries currently rely on aid to meet their basic requirements, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，目前低收入和中等收入国家有近 1450 万难民依靠援助来满足基本需求。

paras.en: “We cannot claim success simply because assistance has been reduced or responsibility has been transferred to host countries,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们不能仅仅因为援助减少或责任转移给东道国就宣称成功，”他补充道。

paras.en: “Success is measured by whether people’s lives have genuinely improved and whether they have become self-reliant and active contributors to their communities. For those who still require humanitarian support, our responsibility remains.”
paras.zh: “衡量成功的标准是人们的生活是否真正得到改善，以及他们是否成为自力更生并积极为社区做出贡献。对于那些仍然需要人道主义支持的人，我们的责任依然存在。”

paras.en: Mr. Salih urged solidarity and empathy with asylum-seekers, whose long-standing plight and hardship remains unresolved around the world. “When we speak about refugees and displacement, we should do so with humility,” he said.
paras.zh: 萨利赫先生敦促对寻求庇护者表示声援和同情，他们长期面临的困境和困难在世界各地仍未得到解决。 “当我们谈论难民和流离失所时，我们应该保持谦逊，”他说。

paras.en: “None of us knows who may be forced to flee tomorrow, or who may be called upon to offer refuge.”
paras.zh: “我们谁也不知道明天谁可能被迫逃离，或者谁可能被要求提供庇护。”

articles.title: UN aid operation underway in Nepal following fresh floods

paras.en: UN aid operation underway in Nepal following fresh floods
paras.zh: 联合国在尼泊尔发生新洪水后开展援助行动

paras.en: The United Nations has rushed to assist Nepal following new flash floods in the central Gorkha district on Sunday that swept away homes and bridges just weeks after catastrophic flooding in the north.
paras.zh: 周日，廓尔喀中部地区再次发生山洪，在北部发生灾难性洪水几周后，联合国已紧急向尼泊尔提供援助，洪水冲毁了房屋和桥梁。

paras.en: At least five people are missing and 95 have been rescued, according to the authorities. Hundreds are affected.
paras.zh: 据当局称，至少有 5 人失踪，95 人已获救。数百人受到影响。

paras.en: It is believed the disaster was caused by a landslide that blocked the Budhi Gandaki River.
paras.zh: 据信，这场灾难是由山体滑坡堵塞布迪甘达基河造成的。

paras.en: “Our hearts are with every family affected by the Budhi Gandaki floods,” the UN Country Team said on social media. “We stand with Nepal.”
paras.zh: 联合国国家工作队在社交媒体上表示：“我们的心与每一个受布迪甘达基洪水影响的家庭同在。” “我们与尼泊尔站在一起。”

paras.en: The UN is supporting the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) in getting food to those who lost their homes.
paras.zh: 联合国正在支持国家灾害风险减少和管理局（NDRRMA）为失去家园的人们提供食物。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) said on Sunday that three trucks carrying ready-to-eat food and relief supplies were on the way to help meet the immediate needs of affected communities.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）周日表示，三辆载有即食食品和救援物资的卡车正在路上，以帮助满足受影响社区的迫切需求。

paras.en: The “devastating” floods have damaged key roads, crops and livestock, threatening local food security, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) said in a post on social media.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）在社交媒体上发帖称，“毁灭性”洪水损坏了主要道路、农作物和牲畜，威胁到当地粮食安全。

paras.en: The UN Country Team said FAO drones and satellite imagery by the UN humanitarian affairs office OCHA are being used to “map damage in places roads can’t reach.”
paras.zh: 联合国国家工作队表示，粮农组织无人机和联合国人道主义事务办公室人道协调厅提供的卫星图像被用来“绘制道路无法到达地区的受损情况”。

paras.en: The raging flood waters disrupted essential services that children and families rely on, including water supply, education and healthcare. Displaced families now require safe shelter, clean drinking water, child protection and psychosocial support
paras.zh: 汹涌的洪水扰乱了儿童和家庭赖以生存的基本服务，包括供水、教育和医疗保健。流离失所的家庭现在需要安全的住所、清洁的饮用水、儿童保护和社会心理支持

paras.en: UN children’s agency UNICEF is supporting rapid assessments to identify impacts and to determine priorities for the immediate response.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会正在支持快速评估，以确定影响并确定立即应对的优先事项。

paras.en: UNICEF also has stocks of emergency supplies pre-positioned and ready for deployment, including hygiene kits, water treatment supplies, dignity kits, winter clothing, education materials and psychosocial support services.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会还预先储备了应急物资储备，可供部署，包括卫生用品包、水处理用品、尊严包、冬季服装、教育材料和心理社会支持服务。

paras.en: Communities in Nepal are still reeling from the impact of flooding in late August that was triggered by a glacier collapse in the Himalayas. At least 1,400 people were killed and more than 5,000 are still missing.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔的社区仍在遭受八月下旬喜马拉雅山冰川崩塌引发的洪水的影响。至少1,400人死亡，5,000多人仍然失踪。

articles.title: Saracens sack academy player involved in Stokes-Atkinson fracas after new incident

paras.en: Totoa Auvaa: Saracens sack academy forward involved in nightclub fracas with Ben Stokes and Gus Atkinson after new incident
paras.zh: 托托亚·奥瓦（Totoa Auvaa）：在新事件发生后，撒拉逊人解雇了与本·斯托克斯（Ben Stokes）和格斯·阿特金森（Gus Atkinson）夜总会争吵的青训前锋

paras.en: Saracens have dismissed Senior Men’s Academy forward Totoa Auvaa with immediate effect following an incident at the weekend; the 21-year-old Samoan was part of the June nightclub altercation that preceded Ben Stokes’ retirement from international cricket
paras.zh: 周末发生事件后，撒拉逊人立即解雇了高级男子学院前锋托托亚·奥瓦（Totoa Auvaa）；这位 21 岁的萨摩亚人参与了本·斯托克斯 (Ben Stokes) 从国际板球界退役之前的 6 月夜总会争吵。

paras.en: Saracens have sacked Totoa Auvaa with immediate effect after an incident over the weekend - four months after the forward was involved in the nightclub altercation that preceded Ben Stokes' retirement from international cricket.
paras.zh: 托托亚·奥瓦 (Totoa Auvaa) 周末发生事件后，撒拉逊人立即解雇了他。四个月前，托托亚·奥瓦 (Totoa Auvaa) 在本·斯托克斯 (Ben Stokes) 从国际板球界退役之前卷入了夜总会争吵。

paras.en: The 21-year-old Samoan, a member of the club's Senior Men's Academy, was involved in an incident in St Albans on Saturday night.
paras.zh: 这位21岁的萨摩亚人是俱乐部高级男子学院的成员，周六晚上在圣奥尔本斯卷入了一起事件。

paras.en: Saracens confirmed on Monday evening Auvaa had left the club following an internal investigation.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，撒拉逊人证实奥瓦在内部调查后离开了俱乐部。

paras.en: - Northampton beat bath in chaotic 18-try, 119-point thriller
paras.zh: - 北安普顿在混乱的 18 次尝试、119 分的惊悚片中击败巴斯

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Get Sky Sports or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？无需签订合同即可观看天空体育或直播

paras.en: "Saracens can confirm that Totoa Auvaa, a member of the Senior Men's Academy, has left the club with immediate effect," a club statement said.
paras.zh: 俱乐部声明称：“撒拉逊人可以确认，高级男子学院成员托托亚·奥瓦（Totoa Auvaa）已立即离开俱乐部。”

paras.en: "Following an incident this weekend, the club has determined that his conduct falls short of the standards expected of everyone who represents Saracens, both on and off the pitch.
paras.zh: “在本周末发生的事件之后，俱乐部确定他的行为没有达到代表撒拉逊人的每个人的预期标准，无论是场内还是场外。

paras.en: "We take our responsibilities to our supporters, young people and partners seriously and we remain committed to upholding the standards of our conduct expected across the club.
paras.zh: “我们认真对待我们的支持者、年轻人和合作伙伴的责任，我们仍然致力于维护整个俱乐部所期望的行为标准。

paras.en: "We will not be making any further comment on this matter."
paras.zh: “我们不会对此事发表任何进一步评论。”

paras.en: Auvaa escaped punishment following the nightclub incident in June which led to cricketers Stokes and Gus Atkinson being dropped by England for the second Test against New Zealand.
paras.zh: 六月的夜总会事件导致板球运动员斯托克斯和格斯·阿特金森被英格兰队淘汰参加对阵新西兰的第二次测试，奥瓦逃脱了处罚。

paras.en: Saracens called the events "regrettable" while describing themselves as "supportive" of the player.
paras.zh: 撒拉逊人称这些事件“令人遗憾”，同时表示自己“支持”该玩家。

paras.en: Separate Saracens and England cricket nights out had converged on two pubs before Stokes, Atkinson and Auvaa ended up in the VIP area of the Rex Rooms nightclub in the early hours of Monday June 8.
paras.zh: 撒拉逊人和英格兰板球之夜分别在两家酒吧举行，随后斯托克斯、阿特金森和奥瓦于 6 月 8 日星期一凌晨来到 Rex Rooms 夜总会的 VIP 区。

paras.en: The two players had broken a midnight curfew while celebrating a first Test win over New Zealand at Lord's and both were dropped for the second Test.
paras.zh: 两名选手在洛德球场庆祝首次测试赛战胜新西兰队时打破了午夜宵禁，两人都被放弃参加第二次测试赛。

paras.en: An England and Wales Cricket Board investigation cleared Stokes and Atkinson of violent conduct, finding they had been blameless victims of "unprovoked attacks".
paras.zh: 英格兰和威尔士板球委员会的一项调查证实斯托克斯和阿特金森没有暴力行为，发现他们是“无端袭击”的无可指责的受害者。

paras.en: Stokes and Atkinson were given formal written warnings for breaching their central contracts before returning for the third Test at Trent Bridge, where Stokes resigned the captaincy and announced his retirement from international cricket.
paras.zh: 斯托克斯和阿特金森因违反中央合同而收到正式书面警告，然后返回特伦特桥进行第三次测试，斯托克斯在那里辞去了队长职务并宣布从国际板球界退役。

paras.en: Atkinson has remained in the England set-up and has since been awarded another central contract.
paras.zh: 阿特金森仍然留在英格兰队，并获得了另一份中央合同。

articles.title: 'This could get very messy, very quickly!' - Carra on Man Utd's lack of intensity

paras.en: MNF: Jamie Carragher picks apart Manchester United's lack of intensity
paras.zh: MNF：杰米·卡拉格批评曼联缺乏强度

paras.en: Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
paras.zh: 请使用Chrome浏览器以获得更方便的视频播放器

paras.en: Jamie Carragher analysed Man United's lack of intensity in the press during their 1-1 draw with Tottenham Hotspur and suggested that if it continues then questions will continue to be asked about head coach Michael Carrick.

articles.title: Coventry thump Newcastle for first home win to move out of drop zone

paras.en: Coventry City vs Newcastle United; Premier League
paras.zh: 考文垂队 vs 纽卡斯尔联队；英超联赛

paras.en: Coventry City vs Newcastle United. Premier League.
paras.zh: 考文垂队对阵纽卡斯尔联队。英超联赛。

paras.en: Coventry 4-1 Newcastle: Sky Blues earn first home win of season to move out of Premier League relegation zone
paras.zh: 考文垂 4-1 纽卡斯尔：天蓝队赢得赛季首场主场胜利，摆脱英超降级区

paras.en: Report and free match highlights as Coventry thump Newcastle 4-1 to earn first home win of season and move out of drop zone; Jack Rudoni, Sidiki Cherif, Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni goals earn back-to-back wins; Magpies suffer second consecutive away loss despite Sven Botman stunner
paras.zh: 报道和免费比赛精彩片段，考文垂 4-1 击败纽卡斯尔，赢得赛季首场主场胜利，并走出降级区；杰克·鲁多尼、西迪基·谢里夫、埃利斯·西姆斯和斯蒂芬·姆富尼的进球赢得了背靠背的胜利；尽管斯文·博特曼表现出色，但喜鹊队仍连续第二次客场失利

paras.en: Coventry made it back-to-back Premier League wins with a thumping 4-1 home victory over Newcastle to move Frank Lampard's side out of the relegation zone.
paras.zh: 考文垂主场4-1大胜纽卡斯尔联，取得英超联赛背靠背胜利，兰帕德的球队脱离了降级区。

paras.en: Goals from Jack Rudoni, teenager Sidiki Cherif and substitutes Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni gave the Sky Blues their first home win of the season.
paras.zh: 杰克·鲁多尼、少年西迪基·谢里夫以及替补球员埃利斯·西姆斯和史蒂芬·姆富尼的进球为天蓝队带来了本赛季的首场主场胜利。

paras.en: A stunning Sven Botman strike had given Newcastle hope of a comeback as they made it 2-1 in the 70th minute, but just 11 minutes later Simms restored Coventry's two-goal lead before Mfuni superbly added a fourth.
paras.zh: 斯文·博特曼的精彩进球给纽卡斯尔带来了翻盘的希望，他们在第 70 分钟将比分改写为 2-1，但仅仅 11 分钟后，西姆斯就恢复了考文垂的两球领先优势，随后姆富尼精彩地打入第四球。

paras.en: The visitors, who suffered a second consecutive 4-1 away defeat, made a nightmare start at the CBS Arena as goalkeeper Lukas Hornicek brought down summer signing Cherif to allow Rudoni to hit a sixth-minute penalty opener.
paras.zh: 客队连续第二次客场1-4失利，他们在哥伦比亚广播公司体育场(CBS Arena)打出了噩梦般的开局，门将卢卡斯·霍尼切克(Lukas Hornicek)放倒了夏季新援谢里夫(Cherif)，让鲁多尼(Rudoni)在第6分钟射入点球首开纪录。

paras.en: Newcastle responded well to falling behind but were wasteful as Matias Fernandez-Pardo missed two big chances, with his one-on-one chance cleared off the line by Bobby Thomas.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔队在落后的情况下反应良好，但浪费了马蒂亚斯·费尔南德斯·帕尔多错过的两次绝佳机会，他的一对一机会被博比·托马斯解围。

paras.en: Coventry then punished their profligacy immediately after the restart as Cherif fantastically doubled the lead in the 48th minute with the 19-year-old's powerful low strike from just outside the box, his first goal for the club.
paras.zh: 考文垂队在比赛重新开始后立即惩罚了他们的挥霍行为，谢里夫在第 48 分钟凭借这位 19 岁球员在禁区外的强力低射将领先优势扩大一倍，这是他为俱乐部打进的第一个进球。

paras.en: Botman's goal, however, was even better as he thundered home from long range, but Coventry responded well through Simm's deflected strike.
paras.zh: 然而，博特曼的进球更加出色，他从远距离雷霆般地破门得分，但考文垂通过西姆的射门偏转做出了很好的回应。

paras.en: Eighteen-year-old summer signing Mfuni, who joined from Manchester City on loan, then hit his first senior goal in the 86th minute to cap off a fine evening for Lampard's side.
paras.zh: 从曼城租借而来的 18 岁夏季新援姆富尼随后在第 86 分钟打进了他的第一个成年队进球，为兰帕德的球队度过了一个美好的夜晚。

paras.en: Coventry can make it three victories in a row when they visit winless Tottenham next Monday, live on Sky Sports, while Newcastle aim to bounce back against Aston Villa at home on Saturday, also live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 考文垂队下周一对阵未尝一胜的托特纳姆热刺队时可以取得三连胜，天空体育直播，而纽卡斯尔队的目标是周六主场迎战阿斯顿维拉，天空体育也直播。

articles.title: Deadly Saudi airport strikes mark major Mideast escalation
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — Fears of intensifying conflict were growing in Saudi Arabia on Monday after Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis launched multiple strikes on Riyadh’s airport over the weekend, killing 13 people and wounding hundreds.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯利雅得——周一，也门伊朗支持的胡塞武装对利雅得机场发动多次袭击，造成 13 人死亡、数百人受伤，人们对冲突加剧的担忧日益加剧。

paras.en: “What is clear is we remain on a strong escalation ladder,” said Adam Baron, a fellow at New America, a Washington, D.C.-based think tank, who follows Yemen and the wider Gulf region.
paras.zh: “显而易见的是，我们仍然处于强劲的升级阶梯上，”华盛顿智库新美国研究员亚当·巴伦(Adam Baron)表示，他关注也门和更广泛的海湾地区的情况。

paras.en: More than 300 people were injured when the kingdom’s main international airport was attacked Saturday, marking a major escalation in the Houthi rebel group’s campaign against the world’s leading oil exporter and key U.S. ally in the region.
paras.zh: 周六，沙特主要国际机场遭到袭击，造成 300 多人受伤，标志着胡塞叛军针对全球主要石油出口国和美国在该地区重要盟友的行动大幅升级。

paras.en: Among the victims were one American, as well as four citizens of Saudi Arabia, two Bangladeshi nationals, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Palestinian, a Syrian and one Sudanese national. The Indian Embassy in Saudi Arabia later said that an Indian national injured in Saturday’s attack had died.
paras.zh: 遇难者包括一名美国人、四名沙特阿拉伯公民、两名孟加拉国公民、一名埃及人、一名约旦人、一名巴勒斯坦人、一名叙利亚人和一名苏丹人。印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆后来表示，一名在周六袭击中受伤的印度国民已经死亡。

paras.en: Video capturing the Saturday attack showed a packed airport before the flash of an explosion sends people running for safety as debris falls on them.
paras.zh: 周六袭击事件的视频显示，机场里挤满了人，爆炸的闪光让人们纷纷逃命，碎片落在他们身上。

paras.en: The impact of the attacks were felt at the WPC Energy Congress in the Saudi capital Monday, with several top energy executives dropping off the event’s schedule.
paras.zh: 周一在沙特首都举行的 WPC 能源大会上感受到了袭击的影响，几位能源高管放弃了此次活动的日程。

paras.en: The chief executives of Exxon Mobil, TotalEnergies, Shell, Chevron and BP had all been expected at the event, which started Sunday, but were no longer on the agenda that conference organizers released early Monday, Reuters reported. The energy giants did not immediately respond to requests for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，埃克森美孚、道达尔能源、壳牌、雪佛龙和英国石油公司的首席执行官都预计将出席周日开始的活动，但会议组织者周一早些时候发布的议程已不再出现。这两家能源巨头没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: “You know this country is safe and that we hold your protection at whole heart,” Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman said, according to Reuters, as he opened Monday’s session of the gathering held just miles away from Riyadh airport. But, he added, “our gathering here does not mean the risk is gone.”
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，沙特能源大臣阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·萨勒曼亲王在周一距离利雅得机场仅几英里的会议开幕时表示：“你们知道这个国家是安全的，我们全心全意地保护你们。”但是，他补充道，“我们聚集在这里并不意味着风险已经消失。”

paras.en: He said the stepped-up fighting was serious and that the kingdom’s response must be “equally serious.”
paras.zh: 他说，战斗升级是严重的，王国的反应必须“同样严肃”。

paras.en: “There is no way that somebody will break our back. We are like a phoenix,” he separately said. “We come out of the ashes all the time and every time.”
paras.zh: “任何人都不可能折断我们的脊背。我们就像凤凰，”他单独说道。 “我们每次都从灰烬中走出来。”

paras.en: Fighting on the ground in neighboring Yemen is also intensifying, with the Houthis expanding their operations along its Red Sea coast and around the Bab el Mandeb, a key shipping route connecting the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.
paras.zh: 邻国也门的地面战斗也在加剧，胡塞武装扩大了红海沿岸和曼德海峡周围的行动，曼德海峡是连接红海和亚丁湾的一条重要航线。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia and the Houthis began fighting in 2015 after the kingdom entered Yemen’s civil war on behalf of the internationally recognized government.
paras.zh: 2015年，沙特阿拉伯代表国际公认的政府介入也门内战后，与胡塞武装开始交战。

paras.en: A period of relative calm following a 2022 ceasefire was shattered in July when the Houthis resumed attacks after accusing Saudi Arabia of striking Sanaa airport as a plane from Iran was attempting to land.
paras.zh: 7 月，胡塞武装指责沙特阿拉伯在一架来自伊朗的飞机试图降落时袭击了萨那机场，随后恢复了袭击，从而打破了 2022 年停火后一段相对平静的时期。

paras.en: Baron said the latest attacks — the deadliest by the Houthis on Saudi Arabia in more than a decade — could have a “galvanizing effect” on Washington and other international actors, including Pakistan and Turkey, which recently reached a joint defense agreement with the kingdom.
paras.zh: 巴伦表示，最新的袭击是十多年来胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯发动的最致命的一次袭击，可能会对华盛顿和其他国际行为体产生“刺激效应”，其中包括最近与沙特达成联合防御协议的巴基斯坦和土耳其。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia defiant following multiple strikes on Riyadh
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯在利雅得遭受多次袭击后表现出挑衅态度

paras.en: “As these attacks are growing stronger and stronger, on the one hand, it’s increasing the hurt on the kingdom, but it’s also increasing assessments for many that there has to be some strong effort to degrade the Houthis and restore deterrence,” Baron said.
paras.zh: 巴伦说：“随着这些袭击越来越严重，一方面，它对沙特王国造成的伤害越来越大，但也让许多人越来越认为，必须采取强有力的措施来削弱胡塞武装并恢复威慑力。”

paras.en: Washington faces mounting pressure. President Donald Trump on Saturday said he was still weighing whether to join in Saudi Arabia’s military operations against the Houthis.
paras.zh: 华盛顿面临着越来越大的压力。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周六表示，他仍在考虑是否加入沙特阿拉伯针对胡塞武装的军事行动。

paras.en: “We may. We’re gonna look at it,” he told reporters. “We just found out about the recent attack. So we’ll make a decision. We move very quickly.”
paras.zh: “我们可能会。我们会考虑一下，”他告诉记者。 “我们刚刚发现最近发生的袭击事件。所以我们会做出决定。我们行动非常快。”

paras.en: After sweeping gains by Houthi forces in Yemen last month, Trump said the rebel group had contacted the U.S. to stress that it doesn’t “want to fight with us” and would “much prefer not having us involved.”
paras.zh: 上个月胡塞武装在也门取得压倒性胜利后，特朗普表示，该反叛组织已与美国联系，强调它“不想与我们一起战斗”，并且“更愿意不让我们参与其中”。

paras.en: While the skies over Riyadh were empty Monday after flights in and out of the capital were canceled, roads were full of traffic as residents tried to get back to normal life.
paras.zh: 周一，进出首都的航班取消后，利雅得上空空无一人，但由于居民试图恢复正常生活，道路上交通堵塞。

paras.en: And in the early hours of Sunday, road crossings at the border with the United Arab Emirates were largely deserted.
paras.zh: 周日凌晨，与阿拉伯联合酋长国边境的路口基本上空无一人。

paras.en: “With the Houthis, we knew that they could hit Riyadh airport, but it’s almost about the precision,” Baron said. “There’s a great degree of anxiety in terms of ... living in a world where you can just have random armed groups hitting airports.”
paras.zh: “对于胡塞武装，我们知道他们可以袭击利雅得机场，但这几乎取决于精确度，”巴伦说。 “人们非常焦虑……生活在一个武装团体可以随机袭击机场的世界里。”

articles.title: Energy prices rise after Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ fails to move Russia or Ukraine
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: Oil and gas prices rose Monday after an “energy ceasefire” announced by President Donald Trump on Sunday failed to gain traction.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统周日宣布的“能源停火”未能获得支持后，石油和天然气价格周一上涨。

paras.en: U.S. diesel fuel futures rose slightly in late afternoon trading, while Brent crude oil jumped 2% to almost $108 per barrel and U.S. crude oil rose more than 2% to about $94.
paras.zh: 美国柴油期货在午后交易中小幅上涨，布伦特原油上涨 2%，至每桶近 108 美元，美国原油上涨超过 2%，至每桶约 94 美元。

paras.en: The price pressures continued to mount with just weeks to go before the Nov. 3 midterm elections. Republicans face a steep climb to maintain their majorities in Congress, and voters across the country cite high gas prices as a key issue affecting their votes.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日中期选举仅剩几周时间，价格压力继续加大。共和党人为了维持在国会的多数席位而面临着大幅攀升，全国各地的选民都将高油价视为影响他们选票的一个关键问题。

paras.en: The average nationwide price of diesel fuel Monday was $6.26 per gallon, nearly 80% higher than it had been at the start of the year, according to AAA data.
paras.zh: 根据 AAA 的数据，周一全国柴油平均价格为每加仑 6.26 美元，比年初上涨近 80%。

paras.en: The rising prices Monday came less than 24 hours after Trump declared that a ceasefire had been agreed to.
paras.zh: 周一价格上涨是在特朗普宣布同意停火后不到 24 小时。

paras.en: “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争已实现能源停火，立即生效。双方都已同意。不要破坏它！”特朗普在《真相社会》上撰文。

paras.en: Shortly after the president’s post, Russia renewed strikes against Ukrainian energy assets.
paras.zh: 总统上任后不久，俄罗斯再次对乌克兰能源资产发动袭击。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine learned about Trump’s ceasefire from media reports and was given no advance warning. He reiterated his position that Ukraine was open to an agreement not to target enemy energy infrastructure as long as Moscow agrees to it, too.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰是从媒体报道中得知特朗普停火的，并且没有收到任何提前警告。他重申了自己的立场，即只要莫斯科也同意，乌克兰就不会以敌方能源基础设施为目标的协议持开放态度。

paras.en: In the meantime, Russia continued with “glide bomb strikes and strikes on our energy infrastructure,” Zelenskyy said Monday, noting that a power plant in Kharkiv had recently been attacked.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯继续“对我们的能源基础设施进行滑翔炸弹袭击”，泽连斯基周一表示，并指出哈尔科夫的一座发电厂最近遭到袭击。

paras.en: “Ukraine has proposed many de-escalatory steps. Putin had one answer to all of them — ‘nyet,’” Zelenskyy said, using the Russian word for “no.”
paras.zh: “乌克兰提出了许多缓和局势的措施。普京对所有这些措施只有一个答案——‘不’，”泽连斯基说，他用的是俄语中的“不”一词。

paras.en: The Kremlin on Monday neither confirmed nor denied having agreed to a deal.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周一既没有证实也没有否认已同意达成协议。

paras.en: Trump’s Sunday announcement closely mirrored a similar post he made in September, when he announced that “Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise!”
paras.zh: 特朗普周日的声明与他九月份发表的类似帖子非常相似，当时他宣布“乌克兰已同意不攻击俄罗斯的能源目标。俄罗斯也同意这样做！”

paras.en: There, too, Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s participation hinged on Russia’s agreement to comply, which never came. Neither Ukrainian nor Russian strikes on the other’s energy assets slowed down in September.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基也表示，乌克兰的参与取决于俄罗斯是否同意遵守，但俄罗斯从未同意遵守。 9月份，乌克兰和俄罗斯对对方能源资产的打击都没有放缓。

paras.en: The dubious ceasefire Trump declared over the weekend followed a stunning announcement Friday in which the president said Russia would supply millions of barrels of diesel “to the American and Global Marketplace.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周末宣布的可疑停火是在周五发布的令人震惊的声明之后宣布的，其中总统表示俄罗斯将“向美国和全球市场”供应数百万桶柴油。

paras.en: The announcement came after a phone call Friday between Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin that reportedly lasted over an hour.
paras.zh: 据报道，周五特朗普与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了长达一个多小时的通话后宣布了这一消息。

paras.en: Trump said the deal with Putin would “immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace.” That would translate into about 2.25 million barrels of diesel, or less diesel than the United States uses in just one day.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，与普京的协议将“立即向美国和全球市场供应超过 30 万吨柴油”。这意味着约 225 万桶柴油，比美国一天使用的柴油还要少。

paras.en: Further details and logistics of Russia’s plan had yet to be announced Monday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯计划的更多细节和后勤工作尚未于周一公布。

paras.en: In addition to the Russia deal, Trump has pressured G7 allies to release more diesel fuel supplies in recent days and lifted domestic restrictions on an off-road variety of diesel.
paras.zh: 除了与俄罗斯的协议外，特朗普最近几天还向七国集团盟友施压，要求释放更多柴油供应，并取消了国内对越野柴油的限制。

paras.en: In order to clear a legal path for the diesel deal, the Treasury Department announced a six-month suspension of the fuel sanctions imposed on the Kremlin in 2022 for its illegal invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 为了为柴油交易扫清法律道路，美国财政部宣布暂停对克里姆林宫2022年因非法入侵乌克兰而实施的燃料制裁六个月。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials, European allies and some U.S. lawmakers were aghast at the deal and the U.S. decision to unilaterally ease Russia sanctions.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员、欧洲盟友和一些美国议员对该协议以及美国单方面放松对俄罗斯制裁的决定感到震惊。

paras.en: Trump defended the deal Monday, calling it “the right choice for the American People.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周一为该协议辩护，称其为“美国人民的正确选择”。

paras.en: Trump also said more diesel fuel would be made available “within a short period of time,” if Russia’s refineries could produce it.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，如果俄罗斯炼油厂能够生产更多柴油，“在短时间内”将提供更多柴油。

paras.en: Yet experts are highly skeptical that there will be any significant resumption of Russian diesel exports in the near term.
paras.zh: 然而，专家们对俄罗斯柴油出口短期内能否大幅恢复持高度怀疑态度。

paras.en: Due to Ukrainian strikes deep inside Russia, refiners that produce oil, gas and diesel have suffered heavy damage.
paras.zh: 由于乌克兰对俄罗斯境内的袭击，生产石油、天然气和柴油的炼油厂遭受了严重损失。

paras.en: “Reported gasoline output is down by 20% compared with 2025 levels, while diesel production is estimated to have fallen by nearly 30%, prompting the government to restrict fuel exports to protect domestic supplies,” analysts at the International Energy Agency wrote in a September report.
paras.zh: 国际能源署分析师在 9 月份的一份报告中写道：“与 2025 年水平相比，报告的汽油产量下降了 20%，而柴油产量估计下降了近 30%，促使政府限制燃料出口以保护国内供应。”

paras.en: For weeks, Trump has focused on the price of diesel fuel, which began rising as a result of the Iran war that the U.S. and Israel launched in February.
paras.zh: 几周来，特朗普一直关注柴油价格，由于美国和以色列二月份发动伊朗战争，柴油价格开始上涨。

paras.en: In July, escalations in the Russia-Ukraine war began adding to the pressure on diesel prices.
paras.zh: 7月份，俄罗斯和乌克兰战争的升级开始加大柴油价格的压力。

paras.en: As Ukrainian drones systematically targeted Russian energy assets, the Kremlin responded by restricting diesel exports in order to preserve its supply for domestic use.
paras.zh: 当乌克兰无人机有系统地瞄准俄罗斯能源资产时，克里姆林宫的回应是限制柴油出口，以保留其国内使用的供应。

paras.en: Until then, Russia had been one of the world’s top exporters of refined oil products, which include diesel fuel.
paras.zh: 在此之前，俄罗斯一直是世界上最大的成品油出口国之一，其中包括柴油。

paras.en: Russia said Friday that it would lift some of its export restrictions in order to accommodate the deal with Trump. But it was unclear how fast that would happen.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯周五表示，将取消部分出口限制，以适应与特朗普的协议。但尚不清楚这会发生多快。

articles.title: Rain turns dry paddocks into bumper crops after years of drought
articles.author: Eliza Berlage and Amelia Walters

paras.en: Farmers struggling to keep cashflow coming a year ago are preparing to harvest the best crop in living memory.
paras.zh: 一年前，努力保持现金流的农民正准备收获人们记忆中最好的作物。

paras.en: As long as locusts do not interfere, many say it will be the first time they make a profit in years.
paras.zh: 许多人表示，只要蝗虫不干扰，这将是他们多年来第一次盈利。

paras.en: Grain Producers SA predicts a record-breaking 13 million tonnes of grain will be harvested in 2026.
paras.zh: Grain Producers SA 预计 2026 年粮食产量将达到创纪录的 1300 万吨。

paras.en: This time last year the cropping paddocks at the Fisher's farm were filled with mounds of red sand, as a pregnant Kiara worried about how her family would make ends meet.
paras.zh: 去年的这个时候，费舍尔农场的农作物围场里堆满了红沙堆，怀孕的基拉担心她的家人如何维持生计。

paras.en: Almost 12 months on, the crops are so high her three-year-old daughter Aurora almost disappears when she runs through them.
paras.zh: 近 12 个月过去了，庄稼长得很茂盛，她三岁的女儿奥罗拉 (Aurora) 跑过庄稼时几乎消失了。

paras.en: Above-average rainfall in parts of South Australia has brought relief to families like Ms Fisher's, at Bugle Hut in the Riverland, about 270 kilometres from Adelaide.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚部分地区高于平均水平的降雨量给像费舍尔女士这样的家庭带来了缓解，她住在距离阿德莱德约 270 公里的 Riverland 的 Bugle Hut。

paras.en: Her property has received 330 millimetres of rain this year, well above their average of 250mm.
paras.zh: 她的房产今年降雨量为 330 毫米，远高于平均水平 250 毫米。

paras.en: "Where we sit now, this was entirely dirt and this year my husband's had to slash it three times already," she said.
paras.zh: “我们现在坐的地方，这完全是泥土，今年我丈夫已经不得不把它砍了三刀，”她说。

paras.en: "There were crops out there last year, but they'd be lucky to be grazing the tops of your ankles … [but] this year my three-year-old daughter … you can barely see her in them."
paras.zh: “去年那里有庄稼，但如果它们能擦过你的脚踝就很幸运了……[但是]今年我三岁的女儿……你几乎看不到她穿着它们。”

paras.en: Ms Fisher was optimistic reaping this year's wheat and barley crop will allow them to rebuild.
paras.zh: 费舍尔女士乐观地表示，今年小麦和大麦的收成将使他们能够重建家园。

paras.en: Off-farm work and the federal government's family household allowance have helped them stay afloat amid four years of drought.
paras.zh: 非农工作和联邦政府的家庭补贴帮助他们在四年的干旱中维持生计。

paras.en: "It'll be really nice just to wipe our slates clean and know that for the first time in a few years we've farmed for something," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“如果能把我们的记录擦干净，并知道几年来我们第一次为某种东西而耕种，那就太好了。”

paras.en: Down the road at her farm at Maggea, Louise Smith has received 350mm so far this year, more than double last year's total of 115mm.
paras.zh: 在马吉亚 (Maggea) 农场的路上，Louise Smith 今年迄今已收到 350 毫米的收割量，是去年总收割量 115 毫米的两倍多。

paras.en: "We were like kids in a lolly factory, just running around playing in the mud like wow we are three-year-olds,"
paras.zh: “我们就像棒棒糖工厂里的孩子，在泥巴里跑来跑去玩，就像哇我们三岁的孩子一样，”

paras.en: She hoped to turn a profit for the first time in about seven years, having sown her paddocks with rye, barley, wheat and oats.
paras.zh: 她希望在围场上种植黑麦、大麦、小麦和燕麦，从而实现大约七年来的首次盈利。

paras.en: "You drive into town, there's actually people, they stop and chat. There's happy smiles and it's not everyone thinking, 'Where do we go next?'" she said.
paras.zh: “你开车进城，实际上有人，他们停下来聊天。那里有幸福的微笑，并不是每个人都在想，‘我们下一步去哪里？’”她说。

paras.en: "You talk to your neighbours, everyone's just happy. It's a good feeling."
paras.zh: “你和邻居交谈，每个人都很高兴。这种感觉很好。”

paras.en: The improved conditions have also seen her sheep and cattle, which were hand-fed during the drought, grow fat.
paras.zh: 条件的改善也让她在干旱期间手工喂养的羊和牛都长胖了。

paras.en: Many of Louise Smith's sheep did not survive last year's harsh drought conditions. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: 路易丝·史密斯（Louise Smith）的许多羊未能在去年的严酷干旱条件下生存。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

paras.en: Holding onto starving stock was a difficult decision, but one that has paid off, with other farmers who destocked now unable to afford to buy.
paras.zh: 保留饥饿的库存是一个艰难的决定，但这个决定已经得到了回报，因为其他减少库存的农民现在买不起。

paras.en: "I think looking back now, 12 months on, we made all the right decisions we could have made back then to get us to the best position we could to get into this season," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为现在回想起来，12 个月过去了，我们做出了当时可以做出的所有正确决定，让我们达到了进入本赛季的最佳位置，”她说。

paras.en: Louise Smith has not had to hand-feed her Charolais cattle this year. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: 路易丝·史密斯今年不必手工喂养她的夏洛莱牛。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

paras.en: "We've got control over our own operation again. It's a very good feeling."
paras.zh: “我们再次掌控了自己的运营。这种感觉非常好。”

paras.en: Headers have begun rolling across paddocks in the west of the state, but most farmers are still gearing up to bring in a bumper crop.
paras.zh: 该州西部的围场上已经开始收割，但大多数农民仍在为丰收做好准备。

paras.en: Grain Producers South Australia chief executive Brad Perry said the 2026/27 harvest was expected to break records.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚谷物生产商首席执行官 Brad Perry 表示，2026/27 年收成预计将打破纪录。

paras.en: Brad Perry says this year will be record-breaking as long as harvest goes to plan. (ABC News: Marco Catalano)
paras.zh: 布拉德·佩里表示，只要收成按计划进行，今年的收成将打破纪录。 （美国广播公司新闻：马可·卡塔拉诺）

paras.en: "An average tonnage for harvest in South Australia in the grain sector is about 9 million tonnes," he said.
paras.zh: “南澳大利亚粮食部门的平均收获吨数约为 900 万吨，”他说。

paras.en: "We're looking at eclipsing that from all reports to about 13 million tonnes."
paras.zh: “我们正在考虑将所有报告中的数字增至约 1300 万吨。”

paras.en: There were some difficulties for growers, with frost events and disease pressure also affecting crops in some regions.
paras.zh: 种植者面临一些困难，霜冻事件和疾病压力也影响了一些地区的作物。

paras.en: Louise Smith and Kiara Fisher say they will likely begin harvesting towards the end of November. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: Louise Smith 和 Kiara Fisher 表示，他们可能会在 11 月底开始收获。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

paras.en: The logistics of harvesting a bumper crop will also prove a challenge.
paras.zh: 丰收的后勤工作也将是一个挑战。

paras.en: Back at Bugle Hut, Ms Fisher said while the drought had broken, farmers were not quite out of the woods yet.
paras.zh: 回到号角小屋，费舍尔女士表示，虽然干旱已经结束，但农民还没有完全摆脱困境。

paras.en: The looming challenges were numerous from low grain prices to locusts threatening crops and skyrocketing input costs, with diesel prices adding an extra $200,000 hit to their budget.
paras.zh: 迫在眉睫的挑战有很多，从谷物价格低廉到蝗虫威胁农作物，再到投入成本飙升，柴油价格使他们的预算额外增加了 20 万美元。

paras.en: "We're going to have to sell most of our saleable grain that we're not holding onto to for feed just to pay the bills from the last three years," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们将不得不出售大部分可销售的谷物，而这些谷物不是我们用来做饲料的，只是为了支付过去三年的账单。”

paras.en: "When the universe provides in the ways that it has this year, as far as weather goes, then it's certainly hit you in other areas."
paras.zh: “当宇宙以今年的方式提供时，就天气而言，它肯定会对其他领域产生影响。”

paras.en: Locust nymphs have already been spotted across the Riverland and Mallee ahead of harvest, spiking concern among farmers. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: 在收获之前，河地和马利地区已经发现了蝗虫若虫，这引起了农民的担忧。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

articles.title: Breaking: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte dies age 34

paras.en: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte has died aged 34, international media outlets are reporting.
paras.zh: 据国际媒体报道，《绝命毒师》明星 RJ Mitte 去世，享年 34 岁。

paras.en: Mitte was best known for his role as the son of drug kingpin Walter White in the hit television series.
paras.zh: 米特因在热门电视剧中饰演毒枭沃尔特·怀特的儿子而闻名。

paras.en: "It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte," his representative said in a statement reported by the BBC, Variety and Deadline.
paras.zh: 他的代表在 BBC、Variety 和 Deadline 报道的一份声明中表示：“我们怀着深切的悲痛，分享深受喜爱的演员、慈善家和热情的残疾人权利倡导者 RJ Mitte 的悲惨去世。”

articles.title: Live: Oil prices on the rise as energy supply concerns continue
articles.author: Stephanie Chalmers and Alex Turner-Cohen

paras.en: Markets live updates: Oil prices climb, ASX poised to open higher after mixed lead
paras.zh: 市场实时更新：油价攀升，澳大利亚证券交易所在涨跌互现后准备高开

paras.en: Oil prices continue to climb, with Brent crude approaching $US107 overnight.
paras.zh: 油价继续攀升，布伦特原油隔夜逼近 107 美元。

paras.en: The ASX looks set for another positive start to the session, following a mixed finish on Wall Street.
paras.zh: 继华尔街股市涨跌互现之后，澳大利亚证券交易所看起来将迎来另一个积极的开局。

paras.en: Follow the day's financial news and insights from our specialist business reporters on our live blog.
paras.zh: 在我们的实时博客上关注我们的专业商业记者当天的财经新闻和见解。

paras.en: Disclaimer: this blog is not intended as investment advice.
paras.zh: 免责声明：本博客无意作为投资建议。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Oil rallies, sending dollar higher on expectations of higher US rates
paras.zh: 油价上涨，因美国加息预期推高美元

paras.en: Oil prices climbed overnight as attacks on Saudi Arabia overshadowed hopes for supply improvements, and expectations for higher US interest rates to fight inflation drove the dollar higher on a narrowly mixed day for global stocks.
paras.zh: 由于对沙特阿拉伯的袭击掩盖了供应改善的希望，以及美国加息以对抗通胀的预期推动美元走高，全球股市涨跌互现，油价隔夜攀升。

paras.en: The action came after US President Donald Trump hailed fresh Russian diesel exports and a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire.
paras.zh: 此前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对俄罗斯新的柴油出口和俄罗斯与乌克兰能源停火表示欢迎。

paras.en: The greenback's rise in recent months has been driven in large part by expectations that high prices for energy and other goods will force the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates at a time when US growth is stronger than in other rich economies. This could expand the rate differentials that drive currency movements.
paras.zh: 美元近几个月的上涨在很大程度上是由于预期能源和其他商品的高价格将迫使美联储在美国经济增长强于其他富裕经济体之际加息。这可能会扩大推动货币波动的利差。

paras.en: While the US bond market was closed for the Columbus Day holiday, investors were cautiously waiting for September inflation data and the third-quarter earnings season, which begins tomorrow with earnings from major US banks.
paras.zh: 虽然美国债券市场因哥伦布日假期休市，但投资者仍在谨慎等待 9 月份通胀数据和第三季度财报季，该季财报季将于明天开始，美国主要银行将公布财报。

paras.en: "There's a lot to be wary of," said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth Management.
paras.zh: 达科他财富管理公司高级投资组合经理罗伯特·帕夫利克表示：“有很多事情需要警惕。”

paras.en: "You're walking down a train line and you don't know, because it's dark, if a train is coming and so, you know, you're just being real careful right today."
paras.zh: “你沿着火车线路行走，你不知道，因为天黑了，火车是否会来，所以，你知道，你今天要非常小心。”
