articles.title: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy

paras.en: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
paras.zh: 科学家可能找到了聚变能源的捷径

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a potentially far more efficient path to fusion ignition that could bring the dream of practical fusion energy closer to reality.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现了一种可能更有效的聚变点火途径，可以使实用聚变能源的梦想更接近现实。

paras.en: - Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory may have found a dramatically more efficient route to fusion energy by reversing the traditional approach: heating plasma first, then increasing its density. Their calculations could help future reactors reach self-sustaining fusion with far less energy while avoiding hidden problems that make ignition harder.
paras.zh: - 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室可能已经通过扭转传统方法找到了一种更有效的聚变能途径：首先加热等离子体，然后增加其密度。他们的计算可以帮助未来的反应堆以少得多的能量实现自我维持聚变，同时避免导致点火更加困难的隐藏问题。

paras.en: Scientists at the U.S.Department of Energy's (DOE) Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL) have identified a potentially much more efficient way to achieve fusion ignition, a major milestone in the pursuit of practical fusion energy. Their calculations suggest that changing the order in which plasma is heated and compressed could dramatically reduce the energy needed to reach a self-sustaining fusion reaction.
paras.zh: 美国能源部 (DOE) 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室 (PPPL) 的科学家们已经找到了一种可能更有效的实现聚变点火的方法，这是追求实用聚变能的一个重要里程碑。他们的计算表明，改变等离子体加热和压缩的顺序可以大大减少实现自持聚变反应所需的能量。

paras.en: For more than seven decades, fusion researchers have relied on a mathematical rule to determine whether plasma can remain sufficiently hot and dense, for a long enough period, to sustain fusion without additional external heating. Known as the Lawson criterion, this equation defines the conditions required for ignition. However, it does not explain the most efficient way to achieve them.
paras.zh: 七十多年来，聚变研究人员一直依靠数学规则来确定等离子体是否可以在足够长的时间内保持足够的热度和密度，从而在没有额外外部加热的情况下维持聚变。该方程称为劳森准则，定义了点火所需的条件。但是，它没有解释实现这些目标的最有效方法。

paras.en: Now, PPPL physicists Luis Delgado-Aparicio, Masayuki Ono, and Jonathan Menard have developed a more comprehensive version of the criterion. By incorporating four additional factors that influence fusion performance, they have mapped a promising route to ignition that could require substantially less energy than alternative approaches.
paras.zh: 现在，PPPL 物理学家 Luis Delgado-Aparicio、Masayuki Ono 和 Jonathan Menard 开发了该标准的更全面版本。通过纳入影响聚变性能的四个额外因素，他们绘制了一条有希望的点火路线，与其他方法相比，该路线所需的能量要少得多。

paras.en: Their findings were published in the journal Physical Review Letters.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果发表在《物理评论快报》杂志上。

paras.en: The research focuses on plasma, often called the fourth state of matter. Plasma forms when a gas becomes so energetic that its particles carry electrical charges. In fusion reactors, this extremely hot material contains the atomic nuclei that researchers hope to combine, releasing energy through nuclear fusion.
paras.zh: 该研究的重点是等离子体，通常被称为物质的第四态。当气体变得如此高能以至于其粒子带有电荷时，等离子体就会形成。在聚变反应堆中，这种极热的材料含有研究人员希望结合的原子核，通过核聚变释放能量。

paras.en: The ultimate goal is to produce a burning plasma, in which fusion reactions generate enough heat to sustain the process without continued external heating. Reaching this state efficiently remains one of the most important challenges in fusion energy research.
paras.zh: 最终目标是产生燃烧的等离子体，其中聚变反应产生足够的热量来维持该过程，而无需持续的外部加热。有效地达到这种状态仍然是聚变能研究中最重要的挑战之一。

paras.en: Scientists Find a Shortcut to Fusion Ignition
paras.zh: 科学家找到聚变点火的捷径

paras.en: Delgado-Aparicio compares the discovery to finding a more efficient route through a mountain range.
paras.zh: 德尔加多-阿帕里西奥将这一发现比作寻找一条穿越山脉的更有效路线。

paras.en: Imagine that the energy requirements for fusion ignition form a landscape dominated by a towering mountain. The destination lies on the other side, but there are several possible routes to reach it.
paras.zh: 想象一下，聚变点火所需的能量形成了一座以高耸的山脉为主的景观。目的地位于另一边，但有多种可能的路线可以到达。

paras.en: Many proposed fusion strategies effectively attempt to climb directly over the mountain. They begin by increasing the density of the plasma and then supplying the enormous amount of heat needed to reach ignition.
paras.zh: 许多提出的融合策略有效地试图直接翻越这座山。他们首先增加等离子体的密度，然后提供点燃所需的大量热量。

paras.en: The new calculations suggest that a different sequence could be considerably more efficient. Instead of increasing density first, researchers could heat the plasma before making it denser. This alternative route avoids the highest energy requirements while still reaching the desired conditions.
paras.zh: 新的计算表明，不同的顺序可能会更加有效。研究人员可以先加热等离子体，然后再使其密度更大，而不是首先增加密度。这种替代路线避免了最高的能量需求，同时仍达到所需的条件。

paras.en: "A lot of companies want to climb the mountain head-on and spend enormous energy to get there," Delgado-Aparicio said. "Go around the peak instead. You reach the same place in a much smarter way, and you use far less energy."
paras.zh: 德尔加多-阿帕里西奥说：“很多公司都想正面攀登这座山，并花费巨大的精力到达那里。” “而是绕过山顶。你可以以更聪明的方式到达同一个地方，而且使用的能源也少得多。”

paras.en: The Hidden Mountain Pass in Fusion Physics
paras.zh: 聚变物理中隐藏的山口

paras.en: The researchers identified a particularly important region of this mathematical landscape called the Cordey saddle.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了这个数学景观中一个特别重要的区域，称为科迪鞍区。

paras.en: In geographical terms, a saddle is a low passage between higher elevations. In fusion physics, the Cordey saddle represents a relatively accessible point along the boundary separating plasma that still needs outside heating from plasma capable of sustaining its own fusion reactions.
paras.zh: 从地理角度来说，马鞍是较高海拔之间的低洼通道。在聚变物理学中，科迪鞍代表了沿分离等离子体边界的一个相对容易接近的点，该点仍然需要来自等离子体的外部加热才能维持其自身的聚变反应。

paras.en: To evaluate different routes, the scientists used a measurement called Q, which compares the power produced by fusion reactions with the external heating power supplied to the plasma.
paras.zh: 为了评估不同的路线，科学家们使用了一种称为 Q 的测量方法，它将聚变反应产生的功率与提供给等离子体的外部加热功率进行比较。

paras.en: For example, a Q value of 5 means the fusion reactions produce five times as much power as the external heating system delivers.
paras.zh: 例如，Q 值为 5 意味着聚变反应产生的功率是外部加热系统提供的功率的五倍。

paras.en: In an idealized plasma containing only pure fusion fuel, the Cordey saddle occurs at approximately Q = 5. However, actual fusion systems are much more complicated. Contaminants within the plasma and extremely strong magnetic fields can shift the location of this passage, increasing the Q value needed to reach it.
paras.zh: 在仅包含纯聚变燃料的理想化等离子体中，科迪鞍发生在大约 Q = 5 处。然而，实际的聚变系统要复杂得多。等离子体内的污染物和极强的磁场会改变该通道的位置，从而增加到达该通道所需的 Q 值。

paras.en: Understanding how these conditions change is essential for determining whether a proposed fusion reactor can realistically achieve ignition.
paras.zh: 了解这些条件如何变化对于确定拟议的聚变反应堆是否能够真正实现点火至关重要。

paras.en: A More Realistic Roadmap for Future Fusion Reactors
paras.zh: 未来聚变反应堆更现实的路线图

paras.en: The findings could influence the design of two major types of magnetic fusion devices: tokamaks and stellarators.
paras.zh: 这些发现可能会影响两种主要类型磁聚变装置的设计：托卡马克和仿星器。

paras.en: Both approaches use powerful magnetic fields to confine plasma while it is heated to the extraordinary temperatures needed for fusion. Tokamaks, which have a characteristic doughnut shape, are among the leading technologies being investigated for future fusion power plants.
paras.zh: 这两种方法都使用强大的磁场来限制等离子体，同时将其加热到聚变所需的异常温度。托卡马克具有独特的甜甜圈形状，是未来聚变发电厂正在研究的领先技术之一。

paras.en: Research institutions and private companies are pursuing several different ways to generate electricity from fusion and eventually deliver that power to the electrical grid. Identifying an efficient route to ignition could help engineers design more practical systems while avoiding costly mistakes.
paras.zh: 研究机构和私营公司正在寻求几种不同的方法来通过聚变发电并最终将电力输送到电网。确定有效的点火途径可以帮助工程师设计更实用的系统，同时避免代价高昂的错误。

paras.en: For PPPL, this work is part of a broader effort to address the scientific and technological challenges that must be overcome before commercial fusion power becomes possible, including the development of future fusion pilot plants.
paras.zh: 对于 PPPL 来说，这项工作是更广泛努力的一部分，旨在解决商业聚变发电成为可能之前必须克服的科学和技术挑战，包括开发未来聚变试验工厂。

paras.en: One of the study's major advances is that it evaluates several important physical processes together rather than examining them separately, as much previous research has done.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要进展之一是它同时评估了几个重要的物理过程，而不是像以前的研究那样单独检查它们。

paras.en: The researchers incorporated four additional factors that can influence whether a plasma reaches and maintains ignition:
paras.zh: 研究人员纳入了四个可能影响等离子体是否达到并维持点火的附加因素：

paras.en: - Helium ash buildup: Fusion reactions produce helium as a byproduct. As this spent fuel accumulates, it can dilute the remaining fusion fuel and reduce performance.
paras.zh: - 氦灰堆积：聚变反应产生副产品氦。随着乏燃料的积累，它会稀释剩余的聚变燃料并降低性能。

paras.en: - Plasma contamination: Light and heavy impurities can enter the plasma from materials lining the inside of the reactor, interfering with fusion conditions.
paras.zh: - 等离子体污染：轻杂质和重杂质可以从反应堆内部衬里的材料进入等离子体，干扰聚变条件。

paras.en: - Synchrotron radiation: Electrons traveling through magnetic fields emit radiation, carrying energy away from the plasma.
paras.zh: - 同步辐射：穿过磁场的电子发出辐射，将能量从等离子体中带走。

paras.en: - Heat loss: Energy continuously escapes from the plasma, and these losses can become greater as its temperature rises.
paras.zh: - 热损失：能量不断从等离子体中逸出，并且随着温度升高，这些损失会变得更大。

paras.en: Accounting for these effects produces a more realistic picture of the conditions future reactors must achieve.
paras.zh: 考虑到这些影响，可以更真实地了解未来反应堆必须达到的条件。

paras.en: "When you leave these effects out, you say the design will work fine," Ono said. "When you put them in, the picture changes, and it becomes quite important."
paras.zh: “当你忽略这些影响时，你会说设计会很好地工作，”小野说。 “当你把它们放进去时，情况就会发生变化，这变得非常重要。”

paras.en: According to Ono, the goal is to establish a more reliable, widely applicable model that scientists can use to evaluate fusion reactor designs before construction begins.
paras.zh: 小野表示，目标是建立一个更可靠、更广泛适用的模型，科学家可以用它在建造开始之前评估聚变反应堆设计。

paras.en: Treating the Lawson criterion as a single unchanging threshold overlooks physical processes that can substantially alter the requirements for ignition. Including those effects early in the design process could prevent expensive problems later.
paras.zh: 将劳森准则视为单一不变的阈值忽略了可以显着改变点火要求的物理过程。在设计过程的早期包括这些影响可以防止以后出现代价高昂的问题。

paras.en: "Fusion experiments cost a great deal of money, and you do not want to make mistakes you could have caught beforehand," he said.
paras.zh: “聚变实验花费了大量资金，而且你不想犯本来可以提前发现的错误，”他说。

paras.en: Tiny Amounts of Tungsten Could Make Fusion Much Harder
paras.zh: 少量的钨会使聚变变得更加困难

paras.en: One particularly striking finding concerns tungsten, an extremely heat-resistant metal selected for the interior walls of more than a dozen next-generation fusion machines.
paras.zh: 一个特别引人注目的发现涉及钨，这是一种极其耐热的金属，被选用于十几台下一代熔合机的内壁。

paras.en: Tungsten is attractive because fusion reactors must withstand conditions involving plasma temperatures greater than those found at the center of the sun. However, the material also presents a significant challenge if even tiny quantities enter the plasma.
paras.zh: 钨很有吸引力，因为聚变反应堆必须承受等离子体温度高于太阳中心温度的条件。然而，即使微量进入等离子体，这种材料也会带来重大挑战。

paras.en: The team's calculations show that tungsten contamination at a concentration of just one part in 10,000 can approximately double the pressure required to achieve fusion ignition.
paras.zh: 该团队的计算表明，浓度仅为万分之一的钨污染可以使实现聚变点火所需的压力大约增加一倍。

paras.en: That is a substantial increase caused by an exceptionally small amount of material.
paras.zh: 这是由于极少量的材料而导致的大幅增加。

paras.en: The calculations were initially developed in two dimensions. When the researchers extended their analysis to three dimensions, they found that the pressure needed for ignition could exceed the limits at which the plasma remains stable.
paras.zh: 计算最初是在二维上进行的。当研究人员将分析扩展到三个维度时，他们发现点火所需的压力可能超过等离子体保持稳定的极限。

paras.en: This suggests that seemingly minor contamination could have major consequences for the feasibility of certain fusion reactor designs.
paras.zh: 这表明看似轻微的污染可能会对某些聚变反应堆设计的可行性产生重大影响。

paras.en: How Energy Losses Could Help Stabilize Fusion
paras.zh: 能量损失如何帮助稳定聚变

paras.en: Surprisingly, some of the processes that make ignition more difficult may also help fusion reactors operate more safely and consistently.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，一些使点火更加困难的过程也可能有助于聚变反应堆更安全、更一致地运行。

paras.en: Scientists have long investigated the possibility of thermal "runaway" instability. This occurs when heat from fusion reactions increases the reaction rate, producing still more heat and potentially creating a self-reinforcing cycle.
paras.zh: 科学家们长期以来一直在研究热“失控”不稳定性的可能性。当聚变反应产生的热量提高反应速率，产生更多热量并可能形成自我强化循环时，就会发生这种情况。

paras.en: The researchers found that energy losses within the plasma can naturally counteract this effect.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，等离子体内的能量损失可以自然地抵消这种影响。

paras.en: Although those losses increase the difficulty of reaching ignition, they also provide a balancing influence that could allow a burning plasma to maintain a stable operating state without constant adjustments.
paras.zh: 尽管这些损失增加了达到点火的难度，但它们也提供了平衡影响，可以使燃烧的等离子体保持稳定的运行状态，而无需不断调整。

paras.en: This balance could be valuable for future reactor designs.
paras.zh: 这种平衡对于未来的反应堆设计可能很有价值。

paras.en: (Unlike a fission power plant, a fusion system holds only seconds of fuel at a time, so losing control means the plasma cools and the burn stops rather than anything worse.)
paras.zh: （与裂变发电厂不同，聚变系统一次只能容纳几秒钟的燃料，因此失去控制意味着等离子体冷却并且燃烧停止，而不是更糟糕的情况。）

paras.en: Liquid Lithium and Advanced Fuel Could Improve Fusion Efficiency
paras.zh: 液态锂和先进燃料可以提高聚变效率

paras.en: The study also identifies technologies that might help overcome some of the obstacles revealed by the calculations.
paras.zh: 该研究还确定了可能有助于克服计算所揭示的一些障碍的技术。

paras.en: One possibility involves coating the inside of fusion reactors with liquid lithium, a technique PPPL researchers have investigated for years.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是在聚变反应堆内部涂上液态锂，PPPL 研究人员多年来一直在研究这项技术。

paras.en: These coatings could help prevent tungsten from entering the plasma while reducing heat losses, making it easier to maintain the extreme conditions necessary for fusion.
paras.zh: 这些涂层可以帮助防止钨进入等离子体，同时减少热损失，从而更容易维持聚变所需的极端条件。

paras.en: Another promising approach uses spin-polarized fuel. This involves preparing the atomic nuclei so that their spins are aligned before fusion occurs, which can increase the fusion reaction rate.
paras.zh: 另一种有前途的方法使用自旋极化燃料。这涉及到准备原子核，使其自旋在聚变发生前对齐，这可以提高聚变反应速率。

paras.en: Together, these strategies could improve the performance of future reactors and make the path to ignition more achievable.
paras.zh: 总之，这些策略可以提高未来反应堆的性能，并使点火之路更容易实现。

paras.en: What Comes Next for the New Fusion Strategy?
paras.zh: 新融合战略的下一步是什么？

paras.en: Despite the promising findings, the proposed heat-first approach has not yet been demonstrated experimentally.
paras.zh: 尽管有这些有希望的发现，但所提出的热优先方法尚未经过实验证明。

paras.en: The research is theoretical and relies on mathematical calculations rather than direct measurements. Existing fusion experiments have not reached the temperatures associated with the Cordey saddle, preventing scientists from testing the predicted route under those conditions.
paras.zh: 该研究是理论性的，依赖于数学计算而不是直接测量。现有的聚变实验尚未达到与科迪鞍相关的温度，这使得科学家无法在这些条件下测试预测的路线。

paras.en: The PPPL team plans to investigate the approach further through digital experiments, using computer-based simulations to explore whether heating plasma before increasing its density can deliver the expected advantages.
paras.zh: PPPL 团队计划通过数字实验进一步研究该方法，使用基于计算机的模拟来探索在增加密度之前加热等离子体是否可以带来预期的优势。

paras.en: If future studies confirm the calculations, the findings could provide an important foundation for designing more efficient fusion systems and help researchers make better decisions about reactor construction.
paras.zh: 如果未来的研究证实了这些计算结果，那么这些发现可以为设计更高效的聚变系统提供重要基础，并帮助研究人员就反应堆建设做出更好的决策。

paras.en: "While more study is needed, we are excited by these results, and they suggest a clear path forward for future research in this area," said Menard.
paras.zh: 梅纳德说：“虽然还需要更多的研究，但我们对这些结果感到兴奋，它们为该领域的未来研究提供了明确的前进道路。”

paras.en: The work was supported by the DOE Office of Science, Office of Fusion Energy Sciences, under contract DE-AC02-09CH11466. Additional support came through a 2015 Fusion Energy Sciences Early Career Award, a 2018 Diagnostic Innovation and Development award, and the 2021 and 2025 Long-Pulse Tokamak Research Programs.
paras.zh: 这项工作得到了美国能源部科学办公室、聚变能源科学办公室的支持，合同为 DE-AC02-09CH11466。其他支持还包括 2015 年聚变能源科学早期职业奖、2018 年诊断创新与发展奖以及 2021 年和 2025 年长脉冲托卡马克研究计划。

paras.en: Materials provided by Princeton University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由普林斯顿大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Luis F. Delgado-Aparicio, Masayuki Ono, Jonathan E. Menard. Generalized Lawson-Cordey-Mills Accessibility of Fusion Ignition. Physical Review Letters, 2026; 137 (11) DOI: 10.1103/mmc9-nzfx
paras.zh: - 路易斯·F·德尔加多-阿帕里西奥、小野雅之、乔纳森·E·梅纳德。聚变点火的广义 Lawson-Cordey-Mills 可达性。物理评论快报，2026； 137（11）DOI：10.1103/mmc9-nzfx

articles.title: A surprisingly simple way to relieve knee arthritis pain without pills or surgery

paras.en: A surprisingly simple way to relieve knee arthritis pain without pills or surgery
paras.zh: 一种无需药物或手术即可缓解膝关节炎疼痛的简单方法

paras.en: A simple change in how you walk could ease knee arthritis pain as effectively as medication while helping protect cartilage from further damage.
paras.zh: 简单改变走路方式就可以像药物一样有效地缓解膝关节炎疼痛，同时有助于保护软骨免受进一步损伤。

paras.en: - A surprisingly simple change in how you walk could help relieve knee arthritis pain and even slow joint damage. In a year-long clinical trial, researchers found that adjusting the angle of a person's foot while walking reduced osteoarthritis pain by an amount comparable to medication, without requiring drugs or surgery. Even more promising, MRI scans revealed that participants who adopted the personalized walking technique experienced slower deterioration in a marker of knee cartilage health.
paras.zh: - 步行方式的一个令人惊讶的简单改变可以帮助缓解膝关节炎疼痛，甚至减缓关节损伤。在一项为期一年的临床试验中，研究人员发现，在步行时调整人脚的角度可以减少骨关节炎疼痛，其程度与药物治疗相当，无需药物或手术。更有希望的是，核磁共振扫描显示，采用个性化步行技术的参与者膝关节软骨健康指标的恶化速度较慢。

paras.en: What if easing knee arthritis pain did not require another pill, an injection, or surgery, but simply changing how you walk?
paras.zh: 如果缓解膝关节炎疼痛不需要另一种药物、注射或手术，而只需改变步行方式会怎样？

paras.en: A clinical trial published in The Lancet Rheumatology suggests that a small, carefully chosen adjustment to the angle of your feet could make a meaningful difference. After one year, participants who learned to walk with a personalized foot position reported significantly less knee pain than those receiving a placebo treatment. They also showed encouraging signs of slower deterioration in their knee cartilage.
paras.zh: 《柳叶刀风湿病学》上发表的一项临床试验表明，对脚部角度进行仔细选择的小调整可能会产生有意义的变化。一年后，学会以个性化足部位置行走的参与者报告膝盖疼痛明显少于接受安慰剂治疗的参与者。他们还显示出膝关节软骨退化速度减缓的令人鼓舞的迹象。

paras.en: The pain relief was comparable in magnitude to benefits reported for some commonly used medications. More importantly, the approach may help address something painkillers cannot: the excessive pressure on knee joints that contributes to osteoarthritis progression.
paras.zh: 疼痛缓解的程度与一些常用药物报道的效果相当。更重要的是，这种方法可能有助于解决止痛药无法解决的问题：膝关节压力过大，导致骨关节炎进展。

paras.en: A Simple Walking Change Could Help Fight Knee Arthritis
paras.zh: 简单的步行改变可以帮助对抗膝关节炎

paras.en: Osteoarthritis affects roughly 22% of adults over age 40 and is one of the leading causes of disability. The condition gradually damages cartilage, the smooth, protective tissue that cushions the ends of bones and allows joints to move with minimal friction.
paras.zh: 大约 22% 的 40 岁以上成年人患有骨关节炎，是导致残疾的主要原因之一。这种情况会逐渐损害软骨，软骨是一种光滑的保护性组织，可以缓冲骨骼末端，并允许关节以最小的摩擦力移动。

paras.en: As cartilage deteriorates, everyday activities such as walking, climbing stairs, and getting out of a chair can become increasingly painful. Although exercise, physical therapy, weight management, and medications can help manage symptoms, there is currently no established treatment that reliably restores cartilage lost to osteoarthritis. People with advanced disease may eventually need joint replacement surgery.
paras.zh: 随着软骨退化，日常活动（例如步行、爬楼梯和从椅子上站起来）会变得越来越痛苦。尽管运动、物理治疗、体重管理和药物可以帮助控制症状，但目前还没有既定的治疗方法可以可靠地恢复因骨关节炎而损失的软骨。患有晚期疾病的人最终可能需要关节置换手术。

paras.en: Researchers from the University of Utah, New York University, and Stanford University have investigated a different strategy called gait retraining. Rather than focusing only on relieving pain, this approach changes the mechanics of walking to reduce pressure on vulnerable parts of the knee.
paras.zh: 来自犹他大学、纽约大学和斯坦福大学的研究人员研究了一种称为步态再训练的不同策略。这种方法不是仅仅专注于缓解疼痛，而是改变了步行的机制，以减少膝盖脆弱部位的压力。

paras.en: The findings, published in August 2025, came from the first randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial to demonstrate the effectiveness of personalized gait retraining for knee osteoarthritis over a full year.
paras.zh: 该研究结果发表于 2025 年 8 月，来自第一项随机、安慰剂对照临床试验，旨在证明个性化步态再训练对膝骨关节炎全年的有效性。

paras.en: The research was co-led by Scott Uhlrich, an assistant professor of mechanical engineering at the University of Utah's John and Marcia Price College of Engineering, with collaborators at Stanford and New York University. The work received support from federal research agencies, with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs listed as the trial's funder.
paras.zh: 这项研究由犹他大学约翰和玛西娅·普莱斯工程学院机械工程助理教授斯科特·乌尔里奇（Scott Uhlrich）与斯坦福大学和纽约大学的合作者共同领导。这项工作得到了联邦研究机构的支持，美国退伍军人事务部被列为该试验的资助者。

paras.en: "We've known that for people with osteoarthritis, higher loads in their knee accelerate progression, and that changing the foot angle can reduce knee load," said Uhlrich, an assistant professor of mechanical engineering. "So the idea of a biomechanical intervention is not new, but there have not been randomized, placebo-controlled studies to show that they're effective."
paras.zh: 机械工程助理教授乌尔里奇说：“我们知道，对于患有骨关节炎的人来说，膝盖的较高负荷会加速病情发展，而改变足部角度可以减轻膝盖负荷。” “因此，生物力学干预的想法并不新鲜，但还没有随机、安慰剂对照研究表明它们是有效的。”

paras.en: The secret lies in how body weight moves through the knee with each step.
paras.zh: 秘密在于每一步体重如何通过膝盖移动。

paras.en: The knee has an inner section, called the medial compartment, and an outer section, known as the lateral compartment. During normal walking, the inner section typically carries more of the load. This helps explain why osteoarthritis affecting the inside of the knee is especially common.
paras.zh: 膝盖有一个内部部分，称为内侧室，和一个外部部分，称为外侧室。在正常行走期间，内部部分通常承载更多的负载。这有助于解释为什么影响膝盖内侧的骨关节炎特别常见。

paras.en: For people with this type of arthritis, repeatedly placing excessive pressure on the already damaged area can accelerate deterioration.
paras.zh: 对于患有这种类型关节炎的人来说，反复对已经受损的部位施加过大的压力会加速恶化。

paras.en: Changing the direction in which the toes point during walking can redistribute some of that pressure. Turning the toes slightly inward or outward alters the forces acting on the knee, potentially reducing stress on the affected cartilage.
paras.zh: 步行时改变脚趾指向的方向可以重新分配一些压力。稍微向内或向外转动脚趾会改变作用在膝盖上的力，从而可能减少受影响软骨的压力。

paras.en: However, there is an important catch: the same adjustment does not work for everyone.
paras.zh: 然而，有一个重要的问题：同样的调整并不适用于所有人。

paras.en: Some people benefit from turning their toes inward, while others respond better when their toes point farther outward. Making the wrong adjustment could fail to help or even increase pressure on the damaged joint.
paras.zh: 有些人将脚趾向内转动会受益，而另一些人则当脚趾向外转动时反应更好。错误的调整可能无法帮助甚至增加受损关节的压力。

paras.en: "Previous trials prescribed the same intervention to all individuals, resulting in some individuals not reducing, or even increasing, their joint loading," Uhlrich said. "We used a personalized approach to selecting each individual's new walking pattern, which improved how much individuals could offload their knee and likely contributed to the positive effect on pain and cartilage that we saw."
paras.zh: 乌尔里奇说：“之前的试验对所有个体都规定了相同的干预措施，导致一些人没有减少甚至增加关节负荷。” “我们使用个性化的方法来选择每个人的新步行模式，这改善了个人可以减轻膝盖负担的程度，并可能有助于我们看到的对疼痛和软骨的积极影响。”

paras.en: How Scientists Found the Right Walking Pattern
paras.zh: 科学家如何找到正确的行走模式

paras.en: The researchers focused on people with mild to moderate osteoarthritis affecting the inner part of the knee.
paras.zh: 研究人员重点关注患有影响膝盖内侧的轻度至中度骨关节炎的人。

paras.en: At their first two laboratory visits, participants underwent MRI scans and walked on a specialized treadmill equipped with sensors that measured the forces generated during each step. Motion capture cameras recorded their movements in detail, allowing the researchers to analyze how different walking styles affected the knee.
paras.zh: 在前两次实验室访问中，参与者接受了核磁共振扫描，并在配备传感器的专用跑步机上行走，该传感器可测量每一步产生的力。动作捕捉摄像机详细记录了他们的动作，使研究人员能够分析不同的行走方式如何影响膝盖。

paras.en: Participants tested small changes in their foot position, turning their toes inward or outward by either 5° or 10°.
paras.zh: 参与者测试了脚部位置的微小变化，将脚趾向内或向外转动 5° 或 10°。

paras.en: The scientists then identified which adjustment reduced pressure on the affected knee most effectively for each person.
paras.zh: 然后，科学家们确定了哪种调整对每个人来说最能有效地减轻受影响膝盖的压力。

paras.en: Not everyone qualified. Some prospective participants were excluded because none of the tested adjustments successfully reduced their knee loading. Including such individuals in earlier studies may help explain why previous attempts at gait retraining produced inconsistent results.
paras.zh: 不是每个人都有资格。一些潜在的参与者被排除在外，因为所有测试的调整都没有成功地减少他们的膝盖负荷。将这些人纳入早期研究可能有助于解释为什么之前的步态再训练尝试产生了不一致的结果。

paras.en: After the initial assessments, 68 participants were randomly divided into two groups of 34.
paras.zh: 初步评估后，68 名参与者被随机分为两组，每组 34 人。

paras.en: One group received personalized instructions designed to minimize stress on the inner knee. The other received a sham treatment, meaning they went through the same training process but were instructed to maintain their natural foot angle.
paras.zh: 一组接受了旨在最大程度地减少膝关节内侧压力的个性化指导。另一人接受了假治疗，这意味着他们经历了相同的训练过程，但被要求保持自然的脚部角度。

paras.en: This comparison allowed the researchers to separate the benefits of changing walking mechanics from improvements caused by expectations, attention from researchers, or participation in a structured walking program.
paras.zh: 这种比较使研究人员能够将改变步行机制的好处与期望、研究人员的关注或参与结构化步行计划所带来的改善区分开来。

paras.en: Just Six Weeks of Training Changed How They Walked
paras.zh: 短短六周的训练改变了他们的行走方式

paras.en: Both groups attended six weekly training sessions.
paras.zh: 两组都参加了每周六次的培训课程。

paras.en: During these visits, participants walked on a treadmill while wearing a small device on their shin. The device provided biofeedback, delivering gentle vibrations whenever their foot moved outside the prescribed angle.
paras.zh: 在这些访问期间，参与者在跑步机上行走，同时在胫骨上佩戴一个小型设备。该设备提供生物反馈，每当他们的脚移动到规定角度之外时，就会发出轻微的振动。

paras.en: Biofeedback is a technique that uses immediate signals to help people recognize and gradually control movements they normally perform without thinking.
paras.zh: 生物反馈是一种利用即时信号来帮助人们识别并逐渐控制他们通常不假思索地进行的动作的技术。

paras.en: Over time, participants learned to maintain their assigned foot position without needing constant reminders.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，参与者学会了在不需要不断提醒的情况下保持指定的脚部位置。

paras.en: After completing the six weeks of supervised training, they were encouraged to practice their walking technique for at least 20 minutes each day until it became a natural habit.
paras.zh: 完成六周的监督训练后，他们被鼓励每天至少练习 20 分钟的步行技巧，直到成为一种自然习惯。

paras.en: Follow-up assessments indicated that participants were remarkably consistent. On average, they maintained their prescribed foot angles to within approximately one degree.
paras.zh: 后续评估表明参与者的表现非常一致。平均而言，他们将规定的足部角度保持在大约一度之内。

paras.en: That consistency is important because the potential benefits depend on continuing the altered walking pattern during ordinary daily activities, not just during laboratory sessions.
paras.zh: 这种一致性很重要，因为潜在的好处取决于在日常活动中持续改变步行模式，而不仅仅是在实验室会议期间。

paras.en: Arthritis Pain Improved, and Cartilage Showed Less Damage
paras.zh: 关节炎疼痛得到改善，软骨损伤减少

paras.en: One year after starting the program, participants returned for another MRI and reported how much knee pain they were experiencing.
paras.zh: 项目开始一年后，参与者再次进行核磁共振检查，并报告他们的膝盖疼痛程度。

paras.en: The results showed a meaningful advantage for those who received personalized gait retraining.
paras.zh: 结果显示，接受个性化步态再训练的人具有有意义的优势。

paras.en: On a pain scale from zero to 10, participants in the intervention group reported an average improvement of 2.5 points, compared with 1.3 points in the sham group.
paras.zh: 在从 0 到 10 的疼痛等级上，干预组的参与者平均改善了 2.5 分，而假手术组的参与者平均改善了 1.3 分。

paras.en: In an exploratory analysis, approximately 91% of participants receiving personalized retraining experienced a clinically meaningful reduction in pain, compared with 66% in the comparison group.
paras.zh: 在一项探索性分析中，大约 91% 接受个性化再培训的参与者经历了具有临床意义的疼痛减轻，而对照组的这一比例为 66%。

paras.en: The researchers also found that the intervention reduced a mechanical measure associated with pressure on the inner knee, confirming that the altered walking pattern had effects beyond participants' perceptions of pain.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，干预措施减少了与膝关节内侧压力相关的机械测量，证实改变的步行模式的影响超出了参与者对疼痛的感知。

paras.en: "The reported decrease in pain over the placebo group was somewhere between what you'd expect from an over-the-counter medication, like ibuprofen, and a narcotic, like OxyContin," Uhlrich said. "With the MRIs, we also saw slower degradation of a marker of cartilage health in the intervention group, which was quite exciting."
paras.zh: 乌尔里希说：“据报道，安慰剂组的疼痛减轻程度介于布洛芬等非处方药和奥施康定等麻醉药之间。” “通过核磁共振成像，我们还看到干预组中软骨健康标志物的退化速度较慢，这非常令人兴奋。”

paras.en: The MRI findings may be especially important.
paras.zh: MRI 结果可能尤其重要。

paras.en: Researchers used advanced imaging techniques capable of detecting subtle changes in cartilage composition before major structural damage becomes visible on conventional scans.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用先进的成像技术，能够在传统扫描中发现主要结构损伤之前检测软骨成分的细微变化。

paras.en: One measurement, known as T1rho, suggested that cartilage in the inner knee deteriorated more slowly among participants who changed their walking pattern. A second MRI measurement did not show a significant difference between the groups.
paras.zh: 一项名为 T1rho 的测量结果表明，改变步行方式的参与者的膝盖内侧软骨恶化得更慢。第二次 MRI 测量并未显示各组之间存在显着差异。

paras.en: These findings do not establish that damaged cartilage was rebuilt or that arthritis progression can be permanently stopped. However, they raise the possibility that reducing mechanical stress could help preserve cartilage health over time.
paras.zh: 这些发现并不能证明受损的软骨得到了重建，也不能证明关节炎的进展可以永久停止。然而，他们提出了一种可能性，即随着时间的推移，减少机械应力有助于保持软骨健康。

paras.en: The treatment also appeared generally well tolerated. No severe adverse events were reported, although two participants in the intervention group and one in the sham group withdrew because of increased knee pain.
paras.zh: 该治疗的耐受性也普遍良好。尽管干预组的两名参与者和假手术组的一名参与者因膝盖疼痛加剧而退出，但没有报告严重的不良事件。

paras.en: More Recent Research Adds to the Evidence
paras.zh: 最近的研究增加了证据

paras.en: Research published since the 2025 trial has provided further insight into how walking modifications might help people with knee osteoarthritis.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年试验以来发表的研究进一步深入了解步行改变如何帮助膝骨关节炎患者。

paras.en: In a separate randomized trial published in Clinical Biomechanics in April 2026, researchers at the University of Bath investigated different types of biofeedback training in 50 people with knee osteoarthritis.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年 4 月《临床生物力学》上发表的另一项随机试验中，巴斯大学的研究人员对 50 名膝骨关节炎患者进行了不同类型的生物反馈训练。

paras.en: Participants completed a six-week program using different feedback strategies intended to improve walking mechanics.
paras.zh: 参与者使用不同的反馈策略完成了为期六周的计划，旨在改善步行力学。

paras.en: All three groups, including the control group, experienced improvements in activity-related knee pain and physical function. However, only the group receiving feedback about its walking pattern achieved a lasting reduction in a key measure of knee loading.
paras.zh: 所有三组，包括对照组，与活动相关的膝盖疼痛和身体功能均得到改善。然而，只有收到步行模式反馈的小组才实现了膝盖负荷这一关键指标的持久减少。

paras.en: That group's knee loading measure fell by 7.6%, with the improvement maintained at a follow-up assessment one month later.
paras.zh: 该组的膝盖负荷测量值下降了 7.6%，一个月后的后续评估仍保持这一改善。

paras.en: Interestingly, the investigators did not detect significant changes in foot angle in any of the groups. This suggests that other adjustments to walking mechanics can also influence the forces acting on the knee.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，研究人员没有发现任何一组的足部角度有显着变化。这表明对行走力学的其他调整也会影响作用在膝盖上的力。

paras.en: The findings reinforce an important lesson from the 2025 trial: simply encouraging people to walk differently is not necessarily enough. The type of movement being taught, and whether it successfully reduces harmful joint loading, appears to matter.
paras.zh: 研究结果强化了 2025 年试验的一个重要教训：仅仅鼓励人们以不同的方式行走是不够的。所教授的运动类型以及它是否成功减少有害的关节负荷似乎很重要。

paras.en: The 2026 study did not examine long-term cartilage deterioration, so it cannot establish whether these additional walking strategies slow osteoarthritis progression.
paras.zh: 2026 年的研究没有检查长期软骨退化，因此无法确定这些额外的步行策略是否会减缓骨关节炎的进展。

paras.en: Could This Help People Avoid Knee Replacement?
paras.zh: 这可以帮助人们避免膝关节置换吗？

paras.en: For people living with knee osteoarthritis, the appeal of this approach extends beyond its measurable effects in the laboratory.
paras.zh: 对于患有膝骨关节炎的人来说，这种方法的吸引力超出了其在实验室中可测量的效果。

paras.en: One trial participant described the freedom of adopting a treatment that did not require medication or an assistive device:
paras.zh: 一位试验参与者描述了采用不需要药物或辅助装置的治疗的自由：

paras.en: "I don't have to take a drug or wear a device…it's just a part of my body now that will be with me for the rest of my days, so that I'm thrilled with."
paras.zh: “我不需要服用药物或佩戴设备……它现在只是我身体的一部分，将陪伴我度过余生，所以我感到很兴奋。”

paras.en: Once a person learns the technique, it can potentially become part of ordinary daily movement without requiring continued use of specialized equipment.
paras.zh: 一旦一个人学会了这项技术，它就有可能成为日常运动的一部分，而无需继续使用专门的设备。

paras.en: That could be particularly valuable for people who develop arthritis relatively early in adulthood.
paras.zh: 这对于成年后相对较早患关节炎的人来说尤其有价值。

paras.en: "Especially for people in their 30s, 40s, or 50s, osteoarthritis could mean decades of pain management before they're recommended for a joint replacement," Uhlrich said. "This intervention could help fill that large treatment gap."
paras.zh: 乌尔里奇说：“特别是对于 30 多岁、40 多岁或 50 多岁的人来说，骨关节炎可能意味着需要数十年的疼痛控制才能被建议进行关节置换术。” “这种干预措施可以帮助填补巨大的治疗缺口。”

paras.en: Whether gait retraining can actually delay or prevent knee replacement remains unknown. Longer studies would need to demonstrate that its benefits persist and translate into better joint health and fewer surgical procedures.
paras.zh: 步态再训练是否真的能延迟或阻止膝关节置换仍然未知。需要更长期的研究来证明它的益处持续存在，并转化为更好的关节健康和更少的外科手术。

paras.en: Still, the prospect of relieving pain while potentially slowing cartilage deterioration makes personalized walking adjustments an intriguing addition to the available treatment options.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，在缓解疼痛的同时可能减缓软骨退化的前景使得个性化步行调整成为现有治疗选择的一个有趣的补充。

paras.en: Smart Shoes and Smartphone Cameras Could Make Treatment Easier
paras.zh: 智能鞋和智能手机摄像头可以让治疗变得更容易

paras.en: One major obstacle remains: delivering personalized gait retraining outside a specialized research laboratory.
paras.zh: 仍然存在一个主要障碍：在专业研究实验室之外提供个性化步态再训练。

paras.en: The original trial relied on sophisticated motion capture equipment, pressure-sensitive treadmill measurements, MRI scans, and repeated in-person visits. Those resources are expensive and difficult to provide in ordinary physical therapy clinics.
paras.zh: 最初的试验依赖于复杂的动作捕捉设备、压敏跑步机测量、核磁共振扫描和重复的亲自访问。这些资源价格昂贵，并且普通物理治疗诊所难以提供。

paras.en: Researchers are exploring ways to make the technology much simpler.
paras.zh: 研究人员正在探索使该技术变得更加简单的方法。

paras.en: "We and others have developed technology that could be used to both personalize and deliver this intervention in a clinical setting using mobile sensors, like smartphone video and a 'smart shoe'," Uhlrich said.
paras.zh: 乌尔里奇说：“我们和其他人已经开发出技术，可以使用移动传感器（例如智能手机视频和‘智能鞋’）在临床环境中实现个性化和提供这种干预。”

paras.en: Smartphone cameras could help analyze walking mechanics and estimate how different movements influence knee loading. Meanwhile, shoes fitted with motion sensors could provide feedback as patients practice walking at home or around their neighborhoods.
paras.zh: 智能手机摄像头可以帮助分析步行力学并估计不同的运动如何影响膝盖负荷。与此同时，当患者在家或在社区附近练习行走时，装有运动传感器的鞋子可以提供反馈。

paras.en: Work published in Machine Learning with Applications in September 2026 explored another possibility: using artificial intelligence to estimate knee loading from acceleration measurements collected at the foot.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月发表在《机器学习与应用》杂志上的研究探索了另一种可能性：使用人工智能根据脚部收集的加速度测量值来估计膝盖负荷。

paras.en: In that proof of concept study, researchers analyzed walking data from 10 healthy adults and demonstrated that a machine learning system could track changes in estimated knee forces across different walking patterns.
paras.zh: 在这项概念验证研究中，研究人员分析了 10 名健康成年人的步行数据，并证明机器学习系统可以跟踪不同步行模式下估计膝盖力的变化。

paras.en: The technology remains experimental and has not yet been validated as a treatment tool for people with knee osteoarthritis. Nevertheless, it illustrates how future rehabilitation systems might provide personalized guidance without requiring a room full of cameras and laboratory equipment.
paras.zh: 该技术仍处于实验阶段，尚未被验证为膝骨关节炎患者的治疗工具。尽管如此，它还是说明了未来的康复系统如何提供个性化指导，而无需充满相机和实验室设备的房间。

paras.en: A Promising Treatment, but Not a Do-It-Yourself Fix
paras.zh: 一种有前途的治疗方法，但不能自行修复

paras.en: Despite the encouraging results, researchers caution that personalized gait retraining is not yet ready for widespread clinical use.
paras.zh: 尽管取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但研究人员警告说，个性化步态再训练尚未准备好广泛应用于临床。

paras.en: The original study included only 68 participants, all of whom had mild to moderate osteoarthritis affecting the inner knee and demonstrated that at least one tested walking adjustment could reduce their joint loading. Its findings may not apply to people with advanced arthritis, other patterns of joint damage, or those whose knees respond differently.
paras.zh: 最初的研究仅包括 68 名参与者，他们都患有影响膝关节内侧的轻度至中度骨关节炎，并证明至少一项经过测试的步行调整可以减轻他们的关节负荷。它的研究结果可能不适用于患有晚期关节炎、其他类型的关节损伤或膝盖反应不同的人。

paras.en: Importantly, turning the toes inward or outward without professional assessment is not the same as receiving personalized gait retraining. An adjustment that helps one person might increase stress on another person's knee.
paras.zh: 重要的是，在没有专业评估的情况下将脚趾向内或向外转动并不等同于接受个性化步态再训练。对一个人有帮助的调整可能会增加另一个人膝盖的压力。

paras.en: Larger trials, longer follow-up periods, and practical methods for delivering the treatment will be needed before clinicians can routinely prescribe it.
paras.zh: 在临床医生可以常规开药之前，需要更大规模的试验、更长的随访期以及提供治疗的实用方法。

paras.en: For now, the research points to an intriguing possibility: the way people walk may influence not only how much their knees hurt today, but potentially how well their cartilage holds up in the years ahead.
paras.zh: 目前，研究指出了一个有趣的可能性：人们行走的方式可能不仅影响他们今天膝盖的疼痛程度，还可能影响他们的软骨在未来几年的承受能力。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Utah. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由犹他大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: NaviGate successfully demonstrates onboard precise orbit determination aboard D-Orbit’s ION Satellite Carrier
articles.author: NaviGate

paras.en: ROME, 30/09/2026 – NaviGate, an Italian space technology company spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, has successfully completed the in-orbit demonstration (IoD) of NaviCode Caravel, its autonomous onboard precise orbit determination software, aboard an ION Satellite Carrier operated by D-Orbit. During the demonstration, NaviCode Caravel ran directly on the satellite’s onboard computer, computing the spacecraft’s position in real time using only the raw data of the GNSS receiver already onboard, with no additional hardware.
paras.zh: 罗马，2026 年 9 月 30 日 – NaviGate 是一家从罗马第一大学衍生出来的意大利空间技术公司，在 D-Orbit 运营的 ION 卫星运载器上成功完成了 NaviCode Caravel（其自主机载精确定轨软件）的在轨演示 (IoD)。在演示过程中，NaviCode Caravel 直接在卫星的机载计算机上运行，​​仅使用卫星上已有的 GNSS 接收器的原始数据实时计算航天器的位置，无需额外的硬件。

paras.en: Today, knowing precisely where a satellite is remains largely a ground-based activity: operators rely on dedicated infrastructure, specialized flight dynamics teams, and repeated ground contacts to accurately reconstruct and predict the orbit of each spacecraft. As constellations grow in size and missions become more responsive, this approach turns into a bottleneck in terms of cost, workload, and reaction time. NaviCode Caravel moves precise orbit determination onboard: a software-only product that transforms the raw measurements of the GNSS receiver a satellite already carries into high-accuracy, real-time knowledge of its own position, available directly where operational decisions are made. Beyond determining where the satellite is now, Caravel can also predict where it will be, together with a measure of how reliable that prediction is, giving the spacecraft the forward-looking awareness it needs to anticipate upcoming events, such as ground station contacts or payload operations, and manage them autonomously onboard.
paras.zh: 如今，准确了解卫星的位置在很大程度上仍然是一项地面活动：运营商依靠专用基础设施、专门的飞行动力学团队以及反复的地面接触来准确重建和预测每个航天器的轨道。随着星座规模的扩大和任务的响应速度越来越快，这种方法在成本、工作量和反应时间方面变成了瓶颈。 NaviCode Caravel 实现机载精确轨道确定：这是一款纯软件产品，可将卫星已携带的 GNSS 接收器的原始测量结果转换为对其自身位置的高精度、实时了解，可直接在做出操作决策时使用。除了确定卫星现在的位置之外，Caravel 还可以预测它将在哪里，并衡量该预测的可靠性，从而为航天器提供预测即将发生的事件（例如地面站接触或有效载荷操作）所需的前瞻性意识，并在船上自主管理它们。

paras.en: The demonstration was carried out through D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service and structured in two phases. NaviCode Caravel was first validated on the ground on an engineering model replicating the in-orbit computing environment. The application was then uploaded to an ION Satellite Carrier already in orbit and executed onboard, processing real flight telemetry from the spacecraft’s GNSS receiver across multiple runs.
paras.zh: 该演示是通过 D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务进行的，并分为两个阶段。 NaviCode Caravel 首先在复制在轨计算环境的工程模型上进行了地面验证。然后，该应用程序被上传到已在轨道上的 ION 卫星载体并在机上执行，在多次运行中处理来自航天器 GNSS 接收器的真实飞行遥测数据。

paras.en: The software executed nominally onboard and in real time without anomalies. Onboard positioning reached a best-case formal uncertainty of 5.2 cm, with mean values in the decimeter range across the runs, using GPS-only measurements. NaviGate then verified the onboard solutions on the ground, proving them consistent with the reference orbits reconstructed through classical ground-based precise orbit determination performed with GODOT, the European Space Agency’s flight dynamics software. NaviCode Caravel is also designed to process multi-constellation GNSS data and correction services such as SBAS and Galileo HAS, enabling even higher accuracy in operational deployments.
paras.zh: 该软件名义上在船上实时执行，没有出现异常。使用仅 GPS 测量，机载定位的最佳情况形式不确定度达到 5.2 厘米，整个运行的平均值在分米范围内。随后，NaviGate 在地面验证了机载解决方案，证明它们与通过欧洲航天局飞行动力学软件 GODOT 执行的经典地面精确轨道确定重建的参考轨道一致。 NaviCode Caravel 还设计用于处理多星座 GNSS 数据和校正服务，例如 SBAS 和 Galileo HAS，从而在操作部署中实现更高的准确性。

paras.en: “Satellites still depend heavily on the ground to know exactly where they are and where they will be. NaviCode Caravel changes that: it is a software product that lets a satellite compute its own position with high accuracy, in real time, using the GNSS receiver it already carries, with no new hardware,” said Andrea Sesta, Chief Technology Officer and Co-founder at NaviGate. “Seeing it run in orbit without a single anomaly, and produce solutions consistent with the reference orbits computed on the ground, is the validation we were working toward, and a real milestone for the whole NaviGate team. D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service was key to getting there quickly: we developed and tested our application on the ground in the same containerized environment used in orbit, iterated fast, and flew on real flight data within months, which is exactly what a company like ours needs to bring a flight-proven product to market.”
paras.zh: NaviGate 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrea Sesta 表示：“卫星仍然严重依赖地面来准确了解它们所在的位置和将要到达的位置。NaviCode Caravel 改变了这一点：它是一款软件产品，可以让卫星使用其已携带的 GNSS 接收器实时高精度地计算自己的位置，而无需新硬件。” “看到它在轨道上运行而没有任何异常，并产生与地面计算的参考轨道一致的解决方案，是我们正在努力实现的验证，也是整个 NaviGate 团队的一个真正的里程碑。D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务是快速实现这一目标的关键：我们在轨道上使用的相同容器化环境中在地面上开发和测试了我们的应用程序，快速迭代，并在几个月内根据真实的飞行数据进行了飞行，这正是像我们这样的公司将经过飞行验证的产品推向市场。”

paras.en: “With five networked Intelligence Nodes in orbit, we can give customers access to space infrastructure that is already up and running. For NaviGate, that means testing their precise orbit determination algorithms ingesting raw GNSS measurements and attitude telemetry in real time from D-Orbit’s ION platform, in-situ directly on-board, with no satellite to develop or launch. It’s a practical way to move from simulation to real flight data in less time and at lower cost,” said Viney Jean-Francois Dhiri, Head of Growth, Sales and Marketing of the Space Cloud Business Unit at D-Orbit.
paras.zh: “通过在轨的五个网络智能节点，我们可以让客户访问已经启动并运行的空间基础设施。对于 NaviGate 来说，这意味着测试他们的精确定轨算法，从 D-Orbit 的 ION 平台实时获取原始 GNSS 测量数据和姿态遥测数据，直接在原位机载，无需开发或发射卫星。这是一种在更短的时间内、以更低的成本从模拟转向真实飞行数据的实用方法，”Viney Jean-Francois 说道。 Dhiri，D-Orbit 太空云业务部增长、销售和营销主管。

paras.en: Caravel is the first release of the NaviCode fleet: subsequent versions will extend these capabilities to multi-sensor resilient navigation and to autonomous maneuver planning for large constellations. NaviCode Caravel was also selected as a winner of the CASSINI Challenges 2026, the European Union’s space entrepreneurship competition run by the EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA).
paras.zh: Caravel 是 NaviCode 舰队的第一个版本：后续版本将把这些功能扩展到多传感器弹性导航和大型星座的自主机动规划。 NaviCode Caravel 还被选为 2026 年 CASSINI 挑战赛的获胜者，这是由欧盟太空计划署 (EUSPA) 主办的欧盟太空创业竞赛。

paras.en: The in-orbit demonstration is the culminating milestone of the proof-of-concept program funded by Galaxia, the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures, which backed NaviGate from its earliest stage. NaviGate was founded by researchers who developed deep expertise in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination through their work on ESA and NASA missions, and originated as a spin-off of Sapienza University of Rome.
paras.zh: 这次在轨演示是概念验证项目的最终里程碑，该项目由 Galaxia 资助，Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持，Obloo Ventures 从最初阶段就支持 NaviGate。 NaviGate 的创始人是罗马第一大学的附属机构，他们通过在欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和美国宇航局 (NASA) 任务中的工作，在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面积累了深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: Following the demonstration, NaviGate is engaging constellation operators and mission integrators for the first pilot deployments. NaviCode Caravel addresses concrete needs across the market: reducing the ground workload and infrastructure required for precise orbit determination in constellation operations, enhancing onboard image processing for Earth observation missions, supporting PNT constellations, and improving orbit knowledge for launch vehicles and orbital transfer applications, with further applications across other mission types and orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 演示结束后，NaviGate 正在与星座运营商和任务集成商合作进行首次试点部署。 NaviCode Caravel 满足整个市场的具体需求：减少星座运行中精确定轨所需的地面工作量和基础设施、增强地球观测任务的机载图像处理、支持 PNT 星座、改善运载火箭和轨道转移应用的轨道知识，以及在其他任务类型和轨道制度中的进一步应用。

paras.en: Spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, NaviGate S.r.l. is an Italian space technology startup founded by researchers with extensive experience in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination across ESA and NASA missions including Juno, Cassini, Veritas, BepiColombo, and JUICE, and initiatives such as ESA Moonlight and Marconi constellations. The company develops NaviCode, a modular, data-agnostic software platform that enables satellites and constellations to perform precise orbit determination, orbit prediction, and autonomous maneuvering without continuous ground intervention, leveraging GNSS, radiometric, optical, and other navigation measurements. NaviGate was incorporated in 2026 and is backed by Galaxia, Italy’s national technology transfer hub for aerospace, and supported by the ESA BIC Lazio incubation program.
paras.zh: NaviGate S.r.l. 是从罗马第一大学分离出来的。是一家意大利空间技术初创公司，由在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面拥有丰富经验的研究人员创立，这些研究人员参与了欧空局和美国宇航局的任务，包括朱诺号、卡西尼号、Veritas、BepiColombo 和 JUICE，以及​​欧空局月光和马可尼星座等计划。该公司开发了 NaviCode，这是一个与数据无关的模块化软件平台，使卫星和星座能够利用 GNSS、辐射、光学和其他导航测量来执行精确的定轨、轨道预测和自主操纵，而无需持续的地面干预。 NaviGate 成立于 2026 年，得到意大利国家航空航天技术转移中心 Galaxia 的支持，并得到 ESA BIC Lazio 孵化计划的支持。

paras.en: More information on www.navigate-space.com
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 www.navigate-space.com

paras.en: D-Orbit develops space logistics systems for orbital transportation, hosted payload operations, and in-orbit data processing. Its ION Satellite Carrier is an orbital transfer vehicle (OTV) used for satellite deployment and hosted payload operations; since 2020 it has flown 23 missions and carried 240+ payloads, including hosted payloads and satellites deployed in orbit. The company also provides space cloud services based on onboard computing for in-orbit data processing and is developing GEA, a servicing spacecraft intended to support autonomous rendezvous, inspection, and refueling, as well as NOX, a synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) Earth observation satellite.
paras.zh: D-Orbit 开发用于轨道运输、托管有效载荷操作和在轨数据处理的空间物流系统。其ION卫星载体是一种轨道传输运载工具（OTV），用于卫星部署和托管有效载荷操作；自 2020 年以来，它已执行 23 次飞行任务，携带 240 多个有效载荷，包括托管有效载荷和部署在轨道上的卫星。该公司还提供基于机载计算的空间云服务，用于在轨数据处理，并正在开发 GEA（一种旨在支持自主交会、检查和加油的服务航天器）以及 NOX（一颗合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 地球观测卫星）。

paras.en: Galaxia is the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace, powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures. Its mission is to promote the development of startups conceived within research laboratories specialized in the aerospace sector. The scientific promoters of Galaxia are Politecnico di Torino and Sapienza University of Rome, together with other leading Italian universities, including the University of Padua and Politecnico di Bari. NEVA SGR, the venture capital company of the Intesa Sanpaolo Group, and Compagnia di San Paolo Foundation are investors in the initiative. Obloo Ventures acts as the entrepreneurial partner and co-investor of the hub, managing the scouting, investment execution and portfolio monitoring. Along with Lazio Innova and the I3P Incubator of the Politecnico di Torino, Obloo Ventures also coordinates the business creation program, dedicated to startups originating from academic research and selected by the hub for seed investments.
paras.zh: Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持。其使命是促进航空航天领域专门研究实验室内构思的初创企业的发展。 Galaxia 的科学推动者是都灵理工大学和罗马第一大学，以及其他意大利领先大学，包括帕多瓦大学和巴里理工大学。 Intesa Sanpaolo 集团的风险投资公司 NEVA SGR 和 Compagnia di San Paolo 基金会是该计划的投资者。 Obloo Ventures 是该中心的创业合作伙伴和联合投资者，负责管理搜寻、投资执行和投资组合监控。 Obloo Ventures 与 Lazio Innova 和都灵理工大学的 I3P 孵化器一起协调企业创建计划，致力于资助源于学术研究并由种子投资中心选择的初创企业。

paras.en: More information on https://galaxia.vc/it/
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 https://galaxia.vc/it/

articles.title: Galileo Space Is Building Satellites That Turn Signals Into Answers in Orbit
articles.author: Galileo Space

paras.en: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers in orbit. Modern defense and commercial operations need fast answers about what is happening and where. Existing systems can leave segmented data crawling through processing for hours or days. FPV drones and moving radars must be detected and tracked quickly. Ballistic missile launch plume detection can provide critical early warning. Interference disrupting navigation frequencies or crucial satcom links must be detected and traced to its source. A ship lost at sea may still broadcast a distress signal. A tumbling satellite may lose contact with the ground while still emitting signals that help locate it. Rescue crews may have only hours to find someone before nightfall.
paras.zh: 伽利略航天公司正在建造旨在将信号转化为轨道上答案的卫星。现代国防和商业运营需要快速了解正在发生的事情和地点。现有系统可能会让分段数据在处理过程中爬行数小时或数天。 FPV 无人机和移动雷达必须被快速检测和跟踪。弹道导弹发射羽流检测可以提供关键的早期预警。必须检测干扰导航频率或关键卫星通信链路的干扰并追踪其来源。在海上失踪的船只仍可能会发出求救信号。翻滚的卫星可能会与地面失去联系，但仍会发出有助于定位卫星的信号。救援人员可能只有几个小时的时间才能在夜幕降临之前找到人。

paras.en: The solution combines innovative sensors with AI fusion at the edge to generate actionable reports directly in orbit. The system is designed to operate fully autonomously for weeks, selecting and carrying out its own sensing tasks. It identifies threats, geolocates signals and delivers actionable intelligence to operators within minutes, not hours or days. The mission is to give defense teams the early warning they need to survive and commercial operators the answers they need to act.
paras.zh: 该解决方案将创新传感器与边缘人工智能融合相结合，直接在轨道上生成可操作的报告。该系统设计为完全自主运行数周，选择并执行自己的传感任务。它可以在几分钟（而不是几小时或几天）内识别威胁、对信号进行地理定位并向操作员提供可采取行动的情报。其使命是为防御团队提供生存所需的早期预警，并为商业运营商提供采取行动所需的答案。

paras.en: Working side by side with government stakeholders, the team has developed a deep understanding of operational needs and critical capability gaps. The company is in the final stages of securing its first government contract. Its first demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2027 to prove its capabilities in orbit and open the door to a potential Phase III government contract. Galileo has also deepened relationships with commercial companies that need near live data, creating a path to early revenue alongside its defense business.
paras.zh: 该团队与政府利益相关者并肩工作，对运营需求和关键能力差距有了深入的了解。该公司正处于获得第一份政府合同的最后阶段。其第一颗示范卫星计划于 2027 年第四季度发射，以证明其在轨能力，并为潜在的第三阶段政府合同打开大门。伽利略还加深了与需要近乎实时数据的商业公司的关系，为其国防业务创造了一条早期收入的途径。

paras.en: Galileo was selected for a16z speedrun as one of 80 companies chosen from 30,000 applicants.
paras.zh: Galileo 是从 30,000 名申请者中选出的 80 家公司之一，被选为 a16z speedrun 项目的一员。

paras.en: CEO: Brings a decade of experience in national security space and military systems at Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin. Led testing in orbit for protected military communications satellites and consulted for the U.S. Space Force on acquiring new technology. Combines spacecraft engineering expertise with deep knowledge of defense missions, government procurement and what operators need.
paras.zh: 首席执行官：在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司和洛克希德·马丁公司拥有十年的国家安全空间和军事系统经验。领导受保护的军用通信卫星在轨测试，并就获取新技术为美国太空军提供咨询。将航天器工程专业知识与国防任务、政府采购和运营商需求的深入了解相结合。

paras.en: CSO: Was responsible for building machine learning systems for Google, YouTube and Amazon’s Prime Video. Brings expertise in AI, software infrastructure and building systems at global scale. Now leads Galileo’s satellite software, bringing that experience into orbit to turn complex sensor data into clear intelligence that operators can act on.
paras.zh: CSO：负责为谷歌、YouTube 和亚马逊的 Prime Video 构建机器学习系统。在全球范围内带来人工智能、软件基础设施和建筑系统方面的专业知识。现在领导伽利略的卫星软件，将这种经验带入轨道，将复杂的传感器数据转化为操作员可以采取行动的清晰情报。

paras.en: CTO: Designed, tested and delivered all RF radios for SpaceX Starship flights, owning the radios through Flight 10, including first booster catch at the tower. Introduced Starship’s first integrated Starlink phased array antenna and RTK GPS receiver hardware that helped guide the booster back to the tower. Previously worked on electronic warfare for a Navy jammer missile at Raytheon and designed high power RF amplifiers for the Navy and Ka band block upconverters for the Army at two startups.
paras.zh: 首席技术官：为 SpaceX 星舰飞行设计、测试并交付了所有 RF 无线电设备，并拥有 10 号航班的无线电设备，包括塔上的第一个助推器捕获器。推出 Starship 首款集成 Starlink 相控阵天线和 RTK GPS 接收器硬件，帮助引导助推器返回塔楼。此前曾在雷神公司从事海军干扰导弹的电子战工作，并在两家初创公司为海军设计高功率射频放大器，为陆军设计 Ka 频段上变频器。

paras.en: Visit our website: https://galileo-space.com
paras.zh: 访问我们的网站：https://galileo-space.com

articles.title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport

paras.en: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
paras.zh: “这些袭击必须立即停止”：古特雷斯谴责胡塞武装对利雅得机场的致命袭击

paras.en: In a short statement issued late on Saturday, he said attacks on civilians and civilian infrastructure violate international law. “These attacks must cease immediately,” Mr. Guterres said.
paras.zh: 他在周六晚间发表的一份简短声明中表示，对平民和民用基础设施的袭击违反了国际法。 “这些袭击必须立即停止，”古特雷斯先生说。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s civil aviation authority said on Sunday that 309 people were wounded in the strike on King Khalid International Airport, some of them critically.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯民航局周日表示，哈立德国王国际机场空袭造成 309 人受伤，其中一些人伤势严重。

paras.en: The dead include at least four Saudis, two Bangladeshis, a US citizen, plus others from Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Palestine and Sudan. Operations were suspended and flights diverted.
paras.zh: 死者包括至少四名沙特人、两名孟加拉国人、一名美国公民，以及来自埃及、约旦、叙利亚、巴勒斯坦和苏丹的其他人。运营暂停，航班改道。

paras.en: Late on Sunday, Saudi authorities reported that another projectile had hit a passenger terminal at the airport in Riyadh, causing further injuries and a fire.
paras.zh: 周日晚间，沙特当局报告称，另一枚弹丸击中利雅得机场的一个客运航站楼，造成进一步人员受伤并引发火灾。

paras.en: It was the third Houthi attack on the airport this week. Thursday’s strikes killed three Saudis, including a Saudia pilot, and earlier attacks on King Khalid and Abha airports reportedly killed three more and wounded 36.
paras.zh: 这是胡塞武装本周对机场进行的第三次袭击。周四的袭击造成三名沙特人死亡，其中包括一名沙特航空公司飞行员，据报道，早些时候对哈立德国王机场和艾卜哈机场的袭击造成另外 3 人死亡、36 人受伤。

paras.en: Houthi media reported the airport in Yemen’s capital Sana’a – which the group has controlled for years – had been hit by an airstrike on Sunday, blaming Saudi Arabia for the attack.
paras.zh: 胡塞媒体报道称，该组织控制多年的也门首都萨那机场周日遭到空袭，并指责沙特阿拉伯应对此次袭击负责。

paras.en: According to news reports, the vice-president of Yemen’s internationally recognised government called on Sunday for decisive action by regional and international partners to end the Houthi aggression.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，国际公认的也门政府副总统周日呼吁区域和国际合作伙伴采取果断行动，结束胡塞武装的侵略。

paras.en: The Iran-backed Houthis have fought the Saudi-backed government since 2014. A 2022 ceasefire largely held until this summer. In September, the Houthis swept down Yemen’s Red Sea coast, capturing the port of Mokha and islands in the Bab al-Mandab strait.
paras.zh: 自 2014 年以来，伊朗支持的胡塞武装一直与沙特支持的政府作战。2022 年的停火协议基本上一直维持到今年夏天。 9月，胡塞武装横扫也门红海沿岸，占领了莫卡港和曼德海峡的岛屿。

paras.en: Early this month, government forces launched a counteroffensive, backed by Saudi-led air strikes, aiming to retake all Houthi-held territory – including Sana’a. The Houthis have answered with missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 本月初，政府军在沙特领导的空袭支持下发动反攻，旨在夺回胡塞武装控制的所有领土，包括萨那。胡塞武装以对沙特阿拉伯的导弹和无人机袭击作为回应。

paras.en: The battle for Bab al-Mandab, the narrow gateway to the Red Sea, is a spillover from the US-Iran conflict which has destabilised global oil and gas supplies through the vital Strait of Hormuz in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 曼德海峡之战是通往红海的狭窄门户，是美伊冲突的溢出效应，这场冲突破坏了海湾地区重要的霍尔木兹海峡的全球石油和天然气供应的稳定。

paras.en: With Iran continuing to disrupt the strait, the Red Sea has become vital for Saudi oil exports.
paras.zh: 随着伊朗继续扰乱该海峡，红海对沙特石油出口变得至关重要。

paras.en: Saudi officials and the Yemeni government say they have now regained control of the Red Sea chokepoint – but the Houthis have denied the claim.
paras.zh: 沙特官员和也门政府表示，他们现已重新控制了红海咽喉要道，但胡塞武装否认了这一说法。

paras.en: The UN Security Council met Friday morning in New York on Yemen where Special Envoy Hans Grundberg said the country had slid back into full-scale war.
paras.zh: 联合国安理会周五上午在纽约就也门问题举行会议，特使汉斯·格伦德伯格表示，该国已重新陷入全面战争。

paras.en: The conflict is intensifying, raising regional security and economic risks, he told amassadors.
paras.zh: 他告诉大使，冲突正在加剧，增加了地区安全和经济风险。

paras.en: UN Deputy Emergency Relief Coordinator Mohamed Yahya said over 200,000 people have been displaced since August, the highest new displacement since the now-shattered 2022 truce.
paras.zh: 联合国副紧急救济协调员穆罕默德·叶海亚表示，自 8 月以来已有超过 20 万人流离失所，这是自现已破裂的 2022 年休战以来新增流离失所人数最多的一次。

articles.title: Sustaining livelihoods amid crisis in Gaza

paras.en: Sustaining livelihoods amid crisis in Gaza
paras.zh: 加沙危机中维持生计

paras.en: Nidaa, Hanaa and Hanin have different stories, but share a common thread: the determination to build something of their own and keep it going despite extraordinary challenges facing them in war-ravaged Gaza.
paras.zh: 尼达、哈娜和哈宁有着不同的故事，但有一个共同点：尽管在饱受战争蹂躏的加沙面临着巨大的挑战，但他们决心建立自己的东西并保持下去。

paras.en: Following the devastation of the past three years, productive capacity in Gaza has been severely damaged, markets disrupted and the cost of basic goods has risen sharply.
paras.zh: 经过过去三年的破坏，加沙的生产能力受到严重破坏，市场受到干扰，基本商品的成本急剧上升。

paras.en: Their experiences reflect different parts of the same challenge: sustaining livelihoods that still exist, helping businesses restart and creating new opportunities where livelihoods have disappeared.
paras.zh: 他们的经历反映了同一挑战的不同部分：维持仍然存在的生计、帮助企业重启以及在生计消失的地方创造新的机会。

paras.en: Running a business today means navigating uncertainty at every turn. Yet amid these challenges, women continue to find ways to work, adapting their businesses, learning new skills and somehow – supporting their families.
paras.zh: 如今经营企业意味着在每一个转折点都要应对不确定性。然而，在这些挑战中，女性继续寻找工作方式、调整业务、学习新技能以及以某种方式养家糊口。

paras.en: Nidaa: A livelihood built from childhood
paras.zh: Nidaa：从小建立的生计

paras.en: Nidaa, 35, has her own business raising and selling chickens, ducks and rabbits in the southern city of Khan Younis.
paras.zh: 35 岁的尼达 (Nidaa) 在南部城市汗尤尼斯 (Khan Younis) 有自己的养殖和销售鸡、鸭和兔子的生意。

paras.en: “I was passionate about this business since I was a child,” she said. “My mother worked with animals, and she taught me everything she knew. During the war, I faced many challenges with continuing my business. However, I insisted on continuing.”
paras.zh: “我从小就对这个行业充满热情，”她说。 “我的母亲与动物打交道，她教给我她所知道的一切。在战争期间，我在继续我的生意方面面临着许多挑战。但是，我坚持继续下去。”

paras.en: When her home was destroyed during the war and she was displaced, she managed to save some of her animals and move them to Khan Younis.
paras.zh: 当她的家在战争期间被摧毁并流离失所时，她设法拯救了一些动物并将它们转移到汗尤尼斯。

paras.en: Trained as a teacher, Nidaa chose to follow her passion for raising animals, turning it into a business that helps support her family, including two brothers with disabilities. But there have been constant challenges.
paras.zh: 奈达接受过教师培训，她选择追随自己对饲养动物的热情，将其转变为一项帮助养家糊口的事业，其中包括两个残疾兄弟。但挑战一直存在。

paras.en: ‘During the time of famine, I lost many animals’
paras.zh: “在饥荒期间，我失去了很多动物”

paras.en: “Especially during the time of famine, I lost many animals,” she recalled. “Food became very expensive.”
paras.zh: “特别是在饥荒期间，我失去了很多动物，”她回忆道。 “食物变得非常昂贵。”

paras.en: Right now, challenges include shelter for the coming winter, access to safe water and limited ingredients for food for the birds and animals, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，目前面临的挑战包括即将到来的冬季的住所、获得安全水源以及鸟类和动物的食物成分有限。

paras.en: “I don’t know how I will take care of them without a proper shelter,” she said.
paras.zh: “如果没有适当的庇护所，我不知道如何照顾他们，”她说。

paras.en: Through the UN Development Programme (UNDP) partnership with the local Chamber of Commerce, she received a grant to purchase animals and equipment, alongside training to strengthen her production skills.
paras.zh: 通过联合国开发计划署 (UNDP) 与当地商会的合作，她获得了一笔赠款，用于购买动物和设备，并接受了加强生产技能的培训。

paras.en: Now, Nidaa’s ambition goes beyond sustaining what she has today.
paras.zh: 现在，奈达的雄心壮志超越了维持她今天所拥有的一切。

paras.en: “I hope that my business will grow,” she said, “and I can inspire other women to work with animals.”
paras.zh: “我希望我的生意能够发展，”她说，“我可以激励其他女性从事与动物相关的工作。”

paras.en: In Gaza City, Hanaa, 49, started a family dairy business with her husband in 2021.
paras.zh: 2021 年，49 岁的哈娜 (Hanaa) 与丈夫在加沙城创办了一家家庭乳制品企业。

paras.en: During the war, she lost her husband, one of her sons and her business. She was left supporting her three remaining children while also caring for five children who lost both parents.
paras.zh: 战争期间，她失去了丈夫、儿子和生意。她不得不抚养剩下的三个孩子，同时还要照顾失去双亲的五个孩子。

paras.en: With encouragement from her eldest son, Fouad, Hanaa decided to restart the business despite limited resources and severe shortages of milk and other raw materials.
paras.zh: 尽管资源有限，牛奶和其他原材料严重短缺，但在长子福阿德的鼓励下，哈娜决定重新开始生意。

paras.en: “Sometimes, the people who need us are the reason we find the strength to keep going,” Hanaa said, adding that she chooses to remain strong and resilient in the face of many challenges.
paras.zh: 哈娜说：“有时，需要我们的人是我们找到继续前进的力量的原因。”她补充说，面对许多挑战，她选择保持坚强和韧性。

paras.en: The destruction of Gaza’s electricity system has made dairy production particularly difficult. Power interruptions can cause products to spoil, resulting in losses at a time when resources are already scarce.
paras.zh: 加沙电力系统的破坏使乳制品生产变得尤其困难。电力中断可能会导致产品变质，在资源本已匮乏的情况下造成损失。

paras.en: With grant support, Hanaa was able to resume producing cheese, milk, labneh and laban, with hopes of growing her business into a larger production facility and build a more stable source of income for her family.
paras.zh: 在赠款支持下，哈娜得以恢复生产奶酪、牛奶、拉布尼和拉班，希望将她的企业发展成为更大的生产设施，并为家人建立更稳定的收入来源。

paras.en: For other women, starting over begins with a new skill.
paras.zh: 对于其他女性来说，重新开始是从一项新技能开始的。

paras.en: Hanin, 36, is learning carpentry. From southern Khan Younis, she travels to Deir al-Balah to complete 80 hours of vocational training, followed by entrepreneurship and business-planning training.
paras.zh: 36 岁的哈宁正在学习木工。她从汗尤尼斯南部前往代尔巴拉赫完成 80 小时的职业培训，然后接受创业和商业规划培训。

paras.en: “This is something unique, especially for women,” Hanin said. “It’s needed now more than ever, because there are limited sources of wood for furniture, and many people lost their furniture during the war.”
paras.zh: “这是独一无二的，特别是对于女性来说，”哈宁说。 “现在比以往任何时候都更需要它，因为家具木材来源有限，而且许多人在战争期间失去了家具。”

paras.en: More than 200 trainees will receive skills development in carpentry, textiles, recycling, compost production, data science, graphic design and digital marketing.
paras.zh: 超过 200 名学员将接受木工、纺织、回收、堆肥生产、数据科学、平面设计和数字营销方面的技能发展。

paras.en: For Hanin, learning carpentry is not simply about completing a training course. It offers a pathway towards earning an income and potentially building a business of her own.
paras.zh: 对于哈宁来说，学习木工不仅仅是完成培训课程。它为她提供了一条赚取收入并有可能建立自己的企业的途径。

paras.en: For women entrepreneurs, access to finance and skills is important, but their ability to sustain and grow their businesses also depends on the systems around them.
paras.zh: 对于女性企业家来说，获得资金和技能很重要，但她们维持和发展业务的能力也取决于她们周围的系统。

paras.en: That means reliable energy and water, functioning markets and access to the equipment and materials they need.
paras.zh: 这意味着可靠的能源和水、运转良好的市场以及获得所需的设备和材料。

paras.en: Supporting women-led businesses is therefore about more than individual livelihoods, according to UNDP.
paras.zh: 因此，联合国开发计划署表示，支持女性领导的企业不仅仅关乎个人生计。

paras.en: It also helps preserve local productive capacity, generate income and keep economic activity rooted in Palestinian communities, laying the foundation for locally driven recovery.
paras.zh: 它还有助于保护当地的生产能力、创造收入并使经济活动扎根于巴勒斯坦社区，为当地推动的复苏奠定基础。

paras.en: Nearly two million Palestinians have experienced repeated displacement since the war began. Here are some ongoing efforts to help them recover:
paras.zh: 自战争开始以来，近两百万巴勒斯坦人多次经历流离失所。以下是一些帮助他们康复的持续努力：

paras.en: - Since October 2023, UNDP has supported 6,000 emergency employment opportunities
paras.zh: - 自2023年10月以来，开发署已支持6,000个紧急就业机会

paras.en: - Nidaa and Hanaa are among 30 women whose businesses are being supported as part of UNDP’s Gaza Neighbourhood Approach initiative, which brings together shelter, essential services and livelihood opportunities to help communities regain some of the basic conditions they need to function
paras.zh: - Nidaa 和 Hanaa 等 30 名妇女的企业得到开发署加沙邻里办法倡议的支持，该倡议汇集了住房、基本服务和生计机会，帮助社区重新获得运作所需的一些基本条件

paras.en: - UNDP’s Programme of Assistance to the Palestinian People (PAPP) supports micro, small and medium enterprises with grants, equipment and skills development
paras.zh: - 联合国开发计划署援助巴勒斯坦人民计划 (PAPP) 通过赠款、设备和技能开发支持微型、小型和中型企业

paras.en: - The REVIVE housing project has already helped build homes for displaced Palestinians
paras.zh: - REVIVE 住房项目已经帮助流离失所的巴勒斯坦人建造房屋

articles.title: Djibouti shipwreck: Death toll rises to 139 as 84 remain missing

paras.en: Djibouti shipwreck: Death toll rises to 139 as 84 remain missing
paras.zh: 吉布提沉船事故：死亡人数上升至139人，84人失踪

paras.en: The toll rose from 109 after the bodies of 30 more people were recovered. Search and rescue efforts are continuing.
paras.zh: 在又找到 30 具尸体后，死亡人数从 109 人上升。搜救工作仍在继续。

paras.en: The boat was carrying 305 people from Djibouti towards Yemen when it went down near Guehere, north of Obock, in the early hours of Friday. About 82 people survived.
paras.zh: 周五凌晨，这艘载有 305 人的船从吉布提前往也门，在奥博克以北的盖埃雷附近沉没。大约82人幸存。

paras.en: IOM described it as one of the deadliest shipwrecks recorded on the Eastern Route, which runs from the Horn of Africa to the Arabian Peninsula.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织将其描述为从非洲之角至阿拉伯半岛的东部航线上记录的最致命的沉船事故之一。

paras.en: The shipwreck comes as Djibouti deals with continued traffic in both directions.
paras.zh: 此次沉船事故发生之际，吉布提正在处理持续不断的双向交通问题。

paras.en: Since 10 September, IOM’s Displacement Tracking Matrix has recorded more than 20,000 movements into the country from Ethiopia, as migrants keep heading for the Gulf despite the return to full-scale fighting in Yemen.
paras.zh: 自 9 月 10 日以来，国际移民组织的流离失所追踪矩阵记录了超过 20,000 人从埃塞俄比亚进入该国，尽管也门恢复全面战斗，但移民仍在继续前往海湾。

paras.en: Over roughly the same period, more than 3,700 refugees have arrived from Yemen, while 539 Ethiopian migrants have come back from there.
paras.zh: 大约在同一时期，超过 3,700 名难民从也门抵达，539 名埃塞俄比亚移民从也门返回。

paras.en: Alexandre Coissac, IOM’s chief of mission in Djibouti, told journalists in Geneva on 6 October that the country was facing “overlapping emergencies”.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织驻吉布提代表团团长亚历山大·科瓦萨克 (Alexandre Coissac) 10 月 6 日在日内瓦告诉记者，该国正面临“重叠的紧急情况”。

paras.en: “Djibouti is therefore confronting movements in both directions,” Mr. Coissac said, adding that migrants were increasingly becoming stranded, with more than 3,000 seen along routes in Djibouti between 20 and 30 September, often without access to basic services.
paras.zh: 科瓦萨克表示，“因此，吉布提面临着双向流动”。他补充说，越来越多的移民陷入困境，9 月 20 日至 30 日期间，有超过 3,000 人沿着吉布提的路线出现，他们往往无法获得基本服务。

paras.en: “No one gets into a boat like that unless they believe there is no other safe way,” said IOM Director General Amy Pope.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织总干事艾米·波普 (Amy Pope) 表示：“除非相信没有其他安全方法，否则没有人会登上这样的船。”

paras.en: “We cannot keep treating these deaths as normal. Safe and legal pathways save lives. I am asking governments and donors to act before the next boat goes down.”
paras.zh: “我们不能继续将这些死亡视为正常现象。安全合法的途径可以拯救生命。我要求各国政府和捐助者在下一艘船沉没之前采取行动。”

paras.en: Djiboutian authorities are continuing search and recovery operations as fears grow for those still unaccounted for.
paras.zh: 由于人们对下落不明者的担忧与日俱增，吉布提当局正在继续开展搜救行动。

paras.en: IOM is providing emergency assistance to survivors at its Migrant Response Centre in Obock, including healthcare, psychosocial support, food, shelter and protection services.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织正在奥博克的移民响应中心向幸存者提供紧急援助，包括医疗保健、社会心理支持、食品、住所和保护服务。

paras.en: The UN Resident Coordinator in Djibouti, Jose Barahona, said he was deeply saddened by the loss of at least 139 lives, among them children.
paras.zh: 联合国驻吉布提驻地协调员何塞·巴拉奥纳 (Jose Barahona) 表示，他对至少 139 人丧生（其中包括儿童）深感悲痛。

paras.en: “Our thoughts are with the victims, the survivors and the families waiting for news of their loved ones,” Mr. Barahona said on social media. “We express our solidarity and welcome the ongoing search and rescue efforts.”
paras.zh: 巴拉奥纳在社交媒体上表示：“我们的心与受害者、幸存者和等待亲人消息的家人同在。” “我们表示声援并欢迎正在进行的搜救工作。”

paras.en: Every life lost at sea is a tragedy, he added, recalling the Secretary-General’s recent warning that such deaths underline the urgency of protecting people on the move, expanding safe migration pathways and strengthening international cooperation.
paras.zh: 他补充说，每一个在海上丧生的人都是一场悲剧，并回顾了秘书长最近的警告，即此类死亡凸显了保护流动人口、扩大安全移民通道和加强国际合作的紧迫性。

articles.title: Greaves ends Women's Series season with record-breaking win

paras.en: PDC Women's Series: Beau Greaves ends season with highest event-winning average in tournament history
paras.zh: PDC 女子系列赛：Beau Greaves 以锦标赛历史上最高的赛事获胜平均数结束赛季

paras.en: Beau Greaves records the highest event-winning average in Women's Series history; Vicky Pruim secures World Darts Championship qualification; you can watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports from November 14-22
paras.zh: 博·格里夫斯 (Beau Greaves) 创下女子系列赛历史上最高的赛事获胜平均数；维姬·普鲁姆 (Vicky Pruim) 获得世界飞镖锦标赛资格；您可以在 11 月 14 日至 22 日期间通过天空体育观看伍尔弗汉普顿飞镖大满贯比赛的直播

paras.en: Beau Greaves ended her 2026 PDC Women's Series season with a record-breaking streak of victories on the way to two tournament wins at Event 23 and 24 in Wigan.
paras.zh: Beau Greaves 以破纪录的连胜结束了她的 2026 年 PDC 女子系列赛赛季，并在维冈举行的第 23 场和第 24 场比赛中赢得了两场比赛的胜利。

paras.en: Greaves - who had already claimed back-to-back titles in Event 21 and 22 on Saturday - averaged 98.75 on the way to her third successive competition title at Event 23, marking the highest event-winning average in the history of the Women's Series.
paras.zh: 格里夫斯已经在周六的第 21 项和第 22 项赛事中连续获得冠军，她在第 23 项赛事中以 98.75 分的平均成绩连续第三次获得冠军，这是女子系列赛历史上最高的赛事获胜平均分。

paras.en: The Yorkshire native - who has won 17 out of a possible 24 Women's Series events this year - won all of her first four matches by a 4-0 scoreline, posting a stunning 103.66 average in her victory against Steph Clark.
paras.zh: 这位约克郡本地人在今年可能举行的 24 场女子系列赛中赢得了 17 场，她以 4-0 的比分赢得了前四场比赛的所有比赛，在战胜斯蒂芬·克拉克的比赛中，她的平均分达到了惊人的 103.66。

paras.zh: - 2026 年飞镖：关键日期、日历、结果 📅

paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在天空体育应用程序上观看📱

paras.zh: - 没有天空？现在就立即访问📺

paras.en: She lost her first legs of the day in her 5-2 victory against Gemma Hayter in the quarter-finals, before beating Fallon Sherrock - who confirmed her own return to the World Darts Championship on Saturday - in the semi-final.
paras.zh: 她在四分之一决赛中以 5-2 战胜杰玛·海特 (Gemma Hayter)，输掉了当天的首回合比赛，随后在半决赛中击败了法伦·舍洛克 (Fallon Sherrock)，法伦·舍洛克于周六确认重返世界飞镖锦标赛。

paras.en: Her 5-3 victory against Jade Gofford in the final confirmed her first title of the day, before beating Laura van den Berg, Sara Walton, Vicky Martin and Lauren Bloomfield to reach the quarter-finals of event 24.
paras.zh: 她在决赛中以 5-3 击败杰德·戈福德 (Jade Gofford)，确认了自己当天的第一个冠军头衔，随后击败劳拉·范登伯格 (Laura van den Berg)、萨拉·沃尔顿 (Sara Walton)、维基·马丁 (Vicky Martin) 和劳伦·布卢姆菲尔德 (Lauren Bloomfield) 进入第 24 场赛事的四分之一决赛。

paras.en: Wins against Kirsty Hutchinson and 20-year-old Italian Aurora Fochesato confirmed her second title of the day and her fourth of the weekend to cap off a successful 2026 season.
paras.zh: 战胜 Kirsty Hutchinson 和 20 岁的意大利选手 Aurora Fochesato 确认了她当天的第二个冠军头衔，也是周末的第四个冠军头衔，为 2026 年赛季的成功画上了圆满的句号。

paras.en: "I felt good," Greaves said. "I was chuffed with the first competition. I had some good averages and then I played steady enough in the second event.
paras.zh: “我感觉很好，”格里夫斯说。 “我对第一场比赛很满意。我有一些不错的平均成绩，然后我在第二场比赛中发挥得足够稳定。

paras.en: "I knew I hadn't been playing at my best recently, but I've had some good moments today and I'm ready to build on it and take this into the back end of the year."
paras.zh: “我知道我最近并没有发挥出最佳状态，但今天我经历了一些美好的时刻，我已经准备好在此基础上再接再厉，并将其带入今年年底。”

paras.en: The Wigan double-header also saw Vicky Pruim claim the final spot on offer to compete in the World Darts Championship through the Women's Series rankings, joining Greaves, Sherrock, Hayter and Lisa Ashton.
paras.zh: 在维冈双赛中，维琪·普鲁姆 (Vicky Pruim) 也通过女子系列赛排名获得了参加世界飞镖锦标赛的最后一个席位，与格里夫斯 (Greaves)、舍洛克 (Sherrock)、海特 (Hayter) 和丽莎·阿什顿 (Lisa Ashton) 一起。

articles.title: Bellingham, United and bedlam - London's greatest NFL moment?

paras.en: Jude Bellingham celebrations, Man Utd representation and the greatest NFL London game climax in history
paras.zh: 裘德·贝林厄姆的庆祝活动、曼联的代表以及历史上最伟大的 NFL 伦敦比赛高潮

paras.en: NFL Sunday Review: Headbutts, brawls, ejections, Jude Bellingham celebrations and a remarkable finish to latest NFL London game asJacksonville Jaguars beat Philadelphia Eagles; watch the Jaguars against Houston Texans at Wembley Stadium, live on Sky Sports NFL from 2pm on Sunday
paras.zh: NFL 周日回顾：头撞、斗殴、驱逐、裘德·贝林厄姆的庆祝活动以及最新 NFL 伦敦比赛杰克逊维尔美洲虎队击败费城老鹰队的精彩收官；周日下午 2 点，天空体育 NFL 直播，观看美洲虎队在温布利体育场对阵休斯顿德州人队的比赛

paras.en: Arms out-stretched, frenzied teammates in tow, Tottenham in shock, the NFL in awe, Roger Goodell (most likely) smirking at the sight of more international iconicity.
paras.zh: 张开双臂，疯狂的队友们紧随其后，托特纳姆热刺队感到震惊，美国国家橄榄球联盟感到敬畏，罗杰·古德尔（很可能）看到更多的国际标志性人物而得意地笑。

paras.en: Cam Little had conjured one of the greatest moments in NFL London games history, his spine-tingling icer prompting a nod to his British stage as the Jacksonville Jaguars kicker imitated Jude Bellingham's famed celebration.
paras.zh: 卡姆·利特尔 (Cam Little) 创造了 NFL 伦敦比赛历史上最伟大的时刻之一，杰克逊维尔美洲虎队的踢球手模仿了裘德·贝林厄姆 (Jude Bellingham) 著名的庆祝动作，他那令人脊背发麻的冰球让他在英国舞台上获得了认可。

paras.en: Just two weeks earlier the NFL had celebrated its Rio de Janeiro debut with a late miracle by way of Tyler Loop's game-winning field goal to lift the Baltimore Ravens past the Dallas Cowboys with one second left. On that occasion he celebrated with Cristiano Ronaldo's SIU, there having been something fitting about a kick deciding things at Brazil's Pele, Zico and Ronaldo-graced Maracana.
paras.zh: 就在两周前，美国国家橄榄球联盟(NFL)庆祝了里约热内卢的首秀，在比赛还剩一秒时，泰勒·卢普(Tyler Loop)的制胜一球帮助巴尔的摩乌鸦队(Baltimore Ravens)击败达拉斯牛仔队(Dallas Cowboys)，创造了最后的奇迹。那一次，他与克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多的 SIU 一起庆祝，在巴西的贝利、济科和罗纳尔多恩赐的马拉卡纳球场上，一脚决定比赛的结果是很恰当的。

paras.en: - Miracle in London as Jags beat Eagles as time expires
