paras.en: It was London's turn. Tottenham's turn. Jacksonville's turn. Cam Little's turn.
paras.zh: 轮到伦敦了。轮到托特纳姆热刺了。轮到杰克逊维尔了。轮到卡姆·利特尔了。

paras.en: Little converted a 57-yard field goal with one second left to clinch a stunning 19-17 win over the Philadelphia Eagles, who had taken the lead with eight seconds left on the clock thanks to Jake Elliott's 48-yard kick.
paras.zh: 利特尔在比赛还剩一秒时完成一记 57 码射门，以 19-17 击败费城老鹰队，费城老鹰队在比赛还剩 8 秒时凭借杰克·埃利奥特 (Jake Elliott) 的 48 码踢球取得领先。

paras.en: "One of the craziest games, maybe the craziest games I've ever been a part of, and I've been in some pretty wild ones," said Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence. "Just how cool is this sport? The game's never over."
paras.zh: “最疯狂的比赛之一，也许是我参加过的最疯狂的比赛，我参加过一些非常疯狂的比赛，”美洲虎队四分卫特雷弗·劳伦斯说。 “这项运动到底有多酷？比赛永远不会结束。”

paras.en: It was over. It had to be over. An Eagles-dominated Tottenham Hotspur Stadium believed it was over. A poor coaching call not to take the touchback and some Ameer Abdullah magic had other plans, the latter producing a 53-yard kick return to tee up Little's big moment.
paras.zh: 一切都结束了。事情必须结束了。老鹰队主宰的托特纳姆热刺球场认为一切都结束了。糟糕的教练要求不要接回触球，一些阿米尔·阿卜杜拉魔术师有其他计划，后者踢出一脚 53 码的回攻球，为利特尔的重要时刻奠定了基础。

paras.en: He later joked it was the unofficial winner for his beloved Manchester United, whose shirt he wore to his post-game press conference, after they squandered Saturday's lead over Spurs. Having grown up accustomed to both codes of football, Sunday's climax would prove that little bit sweeter as he described it as the greatest moment in his career.
paras.zh: 他后来开玩笑说，这是他心爱的曼联队的非官方获胜者，在曼联浪费了周六对热刺的领先优势后，他在赛后新闻发布会上穿着曼联的球衣。在习惯了这两种足球规则的过程中，周日的高潮将证明这一点更加甜蜜，因为他形容这是他职业生涯中最伟大的时刻。

paras.en: "A hundred per cent," said Little. "A hundred per cent. Like the record was cool and all, but it still gives me goosebumps because I don't think you guys realise I wake up every Saturday morning watching the Premier League, every Saturday, and then to play soccer from ages five to 16 - I didn't touch a football until I was almost 17. So my whole life was soccer up to that point.
paras.zh: “百分之一百，”利特尔说。 “百分之一百。就像这张唱片很酷一样，但它仍然让我起鸡皮疙瘩，因为我认为你们没有意识到我每个星期六早上醒来看英超联赛，每个星期六，然后从五岁到十六岁踢足球 - 直到我快 17 岁时我才碰过足球。所以在那之前我的一生都是足球。

paras.en: "So to do it in this stadium is like I've achieved my goal of playing professional soccer even though I'm playing pro football. It's so cool. It's my first in my entire career, excluding overtime obviously, but it's the first walk off game winner I've hit in my entire career, where the clock has hit zero and we won the game."
paras.zh: “所以，在这个体育场做到这一点，就好像我已经实现了踢职业足球的目标，尽管我正在踢职业足球。这太酷了。这是我整个职业生涯中的第一次，当然不包括加时赛，但这是我整个职业生涯中第一个在比赛结束时击中的制胜球，当时时钟已经指向零，我们赢得了比赛。”

paras.en: It was a spectacle that bean in chaos and ended in chaos. Bryan Thomas Jr and Jeremiah Trotter were ejected for a brawl during a 90-yard opening kickoff return touchdown that was eventually nullified by offsetting penalties. A deafening Eagles crowd (at what was technically a Jags home game) was then the case of a false start and two delay of game penalties in the space of six plays inside the 10-yard line to prompt a seethe-fuelled ball spike from Lawrence. Parker Washington produced one of the catches of the season with a phenomenal one-handed 27-yard touchdown for a 16-14 lead, after which Littler missed the extra point.
paras.zh: 这是一场在混乱中酝酿并在混乱中结束的奇观。小布莱恩​​·托马斯 (Bryan Thomas Jr) 和耶利米·特罗特 (Jeremiah Trotter) 在 90 码开球回攻达阵期间发生争吵，最终被罚出场，但最终因抵消罚球而无效。当时，老鹰队的观众震耳欲聋（严格来说，这是美洲虎队的主场比赛），但在 10 码线内的六次进攻中，出现了错误的开局和两次延迟的比赛处罚，导致劳伦斯的一记激动人心的球扣球。帕克·华盛顿 (Parker Washington) 完成了本赛季的接球之一，一记惊人的单手 27 码达阵，以 16-14 领先，但利特勒错过了加分。

paras.en: And of course, there was the eight seconds of bedlam.
paras.zh: 当然，还有那八秒钟的混乱。

paras.en: Eagles offensive tackle Jordan Mailata described it was a "week from hell", Sunday's defeat following the shock retirement of stalwart offensive tackle Lane Johnson and the trade departure of center Cam Jurgens. For Liam Coen's Jags it was dreamland for a team that has now run three in a row, this one coming in the face of a hostility rarely witnessed at an NFL London game.
paras.zh: 老鹰进攻截锋乔丹·麦拉塔形容这是“地狱般的一周”，周日的失败是在坚定的进攻截锋莱恩·约翰逊令人震惊的退役和中锋卡姆·尤尔根斯的交易离开后发生的。对于利亚姆·科恩 (Liam Coen) 的美洲虎队来说，这是一支已经连续三连冠的球队的梦想之地，而这支球队面对的是 NFL 伦敦比赛中罕见的敌意。

paras.en: One second. One kick to win it all. One Cam Little, there's only one Cam Little (if we're sticking to the football theme).
paras.zh: 一秒钟。一脚就能赢得一切。一个小卡姆，只有一个小卡姆（如果我们坚持足球主题的话）。

paras.en: - The uncomfortable conversations are coming for the Tennessee Titans and Cam Ward. That's if they haven't already started. Head coach Robert Saleh was asked about the prospect of benching his quarterback after Sunday's 26-3 loss to the Houston Texans, albeit downplaying that idea in response. But the ground is shaking beneath Ward, who isn't exactly blessed with a clear stage for success in Tennessee, while also falling short of the needle-moving influence you might expect from a No 1 pick quarterback. He finished 23 of 36 passing for 170 yards, while being sacked four times and throwing an interception. With no real threat in the running game, teams are having a field day challenging him to beat them.
paras.zh: - 田纳西泰坦队和卡姆·沃德之间即将发生令人不安的对话。 That's if they haven't already started.在周日球队以 26-3 输给休斯敦德州人队后，主教练罗伯特·萨利赫被问及是否有可能让他的四分卫坐在替补席上，尽管他在回应中淡化了这个想法。但沃德脚下的地面正在震动，他在田纳西州并没有获得成功的明确舞台，同时也没有达到你所期望的状元四分卫的针锋相对的影响力。他 36 次传球完成 23 次，推进 170 码，同时被擒杀 4 次并被拦截。由于在跑动比赛中没有真正的威胁，球队在比赛中挑战他击败他们。

paras.en: - Mike Evans is still doing it at an elite level at the age of 33. Brock Purdy may have never had a more reliable pair of hands at the receiver position than that of Evans since taking over at quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers a few years back. Evans had seven catches for 113 yards and a touchdown as San Francisco downed the Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks 32-29, his first 100-yard game since signing with the Niners in the offseason.
paras.zh: - 迈克·埃文斯 (Mike Evans) 33 岁了，仍然保持着精英水平。自从几年前接手旧金山 49 人队四分卫以来，布罗克·珀迪 (Brock Purdy) 可能从未在接球位置上遇到过比埃文斯更可靠的接球手。埃文斯7次接球推进113码并达阵，帮助旧金山队以32比29击败超级碗冠军西雅图海鹰队，这是他休赛期与九人队签约以来的首场100码比赛。

paras.en: - Parker Washington deserves more respect. It's not uncommon for a sixth-round wide receiver to stray from conversations centred around the elite, but whether he is or isn't part of that group, the Jaguars wideout has become indispensable for Trevor Lawrence. He had six catches for 124 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's miracle win over the Eagles, including his one-handed diving grab in the end zone to stun the Philly crowd. He is dynamic with the ball in hand, a crisp route runner and has automatic hands. You can just tell he is a dream teammate for Lawrence.
paras.zh: - 帕克·华盛顿值得更多尊重。第六轮外接手偏离以精英为中心的对话并不罕见，但无论他是否属于这个群体，美洲虎外接手已经成为特雷弗·劳伦斯不可或缺的一部分。在周日奇迹般战胜老鹰队的比赛中，他六次接球推进 124 码并两次达阵，其中包括他在达阵区的单手鱼跃抢球，震惊了费城球迷。他持球时充满活力，跑动干脆，双手自动。你可以看出他是劳伦斯的梦想队友。

paras.en: Brian Flores is currently the best non-head coach coach in the NFL. Unfortunately for the Minnesota Vikings, you suspect his days as a non-head coach are edging closer to an end, though you also wonder if he is merely enjoying the freedom of full defensive rein on his own reign of terror. Flores tormented New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough in Sunday's 23-13 win, blitzing him on 90 per cent of dropbacks in the first half and just 40 per cent in the second half while limiting him to 16 passes for 96 yards and no touchdowns. His Vikings
paras.zh: 布莱恩·弗洛雷斯 (Brian Flores) 是目前 NFL 中最好的非主教练教练。不幸的是，对于明尼苏达维京人队来说，你怀疑他作为非主教练的日子即将结束，尽管你也想知道他是否只是享受着对自己的恐怖统治的全面防守控制的自由。周日，弗洛雷斯在新奥尔良圣徒队以 23-13 获胜的比赛中折磨了新奥尔良圣徒队四分卫泰勒·肖 (Tyler Shough)，上半场他的回球成功率为 90%，下半场只有 40%，同时将他的传球次数限制在 16 次，推进 96 码，没有达阵。他的维京人

paras.en: Jaylen Warren: Have a day, Jaylen Warren. The Steelers running back recorded 15 carries for 101 yards and a touchdown alongside a team-high six catches for 87 yards and a score as Pittsburgh beat the Indianapolis Colts 34-22 on a day that saw Aaron Rodgers throw three touchdowns in his cleanest game of the year.
paras.zh: 杰伦·沃伦：祝你有一天，杰伦·沃伦。这位钢人队跑卫完成 15 次冲球推进 101 码和一次达阵，同时还以全队最高的 6 次接球推进 87 码和一记得分帮助匹兹堡队以 34-22 击败印第安纳波利斯小马队，亚伦·罗杰斯 (Aaron Rodgers) 在他今年最干净的一场比赛中传出 3 次达阵。

paras.en: Will Anderson Jr: The Texans pass rusher collected three more sacks on Sunday to continue his Defensive Player of the Year campaign as his side dominated the Tennessee Titans 26-3. He has become one of the unequivocal premier players in his position in football, and is increasingly aware of his ability to takeover games.
paras.zh: 小威尔·安德森（Will Anderson Jr）：这位德州人的冲传手在周日又完成了 3 次擒杀，继续他的年度最佳防守球员征战，他的球队以 26-3 统治了田纳西泰坦队。他已经成为足球界无可争议的顶级球员之一，并且越来越意识到自己接管比赛的能力。

paras.en: Ben Johnson: The Chicago Bears head coach remains one of the true geniuses in football, redefining modern offense in some ways. But when you talk as openly about your hate for an opponent, you are falling into 'loser ' territory should you fall to them. His Bears were on the wrong side of a 31-7 defeat to their fierce rival Green Bay Packers, during which Jordan Love stepped up with his most commanding performance of the season.
paras.zh: 本·约翰逊：芝加哥熊队主教练仍然是足球界真正的天才之一，在某些方面重新定义了现代进攻。但是，当你公开谈论你对对手的仇恨时，如果你落入他们的手中，你就陷入了“失败者”的境地。他的熊队以 31-7 输给了劲敌绿湾包装工队，乔丹·乐福在这场比赛中上演了他本赛季最具统治力的表现。

paras.en: The Los Angeles Chargers: Jim Harbaugh's side are in turmoil. The running joke this past offseason had been the severity of their tough schedule, and as much is proving a frightening reality. They fell to 0-5 on Sunday after a 23-17 loss to the Denver Broncos, marking their worst start to a season in 23 years. What's more, Justin Herbert has thrown a second-most six interceptions and is ranked bottom in quarterback rating among qualifying players. Next up: Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶闪电队：吉姆·哈博的球队陷入混乱。过去的休赛期一直流传的笑话是他们艰难的赛程的严重性，这也证明了一个可怕的现实。周日，他们以 17-23 输给丹佛野马队，战绩为 0-5，这是 23 年来最糟糕的赛季开局。更重要的是，贾斯汀·赫伯特（Justin Herbert）的六次拦截次数排名第二，并且在合格球员中四分卫评分中排名垫底。接下来：帕特里克·马霍姆斯和堪萨斯城酋长队。

paras.en: Player of the Weekend - Drake Maye, QB, New England Patriots
paras.zh: 周末最佳球员 - Drake Maye，四分卫，新英格兰爱国者队

paras.en: Drake Maye has shaken off his early season struggles and is beginning to look like something closer to the MVP contender that led the New England Patriots to the Super Bowl last season. He put in his most accomplished performance of the campaign on Sunday as he went 26 of 34 passing for 374 yards and four touchdowns while also rushing for 25 yards and a score in New England's 45-17 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
paras.zh: 德雷克·梅耶 (Drake Maye) 已经摆脱了赛季初的挣扎，开始看起来更接近上赛季带领新英格兰爱国者队夺得超级碗的 MVP 竞争者。周日，他打出了本赛季最出色的表现，34次传球26中推进374码并取得4次达阵，同时还冲球25码并取得进球，帮助新英格兰队以45-17战胜拉斯维加斯突袭者队。

paras.en: Drama in London found its way to the West Coast later in the day as the San Francisco 49ers beat the Seattle Seahawks 32-29 in an epic after Eddy Pineiro's late field goal.
paras.zh: 当天晚些时候，伦敦的戏剧性场面在西海岸上演，旧金山 49 人队在艾迪·皮内罗 (Eddy Pineiro) 最后投篮后以 32-29 击败西雅图海鹰队，完成了一场史诗般的比赛。

paras.en: An action-packed game featured a season-high seven turnovers, while Brock Purdy threw two touchdowns to Evans and Brandin Cooks. 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw was also ejected for a head-butt on Ernest Jones, who was not wearing a helmet at the time.
paras.zh: 这场充满动感的比赛出现了赛季最高的七次失误，而布罗克·珀迪则向埃文斯和布兰丁·库克斯两次达阵。 49人队线卫德雷·格林劳也因头撞欧内斯特·琼斯而被驱逐出场，当时琼斯没有戴头盔。

paras.en: Two outstanding teams and legitimate contenders going toe-to-toe, the Niners taking it to improve to 5-0 on the season as they continue their Super Bowl charge. The hearts of San Francisco fans were in their mouths when Jaxon Smith-Njigba broke free on third down late in the fourth quarter, only for the reigning Offensive Player of the Year to be guilty of a surprise drop.
paras.zh: 两支出色的球队和合法的竞争者进行了针锋相对的比赛，九人队将本赛季的战绩提高到 5 胜 0 负，继续他们的超级碗之旅。当贾克森·史密斯·恩吉巴在第四节末第三个落后点突破时，旧金山球迷的心都提到了嗓子眼，结果这位卫冕年度最佳进攻球员却出人意料地跌倒了。

paras.zh: 在天空体育 (Sky Sports) 上观看 2026 年 NFL 赛季直播，包括 2027 年 2 月 14 日星期日季后赛和第 61 届超级碗 (Super Bowl LXI) 的每一分钟。 获取天空体育 (Sky Sports) 或通过 NOW 进行无合约直播。

articles.title: Potters Charm makes his chasing debut at Worcester

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Newcastle, Worcester and Yarmouth
paras.zh: 今日天空体育赛车：纽卡斯尔、伍斯特和雅茅斯

paras.en: Nigel and Willy Twiston-Davies' talented hurdler Potters Charm tries his hand at chasing for the first time in a potentially hot Novices’ Chase at Worcester; we also have competitive action from Worcester and Yarmouth, live on Sky Sports Racing from 1.37pm
paras.zh: 奈杰尔和威利·特威斯顿-戴维斯的才华横溢的跨栏运动员波特斯·魅力 (Potters Charm) 在伍斯特举行的可能很热门的新手追逐赛中首次尝试追逐；我们还有来自伍斯特和雅茅斯的比赛，天空体育赛车从下午 1.37 开始直播

paras.en: We have a busy day's racing on Monday with action from Newcastle, Worcester and Yarmouth, live on Sky Sports Racing...
paras.zh: 周一我们将进行忙碌的一天比赛，来自纽卡斯尔、伍斯特和雅茅斯的比赛将在天空体育赛车直播......

paras.en: 3.07 Worcester - Potters Charm makes chasing debut
paras.zh: 3.07 伍斯特-波特斯魅力首次亮相

paras.en: Potters Charm makes his chasing debut in the Paul Ferguson's Jumpers to Follow Novices' Chase at Worcester.
paras.zh: 波特斯魅力在伍斯特的保罗·弗格森跳投追随新手追逐赛中首次亮相。

paras.en: He found it tough when pitched into open company last season after only losing once in his novice campaign but got back to winning ways in January at Windsor before scoring at Grade Two level in the National Spirit Hurdle at Fontwell.
paras.zh: 上个赛季，他在新秀赛季只输了一次后，在进入公开赛时发现自己很艰难，但一月份在温莎重新找到了胜利之路，然后在丰特维尔的国家精神跨栏比赛中获得二级成绩。

paras.en: Connections have always been optimistic of him doing his best work over fences so they will be hoping for a successful chasing debut, clearly being the one to beat.
paras.zh: 连接一直对他在围栏上尽最大努力感到乐观，因此他们希望他能够成功追逐首秀，显然是要击败的人。

paras.en: - Darkness Falls strikes Dewhurst gold for O'Brien
paras.zh: - 《黑暗瀑布》为奥布莱恩赢得了杜赫斯特金牌

paras.en: - Alphonse Le Grande edges Sea Lantern for historic Cesarewitch win
paras.zh: - Alphonse Le Grande 击败 Sea Lantern 取得历史性的 Cesarewitch 胜利

paras.en: Jupiter des Mottes remains unexposed and holds a good level of form over hurdles, notably when winning a solid handicap hurdle at Perth in April. He made his chasing debut back in November 2025 but did not take to fences at the time, however, he looks the type to improve for a fence at three miles and switched to top trainer Dan Skelton, a much better chasing attempt is anticipated.
paras.zh: 朱庇特·德莫特斯 (Jupiter des Mottes) 仍然没有暴露在外，并且在跨栏方面保持着良好的状态，特别是在四月份在珀斯赢得了坚实的障碍栏时。他在 2025 年 11 月首次亮相追逐赛，但当时并没有参加围栏比赛，不过，他看起来是那种在三英里的围栏上有所提高的人，并换成了顶级教练丹·斯凯尔顿 (Dan Skelton)，预计会有更好的追逐尝试。

paras.en: Who's Glen has run respectably over fences, and he can use his experience here, although Nick Scholfield's charge will be hoping that the former two fluff their lines over fences.
paras.zh: 格伦在越过栅栏方面表现出色，他可以在这里利用自己的经验，尽管尼克·斯科菲尔德的负责人希望前两人能够在栅栏上松动他们的线。

paras.en: Irish pointer, Vicomte le Brave makes rules debut.
paras.zh: 爱尔兰指针 Vicomte le Brave 首次亮相规则。

paras.en: 6.00 Newcastle - Promising Starburster makes handicap debut
paras.zh: 6.00 纽卡斯尔 - 有前途的 Starburster 首次亮相让分盘

paras.en: Promising two-year-old Starburster makes handicap debut in the Follow @attheraces On Instagram Nursery Handicap at Newcastle.
paras.zh: 前途光明的两岁马 Starburster 在纽卡斯尔幼儿园障碍赛中首次亮相。

paras.en: The Richard Spencer-trained filly was an eye-catching fourth on debut before improving for her second start when scoring at Newbury. She showed a willing attitude that day to beat Bidsta who won on her next two starts. Her unexposed profile and strong form should mean she can be very competitive off an opening mark of 82.
paras.zh: 这匹由理查德·斯宾塞 (Richard Spencer) 训练的母马在首秀中获得了引人注目的第四名，随后在纽伯里 (Newbury) 得分时第二次首发取得了进步。那天她表现出了愿意击败比斯塔的态度，后者在接下来的两场比赛中获胜。她不暴露的形象和强劲的状态意味着她在开局得分 82 分的情况下会非常有竞争力。

paras.en: She does meet some creditable rivals as Innichen holds plenty of experience in big meeting nurseries and should go well in calmer waters and Blazing Inferno can bounce back to form after finishing last in the Weatherbys 2-Y-O Stakes at York, with a poor draw in 15.
paras.zh: 她确实遇到了一些值得信赖的对手，因为Innichen在大型会议托儿所中拥有丰富的经验，并且应该在平静的水域中表现良好，而Blazing Inferno在约克的Weatherbys 2-Y-O锦标赛中排名最后，在第15场比赛中抽签不佳后，可以恢复状态。

paras.en: Siouxperb could potentially be overlooked. He disappointed in the Coventry after a dazzling debut, before running well to finish a close second to a nice type in Sonic Angel. The Acomb Stakes was then too hot for him before he didn't seem to enjoy the soft conditions at Ayr. He contains the potential to return to form back on the all-weather and dropped two-pounds in the handicap.
paras.zh: Siouxperb 可能会被忽视。在令人眼花缭乱的首秀后，他在考文垂感到失望，但在《音速天使》中跑得很好，以微弱的优势获得第二名。在他似乎不喜欢艾尔的柔软条件之前，阿科姆锦标赛对他来说太热了。他有潜力在全天候情况下恢复状态，并在差点中减重了两磅。

paras.en: Minzelle is another who has been highly tried in Listed company after impressive early form. She has gone off favourite in her last three, although has not shown much.
paras.zh: Minzelle 是另一位在上市公司经历过多次考验的人，早期表现令人印象深刻。尽管没有表现出太多表现，但她在过去的三场比赛中已经失去了人们的最爱。

paras.en: 2.24 Yarmouth - Eye-catching Status Symbol steps up in trip
paras.zh: 2.24 雅茅斯——引人注目的地位象征在旅途中升级

paras.en: Eye-catching Status Symbol steps up in trip in the British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes at Yarmouth.
paras.zh: 引人注目的身份象征在雅茅斯举行的英国 EBF 限制新手锦标赛中崭露头角。

paras.en: His opposition set a solid standard, although Status Symbol stayed on very nicely into fourth on debut at 50-1. Ed Walker's two-year-olds usually improve plenty for their first starts, and this son of Space Blues looks sure to improve now up in trip to 10 furlongs, with his dam being a winner over a mile and a half.
paras.zh: 他的对手树立了坚实的标准，尽管Status Symbol在首秀中以50胜1负的战绩很好地保持在第四位。埃德·沃克 (Ed Walker) 的两岁孩子通常会在第一次比赛中取得很大进步，而这个“太空蓝调”(Space Blues) 的儿子现在看起来肯定会在 10 弗隆的比赛中取得进步，他的母亲是超过一英里半的冠军。

paras.en: Able Tasman remains the only winner in the field as he won after a four-month break on his second start, beating the re-opposing Deira Moon, who he reopposes here.
paras.zh: 阿布尔·塔斯曼 (Able Tasman) 仍然是该领域唯一的获胜者，他在第二次比赛中断四个月后获胜，击败了他在这里再次对阵的德伊拉·穆恩 (Deira Moon)。

paras.en: Deira Moon ran on well that day, despite getting hampered in the final strides. He produced his best effort to date next time out at Goodwood when second again, and a seven-pound penalty for Able Tasman could bring them even closer.
paras.zh: 德伊拉·穆恩（Deira Moon）那天跑得很好，尽管在最后的步伐中受到了阻碍。下一次在古德伍德，他打出了迄今为止最好的成绩，再次获得第二名，而阿布尔·塔斯曼的七磅处罚可以让他们更加接近。

paras.en: Quintillion put up a much improved second start when bumping into the smart Wykehurst Park. Up again in trip to 10-furlongs should suit and he can put up a bold bid in attempting to break his maiden tag.
paras.zh: 当进入聪明的威克赫斯特公园时，Quintillion 在第二次起步时取得了很大的进步。在 10 弗隆的旅程中再次上升应该适合，他可以大胆地尝试打破他的处女标签。

paras.en: Good Job and Spong Hill make their debuts, with the former containing the most promising pedigree being half-brother to dual Group Two winner, Opal Tiara.
paras.zh: “好工作”和“海绵山”首次亮相，前者拥有最有前途的血统，是第二组冠军“蛋白石皇冠”的同父异母兄弟。

paras.en: 4.28 Newcastle - Debut winner Ella Beach faces Indhaar.
paras.zh: 4.28 纽卡斯尔 - 首秀冠军艾拉·海滩对阵因达尔。

paras.en: 5.00 Newcastle - Trappy fillies' handicap.
paras.zh: 5.00 纽卡斯尔 - Trappy 母马的让分盘。

paras.en: 5.30 Newcastle - Impressive debut winner Great Balls O'Fire aims to bounce back.
paras.zh: 5.30 纽卡斯尔 - 令人印象深刻的首秀获胜者 Great Balls O'Fire 旨在反弹。

paras.en: 6.30 Newcastle - Juan Les Pins and Mae Amor clash.
paras.zh: 6.30 纽卡斯尔 - 胡安·莱潘和梅·阿莫尔发生冲突。

paras.en: 7.00 Newcastle - Competitive 0-75 handicap.
paras.zh: 7.00 纽卡斯尔 - 竞技让分 0-75。

paras.en: 3.37 Worcester - Informative mares' handicap chase.
paras.zh: 3.37 伍斯特 - 信息丰富的母马障碍赛。

paras.en: 4.07 Worcester - Progressive Kykorock headlines for the Skeltons.
paras.zh: 4.07 伍斯特 - 骷髅乐队 (Skeltons) 的进步凯科洛克 (Kykorock) 头条新闻。

paras.en: 4.37 Worcester - Big Cadillac features for the Skeltons.
paras.zh: 4.37 伍斯特 - 骷髅队的大型凯迪拉克特色。

paras.en: 1.54 Yarmouth - Informative novice stakes which Sallaal won in 2024.
paras.zh: 1.54 雅茅斯 - Sallaal 在 2024 年赢得的信息丰富的新手赌注。

paras.en: 2.54 Yarmouth - Yokohama and Newton Duke feature in competitive contest.
paras.zh: 2.54 雅茅斯 - 横滨队和牛顿杜克队参加了激烈的比赛。

articles.title: Navi Pillay, who led U.N. panel that found Israel committed genocide in Gaza, wins Nobel Peace Prize
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: The Nobel Peace Prize was awarded Friday to the South African legal pioneer Navanethem “Navi” Pillay for defending international law and institutions in a world in which increasingly “might overtakes right.”
paras.zh: 周五，诺贝尔和平奖被授予南非法律先驱纳瓦尼特姆·皮莱 (Navanethem “Navi” Pillay)，以表彰他在一个日益“强权压倒权利”的世界中捍卫国际法和机构的行为。

paras.en: Pillay, 85, has a decadeslong career that spans defending Nelson Mandela and standing up against the racist apartheid regime in South Africa, to leading a United Nations commission that concluded Israel committed genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.
paras.zh: 85 岁的皮莱拥有数十年的职业生涯，从捍卫纳尔逊·曼德拉、挺身反对南非的种族主义种族隔离政权，到领导一个联合国委员会，得出以色列对加沙巴勒斯坦人实施种族灭绝的结论。

paras.en: “Navi Pillay is one of the great defenders of international legal principles in our time,” said Jørgen Watne Frydnes, chair of the Norwegian Nobel Committee.
paras.zh: “纳维·皮莱是我们这个时代国际法律原则的伟大捍卫者之一，”挪威诺贝尔委员会主席约尔根·沃特纳·弗里德内斯 (Jørgen Watne Frydnes) 说。

paras.en: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay
paras.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖授予纳维·皮莱

paras.en: Frydnes contrasted Pillay’s work with the wider international “shift towards power politics,” in which “international law is under tremendous pressure, and its institutions are under attack.”
paras.zh: 弗里德尼斯将皮莱的工作与更广泛的国际“向强权政治的转变”进行了对比，其中“国际法承受着巨大的压力，其机构受到攻击”。

paras.en: Her “distinguished career reminds us of the need to support, fortify and expand the global rule of law,” he said. “Navi Pillay’s commitment to justice and human dignity is a source of hope and inspiration to all who seek to bring about a more peaceful world.”
paras.zh: 他说，她“杰出的职业生涯提醒我们需要支持、加强和扩大全球法治”。 “纳维·皮莱对正义和人类尊严的承诺是所有寻求建立一个更加和平世界的人的希望和灵感的源泉。”

paras.en: That was a reference to President Donald Trump’s long-standing ambitions to win the Nobel Peace Prize, and the offer by last year’s winner, Maria Corina Machado, to share it with him as she sought support for her efforts in Venezuela.
paras.zh: 这指的是唐纳德·特朗普总统长期以来赢得诺贝尔和平奖的雄心，以及去年的获奖者玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多在为委内瑞拉的努力寻求支持时提出与他分享这一雄心。

paras.en: “Everybody asks me: ‘When are you going to stop? When are you going to stop?’” Pillay said, adding that despite turning 85 last month, she had no intention of doing so.
paras.zh: “每个人都问我：‘你什么时候要停下来？你什么时候要停下来？’”皮莱说，并补充说，尽管上个月她已经 85 岁了，但她无意这样做。

paras.en: “The last thing I did was the report on Gaza, namely what’s happening there is genocide,” she said.
paras.zh: “我做的最后一件事是关于加沙的报道，即那里正在发生的种族灭绝，”她说。

paras.en: “One of the main reactions to that report was paying tribute to me for my courage,” she added. “But why would you need courage to speak the truth? You interpret the law and you look at all the facts.”
paras.zh: “对该报告的主要反应之一是赞扬我的勇气，”她补充道。 “但是为什么你需要勇气说实话呢？你解释法律并审视所有事实。”

paras.en: In later more formal remarks accepting the prize, she dedicated the award to “all of the survivors of international crimes,” warning against efforts “which attempt to weaken international criminal justice” which “risk returning us to a world in which power, rather than law, determines whose suffering matters.”
paras.zh: 在后来更正式的获奖感言中，她将这一奖项献给了“所有国际罪行的幸存者”，并警告不要“试图削弱国际刑事司法”，因为这种行为“有可能让我们回到一个由权力而非法律决定谁的痛苦才是重要的世界”。

paras.en: Among her many positions, Pillay previously served as a judge on the International Criminal Court, a frequent focus of ire for the Trump administration. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced fresh sanctions on the body on Friday, hours after the prize was announced.
paras.zh: 皮莱曾担任过众多职务，其中包括国际刑事法院法官，这经常是特朗普政府愤怒的焦点。周五，在奖项宣布几小时后，国务卿马可·卢比奥宣布对该机构实施新的制裁。

paras.en: “We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate,” Rubio said in a statement, threatening to continue a campaign “to dismantle the ICC, brick by brick.”
paras.zh: 卢比奥在一份声明中表示：“我们将禁止与这个流氓法院进行交易，切断他们的资源并削弱其运作能力。”他威胁要继续开展“一砖一瓦地解散国际刑事法院”的运动。

paras.en: Agnès Callamard, secretary general of Amnesty International, was with Pillay in Germany and among the first people to congratulate her on the prize.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织秘书长阿涅斯·卡拉马尔 (Agnès Callamard) 与皮莱一起在德国，也是第一批祝贺她获奖的人之一。

paras.en: “This could not be a better choice at a time of attacks against international justice,” Callamard told NBC News. “She is a former ICC judge at a time when the U.S. administration is seeking to destroy the ICC,” she said, praising her work leading the U.N. commission “which found that Israel committed the crime of genocide at a time when many states are trying to defend and protect Israel’s actions.”
paras.zh: 卡拉马德告诉 NBC 新闻：“在国际正义受到攻击之际，这可能是一个更好的选择。”她说：“在美国政府寻求摧毁国际刑事法院的时候，她是前国际刑事法院法官。”她赞扬了她领导联合国委员会的工作，“该委员会发现以色列犯下了种族灭绝罪，而此时许多国家都在试图捍卫和保护以色列的行为。”

paras.en: The ICC condemned the new U.S. sanctions Friday, and separately praised Pillay’s win as “an important recognition of the vital role that international justice plays as a cornerstone of lasting peace.”
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院周五谴责美国的新制裁，并单独称赞皮莱的胜利“是对国际正义作为持久和平基石所发挥的重要作用的重要认可”。

paras.en: Pillay was not among those speculated to be front-runners, who included Yulia Navalnaya, the widow of anti-Kremlin figure Alexei Navalny, Ugandan climate activist Vanessa Nakate, and Mykola Kuleba, who founded an organization to rescue Ukrainian children abducted and forcibly taken to Russia.
paras.zh: 皮莱并不在被认为是领先者之列，其中包括反克里姆林宫人物阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的遗孀尤利娅·纳瓦尔纳亚、乌干达气候活动家凡妮莎·纳卡特和米科拉·库莱巴，后者成立了一个组织来营救被绑架并强行带到俄罗斯的乌克兰儿童。

paras.en: The Norwegian Nobel Institute said it had has registered a total of 287 candidates for this year’s peace prize, with politicians, international judges and professors among those who can put names forward. The committee that decides the winner is composed of five members appointed by the Norwegian Parliament.
paras.zh: 挪威诺贝尔研究所表示，已登记了今年和平奖的总共287名候选人，其中包括政界人士、国际法官和教授。决定获胜者的委员会由挪威议会任命的五名成员组成。

paras.en: The leaders of Israel, Pakistan and Cambodia all said they nominated Trump for the prize, though he said this week he didn’t think he would win.
paras.zh: 以色列、巴基斯坦和柬埔寨领导人均表示，他们提名特朗普获奖，但特朗普本周表示，他认为自己不会获胜。

paras.en: “I don’t know what their decision is going to be,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office Wednesday. “They have a reputation for maybe not giving it to people like me.”
paras.zh: “我不知道他们会做出什么决定，”特朗普周三在椭圆形办公室对记者说。 “他们以可能不会把它提供给像我这样的人而闻名。”

paras.en: Trump did not congratulate Pillay on Friday. Instead, on Truth Social, he reposted a message from another user that said the Nobel committee had “shamed itself beyond repair and demeaned the once great Nobel Peace Prize,” describing Pillay as “an unabashed hater of America and Israel.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周五没有向皮莱表示祝贺。相反，他在《Truth Social》上转发了另一位用户的消息，称诺贝尔委员会“使自己蒙羞至无可挽回，贬低了曾经伟大的诺贝尔和平奖”，并将皮莱描述为“毫不掩饰的美国和以色列仇恨者”。

articles.title: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to discuss ‘new’ peace plan with Ukrainian delegation, sources say
articles.author: Garrett Haake

paras.en: Ukrainian negotiators heading to the United States for a new round of talks to end the war with Russia will discuss a comprehensive new plan to help break the ongoing impasse in the conflict, a senior administration official told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一名高级政府官员告诉 NBC 新闻，乌克兰谈判代表前往美国进行新一轮结束与俄罗斯战争的谈判，他们将讨论一项全面的新计划，以帮助打破冲突中持续的僵局。

paras.en: The talks starting Friday and led by special envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner are the latest attempt to negotiate a settlement amid intensifying deadly aerial attacks on both sides of the border.
paras.zh: 此次会谈将于周五开始，由特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳主持，这是在边境两侧致命空袭加剧之际谈判达成解决方案的最新尝试。

paras.en: The discussions will center on “a new, unified proposal that is focused on all aspects of the conflict to try to end the war,” the senior administration official said Thursday evening.
paras.zh: 这位高级政府官员周四晚表示，讨论将集中在“一项新的、统一的提案，重点关注冲突的各个方面，以试图结束战争”。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the Ukrainian delegation will travel to the U.S. for two days of negotiations, and include Rustem Umerov, the head of the country’s Foreign Intelligence Service, and Kyrylo Budanov, who heads the office of the president.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基总统表示，乌克兰代表团将前往美国进行为期两天的谈判，代表团成员包括该国对外情报局局长鲁斯泰姆·乌梅罗夫和总统办公室主任凯里洛·布达诺夫。

paras.en: Zelenskyy acknowledged a possible new phase in the negotiations.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基承认谈判可能进入新阶段。

paras.en: “We see on the part of the United States of America, an intensification of talks and meetings,” he told reporters, without mentioning any new proposals. “I myself have spoken with the American side three times in recent days, and I hope for a good result from our negotiators’ meeting.”
paras.zh: “我们看到美利坚合众国方面正在加强会谈和会议，”他对记者表示，但没有提及任何新提议。 “我本人这几天已与美方进行了3次通话，希望我们的谈判能取得好结果。”

paras.en: Trump had vowed to swiftly end the conflict that began when Russia launched a full-scale invasion in February 2022. Despite numerous meetings and talks to broker a ceasefire since he took office, the two sides have been locked in a stalemate over the industrial region of Donbas in Ukraine’s east.
paras.zh: 特朗普发誓要迅速结束2022年2月俄罗斯发动全面入侵时引发的冲突。尽管自他上任以来为促成停火举行了多次会议和会谈，但双方在乌克兰东部顿巴斯工业区问题上陷入僵局。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has said that he wants to seize the entire region, parts of which Kyiv’s forces still hold. Zelenskyy has ruled out ceding this territory, arguing that Putin could use it as a base to again attack Ukraine. Russia currently occupies about one-fifth of Ukraine’s territory.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，他希望占领整个地区，其中部分地区仍由基辅军队控制。泽连斯基排除了放弃这片领土的可能性，认为普京可能会利用它作为再次攻击乌克兰的基地。俄罗斯目前占据乌克兰约五分之一的领土。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned Thursday that stalemates are “very dangerous” because they either end in a negotiated settlement or escalation. In the context of Ukraine, that “could wind up being a sabotage campaign in neighboring countries that are members of NATO,” he said.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周四警告说，僵局“非常危险”，因为要么以谈判解决，要么升级。他说，就乌克兰而言，这“最终可能成为对北约邻国的破坏活动”。

paras.en: European leaders are growing increasingly concerned about Russia escalating and expanding the conflict onto the continent.
paras.zh: 欧洲领导人越来越担心俄罗斯将冲突升级并扩大到欧洲大陆。

paras.en: “In the end, we do not believe that there is a military solution to this conflict, to this war. We think this war needs to end in a negotiated settlement,” Rubio said. “The sooner, the better.”
paras.zh: “最终，我们不认为这场冲突、这场战争有军事解决方案。我们认为这场战争需要通过谈判解决，”卢比奥说。 “越早越好。”

paras.en: In separate comments to the Greek newspaper Kathimerini, Rubio said “there don’t seem to be prospects of a negotiated settlement” on peace in Ukraine right now. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov responded by saying he agreed with Rubio’s assessment, the Russian state news agency Tass reported.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在向希腊报纸 Kathimerini 发表单独评论时表示，目前乌克兰和平问题“似乎没有通过谈判达成解决方案的前景”。据俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社报道，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫回应称，他同意卢比奥的评估。

paras.en: The U.S. diplomatic efforts to end the war were revived last month when Witkoff and Kushner traveled to Moscow and, for the first time, Kyiv. No major breakthroughs were announced.
paras.zh: 上个月，威特科夫和库什纳前往莫斯科，并首次前往基辅，美国结束战争的外交努力得到恢复。没有宣布重大突破。

paras.en: The White House has previously repeated some of Putin’s hard-line demands and tried to push Kyiv for concessions.
paras.zh: 白宫此前曾多次重申普京的一些强硬要求，并试图迫使基辅做出让步。

paras.en: Putin explained the invasion by saying Russia was trying to demilitarize Ukraine and overthrow Kyiv’s government, which he said is driven by “Nazi ideology” — a common Kremlin propaganda line.
paras.zh: 普京在解释这次入侵时表示，俄罗斯试图使乌克兰非军事化并推翻基辅政府，他说基辅政府的驱动力是“纳粹意识形态”——这是克里姆林宫的共同宣传路线。

paras.en: What was supposed to be a swift military operation to topple Zelenskyy and replace him with a pro-Kremlin government quickly foundered, leaving the capture of Donbas as Putin’s only option to claim a significant victory in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 原本旨在推翻泽伦斯基并以亲克里姆林宫政府取而代之的迅速军事行动很快就失败了，夺取顿巴斯成为普京在乌克兰取得重大胜利的唯一选择。

articles.title: Saudi airport struck again a day after deadly attack
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: An unidentified projectile struck Saudi Arabia’s main international airport Sunday, injuring people a day after a deadly missile attack at the same site raised questions about whether the United States would join another conflict in the region.
paras.zh: 周日，一枚身份不明的弹丸袭击了沙特阿拉伯的主要国际机场，造成人员受伤，一天前同一地点发生致命的导弹袭击，引发了人们对美国是否会加入该地区另一场冲突的疑问。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation confirmed the death of a Pakistani resident and injuries to 11 others in the new attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. It said authorities were assessing damage and checking the safety of airport facilities.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯民航总局证实，在利雅得哈立德国王国际机场发生的新袭击中，一名巴基斯坦居民死亡，另有 11 人受伤。据称，当局正在评估受损情况并检查机场设施的安全性。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition said the projectile struck Terminal 4, causing a fire that authorities were working to control. It also reported intercepting and destroying a cruise missile near the airport.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联军表示，导弹击中了 4 号航站楼，引发火灾，当局正在努力控制火灾。它还报告在机场附近拦截并摧毁了一枚巡航导弹。

paras.en: Saturday’s strike killed at least 13 people and injured more than 300, according to Saudi civil aviation authorities. The victims included one American as well as four citizens of Saudi Arabia, two Bangladeshi nationals, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Palestinian, a Syrian and one Sudanese.
paras.zh: 据沙特民航当局称，周六的空袭造成至少 13 人死亡、300 多人受伤。遇难者包括一名美国人、四名沙特阿拉伯公民、两名孟加拉国公民、一名埃及人、一名约旦人、一名巴勒斯坦人、一名叙利亚人和一名苏丹人。

paras.en: The Indian Embassy in Saudi Arabia said Sunday that an Indian national injured in Saturday’s attack had died. The embassy said it was in contact with the family and would help repatriate the remains.
paras.zh: 印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆周日表示，一名在周六袭击中受伤的印度国民已经死亡。使馆表示正在与死者家属取得联系，并将协助遣返遗体。

paras.en: Some of the wounded were in critical condition, authorities said, while airport operations remained suspended Sunday.
paras.zh: 当局表示，一些伤者情况危急，而机场周日仍暂停运营。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said afterward that the U.S. was considering joining Saudi military operations against the Iran-backed Houthi rebels.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统随后表示，美国正在考虑加入沙特针对伊朗支持的胡塞叛军的军事行动。

paras.en: “We may. We’re gonna look at it,” Trump told reporters. “We just found out about the recent attack. So we’ll make a decision. We move very quickly.”
paras.zh: “我们可能会。我们会考虑一下，”特朗普告诉记者。 “我们刚刚发现最近发生的袭击事件。所以我们会做出决定。我们行动非常快。”

paras.en: Saturday’s strike drew widespread condemnation and intensified pressure on the kingdom and its allies to respond to the Houthi rebels. The attack was the deadliest to hit the kingdom in a decade and marked a sharp escalation in the Yemen-based Houthis’ campaign against the leading oil exporter, which has already rattled the global economy.
paras.zh: 周六的袭击引起了广泛谴责，并加大了沙特及其盟友应对胡塞叛军的压力。这次袭击是该国十年来最严重的一次袭击，标志着也门胡塞武装针对主要石油出口国的行动急剧升级，这已经令全球经济感到不安。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s government and its allies blamed the Houthis for Saturday’s strike. The group did not immediately claim responsibility for the latest attack, although it renewed a warning to stay away from Saudi airports.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯政府及其盟友指责胡塞武装发动了周六的袭击。该组织没有立即声称对最近的袭击负责，但再次警告不要进入沙特机场。

paras.en: Washington also blamed the Houthis for Saturday’s assault, the latest of several on the busy facility in the past week. Three people were killed there in an attack on Thursday.
paras.zh: 华盛顿还指责胡塞武装对周六的袭击事件负责，这是过去一周对这座繁忙设施的几起袭击事件中的最新一起。周四的一次袭击造成三人死亡。

paras.en: The attack has drawn fresh scrutiny of Washington’s response to the widening conflict, in which the Houthis have hit Saudi energy infrastructure and seized territory that gives them leverage over shipping in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 这次袭击引发了人们对华盛顿对日益扩大的冲突的反应的新审视，胡塞武装袭击了沙特的能源基础设施，并夺取了使他们能够控制红海航运的领土。

paras.en: Trump responds to potential U.S. involvement after Saudi attack
paras.zh: 特朗普回应沙特袭击后美国可能介入

paras.en: The U.S. launched a three-month bombing campaign against the Houthis last year to stop them from targeting shipping through the critical waterway, an alternative to the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 美国去年对胡塞武装发起了为期三个月的轰炸行动，以阻止他们瞄准通过这条替代霍尔木兹海峡的重要水道的航运。

paras.en: The Saudis will be looking to allies like Pakistan, Turkey, Syria, Egypt and the U.S. for help, said Fawaz Gerges, a professor of international relations at the London School of Economics.
paras.zh: 伦敦经济学院国际关系教授法瓦兹·格尔格斯表示，沙特将向巴基斯坦、土耳其、叙利亚、埃及和美国等盟友寻求帮助。

paras.en: “But I doubt very much whether there is an answer or even a military solution to the Yemeni conflict,” he told NBC News.
paras.zh: “但我非常怀疑也门冲突是否有答案，甚至是军事解决方案，”他告诉 NBC 新闻。

paras.en: “The Houthis are determined to fight to the end,” Gerges said. “I suspect that the reason why the U.S. has been reluctant is not only because of the Iran war, but also because the U.S. tried for several months to force the Houthis to stand down, and they did not succeed.”
paras.zh: 格尔格斯说：“胡塞武装决心战斗到底。” “我怀疑美国之所以不情愿，不仅是因为伊朗战争，还因为美国几个月来试图迫使胡塞武装下台，但没有成功。”

paras.en: At the same time, the Houthis are becoming “more nimble, more resourceful, more deadly by the day, and I think what we have seen in the past few weeks is that the targeting system of the Houthis has become much more effective,” he said.
paras.zh: 与此同时，胡塞武装正变得“日益灵活、更加足智多谋、更加致命，我认为我们在过去几周看到的是，胡塞武装的目标系统变得更加有效”，他说。

paras.en: Egypt said Sunday that it “stands firmly” with Saudi Arabia, expressing “strong condemnation” for the attacks. Qatar called the missile strike “a grave violation of Saudi Arabia’s sovereignty and a direct threat to regional security.”
paras.zh: 埃及周日表示，它“坚定地”与沙特阿拉伯站在一起，对袭击事件表示“强烈谴责”。卡塔尔称这次导弹袭击“严重侵犯了沙特阿拉伯的主权，对地区安全构成直接威胁”。

paras.en: Germany and Canada also condemned the attacks, with Prime Minister Mark Carney describing them as “abhorrent.”
paras.zh: 德国和加拿大也谴责了这些袭击，总理马克·卡尼称这些袭击“令人憎恶”。

paras.en: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres blamed the Houthis, calling the attack “a violation of international law.” The Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis called the attack a “fully-fledged war crime” and vowed a strong response.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯指责胡塞武装，称这次袭击“违反了国际法”。沙特领导的打击胡塞武装的联军称这次袭击是“彻底的战争罪行”，并誓言将予以强烈回应。

paras.en: Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport kill 3 Saudi nationals
paras.zh: 胡塞武装袭击利雅得机场 造成 3 名沙特公民死亡

paras.en: The renewed fighting has developed alongside the broader war involving Iran, with the Houthis stepping up attacks on Saudi territory as Saudi-backed forces battle the group inside Yemen. The latest violence follows the collapse of a truce in July and a renewed Saudi-backed offensive against Houthi positions.
paras.zh: 新的战斗是与涉及伊朗的更广泛的战争一起发展的，随着沙特支持的部队在也门境内与胡塞武装作战，胡塞武装加大了对沙特领土的攻击力度。最近的暴力事件是在七月份停战协议破裂以及沙特支持的对胡塞武装阵地重新发起进攻之后发生的。

paras.en: The Houthis have expanded their operations along Yemen’s Red Sea coast and around the Bab el Mandeb Strait, a critical shipping route connecting the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. Disruption there threatens international trade and energy shipments, raising fuel prices and adding another source of instability to global markets.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装扩大了也门红海沿岸和曼德海峡周围的行动，曼德海峡是连接红海和亚丁湾的重要航线。那里的干扰威胁到国际贸易和能源运输，导致燃料价格上涨，并给全球市场带来另一个不稳定因素。

paras.en: Trump has focused intensely on energy prices ahead of the midterm elections, including a diesel deal with the Kremlin that stunned Ukraine. But he has so far resisted deeper involvement in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 特朗普在中期选举前高度关注能源价格，其中包括与克里姆林宫达成的令乌克兰震惊的柴油协议。但迄今为止，他一直拒绝进一步介入中东。

paras.en: After sweeping gains by Houthi forces last month, Trump said the group had contacted the U.S. to stress that they “don’t want to fight with us” and would “much prefer not having us involved.”
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，胡塞武装上个月取得巨大胜利后，该组织已与美国联系，强调他们“不想与我们并肩作战”，并且“宁愿不让我们参与其中”。

paras.en: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman urged Trump in September to take military action against the Houthis, a person familiar with the matter told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉 NBC 新闻，沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼 9 月敦促特朗普对胡塞武装采取军事行动。

paras.en: “There is a whole lot that America can deliver,” said Abdulkhaleq Abdulla, a retired professor of political science from the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: “美国可以提供很多东西，”阿拉伯联合酋长国退休政治学教授阿卜杜勒哈利克·阿卜杜拉 (Abdulkhaleq Abdulla) 说。

paras.en: “It doesn’t have to be in the form of going all out against the Houthis, but American sharing of intelligence, America providing the best of defense systems against Houthis’ drones and missiles is needed, and I think if that is delivered, Saudi Arabia and the rest can defend themselves,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“不一定要全力以赴打击胡塞武装，但美国需要分享情报，需要美国提供最好的防御系统来抵御胡塞武装的无人机和导弹，我认为如果做到这一点，沙特阿拉伯和其他国家就可以保卫自己。”

paras.en: Abdulla also called on Turkey and Pakistan to come to Saudi Arabia’s defense. The three nations signed a joint defense agreement in Mecca in August, a pact of Sunni Muslim U.S. allies alarmed at growing regional conflict.
paras.zh: 阿卜杜拉还呼吁土耳其和巴基斯坦保卫沙特阿拉伯。这三个国家八月在麦加签署了一项联合防御协议，这是美国逊尼派穆斯林盟友对日益加剧的地区冲突感到震惊的协议。

paras.en: “Now it’s the time to activate what this alliance treaty involves,” added Abdulla. “That an attack on one is an attack against all.”
paras.zh: 阿卜杜拉补充道：“现在是启动该联盟条约所涉内容的时候了。” “对一个人的攻击就是对所有人的攻击。”

articles.title: Breaking: Infant girl flown to hospital after being hit by car near Ballarat
articles.author: Charlotte Wilkes

paras.en: An infant girl has been flown to hospital with life-threatening injuries after being hit by a car south-west of Ballarat.
paras.zh: 一名女婴在巴拉瑞特西南部被一辆汽车撞倒后被送往医院，伤势危及生命。

paras.en: Emergency services were called to Vermont Road in Smythesdale after reports an infant was hit by a car at about 1:20pm.
paras.zh: 下午 1 点 20 分左右，有报道称一名婴儿被汽车撞倒，紧急服务人员接到电话前往 Smythesdale 的佛蒙特路。

paras.en: Mobile Intensive Care Ambulance and Advanced Life Support teams attended the site.
paras.zh: 移动重症监护救护车和高级生命支持团队参加了现场。

paras.en: Ambulance Victoria said the child was in a critical condition and had been flown to The Royal Children's Hospital.
paras.zh: 维多利亚救护车表示，孩子情况危急，已被送往皇家儿童医院。

paras.en: Smythesdale is a town of about 1,800 people, roughly 25 kilometres from Ballarat.
paras.zh: Smythesdale 小镇约有 1,800 人，距离巴拉瑞特约 25 公里。

articles.title: Boyfriend of murdered backpacker sues police over arrest
articles.author: Cath Adams

paras.en: Tobias Moran has filed civil proceedings in the NSW District Court against the NSW Police for malicious prosecution.
paras.zh: 托比亚斯·莫兰（Tobias Moran）已向新南威尔士州地方法院提起民事诉讼，指控新南威尔士州警方恶意起诉。

paras.en: Mr Moran was charged in 2022 over the 2005 death of his girlfriend Simone Strobel in Lismore, but charges were withdrawn a year later.
paras.zh: 莫兰先生于 2022 年因女友西蒙娜·斯特罗贝尔 (Simone Strobel) 2005 年在利斯莫尔死亡而受到指控，但一年后指控被撤回。

paras.en: The civil case will be heard in the NSW District Court in January.
paras.zh: 该民事案件将于一月在新南威尔士州地方法院审理。

paras.en: The boyfriend of a German backpacker murdered in northern New South Wales 20 years ago is suing the NSW Police Force.
paras.zh: 20 年前在新南威尔士州北部被谋杀的一名德国背包客的男友正在起诉新南威尔士州警察局。

paras.en: Tobias Moran, formerly known as Tobias Suckfuell, has alleged police maliciously targeted him rather than searching for the truth about how the woman died.
paras.zh: 托拜厄斯·莫兰（Tobias Moran），原名托拜厄斯·苏克菲尔（Tobias Suckfuell），声称警方恶意针对他，而不是寻找该女子死亡的真相。

paras.en: He was charged in 2022 over the death of 25-year-old Simone Strobel, whose naked body was found near the Lismore caravan park they were staying at in February 2005.
paras.zh: 2022 年，他因 25 岁的西蒙娜·史特罗贝尔 (Simone Strobel) 的死亡而受到指控，2005 年 2 月，他们在利斯莫尔房车公园附近发现了她的裸体。

paras.en: Mr Moran spent 10 days in custody and 10 months adhering to bail conditions before the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions withdrew the charges.
paras.zh: 莫兰先生被拘留 10 天，并遵守保释条件 10 个月，之后检察长办公室撤回了指控。

paras.en: The court ordered the state of New South Wales to pay Mr Moran's legal costs of $190,000.
paras.zh: 法院命令新南威尔士州支付 Moran 先生的法律费用 190,000 美元。

paras.en: Mr Moran has now filed civil proceedings in the NSW District Court against the NSW Police for malicious prosecution.
paras.zh: 莫兰先生现已向新南威尔士州地方法院提起民事诉讼，指控新南威尔士州警方恶意起诉。

paras.en: In a statement, Mr Moran challenged the police motive for the arrest.
paras.zh: 莫兰在一份声明中对警方逮捕的动机提出质疑。

paras.en: "This is an important step towards clearing my name and holding the relevant NSW police officers to account for what I believe was a prosecution driven by improper motives rather than a pursuit of the truth," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是为我洗清罪名并让新南威尔士州相关警察承担责任的重要一步，我认为这次起诉是出于不正当动机，而不是为了追求真相。”

paras.en: Simone Strobel disappeared from the Lismore Tourist Caravan Park near the city's CBD on Friday, February 11, 2005.
paras.zh: 2005 年 2 月 11 日星期五，西蒙娜·史特博 (Simone Strobel) 从该市中央商务区附近的利斯莫尔旅游大篷车公园失踪。

paras.en: She had been staying their her then-boyfriend, Tobias Moran, his sister, Katrin Suckfuell, and their friend, Jens Martin.
paras.zh: 她一直和她当时的男友托比亚斯·莫兰（Tobias Moran）、他的妹妹卡特琳·苏克菲尔（Katrin Suckfuell）以及他们的朋友詹斯·马丁（Jens Martin）在一起。

paras.en: They reported her missing when she failed to return from a walk after a disagreement.
paras.zh: 当她因一次争执而散步后未能返回时，他们报告说她失踪了。

paras.en: Six days later, Ms Strobel's body was discovered under palm fronds at a bocce court, less than 100 metres from their campsite.
paras.zh: 六天后，史特罗贝尔女士的尸体在地掷球场的棕榈叶下被发现，距离他们的露营地不到 100 米。

paras.en: In late 2025, State Coroner Teresa O'Sullivan overturned the findings of a previous inquest.
paras.zh: 2025 年末，州验尸官 Teresa O'Sullivan 推翻了之前调查的结果。

paras.en: She found that while Mr Moran could not be completely ruled out as a suspect, it was unlikely he could have killed Ms Strobel without help.
paras.zh: 她发现，虽然不能完全排除莫兰先生的嫌疑，但他不太可能在没有帮助的情况下杀死史特罗贝尔女士。

paras.en: "It is unlikely that Mr [Jens] Martin and Ms [Katrin] Suckfuell were involved in Simone's death; and secondly, it is unlikely that Mr Moran could have acted alone in killing Simone and disposing of her body," Ms O'Sullivan said in handing down her findings.
paras.zh: 奥沙利文女士在公布调查结果时表示：“詹斯·马丁先生和卡特琳·苏克菲尔女士不太可能参与西蒙娜的死亡；其次，莫兰先生也不可能单独杀死西蒙娜并处理她的尸体。”

paras.en: "I do not, however, accept that the evidence goes so far as to support a finding by me that it is very unlikely Mr Moran was involved in Simone's death".
paras.zh: “然而，我不认为证据足以支持我的调查结果，即莫兰先生不太可能参与西蒙娜的死亡”。

paras.en: Mr Moran spoke to the ABC about the unsolved murder earlier this year for the Unravel: Lies in Lismore podcast.
paras.zh: 莫兰先生在今年早些时候的节目《揭秘：利斯莫尔的谎言》中向美国广播公司讲述了这起悬而未决的谋杀案。

paras.en: He told ABC journalist Richard Baker he was innocent and that police developed "tunnel vision" about him at the expense of finding Ms Strobel's killer.
paras.zh: 他告诉美国广播公司记者理查德·贝克（Richard Baker），他是无辜的，警方对他产生了“狭隘视野”，但代价是找不到杀害斯特罗贝尔女士的凶手。

paras.en: "Crucial evidence has not been considered," Mr Moran said in the podcast.
paras.zh: “关键证据尚未得到考虑，”莫兰先生在播客中说。

paras.en: "They've been on the wrong track for 20 f***ing years … I think the Australian public has a right to know that this is a full Muppet show."
paras.zh: “20年来他们一直走在错误的道路上……我认为澳大利亚公众有权知道这是一场完整的布偶表演。”

paras.en: Stewart O'Connell SC is representing Mr Moran in the civil action.
paras.zh: Stewart O'Connell SC 在民事诉讼中代表 Moran 先生。

paras.en: He said in a statement that Mr Moran had "consistently maintained his innocence of this horrific crime".
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示，莫兰先生“始终坚称自己对这一可怕的罪行是无辜的”。

paras.en: "There has never been any convincing evidence of his involvement," Mr O'Connell said.
paras.zh: “从来没有任何令人信服的证据表明他参与其中，”奥康奈尔先生说。

paras.en: "He has had to endure both the shock and pain of Simone's death and the devastation and distress of being blamed, arrested and detained for it.
paras.zh: “他不得不忍受西蒙娜之死的震惊和痛苦，以及因此而受到指责、逮捕和拘留的毁灭和痛苦。

paras.en: "These proceedings will examine the investigation and prosecution of Mr Moran and, if found to be improperly motivated, will ensure that Mr Moran receives some justice."
paras.zh: “这些程序将审查对莫兰先生的调查和起诉，如果发现动机不当，将确保莫兰先生得到一些正义。”

paras.en: Mr O'Connell said compensation was being sought for Mr Moran, but had not put a figure on the amount being sought.
paras.zh: 奥康奈尔表示，正在为莫兰寻求赔偿，但没有具体说明赔偿金额。

paras.en: Mr Moran said he hoped the court action would bring renewed focus on the investigation into Ms Strobel's death.
paras.zh: 莫兰先生表示，他希望法院的行动能够让人们重新关注对斯特罗贝尔女士死亡事件的调查。

paras.en: "She was a very special person who deserved better, and her family deserves better," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“她是一个非常特别的人，应该得到更好的待遇，她的家人也应该得到更好的待遇。”

paras.en: "Everyone impacted by Simone's death and the aftermath deserves some answers and closure."
paras.zh: “每个受到西蒙娜之死及其后果影响的人都应该得到一些答案和结束。”

paras.en: In a statement, NSW Police said it was aware of the court action, but declined to comment.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方在一份声明中表示，他们了解法院的行动，但拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: The civil case has been listed in the NSW District Court for January 27, 2027.
paras.zh: 该民事案件已于 2027 年 1 月 27 日在新南威尔士州地方法院审理。

articles.title: Breaking: Police pursuit ends in serious crash in Perth's south
articles.author: Blake Kagi and Lauren Smith

paras.en: A person has been rushed to hospital and another is in custody after a police pursuit through Perth's southern suburbs ended in a serious crash.
paras.zh: 警方在珀斯南郊的追捕行动以严重车祸告终，一名男子被送往医院，另一人被拘留。

paras.en: The crash happened just before 11am, with fire and ambulance crews rushing to the scene on South Street in Leeming, near the intersection of Beasley Road.
paras.zh: 事故发生在上午 11 点左右，消防和救护人员赶到利明南街比斯利路交叉口附近的现场。

paras.en: St John Ambulance said a man was taken to Royal Perth Hospital under the highest priority, while a man in his 40s and a woman in her 30s were taken to Fiona Stanley Hospital.
paras.zh: 圣约翰救护车表示，一名男子被紧急送往皇家珀斯医院，一名40多岁的男子和一名30多岁的女子被送往菲奥娜斯坦利医院。

paras.en: Aerial vision from the scene shows the front of a white sedan had been ripped off before the car eventually came to a standstill in the westbound lanes of South St.
paras.zh: 现场鸟瞰图显示，一辆白色轿车的车头被扯掉，最终汽车停在了南圣路易斯的西行车道上。

paras.en: The car's engine was ejected in the smash, landing 50 metres away on the opposite side of the six-lane road.
paras.zh: 汽车的发动机在撞击中被弹出，落在 50 米外的六车道道路的对面。

paras.en: Another black van 90 metres further down the road has a smashed windscreen and a metal road sign lodged in its bonnet.
paras.zh: 路边 90 米处的另一辆黑色货车的挡风玻璃被打碎，引擎盖上嵌着一个金属路标。

paras.en: Debris could be seen scattered through all lanes of traffic.
paras.zh: 交通的各个车道上都可以看到碎片散落一地。

paras.en: Jessica Humble said she heard what sounded like "a really bad crash" as she was leaving her home around 11am.
paras.zh: 杰西卡·汉布尔 (Jessica Humble) 表示，上午 11 点左右，当她离开家时，她听到了“非常严重的撞车声”。

paras.en: "I just heard loads of police sirens, and then all of a sudden it was just like bang bang bang, really loud," she said.
paras.zh: “我刚刚听到大量的警笛声，然后突然间就像砰砰砰一样，非常响亮，”她说。

paras.en: She said a couple of drivers pulled over to help but then backed off when police descended on the area.
paras.zh: 她说，几名司机停下来帮忙，但当警察来到该地区时，他们又退缩了。

paras.en: "It has shaken the neighbourhood a little bit, but it's a really bad spot, it's notorious for crashes."
paras.zh: “它对附近地区造成了一些震动，但这是一个非常糟糕的地方，它因车祸而臭名昭著。”

paras.en: Another witness, who did not want to be named, said he was confronted by the scene as he returned home.
paras.zh: 另一位不愿透露姓名的目击者表示，他回到家时就看到了这一幕。

paras.en: "There was just debris spread as far as the eye could see," the witness said.
paras.zh: 目击者说：“目力所及之处，只有碎片散布开来。”

paras.en: He said his wife described the sound of the crash as "like a bomb going off".
paras.zh: 他说，他的妻子形容坠机的声音“就像炸弹爆炸一样”。

paras.en: "Police cars seemed to come from everywhere."
paras.zh: “警车似乎来自四面八方。”

articles.title: Saudis say Riyadh airport struck for 2nd day in a row, separate airport also attacked

paras.en: Saudis say Riyadh airport struck for 2nd day in a row, separate airport also attacked
paras.zh: 沙特称利雅得机场连续第二天遭到袭击，其他机场也遭到袭击

paras.en: Yemen's Houthi rebels claim responsibility for Sunday's attacks as conflict intensifies
paras.zh: 随着冲突加剧，也门胡塞武装声称对周日的袭击负责

paras.en: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at the international airport in Riyadh on Sunday, a day after a missile hit the same terminal and killed 12 people, the Saudi-led coalition fighting Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen said.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的在也门打击伊朗支持的胡塞叛乱分子的联军表示，周日，一枚导弹袭击了利雅得国际机场的一个航站楼，一天前，一枚导弹击中了同一航站楼，造成 12 人死亡。

paras.en: The Houthis claimed responsibility for those attacks and others.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装声称对这些袭击和其他袭击负责。

paras.en: The Saudi Civil Aviation Authority said one person was killed in Sunday's attack on the King Khalid International Airport — a Pakistani resident — and 11 others were injured.
paras.zh: 沙特民航局表示，哈立德国王国际机场周日发生的袭击事件造成 1 人死亡（一名巴基斯坦居民），另有 11 人受伤。

paras.en: Saturday's missile attack was the deadliest in a Gulf Arab nation since the Iran war began in February, with another 300 people wounded, some critically.
paras.zh: 周六的导弹袭击是自 2 月份伊朗战争爆发以来海湾阿拉伯国家最严重的一次导弹袭击，另有 300 人受伤，其中一些人伤势严重。

paras.en: The sharp escalation in the new front in the Iran war threatens to draw in greater U.S. military involvement as U.S. President Donald Trump has said he is weighing joining the fight against the rebels.
paras.zh: 伊朗战争新战线的急剧升级可能会吸引美国更多的军事介入，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他正在考虑加入打击叛乱分子的斗争。

paras.en: This screengrab from surveillance footage released by the Saudi Ministry of Media shows people reacting to an attack at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday. (Saudi Ministry of Media/Reuters)
paras.zh: 沙特媒体部发布的监控录像的屏幕截图显示了人们对周六利雅得哈立德国王国际机场袭击事件的反应。 （沙特媒体部/路透社）

paras.en: The Indian Embassy in Saudi Arabia said one of its citizens died Sunday of injuries sustained in Saturday's attack, which would bring the death toll to 13.
paras.zh: 印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆表示，周日，一名印度公民在周六的袭击中受伤死亡，死亡人数将达到 13 人。

paras.en: Saudi authorities later said King Fahd International Airport in Dammam had also been attacked, with few details. The city is on the Persian Gulf near Bahrain and Qatar.
paras.zh: 沙特当局后来表示，达曼法赫德国王国际机场也遭到袭击，但没有透露更多细节。该城市位于波斯湾，靠近巴林和卡塔尔。

paras.en: The strikes came shortly after the Houthis said the airport under their control in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa had been struck again. They blamed the Saudis but provided no details.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们控制下的也门首都萨那机场再次遭到袭击后不久，袭击发生了。他们指责沙特，但没有提供细节。

paras.en: At stake, again, are global supplies and prices of oil, as well as commercial shipping through a crucial alternative waterway to the Iran-threatened Strait of Hormuz — along with civilians and aviation throughout the region.
paras.zh: 再次受到威胁的是全球石油供应和价格，以及通过一条重要的替代水道前往受伊朗威胁的霍尔木兹海峡的商业运输，以及整个地区的民用和航空业。

paras.en: Trump on Saturday also said he planned to speak with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, who has been seeking assistance.
paras.zh: 特朗普周六还表示，他计划与一直在寻求援助的沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼进行交谈。

paras.en: A U.S. intervention could prompt the Houthis to halt shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait at the southern end of the Red Sea off Yemen and further restrict the flow of oil out of the Persian Gulf. The rebels seized key areas along the strait last month, and the Saudi-led coalition has been trying to seize them back.
paras.zh: 美国的干预可能会促使胡塞武装停止通过也门附近红海南端的曼德海峡的航运，并进一步限制石油流出波斯湾。叛乱分子上个月占领了海峡沿岸的关键地区，沙特领导的联军一直试图夺回这些地区。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is running low on missile interceptors and has asked France, Britain, Pakistan and Egypt to deploy air defence support to the region, regional officials told The Associated Press last month, with one noting that the U.S. has seen its own stock dwindle during the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 地区官员上个月告诉美联社，沙特阿拉伯的导弹拦截器数量不足，已要求法国、英国、巴基斯坦和埃及向该地区部署防空支持，其中一位官员指出，在与伊朗的战争期间，美国的库存不断减少。

paras.en: Sunday's attack occurred as the Saudis hosted a major international energy conference in Riyadh, with other high-profile events, including an investment gathering, on the horizon. Saudi Arabia under bin Salman has sought to open more to the world as a business and tourism destination, but the Houthi attacks threaten those efforts.
paras.zh: 周日的袭击发生时，沙特正在利雅得主办一场大型国际能源会议，其他备受瞩目的活动，包括一次投资聚会，也即将举行。本·萨勒曼领导下的沙特阿拉伯一直寻求向世界开放更多的商业和旅游目的地，但胡塞武装的袭击威胁到了这些努力。

paras.en: "There is no way that somebody will break our back. We are like a phoenix, we come out of the ashes all the time," the Saudi energy minister, Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud, told the conference.
paras.zh: 沙特能源大臣阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·萨勒曼·阿勒沙特亲王在会议上表示：“任何人都不可能折断我们的脊梁。我们就像凤凰，我们总是从灰烬中涅槃。”

paras.en: He added that the kingdom is also working on pipelines, in addition to the East-West one that was attacked and closed for days last month, with no details.
paras.zh: 他补充说，除了上个月遭受袭击并关闭数天的东西向管道外，沙特还在修建管道，但没有透露任何细节。

paras.en: Airports a 'theatre of operations': Houthis
paras.zh: 胡塞武装：机场是“战区”

paras.en: Earlier Sunday, the Houthi-run Health Ministry reported that a child was killed and six people wounded in a suspected Saudi airstrike on a house in Sanaa.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，胡塞武装控制的卫生部报告称，沙特疑似对萨那一所房屋发动空袭，造成一名儿童死亡、六人受伤。

paras.en: The ministry says 91 Yemenis have been killed and 168 injured by the Saudi-led coalition in five weeks. It said that 60 per cent of those killed were women and children.
paras.zh: 该部表示，五周内，沙特领导的联军已造成 91 名也门人死亡、168 人受伤。据称，遇难者中 60% 是妇女和儿童。

paras.en: There was no immediate comment from Saudi authorities.
paras.zh: 沙特当局没有立即发表评论。

paras.en: On Sunday, the Houthis claimed the attack on the airport in Dammam as well as attacks on oil and gas facilities in the kingdom's east. They have targeted the Riyadh airport, which has no military facilities, every day since Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周日，胡塞武装声称对达曼机场袭击以及沙特东部石油和天然气设施袭击负责。自周三以来，他们每天都瞄准没有军事设施的利雅得机场。

paras.en: The rebels again warned "all airlines, experts, employees, workers and travellers against using Saudi airports and airspace, as they are vulnerable to attack and have become a theatre of operations for our forces." Several international airlines have suspended flights for varying periods.
paras.zh: 叛乱分子再次警告“所有航空公司、专家、雇员、工人和旅客不要使用沙特机场和领空，因为它们很容易受到攻击，并已成为我们部队的行动战场。”多家国际航空公司已在不同时期暂停航班。

paras.en: Saudi authorities said the dead in Saturday's attack included four Saudi citizens, two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese.
paras.zh: 沙特当局表示，周六袭击事件中的死者包括四名沙特公民、两名孟加拉国公民、一名巴勒斯坦人、一名美国公民、一名埃及人、一名约旦人、一名叙利亚人和一名苏丹人。

paras.en: Relatives display a portrait of Syrian citizen Buthaina Ahmad Oweida, who they say was killed in Saturday's attack on the international airport in Riyadh. (Omar Albam/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 亲属展示了叙利亚公民布塞纳·艾哈迈德·奥韦达的肖像，他们说她在周六利雅得国际机场的袭击中丧生。 （奥马尔·阿尔巴姆/美联社）

paras.en: The Egyptian woman was a flight attendant identified as Azza Ramzy, 28, who worked for the Saudi airline Flynas, according to Egyptian state-run TV.
paras.zh: 据埃及国营电视台报道，这名埃及女子是一名空乘人员，名叫阿扎·拉姆齐 (Azza Ramzy)，28 岁，为沙特航空公司 Flynas 工作。

paras.en: The Syrian woman was a widowed mother of four who had been living in Saudi Arabia for five years, a relative told The Associated Press. The Syrian Embassy in Riyadh identified her as Buthaina Ahmad Oweida.
paras.zh: 一名亲戚告诉美联社，这名叙利亚妇女是四个孩子的寡妇，她在沙特阿拉伯生活了五年。叙利亚驻利雅得大使馆确认她是布塞娜·艾哈迈德·奥韦达。

paras.en: Until recently, the Houthis had been largely on the sidelines of the Iran war. Now, the rebels are helping Iran to pressure a key U.S. ally.
paras.zh: 直到最近，胡塞武装一直处于伊朗战争的边缘。现在，叛军正在帮助伊朗向美国的一个重要盟友施压。

paras.en: The Saudis and the Houthis began fighting in 2015, when the kingdom entered Yemen's civil war on behalf of the internationally recognized government.
paras.zh: 沙特和胡塞武装于 2015 年开始交战，当时沙特代表国际公认的政府介入也门内战。

paras.en: Relative calm after a 2022 ceasefire ended in July, when the Houthis resumed attacks, saying the Saudis fired on the Sanaa airport as a plane from Iran was trying to land. That revived anger over the Saudi-led blockade that has largely isolated Houthi-run areas.
paras.zh: 7 月 2022 年停火结束后，局势相对平静，胡塞武装重新发动袭击，称沙特在一架来自伊朗的飞机试图降落时向萨那机场开火。这再次激起了人们对沙特领导的封锁的愤怒，封锁在很大程度上孤立了胡塞武装控制的地区。

paras.en: Now fighting has escalated, with the Saudi-led coalition providing air support for Yemeni government forces attempting to reverse recent Houthi gains along the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 现在战斗已经升级，沙特领导的联军为也门政府军提供空中支援，试图扭转胡塞武装最近在红海沿岸的进展。

paras.en: Those gains gave the rebels better surveillance of shipping through the Bab el-Mandeb, a corridor that is a crucial alternative to the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran has been attacking ships.
paras.zh: 这些成果使叛军能够更好地监视通过曼德海峡的航运，这条走廊是霍尔木兹海峡的一个重要替代通道，伊朗一直在霍尔木兹海峡攻击船只。

paras.en: Ahmed Nagi, the International Crisis Group's senior analyst for Yemen, said the Houthi pressure tactics could backfire: "Rather than pushing Riyadh to step back, attacks on critical Saudi infrastructure could make the Saudis more determined to continue the campaign."
paras.zh: 国际危机组织也门高级分析师艾哈迈德·纳吉表示，胡塞武装的施压策略可能会适得其反：“对沙特关键基础设施的袭击不仅不会迫使利雅得后退，反而会让沙特人更坚定地继续这场行动。”

articles.title: Hurricane Simon hits Mexico's Pacific coast, slamming towns and resorts

paras.en: Hurricane Simon hits Mexico's Pacific coast, slamming towns and resorts
paras.zh: 飓风西蒙袭击墨西哥太平洋海岸，摧毁城镇和度假村

paras.en: Hurricane specialist says 'life-threatening' storm surge expected
paras.zh: 飓风专家称预计会出现“危及生命”的风暴潮

paras.en: Hurricane Simon was pounding Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 4 storm on Sunday, its eye remaining just offshore as its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.
paras.zh: 周日，飓风西蒙以四级风暴的形式袭击了墨西哥的太平洋海岸，其风眼仍位于近海，其最强的风和降雨袭击了居住在马德雷山脉和海洋之间的人们。

paras.en: Simon's eye was moving northward just off the coast, and forecasters at the U.S. National Hurricane Center said it's not clear if it will make landfall. This could mean Simon maintains its extremely dangerous strength, sustaining winds of 240 km/h.
paras.zh: 西蒙的视线正在向北移动，距离海岸不远，美国国家飓风中心的预报员表示，尚不清楚它是否会登陆。这可能意味着西蒙仍能保持其极其危险的强度，能够承受 240 公里/小时的风速。

paras.en: That's not good news for people in the Puerto Vallarta area, a popular destination for Canadian tourists. Just inland and uphill from the resort areas, many Mexicans live in communities where housing might not stand up to the storm.
paras.zh: 对于加拿大游客的热门目的地巴亚尔塔港地区的人们来说，这不是一个好消息。就在度假区的内陆和山坡上，许多墨西哥人居住的社区的住房可能无法抵御风暴。

paras.en: At daybreak, Simon was centered about 175 kilometres south-southeast of Cabo Corrientes, and moving north-northwest at a relatively slow eight km/h. A senior Hurricane Center specialist, Phillippe Pappin, said this westernmost tip of mainland Mexico was the most likely place for landfall.
paras.zh: 黎明时分，西蒙以科连特斯角东南偏南约 175 公里处为中心，并以相对缓慢的 8 公里/小时的速度向西北偏北移动。飓风中心高级专家菲利普·帕平表示，墨西哥大陆最西端是最有可能登陆的地方。

paras.en: "Simon is very close to the coast of Mexico this morning," Pappin told The Associated Press on Sunday.
paras.zh: “西蒙今天早上非常接近墨西哥海岸，”帕平周日告诉美联社。

paras.en: "We're expecting catastrophic wind and life-threatening storm surge impacts along that west central coast of Mexico where the hurricane warning is currently in effect," Pappin said.
paras.zh: 帕平说：“我们预计目前飓风警报生效的墨西哥中西部海岸将遭受灾难性大风和危及生命的风暴潮影响。”

paras.en: "They're also getting very heavy rainfall associated with the storm that's likely going to produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides in areas of higher terrain along the Mexican coastline, and there will be significant swells."
paras.zh: “风暴带来的强降雨可能会在墨西哥海岸线地势较高的地区引发危及生命的洪水和泥石流，并且还会出现严重的海浪。”

paras.en: - Category 4 Hurricane Simon barrels toward Mexico
paras.zh: - 4 级飓风西蒙向墨西哥袭来

paras.en: - Hurricane Simon forecast to get much stronger as it heads to Mexico's Pacific Coast
paras.zh: - 飓风西蒙预计在前往墨西哥太平洋海岸时将变得更加强大

paras.en: As for predicting whether or not Simon will make landfall, "it's a little tricky right now" to forecast, since the eye "is basically moving very close or parallel to the coast currently," Pappin said. But he predicted that Cabo Corrientes is the area most likely to get a direct hit from the system on Sunday.
paras.zh: 至于预测西蒙是否会登陆，“现在预测有点棘手”，因为眼睛“目前基本上非常靠近或平行于海岸移动，”帕平说。但他预测卡波科连特斯是周日最有可能受到该系统直接影响的地区。

paras.en: Waves hit the shore in Manzanillo on Sunday. (Daniel Becerril/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周日，海浪袭击了曼萨尼约的海岸。 （丹尼尔·贝塞里尔/路透社）

paras.en: Meanwhile, the hurricane was dumping rain over parts of southwestern Mexico. It could bring 25 to 50 centimetres of rain in many places, with some areas in the states of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco receiving up to 76 centimetres. "This rainfall will produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain," the centre warned.
paras.zh: 与此同时，飓风给墨西哥西南部部分地区带来降雨。许多地方的降雨量可能达到 25 至 50 厘米，其中米却肯州、科利马州和哈利斯科州的部分地区降雨量高达 76 厘米。该中心警告说：“这次降雨将产生危及生命的洪水和泥石流，特别是在地形陡峭的地区。”

paras.en: Jalisco state suspended classes on Friday and Monday in 22 coastal municipalities and began evacuating people from at-risk areas while asking the tourism sector to make sure workers as well as visitors are fully accommodated in shelters or safe zones.
paras.zh: 哈利斯科州周五和周一在 22 个沿海城市停课，并开始从危险地区疏散人员，同时要求旅游部门确保工人和游客完全安置在避难所或安全区。

paras.en: On Saturday, just ahead of the worst weather, convenience stores, hotels and other businesses in Puerto Vallarta were boarding up their windows.
paras.zh: 周六，就在最恶劣的天气到来之前，巴亚尔塔港的便利店、酒店和其他企业都用木板封上了窗户。

paras.en: A man removes water from a building in Manzanillo on Sunday. (Daniel Becerril/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周日，一名男子从曼萨尼约的一栋建筑中清除积水。 （丹尼尔·贝塞里尔/路透社）

paras.en: The hurricane centre expected a dangerous storm surge along the immediate coast near and to the east of where the centre makes landfall. The agency warned that near the coast, large and destructive waves will accompany the surge.
paras.zh: 飓风中心预计，在该中心登陆地点附近和东部的沿海地区将出现危险的风暴潮。该机构警告说，在海岸附近，海浪将伴随着巨大的破坏性波浪。

paras.en: Canadian tourist Ed Currie, who, along with his wife, still has five more days to enjoy Puerto Vallarta, said the hurricane had not yet affected his plans.
paras.zh: 加拿大游客艾德·柯里 (Ed Currie) 和他的妻子还有五天时间可以游览巴亚尔塔港，他表示飓风尚未影响他的计划。

paras.en: "Just stay in the hotel and look out the window hopefully," he said of what the couple would do. "I just don't know what to expect."
paras.zh: “就呆在酒店里，满怀希望地看着窗外，”他谈到这对夫妇会做的事情时说道。 “我只是不知道会发生什么。”

articles.title: Judge orders Trump administration to end taxpayer-funded TV ads

paras.en: Judge orders Trump administration to end taxpayer-funded TV ads
paras.zh: 法官命令特朗普政府终止由纳税人资助的电视广告

paras.en: Department of Homeland Security tapped $20 million US in taxpayer money for ads
paras.zh: 国土安全部动用了 2000 万美元纳税人资金用于广告

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump must cancel any remaining television commercials paid for with millions of dollars in taxpayer money to promote his political message, a federal judge ordered Sunday night, even as the administration said the ad campaign was coming to an end.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官周日晚上下令，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普必须取消所有用纳税人的数百万美元支付的剩余电视广告，以宣传他的政治信息，尽管政府表示广告活动即将结束。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Jennifer L. Rochon in New York sided with a coalition, including the non-partisan watchdog Common Cause, that challenged the ads and called them an illegal misuse of funds.
paras.zh: 纽约美国地区法官珍妮弗·L·罗雄 (Jennifer L. Rochon) 站在包括无党派监督机构共同事业在内的一个联盟一边，对这些广告提出质疑，称其为非法滥用资金行为。

paras.en: In granting a temporary restraining order, she told the administration to cancel any remaining ads, including any set to air Sunday night.
paras.zh: 在授予临时限制令时，她告诉政府取消所有剩余的广告，包括周日晚上播出的任何广告。

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to an email requesting comment on Sunday night. In a court filing late Saturday, the Justice Department argued that the temporary restraining order was unnecessary because "the alleged offending conduct will end tomorrow."
paras.zh: 周日晚上，白宫没有立即回复请求置评的电子邮件。在周六晚间提交的法庭文件中，司法部辩称临时限制令是不必要的，因为“涉嫌的违法行为将于明天结束”。

paras.en: - Trump administration faces 2 lawsuits for taxpayer-funded ads as midterms draw near
paras.zh: - 随着中期选举临近，特朗普政府因纳税人资助的广告面临两起诉讼

paras.en: - Why pro-Trump ads — paid for with public money — are airing on U.S. TV
paras.zh: - 为什么用公共资金支付的亲特朗普广告在美国电视上播出

paras.en: The Department of Homeland Security tapped $20 million US in taxpayer money for the ads. Legal experts have suggested they ran afoul of a federal statute against congressionally appropriated money being used for "publicity or propaganda" and potentially other federal laws.
paras.zh: 国土安全部动用了 2000 万美元纳税人的钱来制作这些广告。法律专家表示，他们违反了一项联邦法规，禁止将国会拨款用于“宣传或宣传”，并可能违反其他联邦法律。

paras.en: The Homeland Security money tapped for the ads comes from a $175-million package Congress gave to the department as part of Trump's immigration enforcement agenda.
paras.zh: 用于广告的国土安全部资金来自国会向国土安全部提供的 1.75 亿美元一揽子计划，作为特朗普移民执法议程的一部分。

paras.en: The White House has defended the ads as public service announcements akin to what past administrations have done to promote various policies.
paras.zh: 白宫辩称这些广告是公共服务公告，类似于过去几届政府为推广各种政策所做的事情。

paras.en: But the recent ads differ from many past public service announcements because they aren't aimed at helping members of the public benefit from specific government programs. One of the ads is a near replica of a 2024 ad that Trump ran during his presidential re-election campaign.
paras.zh: 但最近的广告与过去的许多公共服务公告不同，因为它们的目的并不是帮助公众从特定的政府项目中受益。其中一则广告几乎是特朗普在总统连任竞选期间投放的 2024 年广告的翻版。

articles.title: Macron and Steinmeier struggle to revive Franco-German ties

paras.en: The German delegation passed through Paris without being hindered by the student strikes taking place on the streets of Paris. The motorcades moved through the French capital without disruption. Around the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees, however, traffic was at a standstill for hours. Due to the high-profile visit, the streets were cordoned off over a wide area.
paras.zh: 德国代表团途经巴黎，没有受到巴黎街头学生罢课的阻碍。车队顺利穿过法国首都。然而，凯旋门和香榭丽舍大街周围的交通停滞了几个小时。由于此次访问的高调，街道被大面积封锁。

paras.en: Emmanuel Macron had decided on a special gesture to send off Frank-Walter Steinmeier, his German guest: The military honors took place under the Arc de Triomphe. And so, early in the morning, the German national anthem rang out in the heart of Paris — amid sunshine and bitter cold.
paras.zh: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙决定以一种特殊的姿态来送别他的德国客人弗兰克·瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔：军事仪式在凯旋门下举行。于是，清晨，在阳光明媚和严寒中，德国国歌在巴黎市中心响起。

paras.en: It was a generous gesture of friendship and symbolism, yet it seemed to be from a bygone era. In both countries, populists on the political fringes are gaining support. In Germany, the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) ranks first in nationwide polls. In France, Emmanuel Macron could soon be succeeded by either Jean-Luc Melenchon of the far left or Marine Le Pen of the far right.
paras.zh: 这是一种慷慨的友谊和象征意义的举动，但它似乎来自一个过去的时代。在这两个国家，政治边缘的民粹主义者正在获得支持。在德国，极右翼的德国另类选择党（AfD）在全国民意调查中排名第一。在法国，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙很快就会被极左翼的让-吕克·梅朗雄或极右翼的马琳·勒庞接替。

paras.en: Added to this is an economic crisis that threatens prosperity. Unresolved issues of social justice are driving younger generations into the streets. At the same time, social media is increasingly becoming a tool of disinformation and "accelerating doubts about democracy," Macron said in Paris.
paras.zh: 除此之外，还有威胁繁荣的经济危机。尚未解决的社会正义问题正促使年轻一代走上街头。与此同时，马克龙在巴黎表示，社交媒体日益成为散布虚假信息和“加速对民主的怀疑”的工具。

paras.en: While the AfD may soon form its first state government in Saxony-Anhalt, President Steinmeier remained confident. He insisted that Germany would continue to "play a leading role in Europe" in the future and that Germans would remain good Europeans. But he did not say where he drew this certainty from. Questions from journalists were not permitted at the joint press conference at the Elysee Palace.
paras.zh: 尽管德国选择党可能很快就会在萨克森-安哈尔特州组建第一个州政府，但施泰因迈尔总统仍然充满信心。他坚称，德国未来将继续“在欧洲发挥领导作用”，德国人仍将是优秀的欧洲人。但他没有透露这种确定性是从何而来。在爱丽舍宫举行的联合新闻发布会上不允许记者提问。

paras.en: Political scientist Jacob Ross isn't surprised by this. Both Macron and Steinmeier lack a "genuine agenda for Germany, France, and Europe." Both represent political systems that "seek to respond to 21st-century crises with 20th-century solutions," said the expert on German-French relations at the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP).
paras.zh: 政治学家雅各布·罗斯对此并不感到惊讶。马克龙和施泰因迈尔都缺乏“德国、法国和欧洲的真正议程”。德国外交关系委员会（DGAP）的德法关系专家表示，两者都代表了“寻求用20世纪的解决方案应对21世纪危机”的政治制度。

paras.en: Even though Steinmeier and Macron have different political styles, Ross sees parallels — especially where their policies have failed. One example of this is strategic foreign policy issues, such as dealing with Russia. "For a long time, they pursued a policy based on integrating Russia into Europe, and then both were overwhelmed by the events of 2022 and had to adjust their course," said Ross. Since then, both have merely reacted to current affairs, according to the political scientist.
paras.zh: 尽管施泰因迈尔和马克龙有不同的政治风格，但罗斯看到了相似之处——尤其是在他们的政策失败的地方。其中一个例子是战略外交政策问题，例如与俄罗斯打交道。罗斯表示：“长期以来，他们奉行将俄罗斯融入欧洲的政策，然后双方都被 2022 年发生的事件压垮，不得不调整路线。”这位政治学家表示，从那时起，两人都只是对时事做出反应。

paras.en: Emmanuel Macron has made some bold moves for Europe, but without support from Berlin, says Ross. Germany's political leadership has long reacted with caution to proposals from Paris.
paras.zh: 罗斯表示，马克龙为欧洲采取了一些大胆的举措，但没有得到柏林的支持。德国政治领导层长期以来一直对巴黎的提议做出谨慎反应。

paras.en: A joint initiative that both countries recently promoted to the European Commission is aimed at combating unfair competition. Countries that gain an advantage through unfair practices should face strict European measures.
paras.zh: 两国最近向欧盟委员会提出了一项旨在打击不公平竞争的联合倡议。通过不公平做法获得优势的国家应该面临严格的欧洲措施。

paras.en: Macron joined German Chancellor Friedrich Merz in speaking out in favor of this. Although China was not explicitly named, the initiative is seen to be primarily aimed at that country. Beijing uses enormous subsidies to support its companies, whose products flood the European market, while European firms continue to face barriers when trying to access the Chinese market.
paras.zh: 马克龙与德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨一起公开表示支持这一点。尽管没有明确点名中国，但该倡议似乎主要针对该国。北京利用巨额补贴来支持其产品涌入欧洲市场的企业，而欧洲企业在试图进入中国市场时仍然面临障碍。

paras.en: Germany and France have also long sought greater cooperation in the defense sector. Yet major joint defense projects are making little progress. When the planned joint fighter jet, the FCAS, fell through in June, officials emphasized ongoing cooperation on the future MGCS main battle tank. And yet differences on this became apparent during the state visit.
paras.zh: 德国和法国长期以来也一直寻求在国防领域加强合作。然而，重大联合防御项目进展甚微。当计划中的联合战斗机 FCAS 在 6 月份落空时，官员们强调了在未来 MGCS 主战坦克方面正在进行的合作。然而，在国事访问期间，这一点上的分歧变得明显。

paras.en: As German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius arrived in Paris, French Chief of the General Staff Fabien Mandon stated during a hearing in the French National Assembly that Germany had decided to withdraw from the tank project. A day later, Mandon clarified that he had expressed himself ambiguously. But some observers believe that such misunderstandings are a sign of dissatisfaction on both sides — below the political level — regarding cooperation with the other partner.
paras.zh: 当德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托利斯抵达巴黎时，法国总参谋长法比安·曼东在法国国民议会听证会上表示，德国已决定退出坦克项目。一天后，曼登澄清说他的表达含糊不清。但一些观察家认为，这种误解是双方对与对方合作的不满的表现——在政治层面以下。

paras.en: It is this political level that often ends up having to set the record straight in such cases. This time was no exception: Pistorius firmly refuted the claim that the project was on the verge of being scrapped. "The MGCS project is not over; it is not dead; it has not been terminated by anyone — quite the contrary. It is a core project of Franco-German cooperation on land systems," said the German defense minister.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，正是这种政治层面最终不得不澄清事实。这次也不例外：皮斯托利斯坚决驳斥了该项目濒临废弃的说法。德国国防部长表示：“MGCS 项目没有结束；它没有消亡；它没有被任何人终止——恰恰相反。它是法德陆地系统合作的核心项目。”

paras.en: The focus is primarily on digital information processing in combat, as well as unmanned and automated systems. Germany and France would continue their cooperation, Pistorius insisted, and MGCS is an important future project for both countries and their armed forces.
paras.zh: 重点主要是战斗中的数字信息处理以及无人和自动化系统。皮斯托里斯坚称，德国和法国将继续合作，MGCS对于两国及其武装部队来说是一个重要的未来项目。

paras.en: On Friday, the presidents of France and Germany visited several facilities near Bordeaux that are closely linked to space exploration and nuclear deterrence. These include ArianeGroup, a Franco-German company that, among other things, manufactures the nuclear-capable M51 missiles for French nuclear submarines. The itinerary also included visits to startups that are looking far into the future.
paras.zh: 周五，法国和德国总统参观了波尔多附近的几个与太空探索和核威慑密切相关的设施。其中包括阿丽亚娜集团（ArianeGroup），这是一家法德公司，除其他外，该公司为法国核潜艇生产可携带核弹头的 M51 导弹。行程还包括参观展望未来的初创公司。

paras.en: It was unofficially reported during the visit that this focus of the trip was a personal priority for Macron. The French president has long spoken of a European dimension to France's nuclear deterrent. Considering announcements from the US saying it would reduce its commitment to Europe, his views are gaining increasing traction.
paras.zh: 访问期间的非正式报道称，此行的重点是马克龙个人的优先事项。法国总统长期以来一直谈到法国核威慑力量的欧洲层面。考虑到美国宣布将减少对欧洲的承诺，他的观点越来越受到关注。

paras.en: As early as 2020, Macron proposed a strategic dialogue on the role of French nuclear weapons in European security. Several countries, including Germany, have since expressed interest. Now, further steps are being considered. The focus is on what Macron once called "forward deterrence," such as joint military exercises and visits to strategically important locations. A permanent deployment of French nuclear weapons in other countries remains off the table. Furthermore, according to French nuclear doctrine, France always retains sole decision-making authority over the use of its nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 早在2020年，马克龙就提出就法国核武器在欧洲安全中的作用进行战略对话。此后，包括德国在内的多个国家表达了兴趣。现在，正在考虑采取进一步措施。重点是马克龙曾经所说的“前沿威慑”，例如联合军事演习和访问具有重要战略意义的地点。法国在其他国家永久部署核武器的可能性仍然不大。此外，根据法国的核学说，法国始终保留对其核武器使用的唯一决策权。

paras.en: Steinmeier's two-day state visit to France ended on Friday afternoon. So far, there has been little sign of new momentum in Franco-German relations. This makes it all the more urgent for the successors to the two presidents to develop a shared vision for the future of the relationship between the two countries starting next year.
paras.zh: 施泰因迈尔对法国为期两天的国事访问于周五下午结束。到目前为止，法德关系还没有出现新势头的迹象。这使得两国总统的继任者更加迫切地需要为明年开始的两国关系的未来制定共同愿景。

paras.en: Macron and Steinmeier will step down from their posts almost simultaneously in 2027 after ten years in office. The state visit to France thus also served as a final joint meeting, marked by some ceremonial farewells.
paras.zh: 马克龙和施泰因迈尔将在任职十年后于 2027 年几乎同时卸任。因此，对法国的国事访问也是最后一次联席会议，并举行了一些仪式性的告别仪式。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Eritrean troops in Ethiopia raise fears of a regional war

paras.en: Various sources have confirmed the presence of Eritrean armed forces in Ethiopia. An AFP report quoted a foreign security source, speaking on condition of anonymity, as estimating that 5,000 to 8,000 Eritrean soldiers were present in the northenmost state of Ethiopia, Tigray.
paras.zh: 各种消息来源已证实厄立特里亚武装部队在埃塞俄比亚的存在。法新社报道援引一位不愿透露姓名的外国安全消息人士的话说，估计埃塞俄比亚最北部的提格雷州有5,000至8,000名厄立特里亚士兵。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ethiopia and Eritrea have ramped up their war talk.
paras.zh: 与此同时，埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚加剧了战争言论。

paras.en: According to Reuters, the government of Ethiopia has written to the UN Security Council, calling for the immediate withdrawal of Eritrean troops from its territory.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，埃塞俄比亚政府已致函联合国安理会，呼吁厄立特里亚军队立即撤出其领土。

paras.en: In the letter, dated Oct. 8, Ethiopian Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos said the presence of Eritrean troops in Ethiopia left "no option but to defend itself against Eritrea,"
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚外交部长吉迪恩·蒂莫特沃斯在 10 月 8 日的信中表示，厄立特里亚军队在埃塞俄比亚的存在让“别无选择，只能保卫自己，对抗厄立特里亚”。

paras.en: in a post on X on October 7, Eritrean Minister of Information Yemane Meskel had accused Ethiopia of "incessantly beating the drums of war."
paras.zh: 10月7日，厄立特里亚新闻部长耶马内·梅斯克尔在X网站上发帖指责埃塞俄比亚“不断敲响战鼓”。

paras.en: Two days later, he wrote in Tigrinya, a working language of Eritrea and the main language of Tigray, that "the sovereign state of Eritrea is bound by blood and law." adding "woe to those who touch it."
paras.zh: 两天后，他用厄立特里亚的工作语言、提格雷的主要语言提格里尼亚语写道，“厄立特里亚主权国家受到血缘和法律的约束”。加上“触摸它的人有祸了”。

paras.en: This comes as the regional conflict in Tigray has deteriorated rapidly in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 近几周来，提格雷地区冲突迅速恶化。

paras.en: Some experts have suggested that Ethiopia may have intentionally triggered the escalation. Just last week, it expelled diplomats from Egypt and Eritrea, causing the latter to sever diplomatic ties altogether.
paras.zh: 一些专家认为，埃塞俄比亚可能是故意引发事态升级的。就在上周，它驱逐了埃及和厄立特里亚的外交官，导致后者完全断绝了外交关系。

paras.en: On Monday, when Abiy Ahmed was sworn in for another five years as Ethiopian prime minister, he stated that access to the sea was a priority. The statement fueled fresh speculation that he intends to take Eritrea's strategic port of Assab by force and prompted fierce reactions from the Eritrean side.
paras.zh: 周一，当阿比·艾哈迈德宣誓就任埃塞俄比亚总理五年后，他表示出海是当务之急。这一声明引发了新的猜测，即他打算用武力夺取厄立特里亚的战略港口阿萨布，并引发厄立特里亚方面的激烈反应。

paras.en: Abiy's internal opposition: Tsimdo and the Alliance for Survival
paras.zh: 阿比的内部反对派：齐姆多和生存联盟

paras.en: While the Ethiopian National Defence Forces (ENDF), aided by the Tigray Peace Force milita, have made significant advances and notably recaptured the Tigray federal state capital of Mekelle, opposition to Ethiopia has found new formats for collaboration.
paras.zh: 尽管埃塞俄比亚国防军（ENDF）在提格雷和平部队民兵的协助下取得了重大进展，特别是重新夺回了提格雷联邦州首府默克莱，但埃塞俄比亚的反对派却找到了新的合作形式。

paras.en: One is the Tsimdo movement, named after a Tigrinya term that loosely translates as "engagement."
