paras.zh: 小企业部长 Anne Aly 今天成为提问时间的焦点，反对派追问她如何以及何时发现 ATO 将禁止信用卡支付（她说她和其他公众一起发现的）。

paras.en: Australian engineer Robert Petherhas been allowed to leave Iraq after being detained for more than four years in a Baghdad jail cell that his family feared would kill him.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚工程师罗伯特·佩瑟在巴格达监狱被关押了四年多后，被允许离开伊拉克，他的家人担心这会杀死他。

paras.en: The NSW government will seek to amend legislation to give One Nation access to the independent Parliamentary Budget Office in a bid to challenge the populist party to cost their promises.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州政府将寻求修改立法，让一国党能够进入独立的议会预算办公室，以挑战民粹主义政党兑现其承诺。

paras.en: The peak body for the oil and gas industry was the only stakeholder the New South Wales government met with before a decision to reopen gas exploration approvals for the first time in more than a decade, documents released under freedom of information laws suggest.
paras.zh: 根据信息自由法发布的文件显示，石油和天然气行业的最高机构是新南威尔士州政府十多年来首次决定重新开放天然气勘探审批之前会见的唯一利益相关者。

paras.en: Aly says she found out about ATO move when the rest of the public did
paras.zh: Aly 表示，当其他公众发现 ATO 的举动时，她就知道了

paras.en: Nationals MP Kevin Hogan again probes small business minister Anne Aly to declare when she found out about the ATO’s decision to ban credit card payments.
paras.zh: 国家党议员凯文·霍根 (Kevin Hogan) 再次调查小企业部长安妮·阿里 (Anne Aly)，要求她在得知 ATO 禁止信用卡支付的决定后做出声明。

paras.en: Hogan says the treasurer said that he’d heard from the ATO not the Reserve Bank about the ban “in the lead up to the decision”, so why didn’t Aly also know in advance?
paras.zh: 霍根说，财长说他“在做出决定之前”从澳大利亚税务局而不是储备银行那里听到了有关禁令的消息，那么为什么阿里也没有提前知道呢？

paras.en: Anne Aly says again that she found out with the rest of the public:
paras.zh: 安妮·阿里再次表示，她和其他公众一起发现了这一点：

paras.en: I’ll repeat my answer from last time, but I’ll add a bit of clarity to it. The RBA announced their plan to ban surcharges on March 31 this year, stating that surcharges will be banned from October 1. On October 1, the ATO announced their decision that they would not be accepting credit cards. That’s when I found out.
paras.zh: 我将重复我上次的回答，但我会澄清一些。今年3月31日，澳洲联储宣布禁止附加费的计划，并表示从10月1日起禁止附加费。10月1日，澳大利亚税务局宣布决定不再接受信用卡。就在那时我发现了。

paras.en: Antisemitism royal commission announces extra hearing to be closed to public
paras.zh: 反犹太主义皇家委员会宣布额外听证会不对公众开放

paras.en: Breaking into question time with a little breaking news. The royal commission into antisemitism has announced it will hold an additional hearing this month, which will be closed to the public, to focus on security and intelligence issues.
paras.zh: 提问时间进入一个小突发新闻。皇家反犹太主义委员会宣布将于本月举行额外听证会，该听证会不对公众开放，重点关注安全和情报问题。

paras.en: The royal commission in August said it was holding its final hearings that month, ahead of handing down its final report in December.
paras.zh: 皇家委员会在 8 月份表示，将在当月举行最终听证会，然后在 12 月份发布最终报告。

paras.en: But on Monday, the royal commission said in a statement that it would hold “additional hearing” in October - with no date announced - “to take additional evidence related to Hearing Block 2.”
paras.zh: 但周一，皇家委员会在一份声明中表示，它将在 10 月份举行“额外听证会”——但没有公布日期——“以获取与第二组听证会相关的更多证据。”

paras.en: That part of the investigation was specifically around “the circumstances surrounding the attack at Bondi on 14 December 2025”, including the terrorism threat level; the conduct of security, intelligence and law enforcement agencies; what was known about the shooters and what was done with that information; and the security arrangements for the Chanukah by the Sea event.
paras.zh: 这部分调查专门围绕“2025 年 12 月 14 日邦迪袭击事件的情况”，包括恐怖主义威胁级别；安全、情报和执法机构的行为；对枪手的了解以及如何处理这些信息；以及光明节海边活动的安保安排。

paras.en: The royal commission said in its statement:
paras.zh: 皇家委员会在声明中表示：

paras.en: Due to the sensitivity of the evidence, this hearing will be classified and therefore closed to the public to avoid prejudice to national security and the ongoing criminal proceedings relating to the attack.
paras.zh: 由于证据的敏感性，这次听证会将是保密的，因此不对公众开放，以避免损害国家安全和正在进行的与袭击有关的刑事诉讼。

paras.en: ‘Not on my bingo card’, PM says as Katter ponders North Queensland state
paras.zh: 卡特思考北昆士兰州时，总理说道：“我的宾果卡上没有”

paras.en: Like the prime minister, this one wasn’t on my bingo card for today (or ever), Bob Katter asks the government for a report on the viability of a North Queensland state.
paras.zh: 和总理一样，鲍勃·卡特（Bob Katter）今天（或永远）都没有出现在我的宾果卡上，鲍勃·卡特（Bob Katter）要求政府提供一份关于北昆士兰州生存能力的报告。

paras.en: He says the north’s resources are being held by a government 3,000km away and the money squandered by “on a two–week athletic meet called the Olympics”.
paras.zh: 他说，北方的资源被3000公里外的政府掌握着，而金钱却被“一场名为奥运会的为期两周的运动会”所浪费。

paras.en: It’s a much more tame description of the events. Katter back in 2024 described the Paris Olympics opening ceremony as “an ‘orgiastic pagan ritual’ denigrating Christianity”.
paras.zh: 这是对事件的更为温和的描述。凯特早在 2024 年就将巴黎奥运会开幕式描述为“一场诋毁基督教的‘狂欢异教仪式’”。

paras.en: A question that, I’ve got to say, was not on my bingo card. The idea of a breakup of the states – including the great state of Queensland – would perhaps see a Premier Katter in Far North Queensland, which might or might not be a good thing. It would weaken the Queensland State of Origin team somewhat, given the magnificent players who’ve come from places like Cloncurry and Mount Isa.
paras.zh: 我必须说，这个问题不在我的宾果卡上。各州分裂的想法——包括伟大的昆士兰州——可能会在远北昆士兰州出现卡特总理，这可能是好事，也可能不是好事。考虑到来自克朗克里和伊萨山等地的出色球员，这将在一定程度上削弱昆士兰州原籍队的实力。

paras.en: Slightly more seriously he says it’s important for the north of the state to get its “fair share”, but defends the Olympics and says it’ll be good economically for the whole state.
paras.zh: 稍微严肃一点的是，他说该州北部获得“公平份额”很重要，但他为奥运会辩护，并表示这对整个州的经济都有好处。

paras.en: The opposition isn’t relenting on its attack on small business minister Anne Aly, with shadow treasurer Tim Wilson now asking her to confirm whether the Reserve Bank made the decision to ban credit card payments to the Australian Taxation Office.
paras.zh: 反对派对小企业部长安妮·阿里(Anne Aly)的攻击并没有放松，影子财务主管蒂姆·威尔逊(Tim Wilson)现在要求她确认储备银行是否做出了禁止向澳大利亚税务局支付信用卡的决定。

paras.en: It’s a quick question and a quick answer.
paras.zh: 这是一个快速提问和快速回答。

paras.en: I think it’s pretty clear, from the statements that were made by the RBA – the RBA made the decision to ban surcharges, and the ATO responded.
paras.zh: 我认为从 RBA 的声明中可以很清楚地看出 – RBA 做出了禁止附加费的决定，ATO 也做出了回应。

paras.en: From the Coalition backbench, Ben Small shouts “You don’t even understand …”
paras.zh: 联盟党后座议员本·斯莫尔 (Ben Small) 喊道：“你根本不明白……”

paras.en: Milton Dick says he’s “had a good go” at interrupting today and he gets booted before he can finish.
paras.zh: 米尔顿·迪克 (Milton Dick) 表示，他今天“做得很好”，但在他说完之前就被踢了。

paras.en: Coalition pushes for who knew what and when on ATO credit card ban
paras.zh: 联盟推动谁知道什么以及什么时候ATO信用卡禁令

paras.en: Angie Bell is back, ditches the preamble and tries the more direct approach, asking the small business minister, Anne Aly: “When was the minister first informed of the credit–card ban, and by whom?”
paras.zh: 安吉·贝尔（Angie Bell）回来了，抛弃了序言，尝试了更直接的方法，询问小企业部长安妮·阿里（Anne Aly）：“部长是什么时候第一次得知信用卡禁令的？由谁通知的？”

paras.en: Aly seems to avoid the question at first, saying that Labor understands what small businesses are going through with rising pries, but then gets to the point.
paras.zh: 阿里一开始似乎回避了这个问题，他说工党理解小企业在不断上涨的撬动中所经历的事情，但随后就进入了正题。

paras.en: On the matter of the credit card surcharge or the ban to the credit card surcharge, it was a decision that was made by the RBA. I became aware of it – as did everyone else – when the RBA made that decision and made it public.
paras.zh: 关于信用卡附加费或禁止信用卡附加费的问题，这是澳大利亚央行做出的决定。当澳大利亚央行做出这一决定并将其公开时，我和其他人一样意识到了这一点。

paras.en: Coalition gets personal against small business minister
paras.zh: 联盟对小企业部长进行人身攻击

paras.en: Liberal frontbencher Angie Bell asks the small business minister when and how she was first informed of the credit card ban for small businesses by the Australian Tax Office. She quotes a Labor MP from a story in Nine newspapers last week that the minister “knows nothing about small business”.
paras.zh: 自由党前座议员安吉·贝尔 (Angie Bell) 询问小企业部长，她何时以及如何首次获悉澳大利亚税务局对小企业的信用卡禁令。她引用了一位工党议员上周在九号报纸上发表的一篇报道，称部长“对小企业一无所知”。

paras.en: Small business minister, Anne Aly, spends the first half of her answer talking about her travels around Australia to talk to small businesses.
paras.zh: 小企业部长 Anne Aly 在回答的前半部分谈到了她在澳大利亚各地与小企业交谈的情况。

paras.en: The Coalition isn’t happy with the answer – she’s not saying when she found out about the ban and who told her. Leader of the House, Tony Burke, says the quote from an unnamed MP is a “political sledge – effectively allows a much broader answer”. Milton Dick tells the opposition that they asked a political question so they’ll get a political answer but directs Aly to be relevant.
paras.zh: 联盟党对答案并不满意——她没有说她是什么时候发现这项禁令的，也没有说是谁告诉她的。众议院领袖托尼·伯克 (Tony Burke) 表示，一位未透露姓名的议员的这句话是“政治雪橇——有效地允许了更广泛的答案”。米尔顿·迪克告诉反对派，他们提出了一个政治问题，以便他们得到政治答案，但指示阿里保持相关性。

paras.en: There’s some more back and forth, with some sledging across the despatch box, and Dick warns the House to show some respect and decorum.
paras.zh: 还有更多的来回，还有一些人在快递箱上滑行，迪克警告众议院要表现出一些尊重和礼节。

paras.en: Anyone with even a cursory understanding of numbers will understand that the number of businesses opening, compared to the number of businesses that are closing, demonstrates ...
paras.zh: 任何对数字有粗略了解的人都会明白，与关闭的企业数量相比，开业的企业数量表明……

paras.en: She’s trying to say that the total number of small businesses has gone up but she runs out of time on the answer.
paras.zh: 她试图说小型企业的总数有所增加，但她没有时间给出答案。

paras.en: Coalition getting lessons from Liz Truss ‘of all people’, Albanese says
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯说，联盟从“所有人”的莉兹·特拉斯身上吸取了教训

paras.en: Shadow treasurer Tim Wilson is up next and puts forward a quote from an unnamed “aspiring backbencher” that no one in cabinet has any small business experience, asking the prime minister when he will scrap Labor’s credit card surcharge ban.
paras.zh: 接下来是影子财务主管蒂姆·威尔逊(Tim Wilson)，他引用了一位未透露姓名的“有抱负的后座议员”的话，即内阁中没有人有任何小企业经验，询问首相何时废除工党的信用卡附加费禁令。

paras.en: (The government was keen on the change, but it’s worth noting the decision itself came from the Reserve Bank).
paras.zh: （政府热衷于这一改变，但值得注意的是，决定本身来自储备银行）。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese says he gives Wilson some “points for courage” given Josh Frydenberg is out there openly campaigning for an increase to the GST.
paras.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯表示，考虑到乔什·弗莱登伯格公开呼吁提高商品及服务税，他给威尔逊一些“勇气点”。

paras.en: [Frydenberg] most remarkably, actually saying that they spent too much and wasted money during the Covid crisis. If only Mr Frydenberg was in a position to have some influence during that time ...! But perhaps the spending was the result of the other bloke who was also the treasurer, Scott Morrison.
paras.zh: [弗莱登伯格]最引人注目的是，实际上说他们在新冠危机期间花了太多钱，浪费了钱。如果弗莱登伯格先生在那段时间能够产生一些影响就好了……！但这笔支出或许是另一位财政部长斯科特·莫里森(Scott Morrison)造成的。

paras.en: The opposition tries to raise a point of order on relevance, but Milton Dick says the question was pretty “political”, ie you ask a broad question you get a broad answer.
paras.zh: 反对派试图就相关性提出程序问题，但米尔顿·迪克表示这个问题相当“政治”，即你提出一个广泛的问题，你会得到一个广泛的答案。

paras.en: Albanese then takes a dig at the Coalition and the members who attended the CPAC conference over the weekend:
paras.zh: Albanese 随后挖苦了联盟以及周末参加 CPAC 会议的成员：

paras.en: At CPAC, they weren’t talking there about policies of small business, Mr Speaker … They weren’t talking about policies of big business. They were getting lessons, of all people, from the only person in the western world who makes Tony Abbott’s period as PM look long, which is Liz Truss, who lasted 45 days.
paras.zh: 在 CPAC，议长先生，他们不是在谈论小企业的政策……他们不是在谈论大企业的政策。在所有人中，他们从西方世界唯一一个让托尼·阿博特担任总理的任期看起来很长的人那里得到了教训，那就是利兹·特拉斯，她持续了 45 天。

paras.en: The opposition has small business in its sights today, with Angus Taylor accusing Labor of “waging war” against the sector. He says they’ve been slugged with rising power bills, increased tax and the ban on credit card surcharging.
paras.zh: 反对党今天把目光投向了小企业，安格斯·泰勒指责工党对该行业“发动战争”。他说，他们受到电费上涨、税收增加和信用卡附加费禁令的困扰。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese takes the question and runs through a list of pro-small business measures the government has taken.
paras.zh: 安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 回答了这个问题，并概述了政府已采取的一系列支持小企业的措施。

paras.en: He says there are 265,000 more small businesses than there were in 2022 when Labor came to office.
paras.zh: 他表示，与 2022 年工党上任时相比，小企业数量增加了 265,000 家。

paras.en: People talk about insolvencies – according to Asic data, insolvencies under this government, as a proportion of all companies, has averaged 0.32%. The rate under the Howard government was 0.5%. Average monthly new company registrations are higher under this government than any government on record.
paras.zh: 人们谈论破产——根据 Asic 的数据，本届政府领导下的破产公司占所有公司的比例平均为 0.32%。霍华德政府时期的税率为0.5%。本届政府的平均每月新公司注册量高于有记录以来的任何政府。

paras.en: Albanese and Taylor mark anniversary of 7 October attack
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯和泰勒纪念 10 月 7 日袭击事件周年

paras.en: Before questions begin, Albanese and Taylor also mark the third anniversary of the 7 October attack in Israel.
paras.zh: 在提问开始之前，阿尔巴尼斯和泰勒还纪念 10 月 7 日以色列袭击事件三周年。

paras.en: For so many, no day since has been easy. But anniversaries fall with their own terrible weight. And for many others, what compounds the pain is the approach of the first anniversary of the antisemitic terrorist attack at Bondi beach. These few years have been hard beyond measure, but Australia stands with the Jewish community here and across the world. We stand against antisemitism and racism in all its forms because it goes against who we are.
paras.zh: 对于很多人来说，此后的每一天都不容易。但周年纪念日却有其可怕的分量。对于许多其他人来说，邦迪海滩反犹太主义恐怖袭击一周年的临近，加剧了他们的痛苦。这几年的艰辛难以估量，但澳大利亚与这里和世界各地的犹太社区站在一起。我们反对一切形式的反犹太主义和种族主义，因为它违背了我们的本质。

paras.en: The fight against antisemitism is a fight for the truth – a fight that continues on our soil too. And the fight for the truth is about acknowledging and combating all forms of antisemitism – especially Islamist extremism.
paras.zh: 反对反犹太主义的斗争是一场争取真理的斗争——这场斗争也在我们的土地上持续进行。争取真相的斗争就是承认并打击一切形式的反犹太主义——尤其是伊斯兰极端主义。

paras.en: Albanese marks 25 years since start of Australia’s mission in Afghanistan
paras.zh: Albanese 纪念澳大利亚在阿富汗执行任务 25 周年

paras.en: Anthony Albanese and Angus Taylor have marked the 25th anniversary of the beginning of Operation Slipper, when Australia joined the US’s war in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 和安格斯·泰勒 (Angus Taylor) 纪念“拖鞋行动”开始 25 周年，当时澳大利亚加入了美国的阿富汗战争。

paras.en: There were more than 35,000 Australian men and women who served in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 有超过 35,000 名澳大利亚男女在阿富汗服役。

paras.en: Albanese and Taylor attended a commemoration of the anniversary at the Australian War Memorial on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，阿尔巴尼斯和泰勒参加了在澳大利亚战争纪念馆举行的周年纪念活动。

paras.en: We honour the families – those who have felt both the pride and weight that comes when a loved one puts on the uniform, and those who have lived with the grief that is the pain of love wrapped around an absence that can never be filled. As we look to Afghanistan, we are reminded again of what Australians in war have faced, and the difference they have made in humanity’s truest spirit. What Australians in Afghanistan embodied is something we must never lose.
paras.zh: 我们向这些家庭致敬——那些在亲人穿上制服时感受到自豪和沉重的人，以及那些生活在悲伤中的人，这种悲伤是爱的痛苦包裹着永远无法填补的缺席。当我们展望阿富汗时，我们再次想起澳大利亚人在战争中所面临的困难，以及他们在人类最真实的精神中所做出的改变。澳大利亚人在阿富汗所体现的东西是我们永远不能失去的。

paras.en: Taylor pays tribute to the men and women who served and the families of the 47 Australians who died.
paras.zh: 泰勒向服役的男女军人以及 47 名遇难澳大利亚人的家人表示敬意。

paras.en: Many still bear the wounds of their service, seen and unseen. We owe them a debt that can never be repaid. That our nation will never forget, and we will always honour what they achieved.
paras.zh: 许多人仍然带着可见和不可见的服役创伤。我们欠他们一笔永远无法偿还的债。我们的国家永远不会忘记，我们将永远尊重他们所取得的成就。

articles.title: Burnham to urge MPs to embrace closer ties with EU
articles.author: Aletha Adu Political correspondent

paras.en: Andy Burnham will put Brexit back on the Commons agenda as MPs return from recess, warning that failing to pursue a better deal with the EU would be a “major dereliction of duty”.
paras.zh: 随着国会议员休会回来，安迪·伯纳姆将把英国脱欧重新提上下议院议程，他警告说，未能与欧盟达成更好的协议将是“重大失职”。

paras.en: The prime minister will use a statement to the Commons on the first day back after the party conference break to urge MPs to face up to the damage caused by Brexit, and embrace closer ties with the EU to increase economic growth and tackle illegal immigration.
paras.zh: 首相将在党大会休息后的第一天向下议院发表声明，敦促议员们正视英国脱欧造成的损害，并与欧盟建立更紧密的关系，以促进经济增长并解决非法移民问题。

paras.en: In a stern warning ahead of the upcoming UK-EU summit, Burnham will argue that Britain cannot afford to turn its back on opportunities for greater cooperation with Europe and that maintaining the status quo is no longer good enough.
paras.zh: 在即将举行的英国-欧盟峰会之前，伯纳姆将发出严厉警告，称英国不能放弃与欧洲加强合作的机会，维持现状已经不够了。

paras.en: He will call for a calm, clear-eyed assessment of Britain’s relationship with Europe and urge MPs from across the Commons to back a pragmatic approach.
paras.zh: 他将呼吁对英国与欧洲的关系进行冷静、清醒的评估，并敦促下议院议员支持务实的做法。

paras.en: Burnham is expected to argue that most of the public would expect the government to seize the opportunity if closer cooperation could strengthen immigration controls while reviving the economy.
paras.zh: 预计伯纳姆将辩称，如果更密切的合作能够在重振经济的同时加强移民管制，大多数公众都会期望政府抓住这个机会。

paras.en: A No 10 source said: “Andy understands why some politicians don’t want to face up to the reality that Brexit has not delivered what they once promised. But it is time for a different conversation about what our long-term relationship should be.
paras.zh: 一位10号消息人士表示：“安迪理解为什么一些政客不愿面对英国脱欧没有兑现他们曾经承诺的现实。但现在是时候就我们的长期关系应该是什么样子进行不同的对话了。”

paras.en: “Sticking with the status quo and not working relentlessly to secure a good deal that boosts growth would be a major dereliction of duty.”
paras.zh: “坚持现状而不是不懈努力以达成一项促进增长的好协议将是严重失职。”

paras.en: The prime minister’s statement comes on the same day MPs are due to debate a petition in Westminster Hall, calling for Britain to apply to rejoin the EU, which got more than 111,000 signatures.
paras.zh: 首相发表声明的同一天，议员们将在威斯敏斯特大厅就一份请愿书进行辩论，该请愿书呼吁英国申请重新加入欧盟，该请愿书已获得超过 111,000 个签名。

paras.en: The intervention comes amid renewed divisions over Britain’s relationship with Europe, with senior Conservatives vowing to reverse Labour’s moves towards closer EU ties, including a proposed agreement designed to ease post-Brexit barriers on food and agricultural trade. It has prompted warnings from businesses that abandoning such arrangements could prolong costs and uncertainty caused by checks and paperwork at the border.
paras.zh: 此次干预发生之际，英国与欧洲的关系再次出现分歧，保守党高层誓言要扭转工党走向更紧密欧盟关系的举措，其中包括一项旨在缓解脱欧后食品和农产品贸易壁垒的拟议协议。这促使企业发出警告，称放弃此类安排可能会延长边境检查和文书工作带来的成本和不确定性。

paras.en: But the idea of Britain having a closer relationship with the EU has also prompted unease within Burnham’s own ranks. Some MPs representing leave-voting constituencies fear renewing the Brexit debate could reopen old divisions, with senior ministers warning of the political and economic risks of pursuing EU membership.
paras.zh: 但英国与欧盟建立更密切关系的想法也引起了伯纳姆内部的不安。一些代表脱欧选区的议员担心，重新开始英国脱欧辩论可能会重新引发旧有分歧，高级部长们警告称，寻求欧盟成员身份会带来政治和经济风险。

paras.en: Burnham’s statement also follows his declaration on Sunday that Russia interfered in the 2016 Brexit referendum. The prime minister has said he sought clarification on foreign interference after entering Downing Street and received confirmation of Russian involvement, although he did not reveal the evidence or suggest it had changed the referendum result.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆发表声明之前，他于周日宣布俄罗斯干预了 2016 年英国脱欧公投。首相表示，他在进入唐宁街后寻求有关外国干涉的澄清，并收到了俄罗斯参与的确认，尽管他没有透露证据或暗示俄罗斯改变了公投结果。

paras.en: The prime minister has already signalled a significant change in tone from his predecessor Keir Starmer, who ruled out rejoining the single market or customs union.
paras.zh: 总理已经表示其前任凯尔·斯塔默的语气发生重大变化，排除了重新加入单一市场或关税同盟的可能性。

paras.en: At Labour’s conference in Liverpool last month, Burnham said Brexit had done more harm than good and promised to examine Britain’s longterm relationship with the EU. He opened the door to options including fully rejoining the bloc.
paras.zh: 上个月在利物浦举行的工党会议上，伯纳姆表示，英国脱欧弊大于利，并承诺审查英国与欧盟的长期关系。他打开了选择的大门，包括完全重新加入欧盟。

paras.en: Monday’s statement will turn the focus towards the immediate negotiations, with ministers seeking progress on removing trade barriers, including bureaucracy affecting food imports and exports, and closer cooperation on migration.
paras.zh: 周一的声明将把焦点转向当前的谈判，部长们寻求在消除贸易壁垒方面取得进展，包括影响粮食进出口的官僚主义，以及在移民问题上加强合作。

articles.title: Lawyers who helped detained Australian Robert Pether leave Iraq criticise Wong for announcing news
articles.author: Christopher Knaus

paras.en: Advisers to Australian Robert Pether have expressed concern about the timing of a statement from the foreign minister announcing his depature from Iraq, saying it was issued at a sensitive period while the engineer was still transiting through Turkey.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚罗伯特·佩瑟的顾问对外交部长宣布离开伊拉克的声明的时机表示担忧，称该声明是在敏感时期发表的，当时工程师仍在土耳其过境。

paras.en: Penny Wong’s office issued a statement on Monday announcing that Pether had been allowed to leave Iraq after five years trapped in the country, including a four-year stint in jail that his family feared would kill him.
paras.zh: 黄英贤的办公室周一发表声明，宣布佩瑟在伊拉克被困五年后被允许离开伊拉克，其中包括四年的监禁，他的家人担心这会杀死他。

paras.en: The news was welcomed by his family, who said they had been “living in hell” since Pether was arrested without charge in April 2021 in connection to a business dispute between his firm – which was building a new headquarters for the central bank – and the Iraqi government.
paras.zh: 这一消息受到了他的家人的欢迎，他们表示，自从佩瑟于 2021 年 4 月因他的公司（该公司正在为中央银行建造新总部）与伊拉克政府之间的商业纠纷而未经指控被捕以来，他们一直“生活在地狱中”。

paras.en: Pether was released from jail last year due to his deteriorating health, but was banned from leaving the country until last week, when an Iraqi court dismissed proceedings against him and lifted the travel ban, citing a lack of evidence.
paras.zh: 佩瑟因健康状况恶化而于去年出狱，但直到上周才被禁止出境，当时伊拉克法院以缺乏证据为由驳回了针对他的诉讼并取消了旅行禁令。

paras.en: He was allowed to board a flight on Monday to Ireland, via Turkey, after painstaking negotiations involving officials in Ireland, Australia, Egypt and Iraq – and Pether’s international pro-bono team at Slaney Advisors, a consultancy specialising in international arbitration.
paras.zh: 经过爱尔兰、澳大利亚、埃及和伊拉克官员以及专门从事国际仲裁的咨询公司 Slaney Advisors 的 Pether 国际公益团队的艰苦谈判后，他于周一获准登机经土耳其飞往爱尔兰。

paras.en: The managing director, Peter Griffin, said he was shocked by the timing of Wong’s statement.
paras.zh: 董事总经理彼得·格里芬 (Peter Griffin) 表示，他对黄的声明时机感到震惊。

paras.en: He said it was issued while Pether was transiting through Turkey and still at risk, particularly if there was premature and negative media reporting concerning the Iraqi government’s handling of the case.
paras.zh: 他说，该消息是在 Pether 过境土耳其时发布的，并且仍然处于危险之中，特别是如果媒体对伊拉克政府处理此案的情况进行过早的负面报道。

paras.en: “We were aware for some time that minister Wong was keen to be the first to break this fantastic news,” Griffin said. “But Robert’s safety was paramount.”
paras.zh: 格里芬说：“我们很早就知道黄部长渴望成为第一个宣布这一好消息的人。” “但罗伯特的安全至关重要。”

paras.en: Wong’s office declined to respond to the criticism. Earlier, the foreign minister said: “The Australian government welcomes the Iraqi government’s decision to allow Mr Robert Pether to leave Iraq today.”
paras.zh: 黄的办公室拒绝回应这些批评。早些时候，外交部长表示：“澳大利亚政府欢迎伊拉克政府决定允许罗伯特·佩瑟先生今天离开伊拉克。”

paras.en: “I spoke to Mr Pether shortly before his departure from Baghdad and am pleased he is now free to move forward with his life and be reunited with his family.
paras.zh: “在佩瑟先生离开巴格达之前不久，我与他进行了交谈，很高兴他现在可以自由地继续自己的生活并与家人团聚。

paras.en: “Today’s outcome follows many years of persistent advocacy by the Australian government, including at the highest levels of government, and sustained consular assistance to Mr Pether and his family.”
paras.zh: “今天的结果是澳大利亚政府（包括政府最高层）多年来坚持不懈的倡导以及对佩瑟先生及其家人的持续领事援助的结果。”

paras.en: Pether’s wife, Desree, said she was “hugely relieved”.
paras.zh: 佩瑟的妻子德斯丽表示，她“如释重负”。

paras.en: “It’s been an absolute nightmare, especially these last few months,” she said. “So many obstacles and plot twists right up to the last minute.”
paras.zh: “这绝对是一场噩梦，尤其是最近几个月，”她说。 “直到最后一刻，还有如此多的障碍和曲折的情节。”

paras.en: Pether and his Egyptian colleague Khalid Radwan were detained in Baghdad in 2021 after flying in for a meeting with bank officials to resolve a dispute they were having with his engineering firm, CME Consulting.
paras.zh: 2021 年，佩瑟和他的埃及同事哈立德·拉德万 (Khalid Radwan) 飞往巴格达与银行官员开会，以解决他们与工程公司 CME Con​​sulting 之间的纠纷，随后在巴格达被拘留。

paras.en: Pether was later sentenced and fined over allegations that his firm spent money that should have gone to an architect and a subcontractor.
paras.zh: 佩瑟后来因指控他的公司花费了本应交给建筑师和分包商的钱而被判刑并罚款。

paras.en: In a report in March 2022, the UN working group on arbitrary detention found Pether had been arbitrarily detained in breach of international law.
paras.zh: 联合国任意拘留问题工作组在 2022 年 3 月的一份报告中发现，任意拘留 Pether 的行为违反了国际法。

paras.en: The UN body also found the arrest constituted an “enforced disappearance” and may have involved forms of torture. The working group said it had received complaints that Pether “was exposed to extreme cold, threats of death, humiliation and various forms of psychological abuse”.
paras.zh: 联合国机构还认定此次逮捕构成“强迫失踪”，并可能涉及各种形式的酷刑。该工作组表示，已收到投诉称佩瑟“遭受极度寒冷、死亡威胁、羞辱和各种形式的心理虐待”。

paras.en: “Mr Pether was detained in a [2x2 metre] cell with the lights permanently on,” the working group said in its report. “He was reportedly blindfolded, interrogated, screamed at, threatened, insulted and shown torture rooms.”
paras.zh: “Pether 先生被关押在一间 [2x2 米] 的牢房里，牢房里的灯一直亮着，”工作组在报告中表示。 “据报道，他被蒙住眼睛、审讯、尖叫、威胁、侮辱，并被带到酷刑室。”

paras.en: Pether’s family described the arrest and ongoing detention as a living nightmare. His health dramatically deteriorated.
paras.zh: 佩瑟的家人将这次逮捕和持续拘留描述为一场活生生的噩梦。他的健康状况急剧恶化。

paras.en: In 2022, the Guardian obtained an emotional letter from Pether to his family, penned from behind bars. The letter warned his prognosis was “bleak” and he was facing a potential “death sentence”.
paras.zh: 2022 年，《卫报》收到了佩瑟在狱中写给家人的一封充满感情的信。这封信警告说，他的预后“黯淡”，他可能面临“死刑”。

paras.en: Pether wrote about potentially telling his family he might not come home.
paras.zh: 佩瑟写道，他可能会告诉家人他可能不会回家。

paras.en: “How do you tell a little girl who loves unicorns and cats that her daddy will not be coming home? How do you tell your children that you are proud of them but will not be sharing the accolades (and pitfalls) of their lives with them?” Pether wrote.
paras.zh: “你如何告诉一个喜欢独角兽和猫的小女孩，她的爸爸不会回家了？你如何告诉你的孩子，你为他们感到骄傲，但不会与他们分享生活中的荣誉（和陷阱）？”佩瑟写道。

paras.en: “And toughest of all, how do you tell your wife, who is very much the other half of you, that you will not be keeping the promise you made to grow old together?”
paras.zh: “最难的是，你如何告诉你的妻子，你的妻子就是你的另一半，你不会遵守共同变老的承诺？”

paras.en: Desree had previously been critical of the efforts of Australian officials to secure Pether’s release. The Australian government said it had raised the case with Iraqi authorities more than 200 times.
paras.zh: 德斯雷此前曾批评澳大利亚官员为确保佩瑟获释所做的努力。澳大利亚政府表示已向伊拉克当局提出此案200多次。

paras.en: Following her husband’s release from jail in 2025, Desree said from Ireland she was “grateful to everyone who contributed to this happening”.
paras.zh: 2025 年她的丈夫出狱后，德斯雷在爱尔兰表示，她“感谢所有为这一事件做出贡献的人”。

paras.en: The UN working group posed serious questions about the conduct of Pether’s trial.
paras.zh: 联合国工作组对佩瑟的审判提出了严重质疑。

paras.en: The 2022 report aired allegations that Pether’s evidence was mistranslated to indicate guilt and said that even during the trial “Pether and Radwan did not have clarity around their charges”. Charges were dropped during the hearing and replaced with others.
paras.zh: 2022 年的报告指控 Pether 的证据被误译为有罪，并表示即使在审判期间，“Pether 和 Radwan 也不清楚他们的指控”。听证会期间，指控被撤销，并被其他指控取代。

paras.en: “In the light of the above, the working group concludes that the violations of the right to a fair trial and due process are of such gravity as to give the deprivation of liberty of Messrs Pether and Radwan is arbitrary,” the report stated.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“鉴于上述情况，工作组得出的结论是，对公平审判和正当程序权利的侵犯非常严重，因此剥夺佩特尔和拉德万先生的自由是任意的。”

articles.title: Watch: Endangered orangutans released back into the wild after Borneo fires

paras.en: Watch: Endangered orangutans released back into the wild after Borneo fires
paras.zh: 观看：婆罗洲大火后濒临灭绝的猩猩被放回野外

paras.en: Eight orangutans have been released into the wild in Borneo after being rescued from intense wildfires.
paras.zh: 八只猩猩在从强烈的野火中获救后被释放到婆罗洲的野外。

paras.en: Three mothers, their three daughters and two adult males were freed in a reserve in the west of the island on Friday.
paras.zh: 周五，三名母亲、她们的三个女儿和两名成年男性在该岛西部的一个保护区被释放。

paras.en: Indonesian wildlife authorities rescued 46 of the apes, which are critically endangered, before fires tore through their habitat in August and September.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚野生动物当局在 8 月和 9 月的大火烧毁了它们的栖息地之前，拯救了 46 只极度濒危的类人猿。

articles.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth

paras.en: The world's biggest accountancy firm helped in falsifying documents to hide Roman Abramovich's wealth and evade tax, BBC Panorama has found.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司全景报道发现，世界上最大的会计师事务所帮助伪造文件，以隐藏罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇的财富并逃税。

paras.en: Accounts signed off by Deloitte in Cyprus meant assets such as superyachts, mansions and private jets worth $672m (Â£508m) vanished from Abramovich's company accounts.
paras.zh: 德勤在塞浦路斯签署的账户意味着价值 6.72 亿美元（5.08 亿英镑）的超级游艇、豪宅和私人飞机等资产从阿布拉莫维奇的公司账户中消失。

paras.en: Deloitte also appears to have advised on a scheme to evade a huge tax bill on the oligarch's wealth through the falsification of documents.
paras.zh: 德勤似乎还为一项通过伪造文件逃避寡头财富巨额税单的计划提供了建议。

paras.en: Barrister Andrew Mitchell KC, an expert in financial services law, said Panorama's evidence showed the scheme was "straightforward" tax evasion and "it couldn't be more blatant".
paras.zh: 金融服务法专家、大律师安德鲁·米切尔 KC 表示，Panorama 的证据表明该计划是“直接”的逃税行为，而且“再明显不过了”。

paras.en: Roman Abramovich's lawyers said he denies that he evaded tax or concealed his fortune. They said Panorama provided no evidence he knew about, authorised or directed the falsification of any document and said it was legitimate to rely on advice from professionals.
paras.zh: 罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇的律师表示，他否认逃税或隐匿财产。他们表示，帕诺拉马没有提供任何他知道、授权或指示伪造任何文件的证据，并表示依赖专业人士的建议是合法的。

paras.en: Deloitte Cyprus said it "acts in compliance with applicable laws".
paras.zh: 德勤塞浦路斯表示，其“行事符合适用法律”。

paras.en: The findings are being revealed following a joint investigation between BBC Panorama and the Bureau of Investigative Journalism.
paras.zh: BBC Panorama 和新闻调查局联合调查后公布了调查结果。

paras.en: For nearly two decades, Roman Abramovich was the most famous Russian oligarch in the UK, welcomed in London where he bought Chelsea Football Club in 2003 and bankrolled the club's most successful period. But after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, he was sanctioned by the UK government as an associate of President Vladimir Putin and forced to sell the club.
paras.zh: 近二十年来，罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇一直是英国最著名的俄罗斯寡头，在伦敦受到欢迎，他于 2003 年收购了切尔西足球俱乐部，并为该俱乐部最成功的时期提供了资金。但在2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，他作为总统弗拉基米尔·普京的助手受到英国政府制裁，并被迫出售俱乐部。

paras.en: Abramovich has been reported to be living in Turkey, a safe haven for him because it did not apply sanctions. In the Channel Island of Jersey, Â£5.4bn of his assets remain frozen and a criminal investigation has been going on for four years.
paras.zh: 据报道，阿布拉莫维奇住在土耳其，土耳其对他来说是一个安全港，因为土耳其没有实施制裁。在海峡群岛的泽西岛，他的 54 亿英镑资产仍被冻结，刑事调查已持续四年。

paras.en: The oligarch's lawyers told the BBC he denies the allegations in the Jersey investigation and says it was "undertaken for political purposes".
paras.zh: 这位寡头的律师告诉英国广播公司，他否认泽西岛调查中的指控，并表示这是“出于政治目的”。

paras.en: Our investigation has uncovered new evidence about the way Abramovich's business empire has been run. It also raises serious questions about the integrity of some of his professional advisers.
paras.zh: 我们的调查发现了有关阿布拉莫维奇商业帝国运作方式的新证据。这也对他的一些专业顾问的诚信提出了严重质疑。

paras.en: The evidence is contained in a leak that includes thousands of documents about the oligarch's finances and the operations of a network of offshore companies administered from Cyprus - which used to be a tax haven popular with Russians - between 1995 and 2022.
paras.zh: 这些证据包含在一份泄露的文件中，其中包括数千份有关该寡头的财务状况以及1995年至2022年间由塞浦路斯管理的离岸公司网络运营的文件，塞浦路斯曾是俄罗斯人喜爱的避税天堂。

paras.en: The BBC and media partners including the Guardian, Paper Trail Media, the Organised Crime and Corruption Reporting Project, and the Cyprus Investigative Reporting Network - as well as the Bureau of Investigative Journalism, external - have been reporting on the leaked files since 2023 as part of the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists' Cyprus Confidential, external investigation.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 和媒体合作伙伴，包括《卫报》、Paper Trail Media、有组织犯罪和腐败报道项目、塞浦路斯调查报道网络以及外部调查新闻局，自 2023 年以来一直在报道泄露的文件，作为国际调查记者联盟塞浦路斯机密外部调查的一部分。

paras.en: In 2022, Panorama also reported on how Abramovich had made his fortune from a corrupt deal to buy a Russian state-owned oil company in the 1990s, selling it back to the government a decade later for billions in profit. He has previously said allegations of corruption in the deal are false.
paras.zh: 2022 年，《全景》还报道了阿布拉莫维奇如何通过 20 世纪 90 年代收购一家俄罗斯国有石油公司的腐败交易发家致富，并在十年后将其卖回政府以获得数十亿美元的利润。他此前曾表示，有关交易中腐败的指控是错误的。

paras.en: The profits from Abramovich's oil deals in Russia were funnelled into a web of offshore companies. They were administered from Cyprus by a corporate services firm called MeritServus, in Limassol, the island's second-largest city.
paras.zh: 阿布拉莫维奇在俄罗斯石油交易中获得的利润被输送到离岸公司网络中。它们由位于塞浦路斯岛第二大城市利马索尔的一家名为 MeritServus 的企业服务公司管理。

paras.en: Until 2005, Deloitte - now the biggest of the "big four" firms which dominate the accounting industry - owned MeritServus. After they split, the two companies worked closely together with Abramovich's associates to manage his global fortune.
paras.zh: 直到 2005 年，德勤——现在主导会计行业的“四大”公司中最大的——拥有 MeritServus。分拆后，两家公司与阿布拉莫维奇的同事密切合作，管理他的全球财富。

paras.en: The leaked documents from MeritServus reveal some of their practices.
paras.zh: MeritServus 泄露的文件揭示了他们的一些做法。

paras.en: Panorama - Roman Abramovich: How He Hid His Fortune
paras.zh: 全景 - 罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇：他如何隐藏自己的财富

paras.en: He was the Russian oligarch who brought his wealth to the UK. But whatâs the truth about Roman Abramovichâs fortune? Panorama investigates the documents that were falsified to hide his wealth and evade tax.
paras.zh: 他是将财富带到英国的俄罗斯寡头。但罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇的财富真相是什么呢？全景调查了他为了隐藏财富和逃税而伪造的文件。

paras.en: Watch now on BBC iPlayer or on BBC One at 20:00 BST on Monday 12 October.
paras.zh: 立即在英国夏令时 10 月 12 日星期一 20:00 在 BBC iPlayer 或 BBC One 上观看。

paras.en: Our first example of backdated paperwork comes in 2006, after a new law in Cyprus meant that company accounts had to be made public. The new transparency law threatened to expose the secrets of Abramovich's vast wealth.
paras.zh: 我们的第一个回溯文书工作的例子出现在 2006 年，当时塞浦路斯的一项新法律规定公司账目必须公开。新的透明度法有可能暴露阿布拉莫维奇巨额财富的秘密。

paras.en: Deloitte Cyprus had prepared draft accounts for 2003 - but had not yet finalised them - for his Cypriot company Amiscan Investments. The accounts detailed $672m of luxury property.
paras.zh: 德勤塞浦路斯公司为其塞浦路斯公司 Amiscan Investments 准备了 2003 年的账目草案，但尚未最终确定。账目详细列出了价值 6.72 亿美元的豪华房产。

paras.en: A mansion in West Sussex, a luxury flat in London and an estate in the south of France were all included - plus helicopters, private jets and a small fleet of boats the oligarch owned at the time, including the $147.5m Pelorus.
paras.zh: 西苏塞克斯的一座豪宅、伦敦的一座豪华公寓和法国南部的一座庄园都包括在内，还有直升机、私人飞机和寡头当时拥有的一小队船只，其中包括价值 1.475 亿美元的 Pelorus 号。

paras.en: To keep them secret, Abramovich's associates and Meritservus decided to rewrite history. They drew up a plan to circumvent the transparency law by transferring the assets to Amiscan's parent company in the British Virgin Islands (BVI), where they could be kept hidden. And they backdated the change by three years to make it look like the asset transfer had happened in 2003.
paras.zh: 为了保守秘密，阿布拉莫维奇的同事和梅里特塞弗斯决定改写历史。他们制定了一项计划，通过将资产转移到 Amiscan 位于英属维尔京群岛 (BVI) 的母公司来规避透明度法，并在那里将资产隐藏起来。他们将这一变化回溯了三年，让资产转移看起来像是 2003 年发生的。

paras.en: Deloitte Cyprus reviewed the backdated documents and said they were "adequate" to allow them to remove the assets from Amiscan's accounts.
paras.zh: 德勤塞浦路斯审查了倒日期的文件，并表示这些文件“足以”允许他们从 Amiscan 的账户中删除资产。

paras.en: When the 2003 accounts were signed off by Deloitte in 2006, the homes, planes and yachts disappeared at the stroke of a pen. Only $75,000 of assets remained.
paras.zh: 2006年德勤签署了2003年的账目后，房屋、飞机和游艇大笔一挥就消失了。只剩下 75,000 美元的资产。

paras.en: Deloitte signed off the accounts even though the leaked documents show it knew they were completely misleading.
paras.zh: 尽管泄露的文件显示德勤知道这些账户完全具有误导性，但德勤还是签署了这些账户。

paras.en: Lord Sikka, professor of accounting at the University of Sheffield, said it was a "violation of a statutory duty" and "pretty scandalous" to misrepresent transaction dates and not to publish true and fair accounts.
paras.zh: 谢菲尔德大学会计学教授西卡勋爵表示，歪曲交易日期、不公布真实、公平的账目是“违反法定义务”的行为，也是“相当可耻的”。

paras.en: Panorama also found evidence that backdated documents had been used in a tax evasion scheme.
paras.zh: 全景还发现证据表明回溯文件已被用于逃税计划。

paras.en: This involved another one of Abramovich's Cypriot companies, Kravin Investments, which had almost $2bn in the bank in 2003.
paras.zh: 这涉及阿布拉莫维奇的另一家塞浦路斯公司克拉文投资公司(Kravin Investments)，该公司2003年在银行存有近20亿美元。

paras.en: It had been earning large amounts in interest, so Roman Abramovich's company should have been paying tax on that interest to the Cypriot authorities.
paras.zh: 该公司一直赚取大量利息，因此罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇的公司应该向塞浦路斯当局缴纳这笔利息税。

paras.en: But his advisers had another idea to rewrite history.
paras.zh: 但他的顾问们有另一个改写历史的想法。

paras.en: An email from MeritServus in August 2005 to Abramovich's Russian associates said a plan had been devised after a meeting with Deloitte. "If you agree, it will be necessary to change the financial statements and the accounting records accordingly for 2003 and 2004," the email read.
paras.zh: 2005 年 8 月，MeritServus 发给阿布拉莫维奇俄罗斯同事的一封电子邮件称，在与德勤会面后制定了一项计划。电子邮件中写道：“如果您同意，则有必要对 2003 年和 2004 年的财务报表和会计记录进行相应的修改。”

paras.en: MeritServus informed the oligarch's Russian associates, that Kravin's "Provisional Tax Assessments for 2005" would be filed showing the company earning no income from the money.
paras.zh: MeritServus 通知寡头的俄罗斯同伙，Kravin 的“2005 年临时纳税评估”将提交，显示该公司没有从这笔钱中获得任何收入。

paras.en: A month later, an associate in Russia emailed in response, "I agree".
paras.zh: 一个月后，俄罗斯的一位同事通过电子邮件回复说：“我同意”。

paras.en: MeritServus then created a series of backdated documents which falsely purported to show that Kravin was only holding and investing the funds on behalf of its parent company in the BVI.
paras.zh: MeritServus 随后制作了一系列回溯文件，谎称 Kravin 仅代表其英属维尔京群岛母公司持有和投资这些资金。

paras.en: This made it look like Kravin did not actually own the money, so it would not be liable for tax in Cyprus.
paras.zh: 这使得克拉文看起来并不真正拥有这笔钱，因此它不需要在塞浦路斯纳税。

paras.en: Deloitte wrote in a September 2005 email that "certain changes will have to be made to the accounts (bank account balances, interest income, profit and loss account)" because of the backdated changes to Kravin's assets.
paras.zh: 德勤在 2005 年 9 月的一封电子邮件中写道，由于 Kravin 资产的变更，“必须对账户（银行账户余额、利息收入、损益账户）进行某些更改”。

paras.en: So Deloitte was apparently advising on the falsification of financial records. The evidence suggests it allowed Abramovich's company to evade millions in tax.
paras.zh: 因此，德勤显然是在就财务记录的伪造问题提供建议。有证据表明，这使得阿布拉莫维奇的公司逃税了数百万美元。

paras.en: Andrew Mitchell KC told us the scheme was "straightforward" tax evasion. "If it happened in England and it was in the millions, His Majesty's Revenue and Customs would be thinking about a prosecution," he said.
paras.zh: Andrew Mitchell KC 告诉我们，该计划是“直接”的逃税行为。他说：“如果这件事发生在英格兰，而且人数达到数百万，英国税务海关总署就会考虑起诉。”

paras.en: Cypriot MP Christos Christofides said that if tax had been evaded, then "we have to see how we can get our money back and how, if some people are guilty, they have to pay the price according to our law."
paras.zh: 塞浦路斯议员克里斯托·克里斯托菲德斯表示，如果有人逃税，那么“我们必须看看如何才能拿回我们的钱，如果有些人有罪，他们必须如何根据我们的法律付出代价。”

paras.en: In addition to the documents which Deloitte helped to backdate, Abramovich's advisers at MeritServus falsified a third set of records. This involved the oligarch's huge business fortune - more than $10bn - held by a company called Electus Investments in Cyprus.
paras.zh: 除了德勤帮助回溯的文件之外，阿布拉莫维奇在 MeritServus 的顾问还伪造了第三组记录。这涉及寡头的巨额商业财富——超过100亿美元——由塞浦路斯一家名为Electus Investments的公司持有。

paras.en: MeritServus backdated documents to make it look like Electus did not own the fortune.
paras.zh: MeritServus 回溯了文件的日期，使之看起来像是 Electus 并不拥有这笔财富。

paras.en: It used another Abramovich company with exactly the same name of Electus Investments, but this time based in the more secretive BVI, where accounts did not have to be made public.
paras.zh: 它使用了另一家与阿布拉莫维奇同名的公司 Electus Investments，但这一次总部设在更加保密的英属维尔京群岛，那里的账户不必公开。

paras.en: Emails show that in 2006, MeritServus acknowledged that the fortune was owned by Electus Cyprus. But again it proposed to rewrite the past, this time "to transfer the beneficial ownership to Electus Investments in the BVI" and make it look as though the change had happened three years earlier.
paras.zh: 电子邮件显示，2006 年，MeritServus 承认这笔财富归 Electus Cyprus 所有。但它再次提议改写过去，这一次“将实益所有权转让给英属维尔京群岛的Electus Investments”，并让这一变化看起来好像是三年前发生的。

paras.en: MeritServus signed and backdated documents which falsely purported to show the BVI company had owned the $10bn fortune since 20 November 2003. So when the accounts of the Cypriot company with the same name were made public, it appeared to have assets worth just $145,000.
paras.zh: MeritServus 签署并回溯了一些文件，谎称该 BVI 公司自 2003 年 11 月 20 日以来已拥有 100 亿美元的财富。因此，当同名塞浦路斯公司的账户被公开时，该公司的资产似乎仅价值 145,000 美元。

paras.en: Roman Abramovich's billions had been made to disappear.
paras.zh: 罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇的数十亿美元就这样消失了。

paras.en: Andrew Mitchell KC told Panorama: "What you take away from it is there are professionals who are prepared to bend and break the rules of their profession and therefore the law. And it looks that they will stop literally at nothing in terms of creating documents."
paras.zh: 安德鲁·米切尔 KC 告诉《Panorama》：“你从中得到的结论是，有些专业人士准备改变和违反他们的职业规则，从而违反法律。而且看起来他们在创建文件方面几乎不择手段。”

paras.en: Vladimir Milov, Russia's deputy minister of energy as Abramovich built his empire and now a critic of the Russian government, said: "For each Russian oligarch or Middle Eastern or African corrupt oligarch, there's an army of Western financial and legal services and PR services providers, who is easily taking money for whitewashing their reputation and making them look normal."
paras.zh: 阿布拉莫维奇建立帝国时担任俄罗斯能源部副部长的弗拉基米尔·米洛夫（Vladimir Milov）现在是俄罗斯政府的批评者，他表示：“对于每一个俄罗斯寡头、中东或非洲腐败寡头来说，都有一支由西方金融、法律服务和公关服务提供商组成的军队，他们很容易拿钱粉饰自己的声誉，让自己看起来很正常。”

paras.en: Denying any wrongdoing by the oligarch, Roman Abramovich's lawyers said that he was "not involved in the day-to-day operation of those companies" and that where arrangements were proposed by professional advisers, "reliance on that advice was entirely proper and legitimate".
paras.zh: 罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇的律师否认寡头有任何不当行为，表示他“没有参与这些公司的日常运营”，并且在专业顾问提出安排的情况下，“依赖该建议是完全适当和合法的”。

paras.en: Deloitte Cyprus said it could not comment on the specific allegations because the documents were more than 20 years old and no longer accessible.
paras.zh: 德勤塞浦路斯表示，无法对具体指控发表评论，因为这些文件已有 20 多年历史，无法再查阅。

paras.en: MeritServus closed following the Cyprus Confidential leak.
paras.zh: MeritServus 在塞浦路斯机密泄露后关闭。

articles.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal

paras.en: A major river in Nepal has flooded, sweeping away houses, bridges and damaging a part of hydropower station, authorities have said.
paras.zh: 当局称，尼泊尔一条主要河流发生洪水，冲毁了房屋、桥梁，并损坏了部分水电站。

paras.en: Officials say they have rescued 95 people, including nine foreigners, along the bank of the Budhi Gandaki River in the central Gorkha district, the army confirmed. No casualties have been reported yet, however five people are missing.
paras.zh: 军方证实，官员称他们已在廓尔喀地区中部的布迪甘达基河沿岸救出了 95 人，其中包括 9 名外国人。目前尚无人员伤亡报告，但有五人失踪。

paras.en: A video of the flood shows the moment raging waters sweep down a valley and wash away an entire building complex.
paras.zh: 一段洪水视频显示，汹涌的洪水冲下山谷，冲毁了整个建筑群。

paras.en: Nepal is on high alert and still trying to recover from catastrophic floods that hit its border towns with Tibet two months ago, leaving more than 1,400 people dead and thousands missing.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔处于高度戒备状态，仍在努力从两个月前袭击其与西藏边境城镇的灾难性洪水中恢复过来，洪水造成 1,400 多人死亡、数千人失踪。

paras.en: Sunday's flood tore through the Gorkha district as children and communities prepared to mark the first day of the Dashain festival, a major moment in the Nepali calendar.
paras.zh: 周日的洪水席卷了廓尔喀地区，儿童和社区正准备庆祝德赛节的第一天，这是尼泊尔日历上的一个重要时刻。

paras.en: More than 200 homes were damaged and more than 650 people were impacted by the flood, Nepal's Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔减灾和管理局表示，洪水导致 200 多所房屋受损，650 多人受到影响。

paras.en: Some settlements have been completely cut off and are now only accessible by air, a local official told The Kathmandu Post.
paras.zh: 当地官员告诉《加德满都邮报》，一些定居点已完全与外界隔绝，现在只能乘飞机进入。

paras.en: Nepal's army said it had mobilised four helicopters for search and rescue operations.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔军方表示，已调动四架直升机进行搜救行动。

paras.en: Families have been forced to flee their homes, with many facing uncertainty over where they will find safe shelter and access to essential supplies.
paras.zh: 许多家庭被迫逃离家园，许多人面临着如何找到安全住所和获得基本物资的不确定性。

paras.en: Ganesh Karki, a resident of Jagatbagar, told The Kathmandu Post that he and others took shelter about 500m (0.3 miles) uphill in a nearby forest after receiving a warning call about the flood early in the morning.
paras.zh: Jagatbagar 居民 Ganesh Karki 告诉《加德满都邮报》，他和其他人一大早就接到洪水警报后，在附近森林里上坡约 500m（0.3 英里）处避难。

paras.en: "We never imagined a flood of this size," he said. "The water surged for about 15 minutes and then stopped repeatedly throughout the morning. We are afraid to return home at night."
paras.zh: 他说：“我们从未想象过会发生如此规模的洪水。” “水流汹涌了大约15分钟，然后整个上午都停了。我们害怕晚上回家。”

paras.en: The flood swept away about a dozen houses and several suspension bridges, while a hydroelectric project was damaged, carrying some of the construction equipment away, the disaster management authority said.
paras.zh: 灾害管理局表示，洪水冲毁了大约十几栋房屋和几座吊桥，一个水力发电项目遭到破坏，部分建筑设备被冲走。

paras.en: Within a couple of hours, the river's water levels at one location had risen from two metres (6ft 5in) to nearly 8.5m (27ft 9in), officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，几个小时内，河水某一地点的水位从 2 米（6 英尺 5 英寸）上升到近 8.5 m（27 英尺 9 英寸）。

paras.en: Binod Parajuli, a meteorologist who works with the Nepalese government, said: "Our hydrological station was swept away and we are not getting any data from that location."
paras.zh: 尼泊尔政府的气象学家比诺德·帕拉朱利 (Binod Parajuli) 表示：“我们的水文站被冲走了，我们没有从那个位置获得任何数据。”

paras.en: However, experts say the debris-flow is much smaller and travelled more slowly than the devastating flash floods in August.
paras.zh: 然而，专家表示，与八月份毁灭性的山洪相比，这次泥石流规模要小得多，移动速度也慢得多。

paras.en: What caused the latest flood is still unclear. Some say a landslide may have blocked the river or its tributary for some time, causing the dammed water to burst out, while others say locals upstream saw an ice-avalanche.
paras.zh: 最近一次洪水的原因尚不清楚。有人说，山体滑坡可能堵塞了河流或其支流一段时间，导致堤坝水喷涌而出，而另一些人则说，上游当地人看到了冰崩。

paras.en: Save the Children is mobilising an emergency team to respond to Sunday's flood.
paras.zh: 救助儿童会正在动员一支应急小组应对周日的洪水。

paras.en: "Children's lives have been ripped apart in an instant yet again", the charity's director in Nepal, Tara Chettry, said.
paras.zh: 该慈善机构驻尼泊尔负责人塔拉·切特里（Tara Chettry）表示，“孩子们的生活再次瞬间被撕裂”。

paras.en: "We are yet to see the full scale of the damage, but they may have lost their homes, schools and communities. Many children in Gorkha will still be in shock and distress after the mega floods in August, barely having a chance to get back on their feet."
paras.zh: “我们还没有看到损失的全部规模，但他们可能失去了家园、学校和社区。八月份的特大洪水过后，廓尔喀的许多儿童仍然处于震惊和痛苦之中，几乎没有机会重新站起来。”

paras.en: The Budhi Gandaki is a tributary of the Trishuli river, downstream from another tributary where a glacier collapse caused the previous disaster.
paras.zh: 布迪甘达基河是特里苏利河的一条支流，位于另一条支流的下游，上次灾难是由冰川崩塌造成的。

paras.en: Nepal is prone to disasters, from earthquakes to landslides and floods, as a result of the unpredictable natural environment in the Himalayas. Hundreds of people were killed in August after floods tore through villages along the Nepal-Tibet border. That disaster was caused by an avalanche of rock and ice near the peak of Lantang Lirung, a mountain on Nepal's side of the Himalayas.
paras.zh: 由于喜马拉雅山不可预测的自然环境，尼泊尔容易遭受地震、山体滑坡和洪水等灾害。八月，尼泊尔和西藏边境沿线的村庄发生洪水，造成数百人死亡。那场灾难是由喜马拉雅山尼泊尔一侧的兰塘利隆峰附近的岩石和冰雪崩造成的。

paras.en: Experts say climate change, which is making glaciers melt faster, is likely raising the risk of such disasters, leaving local communities increasingly vulnerable.
paras.zh: 专家表示，气候变化导致冰川融化速度加快，可能会增加发生此类灾害的风险，使当地社区变得越来越脆弱。

articles.title: How did Roman aqueducts get water to go uphill?
articles.author: Owen Jarus

paras.en: Aqueducts are some of the ancient Romans' most prominent surviving archaeological remains. These aqueducts relied on gravity to bring down the water to cities gradually. But some, such as the aqueduct at Aspendos in Turkey, had sections where they had to go uphill. So how did the Romans get water to flow upward?
paras.zh: 渡槽是古罗马现存最著名的考古遗迹之一。这些渡槽依靠重力将水逐渐引入城市。但有些渡槽，例如土耳其阿斯彭多斯的渡槽，有必须上坡的部分。那么罗马人是如何让水向上流动的呢？

paras.en: The Romans used a few methods, including siphons and various water-lifting devices, experts told Live Science.
paras.zh: 专家告诉《生活科学》，罗马人使用了几种方法，包括虹吸管和各种提水装置。

paras.en: One strategy was a system called an inverted siphon (sometimes simply called a siphon).
paras.zh: 一种策略是一种称为倒虹吸管（有时简称为虹吸管）的系统。

paras.en: At Aspendos, in southern Turkey, there is a second-century-A.D. Roman aqueduct with inverted siphons that scholars have reconstructed with a virtual modeling simulation. To get water through a valley, the Romans built a "header tank" on one end of the valley and a slightly lower "receiving tank" (or "outlet tank") on the other side. In the valley, they constructed two towers between the tanks, Paul Kessener, a researcher in the Department of Language and Culture Studies at Radboud University in the Netherlands, noted in an article published in 2000 in the Journal of Roman Archaeology.
paras.zh: 在土耳其南部的阿斯潘多斯，有一座公元二世纪的建筑。学者们通过虚拟建模模拟重建了带有倒虹吸管的罗马渡槽。为了让水流过山谷，罗马人在山谷的一端建造了一个“总水箱”，并在另一侧建造了一个稍低的“接收水箱”（或“出口水箱”）。荷兰拉德堡德大学语言和文化研究系的研究员保罗·凯塞纳 (Paul Kessener) 在 2000 年《罗马考古学杂志》上发表的一篇文章中指出，他们在山谷中的坦克之间建造了两座塔。

paras.en: As water dropped down a steep hill, the resulting pressure pushed it up the first tower before dropping it steeply down the other side, with the force allowing it to climb the second tower. The water eventually reached the receiving tank on the other side of the valley and continued toward the city of Aspendos.
paras.zh: 当水从陡峭的山坡上落下时，产生的压力将其推上第一座塔，然后从另一侧陡峭地落下，从而使水能够爬上第二座塔。水最终到达了山谷另一边的接收池，并继续流向阿斯潘多斯市。

paras.en: It was important to prevent air pockets from forming as the water went through the inverted siphons. The header and receiving tanks were relatively large, allowing air bubbles to escape, Giovanni De Feo, a professor of industrial engineering at the University of Salerno in Italy, noted in an email.
paras.zh: 当水流过倒虹吸管时，防止形成气穴非常重要。意大利萨勒诺大学工业工程教授乔瓦尼·德·菲奥在一封电子邮件中指出，集管和接收罐相对较大，可以让气泡逸出。

paras.en: "As the flow entered a relatively large chamber, its velocity decreased, allowing air bubbles to rise naturally to the water surface and escape through the open top of the structure," De Feo explained. This reduced the risk of air pockets forming.
paras.zh: “当水流进入一个相对较大的腔室时，其速度会降低，从而使气泡自然上升到水面并通过结构的开放顶部逸出，”德费奥解释道。这降低了形成气穴的风险。

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The Romans tried to avoid using inverted siphons, said Charles Ortloff, a research associate in the Department of Anthropology at the University of Chicago who has a background in both engineering and history. When "Roman engineers encounter a valley, rather than construct a siphon, they [preferred] to build a bridge with a top channel to cross a valley," Ortloff said in an email. One example of this is at the Segovia aqueduct in Spain, which has a stunning bridge that still survives today.
paras.zh: 拥有工程和历史背景的芝加哥大学人类学系研究员查尔斯·奥尔特洛夫 (Charles Ortloff) 表示，罗马人试图避免使用倒虹吸管。奥特洛夫在一封电子邮件中说：“当罗马工程师遇到山谷时，他们[更愿意]建造一座带有顶部通道的桥梁来穿越山谷，而不是建造虹吸管。”西班牙的塞戈维亚渡槽就是一个例子，那里有一座令人惊叹的桥梁，至今仍然存在。

paras.en: While the Romans used inverted siphons to move water upward in an aqueduct, they employed other devices to push water out.
paras.zh: 虽然罗马人使用倒虹吸管将水在渡槽中向上移动，但他们也使用其他装置将水排出。

paras.en: Perhaps the best known of these devices is the Archimedes screw, which was sometimes used to help lift water from rivers to fields. (It was allegedly designed by Archimedes, a Greek inventor who lived during the third century B.C. However, it might have actually been invented at an earlier time, noted historians Stephanie Dalley and John Peter Oleson in a 2003 paper.) When "turned by use of animal power, [it] can effectively raise water from lower river heights to higher land area heights," Ortloff said.
paras.zh: 这些设备中最著名的可能是阿基米德螺杆，它有时被用来帮助将水从河流提升到田野。 （据称，它是由生活在公元前三世纪的希腊发明家阿基米德设计的。然而，历史学家斯蒂芬妮·达利和约翰·彼得·奥尔森在 2003 年的一篇论文中指出，它实际上可能是在更早的时间发明的。）奥特洛夫说，当“通过使用畜力进行转动时，[它]可以有效地将水从较低的河流高度提升到较高的陆地高度”。

paras.en: The Archimedes screw "consisted of a wooden shaft that had [curves] of thin and flexible willow or wicker branches one stuck on top of the other, so that an endless screw was created," the Kotsanas Museum of Ancient Greek Technology's website notes. This screw was placed within a wooden pipe, and the "device was placed in the water with an inclination of 30 degrees," the museum representatives wrote. As the screw was rotated, it lifted the water.
paras.zh: 科察纳斯古希腊技术博物馆的网站指出，阿基米德螺杆“由一根木轴组成，木轴上有细而柔韧的柳条或柳条树枝，一根一根地粘在另一根树枝上，这样就形成了一个无头螺旋”。该螺丝被放置在一根木管内，“该装置被放置在倾斜 30 度的水中”，博物馆代表写道。当螺杆旋转时，它将水升起。

paras.en: Water wheels were also used to lift water, including in Roman mines. "The water wheel is a device that raises water and that is made up of several buckets that are fastened to a big wheel," scientists wrote in a 2024 paper. This "kind of wheel resembles a carriage wheel but it is larger and features buckets to catch water in addition to its larger size," they explained.
paras.zh: 水车也被用来提水，包括在罗马矿井中。科学家在 2024 年的一篇论文中写道：“水车是一种提升水的装置，由固定在一个大轮上的多个水桶组成。”他们解释说，这种“轮子类似于马车轮，但它更大，除了尺寸更大之外，还具有用来接水的桶”。

paras.en: Another device, sometimes known as Ctesibius' pump, "was hand-moved, operating a wooden lever with a swinging motion," the scientists wrote. It had two cylinders connected to a central chamber through pistons, and the driven water exited through a nozzle connected to the central chamber.
paras.zh: 科学家们写道，另一种装置，有时被称为克特比乌斯泵，“是手动移动的，通过摆动运动操作木杆”。它有两个气缸通过活塞连接到中央室，驱动的水通过连接到中央室的喷嘴排出。

paras.en: Whatever method was used, the Romans would not let an uphill climb stop them from bringing water where they wanted it to go.
paras.zh: 无论使用什么方法，罗马人都不会让爬坡阻止他们将水带到他们想要的地方。

paras.en: From Augustus to Nero, see how much you know about ancient Rome's famous leaders with our Roman emperor quiz!
paras.zh: 从奥古斯都到尼禄，通过我们的罗马皇帝测验看看您对古罗马著名领导人了解多少！

paras.en: Owen Jarus is a regular contributor to Live Science who writes about archaeology and humans' past. He has also written for The Independent (UK), The Canadian Press (CP) and The Associated Press (AP), among others. Owen has a bachelor of arts degree from the University of Toronto and a journalism degree from Ryerson University.
paras.zh: 欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus) 是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，撰写有关考古学和人类过去的文章。他还为《独立报》（英国）、加拿大通讯社 (CP) 和美联社 (AP) 等撰稿。欧文拥有多伦多大学文学学士学位和瑞尔森大学新闻学学位。

paras.zh: 评论前您必须确认您的公开显示名称

paras.en: Please logout and then login again, you will then be prompted to enter your display name.
paras.zh: 请注销并重新登录，系统将提示您输入您的显示名称。

articles.title: 'Swamp-like colors' on the moon: NASA report reveals strange sights from Artemis II mission
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: What it is: A view of the moon from the Artemis II crew
paras.zh: 它是什么：阿耳忒弥斯二号船员看到的月球景观

paras.en: Where it is: Aristarchus Plateau, on the moon's near side
paras.zh: 地点：阿里斯塔克斯高原，位于月球近侧

paras.en: What color is the moon? Ask an Earthling, and you'll get a predictably monochromatic answer: white or gray.
paras.zh: 月亮是什么颜色的？问一个地球人，你会得到一个不出所料的单色答案：白色或灰色。

paras.en: But ask the four crewmembers of NASA's Artemis II mission — who spent nearly seven hours circling the moon from just 4,000 miles (6,400 kilometers) from the lunar surface this April — and you'll wonder if they're talking about the same dusty satellite we can see from Earth.
paras.zh: 但如果问一问美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号任务的四名宇航员——今年四月他们花了近七个小时在距离月球表面仅 4,000 英里（6,400 公里）的地方绕月飞行——你会想知道他们所说的是否是我们从地球上看到的同一颗布满尘埃的卫星。

paras.en: Yellow, brown, green, blue and tan features fan across vast volcanic plains and lurk at the edges of ominous craters, according to the crew's in-the-moment observations, which were shared this week in NASA's Artemis II Preliminary Lunar Science Report. The 130-page document catalogs everything crewmembers Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen saw during their historic close flyby of the moon on April 6, drawing from 814 gigabytes of photo, video and audio recordings taken from the Orion crew capsule.
paras.zh: 根据宇航员的即时观察结果，黄色、棕色、绿色、蓝色和棕褐色的特征遍布广阔的火山平原，并潜伏在不祥的陨石坑边缘，这些观察结果本周在美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号初步月球科学报告中分享。这份长达 130 页的文件记录了宇航员 Reid Wiseman、Victor Glover、Christina Koch 和 Jeremy Hansen 在 4 月 6 日历史性的近距离飞越月球过程中所看到的一切，取材于从猎户座乘员舱拍摄的 814 GB 的照片、视频和音频记录。

paras.en: This rainbow of lunar color represents distinct geological features that could inform future missions on where to land and where to explore as the world's space agencies race to set up a permanent presence on the moon.
paras.zh: 月球的彩虹色代表了独特的地质特征，随着世界航天机构竞相在月球上建立永久存在，这些特征可以为未来的任务提供有关在哪里着陆和探索哪里的信息。

paras.en: One spot that particularly enthralled the astronauts (and is featured in the image above) is the Aristarchus Plateau — a broad, elevated region on the northwestern edge of the moon's nearside. The region hosts one of the moon's densest collections of ancient volcanic features, including swaths of dark lava deposits and colorful volcanic glasses.
paras.zh: 特别让宇航员着迷的一个地方（如上图所示）是阿里斯塔克斯高原——月球近侧西北边缘的一个广阔的高地区域。该地区拥有月球最密集的古代火山特征之一，包括大片的深色熔岩沉积物和色彩缤纷的火山玻璃。

paras.en: Koch, mission specialist for Artemis II, was shocked to see distinct yellow shades in the region; she likened the plateau to "a yellow snow-capped mountain," with sunlight-reflecting craters providing the bright "snow." She went on to call the region "a jaundiced cheek of the Moon."
paras.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯二号任务专家科赫惊讶地发现该地区有明显的黄色阴影。她将高原比作“一座黄色的雪山”，反射阳光的火山口提供了明亮的“雪”。她接着称该地区为“月亮的黄疸脸颊”。

paras.en: "There are so many colors now," Glover, Artemis II's pilot, added while photographing the area. "There's also a green. I see brown, especially Aristarchus and north toward the north pole. … It kind of flows down from the north in brown streaks."
paras.zh: “现在有很多颜色，”阿耳忒弥斯二号的飞行员格洛弗在拍摄该地区时补充道。 “还有一种绿色。我看到棕色，尤其是阿里斯塔克斯和北向北极。......它有点像棕色条纹从北方流下来。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: According to the report authors, these colorful hues "could be associated with orange (titanium-rich) and green (magnesium-rich) glass beads respectively," similar to volcanic glass beads collected by the Apollo 15 and 17 missions on separate parts of the moon.
paras.zh: 据报告作者称，这些多彩的色调“可能分别与橙色（富含钛）和绿色（富含镁）玻璃珠有关”，类似于阿波罗 15 号和 17 号任务在月球不同部分收集的火山玻璃珠。

paras.en: Another colorful patch of the lunar surface that caught the crew's attention was Orientale Basin — a huge, young and multiringed impact crater that's about three times as wide as Massachusetts, according to NASA. Straddling the moon's near and far sides, this massive bull's-eye is rarely visible from Earth, but it dominated the crewmembers' field of view as they orbited around the side of the moon.
paras.zh: 月球表面另一个引起宇航员注意的彩色区域是东方盆地——据美国宇航局称，这是一个巨大的、年轻的、多环的撞击坑，宽度约为马萨诸塞州的三倍。这个巨大的牛眼横跨月球的近侧和远侧，从地球上很少可见，但当机组人员绕月侧运行时，它占据了他们的视野。

paras.en: "It has just created chaos across that entire area," Wiseman, commander for the mission, said at the time.
paras.zh: “它刚刚在整个地区造成了混乱，”该任务指挥官怀斯曼当时表示。

paras.en: When flying over this sprawling basin, the crew noted gray, brown, tan and green below. The largest, outermost ring in the basin contained "almost swamp-like colors," Koch reported, while Glover spotted what looked like "dusted peaks" and "white on the very edges of [the mountains], the spines, the ridgebacks." Chains of craters parading away from the impact site looked "like bubbles rising from a team of scuba divers below," Koch added.
paras.zh: 当飞越这个广阔的盆地时，机组人员注意到下面有灰色、棕色、棕褐色和绿色。科赫报告说，盆地中最大、最外层的环含有“几乎沼泽般的颜色”，而格洛弗则发现了看起来像“灰尘山峰”的东西，“[山脉]、脊椎、脊背的边缘呈白色”。科赫补充说，从撞击地点延伸开的一系列陨石坑看起来“就像下面一群水肺潜水员升起的气泡”。

paras.en: While these may sound like off-the-cuff observations, the Artemis II crew spent more than two years training to study and describe the moon's geology. Their regimen included visiting craters on Earth, taking lessons individually and in classrooms, conducting simulated flybys and, according to the report, bringing "self-selected reference materials" into the Orion capsule to read on the way to the moon.
paras.zh: 虽然这些听起来像是即兴观察，但阿耳忒弥斯二号船员花了两年多的时间进行训练来研究和描述月球的地质情况。他们的日程安排包括参观地球上的陨石坑、单独和在教室上课、进行模拟飞越，以及根据报告，将“自行选择的参考材料”带入猎户座太空舱，以便在前往月球的途中阅读。

paras.en: - Earth-based telescope shares image of Artemis II capsule near the moon — one of the farthest photos of humans ever taken
paras.zh: - 地球望远镜分享了月球附近阿耳忒弥斯二号太空舱的图像——这是人类拍摄的最远的照片之一

paras.en: - Artemis II crew captures rare double auroras on the dark side of Earth as they zoom toward the moon — Space photo of the week
paras.zh: - 阿耳忒弥斯二号机组人员在飞向月球时捕捉到地球暗面罕见的双极光 — 本周太空照片

paras.en: - NASA just released 12,000 more Artemis II photos — here are a dozen of our favorites
paras.zh: - NASA 刚刚发布了另外 12,000 张 Artemis II 照片——以下是我们最喜欢的十几张

paras.en: Thanks to this training, the crew's observations provided a wealth of scientific information that no autonomous camera or orbiter could, the report said.
paras.zh: 报告称，由于这次训练，机组人员的观察提供了自主相机或轨道飞行器无法提供的大量科学信息。

paras.en: "The Artemis II mission demonstrated the exceptional value of human observation and cognition as scientific assets in planetary exploration," the report authors concluded. "Unlike cameras, which capture isolated moments and often narrow subsets of a scene, human observers continuously interpret their surroundings, integrating realtime visual perception with contextual understanding."
paras.zh: 报告作者总结道：“阿耳忒弥斯二号任务证明了人类观察和认知作为行星探索中的科学资产的非凡价值。” “与捕捉孤立时刻和场景的狭窄子集的相机不同，人类观察者不断地解释他们的周围环境，将实时视觉感知与上下文理解相结合。”

paras.en: Or, to put that in Glover's more relatable words to mission control, "It's quite a wicked view."
paras.zh: 或者，用格洛弗对任务控制中心更贴切的话来说，“这是一个相当邪恶的观点。”

paras.en: How much do you know about the moon? Test your lunar smarts with our moon quiz!
paras.zh: 关于月球你了解多少？通过我们的月球测验测试您的月球智慧！

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: 'News reports tweaked the science to speak to contemporary anxieties': How Neanderthal extinction is a projection of our own, modern fears
articles.author: Peter Sahlins

paras.en: Since the discovery of their remains in the 19th century, Neanderthals have fascinated scientists and the general public alike. Although our understanding of these ancient hominins has been transformed tremendously since then, how we have viewed this other human lineage became deeply entrenched in how we see our own species, with geopolitical events shaping the rhetoric around our ancient relatives.
paras.zh: 自从 19 世纪发现尼安德特人的遗骸以来，他们一直让科学家和公众着迷。尽管从那时起我们对这些古代人族的理解发生了巨大的变化，但我们对其他人类血统的看法却深深地影响了我们对自己物种的看法，地缘政治事件塑造了围绕我们古代亲戚的言论。

paras.en: In his new book, "Neanderthals Among Us: The Making of a Prehistoric Human" (Oneworld Publications, 2026), historian and author Peter Sahlins examines our complicated view of Neanderthals, with this lost human lineage being viewed through the lens of cultural and political ideologies. In this excerpt, he looks at our theories for why they went extinct and the philosophical reckoning we've placed up on them.
paras.zh: 历史学家兼作家彼得·萨林斯在他的新书《我们中间的尼安德特人：史前人类的形成》（Oneworld Publications，2026）中审视了我们对尼安德特人的复杂看法，并通过文化和政治意识形态的视角来审视这一失落的人类血统。在这段摘录中，他审视了我们关于它们灭绝原因的理论以及我们对它们进行的哲学思考。

paras.en: Between violent extermination and peaceful absorption — with cultural exchange — prehistorians and others propose a wide range of theories to account for Neanderthals' extinction. Just as we've projected our concerns and anxieties about race and gender onto Neanderthals, so too do contemporary challenges shape how we imagine their extinction.
paras.zh: 在暴力灭绝和和平吸收之间——通过文化交流——史前学家和其他人提出了各种各样的理论来解释尼安德特人的灭绝。正如我们将对种族和性别的担忧和焦虑投射到尼安德特人身上一样，当代的挑战也影响着我们对他们灭绝的想象。

paras.en: Sometimes it's the newspapers that translate a more neutral science into easily relatable headlines. "Immigrants Halt Neanderthal Era," announced the Glasgow Herald (29 July 2011), claiming that "Europe's earliest residents may have been crowded out by uncontrolled immigration 40,000 years ago." Glossing a highly technical study by Cambridge archaeologist Paul Mellars about the notable increase in population size during the Upper Palaeolithic, the news reports tweaked the science to speak to contemporary anxieties.
paras.zh: 有时，报纸将更中立的科学转化为容易引起共鸣的头条新闻。 《格拉斯哥先驱报》（2011 年 7 月 29 日）宣称，“移民终止了尼安德特时代”，并声称“欧洲最早的居民可能在 4 万年前就被不受控制的移民挤出了。”新闻报道夸大了剑桥考古学家保罗·梅拉斯（Paul Mellars）关于旧石器时代晚期人口规模显着增加的一项技术性很强的研究，并对科学进行了调整，以应对当代的焦虑。

paras.en: But often the science itself is framed or informed by current events. The pathogen thesis gained credence during and after the COVID-19 epidemic. A 2024 study of a 50,000-year-old case of herpes in a sequenced viral genome confirmed widespread speculation that Sapiens-borne pathogens were passed to a Neanderthal population without immunities. Jonathan Kennedy's popular world history "Pathogenesis" (Crown, 2023) argued that Homo sapiens would have been less vulnerable to Neanderthal diseases because they arrived in much larger numbers and had more evolved immune systems from their tropical environment.
paras.zh: 但科学本身往往是由时事构成或提供信息的。病原体论在 COVID-19 流行期间和之后获得了可信度。 2024 年对一例 5 万年前的疱疹病例进行的病毒基因组测序研究证实了人们普遍的猜测，即智人传播的病原体被传染给了没有免疫力的尼安德特人群体。乔纳森·肯尼迪 (Jonathan Kennedy) 的畅销世界历史著作《发病机制》（Crown，2023 年）认为，智人不太容易受到尼安德特人疾病的影响，因为他们抵达时的数量要大得多，而且在热带环境中拥有更进化的免疫系统。

paras.en: Of growing importance over the last twenty years is the thesis that climate change, our own existential challenge of the Anthropocene, was the principal cause of Neanderthal extinction. The idea takes many shapes, beginning with an update of French geologist Georges Cuvier's "catastrophism," where species died off in cataclysmic geological events like earthquakes and volcanic eruptions. Since 2007, researchers point to the Campanian Ignimbrite eruption near Naples (Italy), now dated to around 39,280 BP [before present] (+/- 110 years), fictionalised in the 2013 animated film The Croods.
paras.zh: 在过去的二十年中，越来越重要的一个论点是，气候变化，人类世对我们自身的生存挑战，是尼安德特人灭绝的主要原因。这个想法有多种形式，首先是法国地质学家乔治·居维叶的“灾难论”的更新，即物种在地震和火山爆发等灾难性地质事件中灭绝。自 2007 年以来，研究人员指出那不勒斯（意大利）附近的坎帕尼亚 Ignimbrite 喷发，现在可以追溯到距今约 39,280 年（+/- 110 年），并在 2013 年动画电影《原始人》中虚构。

paras.en: Scientists argue that arriving Homo sapiens were not as affected, perhaps because there were fewer directly touched by the 120 cubic miles [500 cubic kilometers] of magma released, or perhaps because almost everyone died out — but waves of Sapiens arrived later. After all, while most of us share small parts of the Neanderthal genome, the lineages from which we 'directly' descend settled much later in Europe — long after the Ice Age. By far, the greatest portion of our genome comes from our Neolithic, not Palaeolithic, ancestors.
paras.zh: 科学家认为，抵达的智人并未受到如此大的影响，可能是因为直接接触到释放的 120 立方英里（500 立方公里）岩浆的人较少，也可能是因为几乎所有人都灭绝了，但智人的到来较晚。毕竟，虽然我们大多数人都拥有尼安德特人基因组的一小部分，但我们“直接”后代的谱系在欧洲定居的时间要晚得多——在冰河时代很久之后。到目前为止，我们基因组的最大部分来自我们新石器时代的祖先，而不是旧石器时代的祖先。

paras.en: But perhaps "Climate Change Killed the Neanderthals," that is, the extreme climatic fluctuations during the Upper Pleistocene that National Geographic (9 February 2004) announced, following the work of an international team of thirty scientists who laboured for more than seven years on the study. The team identified a general climatic instability during the Middle Palaeolithic marked by a severe cooling event around 41,000 years ago, lasting six centuries — interstadials GIS 13 to 7 of the Greenland ice-core records, to be precise.
paras.zh: 但也许“气候变化杀死了尼安德特人”，即《国家地理》杂志（2004 年 2 月 9 日）宣布的上更新世期间的极端气候波动，这是在一个由 30 名科学家组成的国际小组进行了七年多的研究后进行的。研究小组发现旧石器时代中期存在普遍的气候不稳定，其特点是大约 41,000 年前的一次严重降温事件，持续了六个世纪——准确地说，是格陵兰冰芯记录的间质 GIS 13 到 7。

paras.en: For the last twenty years, scientists have sought to specify the timing, magnitude and ecological impact of a "mini-Ice Age" — the prehistorical obverse of global warming — that reduced vegetation and herbivore food sources, forcing Neanderthals towards warmer climates, including southern Spain. Clive Finlayson, trained as a zoologist, was an early contributor to sophisticated ecological modeling of Neanderthal extinction. At Gibraltar, he argued, "the last Neanderthal" could be found as late as 29,000 years ago, but there's competition for the title: elsewhere in the southern climatic refugium, Zafarraya (Granada) yielded a skeleton dated to 30,000 BP, but there are skeptics, while other candidates come from the Mezmaiskaya Caves in the Caucasus.
paras.zh: 在过去的二十年里，科学家们一直试图确定“小冰河时代”（全球变暖的史前反面）的时间、规模和生态影响，它减少了植被和食草动物的食物来源，迫使尼安德特人走向更温暖的气候，包括西班牙南部。克莱夫·芬利森 (Clive Finlayson) 接受过动物学家培训，是尼安德特人灭绝复杂生态模型的早期贡献者。他认为，在直布罗陀，“最后的尼安德特人”可以追溯到 29,000 年前，但这个称号存在竞争：在南部气候保护区的其他地方，扎法拉亚（格拉纳达）出土了一具距今 30,000 年的骨架，但有人持怀疑态度，而其他候选者来自高加索的梅兹麦斯卡亚洞穴。

paras.en: The trope, we've seen, is a frequent one in Neanderthal fiction, including Claire Cameron's "The Last Neanderthal" (Little Brown & Co., 2017), a moving, feminist revision of "Neanderthal Woman." It's also been widely used in popular nonfiction, including in Ludovic Slimak's 2023 account of twenty-five years of research in the Mandrin Cave .
paras.zh: 我们已经看到，这一比喻在尼安德特人小说中很常见，包括克莱尔·卡梅伦的《最后的尼安德特人》（Little Brown & Co.，2017），这是对《尼安德特女人》的感人的女权主义修订版。它也被广泛用于流行的非小说类作品中，包括 Ludovic Slimak 在 2023 年对 Mandrin Cave 二十五年研究的描述中。

paras.en: Some of the science blaming climate change for the demise of Neanderthals marks a retreat from the recent archaeological rehabilitation of Neanderthals as a type of human equal to Homo sapiens, as these theories need to account for Sapiens' survival in the same severe conditions. Some experts rewrite basic wisdom, arguing that Neanderthals were not a cold-adapted species, since their origins lay during a warm interglacial stage (MIS 11); or that they lacked the technologies for making complex (and warm) clothing; or perhaps that their preexisting biological cold adaptations delayed the development of such technologies — a story about their technological inertia and deep conservatism.
paras.zh: 一些科学将尼安德特人的灭亡归咎于气候变化，这标志着最近考古学将尼安德特人重新定位为与智人平等的人类类型的倒退，因为这些理论需要解释智人在同样严峻的条件下的生存。一些专家重写了基本观点，认为尼安德特人不是一个适应寒冷的物种，因为他们的起源是在温暖的间冰期（MIS 11）；或者他们缺乏制作复杂（且保暖）服装的技术；或者也许是它们先前存在的生物寒冷适应延迟了此类技术的发展——这是一个关于它们的技术惰性和根深蒂固的保守主义的故事。

paras.en: That Neanderthals died out because of their conservatism, while humans alone mastered innovation, and with it, conquered the world, is the principal claim in Philip Lieberman's "The Unpredictable Species: What Makes Humans Unique" (Princeton University Press, 2013), and it's a widely shared belief.
paras.zh: 菲利普·利伯曼（Philip Lieberman）的《不可预测的物种：人类的独特之处》（普林斯顿大学出版社，2013）中的主要主张是，尼安德特人因其保守主义而灭绝，而人类独自掌握了创新，并以此征服了世界，这是一个广泛认同的信念。

paras.en: - Adversity shaped our evolution as a species. People raised in it may have underrecognized strengths because of it.
paras.zh: - 逆境塑造了我们作为一个物种的进化。在这种环境中长大的人可能因此而没有得到充分认识。

paras.en: - 'More Neanderthal than human': How DNA from our long-lost ancestors affects our health today
paras.zh: - “比人类更像尼安德特人”：我们失散已久的祖先的 DNA 如何影响我们今天的健康

paras.en: - Scientists claimed the world's oldest rock art is 67,800 years old. But is the science behind that estimate flawed?
paras.zh: - 科学家声称世界上最古老的岩画已有 67,800 年的历史。但这一估计背后的科学依据有缺陷吗？

paras.en: Aside from the fact that the high value placed on "innovation" corresponds to the ideological superstructure of contemporary neoliberalism and late-stage capitalism, it seems fitting that Neanderthals died out because, in this view, they were, well, truly Neanderthal. The rhetorical figure returns to haunt the science: Neanderthals were conservative, backward, clinging mindlessly to the past in a changing world.
paras.zh: 除了对“创新”的高度重视与当代新自由主义和晚期资本主义的意识形态上层建筑相对应这一事实之外，尼安德特人的灭绝似乎也很合适，因为从这个角度来看，他们是真正的尼安德特人。这个修辞人物再次困扰着科学：尼安德特人保守、落后，在不断变化的世界中盲目地坚持过去。

paras.en: Neanderthal conservatism — not rhetorically, but as an original character trait — has origins in nineteenth-century anthropological judgements about "primitive" peoples. Augustus Pitt Rivers, an early innovator in British archaeology, underscored "the form of a persistent conservatism" of indigenous peoples, and quoted approvingly his colleague E. B. Tylor's "Primitive Culture" (1871): "The savage is firmly, obstinately conservative. No man appeals with more unhesitating confidence to the great precedent-makers of the past; the wisdom of his ancestors can control against the most obvious evidence of his own opinions and actions."
paras.zh: 尼安德特人的保守主义——不是口头上的，而是作为一种原始的性格特征——起源于十九世纪人类学对“原始”民族的判断。英国考古学的早期创新者奥古斯都·皮特·里弗斯（Augustus Pitt Rivers）强调了土著人民“持久保守主义的形式”，并赞赏地引用了他的同事E·B·泰勒（E. B. Tylor）的《原始文化》（1871）：“野蛮人是坚定的、顽固的保守派。没有人比他更毫不犹豫地向过去伟大的先例创造者求助；他祖先的智慧可以控制最明显的证据他自己的观点和行动。”

paras.en: Just as "savages" were once seen as descendants of Neanderthals, so too is their conservatism a cultural legacy, even when anthropologists, transcending an outdated comparative method, no longer deem them ancestral, or even savage.
paras.zh: 正如“野蛮人”曾经被视为尼安德特人的后裔一样，他们的保守主义也被视为一种文化遗产，即使人类学家超越了过时的比较方法，不再认为他们是祖先，甚至不再是野蛮人。

paras.en: NEANDERTHALS AMONG US: The Making of a Prehistoric Human by Peter Sahlins is published by Oneworld, hardback £28.
paras.zh: 彼得·萨林斯 (Peter Sahlins) 的《我们身边的尼安德特人：史前人类的形成》由 Oneworld 出版，精装本 28 英镑。

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: In "Neanderthals Among Us," historian Peter Sahlins offers a sweeping interdisciplinary history of an obsession that has made Neanderthals into a distorting mirror of our claims to human uniqueness and our anxieties about human difference.
paras.zh: 在《我们身边的尼安德特人》一书中，历史学家彼得·萨林斯提供了一段全面的跨学科历史，讲述了一种痴迷，这种痴迷使尼安德特人成为一面扭曲的镜子，反映出我们对人类独特性的主张和对人类差异的焦虑。

paras.en: At their discovery, Neanderthals helped invent prehistory itself, saturated with racial science; initially cast as ugly, stupid, and hairy, they underwent a long and uneven rehabilitation, with science and popular culture moving at different speeds, and sometimes in opposite directions.
paras.zh: 在他们的发现中，尼安德特人帮助发明了史前史本身，其中充满了种族科学。他们最初被认为丑陋、愚蠢、多毛，但随着科学和流行文化以不同的速度、有时甚至相反的方向发展，他们经历了漫长且不平衡的康复。

paras.en: The reputation of “Neanderthal Man,” our Paleolithic double, has been in constant flux, remaining a site of endless fascination and debate about human uniqueness, race, gender, and the very look of the human.
paras.zh: “尼安德特人”（我们的旧石器时代的替身）的声誉一直在不断变化，仍然是关于人类独特性、种族、性别和人类外貌的无尽迷恋和争论的场所。

paras.en: Peter Sahlins is Professor of History Emeritus at University of California, Berkeley. The son of renowned anthropologist Marshall Sahlins, Peter studied early modern French and European history at Harvard and Princeton, then taught for thirty years at the University of California, Berkeley. He has written six books and scores of articles on a range of topics, most recently "1668: The Year of the Animal in France". He divides his time between Paris and Arcy-sur-Cure in Burgundy, where he also gives guided tours of its famous prehistoric caves.
paras.zh: 彼得·萨林斯 (Peter Sahlins) 是加州大学伯克利分校历史学名誉教授。彼得是著名人类学家马歇尔·萨林斯的儿子，他在哈佛大学和普林斯顿大学研究早期现代法国和欧洲历史，然后在加州大学伯克利分校任教三十年。他撰写了六本书和数十篇涉及一系列主题的文章，最近的一篇是《1668：法国动物年》。他往返于巴黎和勃艮第的屈尔河畔阿尔西之间，并在导游的带领下参观当地著名的史前洞穴。
