paras.en: Oliynyk, from the Maksym Kryvonis battalion, said he initially turned down multiple bids to join Russian forces. He said he only accepted the fourth offer so he could flee.
paras.zh: 来自马克西姆·克里沃尼斯营的奥利尼克表示，他最初拒绝了多次加入俄罗斯军队的提议。他说他只接受了第四个提议，这样他就可以逃跑。

paras.en: He claimed he didn't sign official Defense Ministry paperwork, but a private contract with an individual offering military services. Afterwards, he said, he was brought to a room where he heard lectures and saw videos and photos he was later asked to retell.
paras.zh: 他声称自己没有签署国防部的官方文件，而是与提供军事服务的个人签署了一份私人合同。他说，后来他被带到一个房间，在那里他听到了讲座，看到了视频和照片，后来他被要求复述。

paras.en: Oliynyk said fellow service members in the Maksym Kryvonis battalion consisted both of those who had switched sides of their own volition, and those who had been forced.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克说，马克西姆·克里沃尼斯营的战友中既有自愿改变立场的人，也有被迫改变立场的人。

paras.en: In a video circulating online that appears to be of a trial in Ukraine, he also says former Ukrainian POWs in the unit were followed and guarded by mercenaries of the private Russian military company Redut. In the same video, he also speaks of beatings and torture, and receiving monthly wages in envelopes handed out by a member of Russia's military intelligence.
paras.zh: 在网上流传的一段似乎是在乌克兰进行审判的视频中，他还表示，该部队中的前乌克兰战俘受到俄罗斯私营军事公司 Redut 的雇佣兵的跟踪和看守。在同一视频中，他还谈到了殴打和酷刑，以及接受俄罗斯军事情报人员发放的装在信封里的每月工资。

paras.en: Oliynyk told DW he had been given a phone, but that he was too scared to call anyone in Ukraine because it was under constant surveillance. He denied having fought against Ukrainians, as he fled in March 2025 before his first deployment in the Donetsk province. After running across a field, he said he spent two days hiding from drones in basements and houses before making contact with Ukrainian fighters.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克告诉德国之声，他们给了他一部电话，但他不敢给乌克兰的任何人打电话，因为电话一直处于监视之下。他否认曾与乌克兰人作战，并于 2025 年 3 月在顿涅茨克省首次部署之前逃离。他说，跑过一片田地后，他在地下室和房屋里躲了两天无人机，然后才与乌克兰武装分子取得联系。

paras.en: Now, Oliynyk has been in detention in Ukraine for nearly two years while authorities investigate possible treason. He has yet to be formally charged.
paras.zh: 现在，奥利尼克已在乌克兰被拘留近两年，当局正在调查可能的叛国罪。他尚未受到正式指控。

paras.en: Sergey Nikitin contributed to this article, which originally appeared in Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 谢尔盖·尼基丁 (Sergey Nikitin) 对这篇文章做出了贡献，该文章最初以乌克兰语发表。

articles.title: Surrogacy in Georgia is booming, but at what cost?

paras.en: Three years ago, Olga, 40, and Daniel (both names changed to protect the their identities) from Hamburg decided to employ the services of a surrogate mother. But surrogacy is illegal in Germany, and people whose children are born through surrogacy must pursue the legal recognition of their parenthood in German courts.
paras.zh: 三年前，来自汉堡的 40 岁奥尔加和丹尼尔（为了保护身份而化名）决定聘请代孕母亲。但代孕在德国是非法的，通过代孕出生的孩子必须在德国法院寻求对其父母身份的法律承认。

paras.en: Olga is a German citizen, but was born and raised in Russia. That's why the couple wanted to learn more about the surrogacy market in Russia. But foreign customers have been banned from signing Russian surrogacy contracts since 2022. After Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, many international agencies that liaise between surrogates and intended parents moved to Georgia. So, Olga and Daniel traveled there.
paras.zh: 奥尔加是德国公民，但在俄罗斯出生和长大。这就是为什么这对夫妇想更多地了解俄罗斯代孕市场。但自2022年起，外国客户被禁止签署俄罗斯代孕合同。俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，许多负责代孕者和准父母之间联络的国际机构都搬到了格鲁吉亚。于是，奥尔加和丹尼尔前往那里。

paras.en: Georgia the new destination for surrogate mothers
paras.zh: 乔治亚州成为代孕母亲的新目的地

paras.en: In the past years, Georgia, a mountainous country in the Caucasus region, has become a sort of surrogacy hub, with women traveling from all over the world to work as surrogates. According to Georgia's Public Service Development Agency, over 3,000 surrogate mothers were registered in 2023 across the country. Since 2012, they've given birth to over 5,000 children. And since the beginning of Russia's war in Ukraine, the number of children born to surrogate mothers has skyrocketed. While an estimated 300 surrogate mothers gave birth in 2021, that number leapt to over 1,100 by 2023.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，高加索地区的山区国家格鲁吉亚已经成为一种代孕中心，来自世界各地的女性纷纷前来从事代孕工作。据佐治亚州公共服务发展机构称，2023 年全国有超过 3000 名代孕母亲进行了登记。自2012年以来，他们已经生下了5000多个孩子。自从俄罗斯在乌克兰发动战争以来，代孕母亲所生的孩子数量猛增。 2021 年估计有 300 名代孕母亲分娩，但到 2023 年这一数字将跃升至 1,100 多名。

paras.en: Anastasia, 39, is a surrogate mother from Russia working in Georgia. She has a grown daughter and has already seen through three surrogate pregnancies. Her first was in 2021, which she used to finance a property down payment.
paras.zh: 39 岁的阿纳斯塔西娅是一位来自俄罗斯的代孕母亲，在格鲁吉亚工作。她有一个已经成年的女儿，并且已经经历了三次代孕。她的第一次是在 2021 年，她用这笔钱支付了房产首付。

paras.en: Anastasia says she completed her first two surrogacies in Russia, and her third — for a Japanese couple, brokered through the branch office of a Moscow clinic — in Georgia. Like many surrogate mothers, she went home to Russia after the embryo was implanted, and returned to Georgia when she was 22 weeks pregnant.
paras.zh: 阿纳斯塔西娅说，她在俄罗斯完成了前两次代孕，第三次是在格鲁吉亚，为一对日本夫妇，通过莫斯科一家诊所的分支机构进行了中介。和许多代孕妈妈一样，她在胚胎植入后回到了俄罗斯的家中，并在怀孕22周时返回了格鲁吉亚。

paras.en: "I live in an apartment with another surrogate mother who carried twins to term. This program was the easiest and most practical one for me, but maybe I just got lucky with the right clinic," Anastasia told DW. "Other women who gave birth in Georgia told me they had difficulties. For example, after giving birth, they had to wait a long time before they were paid." She says she's ready to become a surrogate mother again.
paras.zh: “我和另一位代孕妈妈住在一间公寓里，她生下了双胞胎。这个项目对我来说是最简单、最实用的项目，但也许我只是运气好，找到了合适的诊所，”阿纳斯塔西娅告诉德国之声。 “其他在佐治亚州生孩子的妇女告诉我，她们遇到了困难。例如，生完孩子后，她们必须等待很长时间才能拿到工资。”她说她已经准备好再次成为代孕母亲。

paras.en: Estimates vary, but there are about 19 clinics that offer such services across Georgia. And at around €45,000 ($50,400) to €55,000, the average service costs for agencies in Tbilisi or Batumi are only about a third of what agencies in other countries charge.
paras.zh: 虽然估计有所不同，但佐治亚州约有 19 家诊所提供此类服务。第比利斯或巴统的机构平均服务成本约为 45,000 欧元（50,400 美元）至 55,000 欧元，仅为其他国家机构收费的三分之一左右。

paras.en: Several surrogate mothers who gave birth in Georgian clinics told DW that their average salary was between €18,000 and €28,000, with premiums added for birthing twins, for example.
paras.zh: 几位在格鲁吉亚诊所生孩子的代孕妈妈告诉德国之声，她们的平均工资在18,000欧元至28,000欧元之间，例如，生双胞胎还要额外支付保费。

paras.en: Surrogate mothers from Ukraine in demand
paras.zh: 乌克兰代孕妈妈需求旺盛

paras.en: Daniel and Olga told DW that they spent months looking for surrogacy agency in Georgia. "Pretty soon, we had access to a list of women from Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, and Georgia, and were given a detailed description of the process, along with the contact information of lawyers who could help take care of the formalities," they recount. "We were a little concerned that not every agency could give clear answers about the health of some of the surrogate mothers."
paras.zh: 丹尼尔和奥尔加告诉德国之声，他们花了几个月的时间在佐治亚州寻找代孕机构。 “很快，我们就获得了来自俄罗斯、乌克兰、哈萨克斯坦和格鲁吉亚的女性名单，并获得了整个过程的详细描述，以及可以帮助办理手续的律师的联系信息，”他们回忆道。 “我们有点担心，并不是每个机构都能对一些代孕母亲的健康状况给出明确的答案。”

paras.en: Both work in the medical field, and Olga says perhaps some of their questions about the physical health and possible genetic disorders might have been too probing. "We picked a 30-year-old woman from Ukraine who had already been a surrogate mother once for a European couple," she says. The Russian-Georgian agency set up half-hour long Zoom call, "but that hardly seemed enough to make a final decision," Olga adds.
paras.zh: 两人都在医学领域工作，奥尔加说，也许他们对身体健康和可能的遗传疾病的一些问题过于探究。 “我们挑选了一位来自乌克兰的 30 岁女性，她曾为一对欧洲夫妇做过代孕妈妈，”她说。俄罗斯-格鲁吉亚机构安排了半小时的 Zoom 通话，“但这似乎不足以做出最终决定，”奥尔加补充道。

paras.en: In the spring of 2024, the married couple traveled to Georgia's capital to meet Elena (her name has been changed to protect her identity). Following a long discussion, the agency had seemed reluctant when they agreed to bring her to Tbilisi for the meeting. Elena made a good first impression on the couple from Hamburg, showing them pictures of her children and telling them she wanted to use the money she earned to renovate her apartment.
paras.zh: 2024 年春天，这对夫妇前往佐治亚州首府会见埃琳娜（为保护身份，她的名字已更改）。经过长时间的讨论，该机构在同意带她去第比利斯参加会议时似乎不太情愿。埃琳娜给这对来自汉堡的夫妇留下了良好的第一印象，她向他们展示了自己孩子的照片，并告诉他们她想用赚来的钱翻修公寓。

paras.en: "They had initially told us that the surrogate would spent the entire pregnancy living in a rented apartment in Tbilisi," Olga and Daniel tell DW. "But then we found out that Elena was going back home for a few months after the embryo was implanted, back to Ukraine, where there's war."
paras.zh: 奥尔加和丹尼尔告诉德国之声：“他们最初告诉我们，代孕妈妈将在整个怀孕期间住在第比利斯的一间租来的公寓里。” “但后来我们发现，胚胎植入后埃琳娜要回家几个月，回到正在发生战争的乌克兰。”

paras.en: Human rights experts criticize legislation
paras.zh: 人权专家批评立法

paras.en: Georgian laws have a weak spot, the human rights lawyer Nino Bogveradze tells DW: They only regulate the relationship between the surrogate mothers, the intended parents, and the clinics, but they do not consider the roles that agencies play.
paras.zh: 人权律师尼诺·博格韦拉泽 (Nino Bogveradze) 告诉德国之声，格鲁吉亚法律有一个弱点：它们只规范代孕母亲、预期父母和诊所之间的关系，但没有考虑机构所扮演的角色。

paras.en: In Georgia, surrogate mothers have limited rights. Most concerns related to their pregnancy, medical care or payment are not regulated by national law but in contracts between the involved parties. And the state does not set minimum standards for social guarantees or contractual terms.
paras.zh: 在佐治亚州，代孕母亲的权利有限。大多数与怀孕、医疗或付款有关的问题不受国家法律管辖，而是在相关各方之间的合同中规定。国家也没有设定社会保障或合同条款的最低标准。

paras.en: After an embryo has been implanted, surrogate mothers are not allowed to keep the child, leave the program, or end the pregnancy. Several human rights groups, including Human Rights Watch and the International Women's Health Coalition say the established practice in Georgia violates women's rights to reproductive self-determination.
paras.zh: 胚胎植入后，代孕母亲不得保留孩子、退出计划或终止妊娠。包括人权观察组织和国际妇女健康联盟在内的多个人权组织表示，格鲁吉亚的既定做法侵犯了妇女的生殖自决权。

paras.en: "Agencies often speak of their special mission to help people have the child they've been dreaming of," Olga Doletskaya from the University of Leeds tell DW. "But in reality, they're primarily driven by financial interests. And that's why they exploit the precarious situation of surrogate mothers, and pressure intended parents."
paras.zh: 利兹大学的奥尔加·多莱特斯卡娅 (Olga Doletskaya) 告诉德国之声：“各机构经常谈到他们的特殊使命，即帮助人们拥有他们梦想的孩子。” “但实际上，他们主要是受经济利益驱动。这就是为什么他们利用代孕母亲的不稳定处境，并向意向父母施加压力。”

paras.en: Olga and Daniel from Hamburg agree. "We were constantly being made to understand that we should decide as quickly as possible. We had to hurry because apparently several other couples were also interested in our surrogate," Olga says.
paras.zh: 来自汉堡的奥尔加和丹尼尔同意这一点。 “我们不断地被告知，我们应该尽快做出决定。我们必须抓紧时间，因为显然其他几对夫妇也对我们的代孕妈妈感兴趣，”奥尔加说。

paras.en: And the agency kept stressing that it had paid out of pocket for bringing the potential surrogate mother to Georgia, despite that not being contractually agreed. "At some point, a representative noticed my emotional state and asked me how long I wanted to remain childless," Olga recounts. "I felt like I was being manipulated."
paras.zh: 该机构一直强调，尽管合同上没有达成一致，但它还是自掏腰包将潜在的代孕母亲带到佐治亚州。 “在某个时候，一位代表注意到了我的情绪状态，并问我想要不生孩子多久，”奥尔加回忆道。 “我感觉自己被操纵了。”

paras.en: The couple returned to Germany with mixed feelings and decided to shelve the idea of employing a surrogate mother — at least, for now.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇怀着复杂的心情回到德国，并决定搁置雇用代孕母亲的想法——至少现在是这样。

paras.en: Mark Sheider and Asja Lokina contributed to this article, which originally appeared in Russian.
paras.zh: Mark Sheider 和 Asja Lokina 对这篇文章做出了贡献，该文章最初以俄语发表。

articles.title: Trump announces 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine

paras.en: US President Donald Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意停止对彼此能源基础设施的袭击。

paras.en: "Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine," the president wrote on his Truth Social network.
paras.zh: 总统在他的真相社交网络上写道：“俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争实现能源停火，立即生效。”

paras.en: Trump continued: "Both parties have agreed," before urging restraint from both Kyiv and Moscow: "Do not break it!"
paras.zh: 特朗普继续说道：“双方都同意”，然后敦促基辅和莫斯科保持克制：“不要打破它！”

paras.en: Zelenskyy: Energy ceasefire 'news for me'
paras.zh: 泽连斯基：能源停火“对我来说是新闻”

paras.en: There was no immediate confirmation from Moscow, but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told the news site Axios within minutes of Trump's post that the ceasefire was "news for me."
paras.zh: 莫斯科没有立即证实，但乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在特朗普发帖后几分钟内告诉新闻网站 Axios，停火“对我来说是新闻”。

paras.en: "The ceasefire announcement was news for me. But if Russians agree to an energy ceasefire, Ukraine will agree. If President Trump negotiated it with Putin, please tell us when the ceasefire begins; we are ready and we will accept it," he told Axios.
paras.zh: “停火声明对我来说是新闻。但如果俄罗斯同意能源停火，乌克兰也会同意。如果特朗普总统与普京进行谈判，请告诉我们停火何时开始；我们准备好了，我们会接受它，”他告诉 Axios。

paras.en: Earlier Sunday, Zelenskyy repeated his stance that Ukraine would stop hitting Russian oil refineries if the Kremlin curbed its energy attacks.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，泽伦斯基重申了他的立场，即如果克里姆林宫遏制其能源袭击，乌克兰将停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂。

paras.en: Trump and Zelenskyy have argued this week over Ukraine's attacks on Russian diesel facilities, which the US president said have contributed to a global diesel shortage, rather than the Iran war.
paras.zh: 特朗普和泽伦斯基本周就乌克兰袭击俄罗斯柴油设施问题发生争执，美国总统表示，乌克兰袭击俄罗斯柴油设施是导致全球柴油短缺的原因，而不是伊朗战争。

paras.en: Trump needs lower fuel prices before midterms
paras.zh: 特朗普需要在中期选举前降低燃油价格

paras.en: Trump said Friday he had struck a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to buy diesel from Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五表示，他已与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成协议，从俄罗斯购买柴油。

paras.en: The controversial move was an attempt to bring down high fuel prices ahead of the US midterm elections next month.
paras.zh: 这一有争议的举措是为了在下个月美国中期选举之前降低高油价。

paras.en: However, this move undercuts fresh US sanctions Trump signed just weeks ago to further hurt Russian energy revenues funding the war.
paras.zh: 然而，此举削弱了特朗普几周前签署的新制裁措施，该制裁措施进一步损害了俄罗斯为战争提供资金的能源收入。

paras.en: Backing Zelenskyy in the Trump row, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said that she "fully supported" the call for a "ceasefire that protects global food supplies and energy infrastructure in Ukraine and Russia."
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在特朗普之争中支持泽连斯基，表示她“完全支持”“停火以保护乌克兰和俄罗斯的全球粮食供应和能源基础设施”的呼吁。

paras.en: "And my full support for President Zelenskyy as he leads the fight for his people's freedom," she wrote online.
paras.zh: 她在网上写道：“我全力支持泽连斯基总统领导人民争取自由的斗争。”

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron said his country backs a "real energy ceasefire," but lamented that "Russia continues to refuse that."
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙表示，法国支持“真正的能源停火”，但遗憾的是“俄罗斯继续拒绝这样做”。

paras.en: Russia has repeatedly struck Ukraine's power plants and transmission lines around Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa and elsewhere, to lower civilian morale, especially during the winter months.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯多次袭击乌克兰基辅、哈尔科夫、敖德萨等地周边的发电厂和输电线路，以降低民众士气，尤其是在冬季。

paras.en: Recently, Ukraine has stepped up long-range strikes deep inside Russian territory, targeting major oil refineries and other facilities to curb Moscow's refining capacity and fuel supplies.
paras.zh: 近期，乌克兰加强了对俄罗斯领土深处的远程打击，以主要炼油厂和其他设施为目标，以遏制莫斯科的炼油能力和燃料供应。

paras.en: Kyiv on Sunday pressed on its campaign against Russian infrastructure, hitting a data center run by Russian technology giant Yandex.
paras.zh: 基辅周日加大力度打击俄罗斯基础设施，袭击了俄罗斯科技巨头 Yandex 运营的数据中心。

paras.en: It was the third strike on the company’s facilities in four days.
paras.zh: 这是四天内对该公司设施的第三次罢工。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: How the ICC can be saved

paras.en: The sanctions the United States has imposed on the International Criminal Court threaten to degrade its capacity to function, leaving it to die a slow institutional death. Its continued operation as an international organisation, let alone a court of law, would become impossible.
paras.zh: 美国对国际刑事法院实施的制裁有可能削弱其运作能力，使其慢慢走向机构死亡。它作为一个国际组织的继续运作将变得不可能，更不用说法院了。

paras.en: The international community has responded with weak statements of condemnation. States Parties have had more than 20 months since US President Donald Trump came to power to prepare for this move. Efforts should have been made to strengthen the court’s institutional resilience.
paras.zh: 国际社会对此作出了微弱的谴责声明。自美国总统特朗普上台以来，缔约国已有20多个月的时间为这一举措做好准备。应努力增强法院的机构复原力。

paras.en: Still, it is not too late to act. The grace period offered by the US should be used not to engage in fruitless negotiations, but to undertake immediate measures to protect the court.
paras.zh: 不过，现在行动还不算太晚。美国提供的宽限期不应用于进行无果而终的谈判，而应立即采取措施保护法院。

paras.en: The sanctions block the ICC’s assets and other property interests in the US or in the possession or control of US persons. Subject to exemptions and licences issued by the US Department of the Treasury, US individuals and companies are prohibited from doing business with the court.
paras.zh: 制裁封锁了国际刑事法院在美国或美国人拥有或控制的资产和其他财产权益。根据美国财政部颁发的豁免和许可，美国个人和公司不得与法院开展业务。

paras.en: US banks, insurers, IT firms, and other businesses cannot supply the ICC with goods or services or receive payments from it without risking penalties. Many non-US businesses will overcomply and withhold their services out of fear of being sanctioned themselves.
paras.zh: 美国银行、保险公司、IT 公司和其他企业无法向 ICC 提供商品或服务或从其接收付款，否则将面临处罚。许多非美国企业会因为担心自己受到制裁而过度遵守并拒绝提供服务。

paras.en: Cutting the court off from suppliers and service providers could paralyse its investigative and prosecutorial activities across all situations.
paras.zh: 切断法院与供应商和服务提供商的联系可能会使其在所有情况下的调查和起诉活动陷入瘫痪。

paras.en: The sanctions, however, come with a “grace period” of 180 days to allow for maintaining or winding down the ICC operations. This covers States Parties’ payments to the ICC, salary payments, health insurance, and medical services for its employees or contractors, and payments for rent, utilities, and routine services. Separate licences permit the provision of certain telecommunication, cloud and software services, the processing of ICC pension payments, and services needed for the benefit of specified ICC detainees.
paras.zh: 不过，制裁附带 180 天的“宽限期”，以允许维持或结束 ICC 的业务。这包括缔约国向国际刑事法院支付的款项、其雇员或承包商的工资、健康保险和医疗服务费用，以及租金、水电费和日常服务费用。单独的许可证允许提供某些电信、云和软件服务、国际刑事法院养老金支付的处理以及为特定国际刑事法院被拘留者的利益所需的服务。

paras.en: Washington has presented the “grace period” as an opportunity for States Parties “to demonstrate meaningful progress on diplomatic and legal resolutions” addressing US objections. Yet, in essence, it is an instrument of overt political coercion designed to force States Parties into compliance.
paras.zh: 华盛顿将“宽限期”视为缔约国“在外交和法律解决方案方面取得有意义进展”的机会，以解决美国的反对意见。然而，从本质上讲，它是一种公开的政治胁迫工具，旨在迫使缔约国遵守规定。

paras.en: After the sanctions announcement, numerous States Parties once again reaffirmed their support for the court and criticised the US. At this point, however, the ICC cannot be defended with statements alone.
paras.zh: 制裁宣布后，众多缔约国再次重申对国际法院的支持，并对美国提出批评。然而，在这一点上，仅靠声明无法为国际刑事法院辩护。

paras.en: Performative support rings hollow unless accompanied by a coherent, coordinated strategy for countering US coercion and protecting the ICC’s independence. Declarations will not prevent banks from closing ICC accounts, insurers from withdrawing coverage, tech companies from discontinuing their services, or other businesses from abandoning the court out of fear of US retaliation.
paras.zh: 除非有连贯、协调的战略来对抗美国的胁迫和保护国际刑事法院的独立性，否则表演性的支持听起来是空洞的。声明不会阻止银行关闭国际刑事法院账户、保险公司撤回保险、科技公司停止服务或其他企业因担心美国报复而放弃法院。

paras.en: The European Union has repeatedly affirmed that the ICC is a cornerstone of international justice and that its independence from external pressure must be protected. On October 10, EU High Representative Kaja Kallas reiterated this position, calling attacks or threats against the court, its officials, and those cooperating with it “not acceptable”.
paras.zh: 欧盟一再申明国际刑事法院是国际正义的基石，必须保护其免受外部压力的独立性。 10月10日，欧盟高级代表卡贾·卡拉斯重申了这一立场，称针对法院、其官员以及与其合作者的攻击或威胁“不可接受”。

paras.en: Beyond these statements, however, the EU has remained passive, seemingly out of fear of further antagonising Trump and triggering US tariffs.
paras.zh: 然而，除了这些声明之外，欧盟一直保持被动，似乎是因为担心进一步激怒特朗普并引发美国关税。

paras.en: It is troubling that some States Parties and the EU have welcomed the humiliating “grace period” as creating “scope for dialogue” and “space for diplomacy” with Washington. What meaningful compromise is possible when the US objective, stated in unequivocal terms, is to destroy the court?
paras.zh: 令人不安的是，一些缔约国和欧盟对令人屈辱的“宽限期”表示欢迎，认为这是与华盛顿创造“对话空间”和“外交空间”。当美国明确表示其目标是摧毁法院时，还能有什么有意义的妥协呢？

paras.en: Over the past 20 months, the US has steadily escalated its war on the ICC. For States Parties and the EU to expect a different outcome now is an exercise in self-deception that betrays, in equal measure, obsequious deference to Washington and a lack of self-respect. Appeasing bullies only emboldens them.
paras.zh: 过去20个月来，美国对国际刑事法院的战争不断升级。对于缔约国和欧盟来说，现在期待不同的结果是一种自欺欺人的行为，同样暴露了对华盛顿的谄媚顺从和缺乏自尊。安抚欺凌者只会让他们更加大胆。

paras.en: Dialogue under such coercive conditions opens the door to pressure on the ICC to retreat from its mandate in Palestine in exchange for sanctions relief. Accepting US demands, in particular sacrificing the Palestine investigation to appease the rogue regime in Washington, would destroy the court as an independent and impartial institution.
paras.zh: 在这种胁迫性条件下进行的对话为国际刑事法院施加压力打开了大门，要求国际刑事法院放弃其在巴勒斯坦的职责，以换取解除制裁。接受美国的要求，特别是牺牲巴勒斯坦调查来安抚华盛顿的流氓政权，将摧毁法院作为一个独立和公正的机构。

paras.en: It would reinforce the perception that international justice operates selectively, depending on the political power of those within its purview. Betraying the ICC’s mandate and victims’ pursuit of justice would mean an intolerable loss of legitimacy for the court and discredit the very idea that no one is above the law.
paras.zh: 它将强化这样一种观念，即国际司法有选择性地运作，取决于其职权范围内的政治权力。背叛国际刑​​事法院的使命和受害者对正义的追求将意味着该法院无法容忍地丧失合法性，并使“无人凌驾于法律之上”这一理念变得不可信。

paras.en: Meaningful action is long overdue, but it is not too late for it. States Parties must now make a principled choice and stick to it. They must defend the ICC and secure its ability to function – not pursue fruitless dialogue with a hostile non-party state, beg it for mercy, and offer concessions neither they nor the court can afford.
paras.zh: 早就应该采取有意义的行动，但现在还不算太晚。缔约国现在必须做出原则选择并坚持下去。他们必须捍卫国际刑事法院并确保其发挥作用的能力——而不是与敌对的非政党国家进行徒劳的对话，乞求其宽恕，并提供他们和法院都无法承受的让步。

paras.en: They must publicly commit to increasing the ICC’s budget and provide it with the resources and facilities it needs to withstand political and economic pressure. They must adopt effective legal measures, blocking legislation and safeguards against financial de-risking, to shield the court, its officials, and those cooperating with it from the extraterritorial effects of US sanctions. These protections must extend equally to Palestinian civil society organisations, targeted for supporting the court’s investigations.
paras.zh: 他们必须公开承诺增加国际刑事法院的预算，并为其提供承受政治和经济压力所需的资源和设施。他们必须采取有效的法律措施，阻止立法和防范金融去风险的保障措施，以保护法院、其官员以及与其合作的人员免受美国制裁的域外影响。这些保护必须同样延伸到旨在支持法院调查的巴勒斯坦民间社会组织。

paras.en: The EU should immediately activate its Blocking Statute to prohibit EU operators from complying with US sanctions. Although no silver bullet, this measure would go some way towards shielding the ICC. A growing number of Member States and MEPs have called on the European Commission to extend this legislation to the anti-ICC sanctions and ensure that protections would be in place in the event of court-wide sanctions. This step can no longer be postponed.
paras.zh: 欧盟应立即启动其封锁法规，禁止欧盟运营商遵守美国的制裁。尽管没有灵丹妙药，但这一措施将在一定程度上保护国际刑事法院。越来越多的成员国和欧洲议会议员呼吁欧盟委员会将这项立法扩展到反国际刑事法院制裁，并确保在发生全法院制裁时提供保护。这一步不能再拖延了。

paras.en: In parallel, States Parties must urgently finalise arrangements for alternative banking, payment and digital infrastructure to ensure the court’s uninterrupted access to essential services. The measures must form a coordinated, structural response, going beyond declarations of solidarity and temporary fixes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，缔约国必须紧急敲定替代银行、支付和数字基础设施的安排，以确保法院不间断地获得基本服务。这些措施必须形成协调一致的结构性应对措施，而不仅仅是宣布团结和临时解决办法。

paras.en: If the international community stands by as the US dismantles the ICC, the ability of any international court — or even any national court — to operate without fear or favour will become impossible.
paras.zh: 如果国际社会在美国解散国际刑事法院时袖手旁观，任何国际法院——甚至任何国家法院——都将不可能毫无恐惧或偏袒地运作。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the authors’ own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: At least five people missing as flash floods in Nepal sweep away houses

paras.en: Flash floods have hit central Nepal, sweeping away houses and leaving at least five people missing, according to officials, weeks after devastating flooding in the country that killed hundreds.
paras.zh: 据官员称，尼泊尔中部发生山洪，冲毁房屋，造成至少五人失踪，几周前尼泊尔发生毁灭性洪水，造成数百人死亡。

paras.en: A landslide in Chumnubri village in Gorkha district, about 100km (62 miles) west of Kathmandu, blocked the Budhi Gandaki River on Saturday, leading to downstream flooding, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局表示，加德满都以西约 100 公里（62 英里）处的廓尔喀区 Chumnubri 村发生山体滑坡，周六堵塞了布迪甘达基河，导致下游洪水泛滥。

paras.en: Two women and three men were unaccounted for, and there are no reports of casualties, said the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA).
paras.zh: 国家减少灾害风险和管理局（NDRRMA）表示，两名女性和三名男性下落不明，也没有伤亡报告。

paras.en: According to the agency, at least 82 people, including nine foreigners, have been rescued from the affected areas.
paras.zh: 据该机构称，至少82人已从受灾地区获救，其中包括9名外国人。

paras.en: The flood swept away about a dozen houses and two suspension bridges and damaged a hydroelectric project camp, carrying some of the construction equipment away, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局表示，洪水冲毁了大约十几栋房屋和两座吊桥，并损坏了一个水电项目营地，带走了一些建筑设备。

paras.en: A muddy torrent washed away a highway bridge connecting Gorkha with the neighbouring Dhading district, said NDRRMA Chief Executive Dharam Raj Uprety.
paras.zh: NDRRMA 首席执行官达拉姆·拉吉·乌普雷蒂 (Dharam Raj Uprety) 表示，泥泞的洪流冲毁了连接廓尔喀和邻近达丁地区的一座公路桥。

paras.en: The Budhi Gandaki is a tributary of the Trishuli River, downstream from another tributary where a glacier collapse caused a catastrophic flood in August that killed 1,457 people, with thousands still missing.
paras.zh: 布迪甘达基河是特里苏利河的一条支流，位于另一条支流的下游，8 月份，该支流的冰川崩塌引发了灾难性洪水，造成 1,457 人死亡，数千人失踪。

paras.en: “We have asked villagers living along the riverbanks downstream to evacuate and remain safe,” said Dharmendra Kumar Mishra, Gorkha district’s most senior bureaucrat.
paras.zh: 廓尔喀地区最高官员达门德拉·库马尔·米什拉 (Dharmendra Kumar Mishra) 表示：“我们已要求居住在下游河岸的村民撤离并保证安全。”

paras.en: National disaster authorities alerted people living along the river in the Gorkha, Tanahun, Chitwan, East Nawalparasi and West Nawalparasi districts about the flood.
paras.zh: 国家灾害管理部门向廓尔喀、塔纳洪、奇旺、东纳瓦尔帕拉西和西纳瓦尔帕拉西地区沿河居住的人们发出洪水警报。

paras.en: “Please help ensure that people in at-risk areas are moved to safe locations in time and assist search and rescue operations as needed,” the NDRRMA said in a social media post.
paras.zh: NDRRMA 在社交媒体帖子中表示：“请帮助确保高危地区的人员及时转移到安全地点，并根据需要协助搜救行动。”

paras.en: Officials said army and police rescue personnel had reached the area and were also monitoring the situation from a helicopter.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，军队和警察救援人员已抵达该地区，并通过直升机监视局势。

paras.en: “The flood looked similar… It was very scary, and it still feels like a nightmare for us,” said local official Laxmi Gurung of Chumnubri rural municipality.
paras.zh: “洪水看起来很相似……非常可怕，对我们来说仍然感觉像是一场噩梦，”春努布里乡村市的当地官员拉克西米·古隆 (Laxmi Gurung) 说。

paras.en: “Our house is gone, we have no electricity… but there have been no casualties.”
paras.zh: “我们的房子没了，没有电……但没有人员伤亡。”

paras.en: Heavy rainfall in late September also triggered floods and landslides, killing at least 21 people, according to the disaster agency.
paras.zh: 据灾害机构称，9月下旬的强降雨还引发了洪水和山体滑坡，造成至少21人死亡。

articles.title: Turkiye highway crash kills 11, injures 27 after tour bus hits truck

paras.en: At least 11 people have been killed and 27 injured after a tour bus and a tow truck collided in western Turkiye.
paras.zh: 土耳其西部一辆旅游巴士与一辆拖车相撞，造成至少 11 人死亡、27 人受伤。

paras.en: The crash happened near toll booths at Akhisar on the Gebze-Orhangazi-Izmir highway in Manisa province on Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 周日上午，事故发生在马尼萨省盖布泽-奥尔汉加齐-伊兹密尔高速公路阿克希萨尔收费站附近。

paras.en: According to a statement from the Manisa governor’s office, authorities received a report of the collision just after 11am local time.
paras.zh: 马尼萨省长办公室发表声明称，当局于当地时间上午 11 点刚过就收到了事故报告。

paras.en: The wounded were taken to local hospitals, including the bus driver, who was detained by police following his discharge.
paras.zh: 伤者被送往当地医院，其中包括巴士司机，他出院后被警方拘留。

paras.en: Images from the scene showed blue body bags lined along the roadside next to the overturned bus, which sustained heavy structural damage to its rear section.
paras.zh: 现场图像显示，翻倒巴士旁边的路边排列着蓝色的尸袋，巴士后部结构严重受损。

paras.en: The tow truck, which appeared to be carrying wooden planks, had also overturned.
paras.zh: 似乎运载木板的拖车也翻了。

paras.en: Writing on social media platform X, Turkiye’s Interior Minister, Mustafa Ciftci, referred to the victims as citizens, though authorities have not yet confirmed whether any foreign nationals were among the casualties.
paras.zh: 土耳其内政部长 Mustafa Ciftci 在社交媒体平台 X 上撰文称受害者为公民，但当局尚未确认伤亡者中是否有外国人。

paras.en: The governor of Manisa, Vahdettin Ozkan, visited the crash site as emergency teams cleared the wreckage.
paras.zh: 马尼萨省长瓦德丁·奥兹坎 (Vahdettin Ozkan) 在紧急救援队清理残骸时视察了坠机现场。

paras.en: “Work at the scene is currently ongoing under the coordination of the Public Prosecutor’s Office,” Ozkan said. “We are experiencing, in a painful way, just how vital it is to strictly adhere to traffic rules.”
paras.zh: 奥兹坎说：“现场工作目前正在检察官办公室的协调下进行。” “我们正在以痛苦的方式体验到严格遵守交通规则是多么重要。”

articles.title: Protests against voter roll revisions rock capital of world's largest democracy
articles.author: Diaa Hadid

paras.en: Protests against voter roll revisions rock capital of world's largest democracy
paras.zh: 反对修改选民名册的抗议活动席卷了世界最大民主国家的首都

paras.en: Parts of the capital city of India, the world's largest democracy, are on lockdown. Protests over sweeping revisions to the voter rolls were met with a massive police crackdown.
paras.zh: 世界上最大的民主国家印度首都的部分地区已被封锁。对彻底修改选民名册的抗议遭到了警方的大规模镇压。

paras.en: Parts of the capital of the world's largest democracy are on lockdown tonight. Demonstrations flared across New Delhi today to protest a controversial revision of the country's electoral rolls. Authorities there have removed some 130 million names from voter lists or demanded more proof from residents to stay on the list. The protests took place despite authorities barricading routes and detaining hundreds of demonstrators.
paras.zh: 世界上最大民主国家的首都部分地区今晚被封锁。今天，新德里各地爆发了示威活动，抗议对该国选民名册进行有争议的修改。当地当局已从选民名单中删除了约 1.3 亿人的名字，或要求居民提供更多证据以留在名单上。尽管当局封锁了道路并拘留了数百名示威者，但抗议活动还是发生了。

paras.en: NPR's Diaa Hadid is there, and she is on the line with us now. Talk about what sparked all of this - millions of names being struck off of voter rolls. How did this happen?
paras.zh: NPR 的迪亚·哈迪德 (Diaa Hadid) 也在场，她正在与我们通话。谈谈是什么引发了这一切——数以百万计的名字被从选民名册上删除。这是怎么发生的？

paras.en: DIAA HADID, BYLINE: Yeah, it happened because last year, India's electoral commission announced it would clean up the country's voter rolls by removing people who died, moved addresses or were absent in general. And the ruling Hindu nationalist party, known as the BJP, also pitched it as an effort to root out illegal migrants who they claimed were on the voter rolls.
paras.zh: 迪亚·哈迪德连线：是的，之所以发生这种情况是因为去年，印度选举委员会宣布将通过清除死亡、搬迁或缺席的人来清理该国的选民名册。执政的印度教民族主义政党印度人民党也表示此举是为了根除他们声称选民名单上的非法移民。

paras.en: And there were about 980 million people on those rolls. This is the world's largest democracy. But through the role cleanup, an estimated 130 million names were struck off or were threatened with being removed. And one lawyer litigating against this special role revision is Kaustubh Chaturvedi.
paras.zh: 这些名单上约有 9.8 亿人。这是世界上最大的民主国家。但通过角色清理，估计有 1.3 亿个名字被删除或受到删除的威胁。 Kaustubh Chaturvedi 是一位针对这一特殊角色修改提起诉讼的律师。

paras.en: KAUSTUBH CHATURVEDI: It's, by such a wide margin, the largest disenfranchisement that's ever occurred.
paras.zh: KAUSTUBH CHATURVEDI：这是有史以来规模最大的剥夺公民权的事件。

paras.en: HADID: That's ever occurred - now, critics accuse the Hindu nationalist government of trying to disenfranchise India's Muslim minority and other groups unlikely to vote for the ruling party.
paras.zh: 哈迪德：这种情况曾经发生过——现在，批评者指责印度教民族主义政府试图剥夺印度穆斯林少数民族和其他不太可能投票给执政党的群体的选举权。

paras.en: ROSE: And in the streets today, Diaa, did authorities try to stop people from protesting at all?
paras.zh: 罗斯：迪亚，今天在街上，当局是否试图阻止人们抗议？

paras.en: HADID: Yeah, they did. Security forces barricaded the area around the city's designated protest site. They cut off the internet in parts of the city. They even rigged up a loudspeaker blaring recorded warnings.
paras.zh: 哈迪德：是的，他们做到了。安全部队封锁了该市指定抗议地点周围的地区。他们切断了该市部分地区的互联网。他们甚至安装了一个扬声器，大声播放录制的警告。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON: Attention, please. Attention, please. Gathering here is not allowed.
paras.zh: 身份不明的人：请注意。请注意。这里不允许聚集。

paras.en: HADID: So protesters, mostly young people, kept popping up in different places, and police kept detaining them. One outlet, the Indian Express, reported that some 6,000 people were detained in all. And they included protest leaders who were picked up from their airplane seats right after their flight landed. One lawyer we talked to, who was hiding in a courthouse, told us that dozens of his colleagues were taken away. The lawyer's name is Deepankur. He requested we don't use his family name for his own safety.
paras.zh: 哈迪德：所以抗议者，主要是年轻人，不断出现在不同的地方，警察不断拘留他们。印度快报 (Indian Express) 等媒体报道称，共有约 6,000 人被拘留。其中包括在航班降落后立即从飞机座位上接走的抗议领导人。我们采访的一位躲在法院的律师告诉我们，他的数十名同事被带走了。这位律师的名字叫迪潘库尔。为了他的安全，他要求我们不要使用他的姓氏。

paras.en: DEEPANKUR: I've never noticed such a large-scale detention of lawyers happening. It's unprecedented.
paras.zh: DEPANKUR：我从未注意到发生过如此大规模的律师拘留事件。这是前所未有的。

paras.en: HADID: Unprecedented - that's a word we heard today a lot to describe the authorities' response. And at one intersection, we saw a rush of riot police blowing on whistles.
paras.zh: 哈迪德：史无前例——这是我们今天经常听到的一个词来形容当局的反应。在一个十字路口，我们看到一群防暴警察吹着口哨冲过来。

paras.en: HADID: They were running towards a young man. It appears he'd shouted a slogan against the government.
paras.zh: 哈迪德：他们正朝一个年轻人跑去。看来他喊出了反对政府的口号。

paras.en: HADID: Where are you taking him? Where are you taking him?
paras.zh: 哈迪德：你要带他去哪里？你要带他去哪里？

paras.en: Police were detaining journalists, as well. Many of those arrested were taken to a sports stadium that police were using as a makeshift holding pen. And by the afternoon, protesters ended up gathering on a bridge. They chanted, Delhi belongs to us all, and other slogans of the Indian left.
paras.zh: 警方还拘留了记者。许多被捕者被带到警察用作临时拘留所的体育场。到了下午，抗议者最终聚集在一座桥上。他们高呼“德里属于我们所有人”以及印度左派的其他口号。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTER: (Chanting in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（用非英语口号）。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTERS: (Chanting in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（用非英语口号）。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTER: (Chanting in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（用非英语口号）。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTERS: (Chanting in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（用非英语口号）。

paras.en: ROSE: Wow. That sounds like a chaotic day. How has the government responded to these claims by critics that this is a mass disenfranchisement?
paras.zh: 罗斯：哇。这听起来像是混乱的一天。政府如何回应批评者关于这是大规模剥夺公民权的说法？

paras.en: HADID: Well, the electoral commission has issued a statement saying everything they've done is legal, and they urged local officials to check if any voters were incorrectly deleted from the rolls. But the prime minister himself hasn't commented on the situation. Protesters accuse him of hiding behind the police, and they're demanding the resignation of the chief election commissioner.
paras.zh: 哈迪德：选举委员会已发表声明，称他们所做的一切都是合法的，并敦促地方官员检查是否有选民被错误地从名册中删除。但总理本人尚未对此事发表评论。抗议者指责他躲在警察背后，并要求首席选举专员辞职。

paras.en: ROSE: That is NPR's Diaa Hadid in New Delhi. Diaa, thank you, and stay safe.
paras.zh: 罗斯：这是 NPR 驻新德里的迪亚·哈迪德 (Diaa Hadid)。迪亚，谢谢你，注意安全。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: She was a global star: Teen bikes 700 miles carrying injured dad. Where is she now?
articles.author: Kamala Thiagarajan

paras.en: She was a global star: Teen bikes 700 miles carrying injured dad. Where is she now?
paras.zh: 她是一位全球明星：青少年骑着自行车载着受伤的父亲行驶了 700 英里。她现在在哪里？

paras.en: Fame is a strange beast. It brings applause, attention and promises of a better life. But when the spotlight moves on, those promises are often forgotten. No one knows this better than 22-year-old Jyoti Kumari.
paras.zh: 名誉是一种奇怪的野兽。它带来掌声、关注和对美好生活的承诺。但当聚光灯移开时，这些承诺往往会被遗忘。没有人比 22 岁的乔蒂·库马里 (Jyoti Kumari) 更了解这一点。

paras.en: When she was 15 years old, during the peak of India's COVID shutdown, she shot to international fame for cycling over 700 miles, from northern India to her village in the eastern state of Bihar, with her injured father riding on the back of the hot pink bike she'd bought for $20.
paras.zh: 当她 15 岁时，在印度新冠疫情封锁最严重的时期，她因从印度北部骑车到东部比哈尔邦的村庄超过 700 英里而闻名于世，她受伤的父亲骑在她花 20 美元买的亮粉色自行车后座上。

paras.en: Her dad, Mohan Paswan, drove an autorickshaw for 20 years in Gurugram, a city near Delhi, sending money to his wife and five children in the village of Sirhulli. After he suffered a debilitating road accident in January 2020, Kumari and her mom took the train to Gurugram to care for him.
paras.zh: 她的父亲莫汉·帕斯万 (Mohan Paswan) 在德里附近的古尔格拉姆 (Gurugram) 市开了 20 年机动三轮车，为西尔胡利村 (Sirhulli) 的妻子和五个孩子寄钱。 2020 年 1 月，他遭遇了一场严重的交通事故，库玛丽和她的妈妈乘坐火车前往古尔冈照顾他。

paras.en: Five months later, he still hadn't made a full recovery and his family was running out of money for food and rent. The family decided they would all be better off at home. But at the time, authorities had shut down public transportation for the pandemic lockdown. No one knew how Mohan Paswan could make the journey. That's when Kumari insisted she would bring him back home, riding on a pad attached to the main seat of her bicycle.
paras.zh: 五个月后，他仍未完全康复，家里的食物和房租也已经花光了。一家人决定留在家里会过得更好。但当时，当局因疫情封锁而关闭了公共交通。没有人知道莫汉·帕斯万如何完成这一旅程。就在那时，库玛丽坚持要让他骑在自行车主座上的垫子上带他回家。

paras.en: She cycled for seven consecutive days on a relatively empty stomach at the height of the lockdown to get him to safety. Even though it was a test of sheer endurance, Kumari discovered that she loved cycling — it came naturally to her.
paras.zh: 在封锁最严重的时候，她连续七天空着肚子骑自行车，以把他带到安全的地方。尽管这是对纯粹耐力的考验，但库玛丽发现她喜欢骑自行车——这对她来说是很自然的事情。

paras.en: लॉकडाउन था, सो अपने पिता को साइकिल पर बैठाकर गुरुग्राम से दरभंगा ले गई बेटी...
paras.zh: लॉकडाउन था, सो अपने पिता को साइकिल पर बैठाकर गुरुग्रामसेदरभंगालेगईबेटी...

paras.en: वीडियो: मोहन भारद्वाज और सीटू तिवारी pic.twitter.com/Mc7hkmyB4O
paras.zh: 照片：मोहन भारद्वाज और सीटू तिवारी pic.twitter.com/Mc7hkmyB4O

paras.en: — BBC News Hindi (@BBCHindi) May 19, 2020
paras.zh: — BBC 印地语新闻 (@BBCHindi) 2020 年 5 月 19 日

paras.en: Her epic ride grabbed headlines around the world. NPR's previous reporting noted promises of cash rewards, training for a career as a cyclist, even a movie deal.
paras.zh: 她的史诗般的旅程成为了世界各地的头条新闻。 NPR 之前的报道提到了现金奖励、自行车手职业培训、甚至电影交易的承诺。

paras.en: That was in 2020. "Now — life is hard," Kumari told NPR in a phone call from her home in Bihar.
paras.zh: 那是在 2020 年。“现在——生活很艰难，”库玛丽在比哈尔邦的家中给 NPR 打电话。

paras.en: What happened to all the promises made — for financial support, especially to support cycling as a competitive sport?
paras.zh: 所有做出的承诺——财政支持，特别是支持自行车运动作为一项竞技运动——都发生了什么？

paras.en: "The politicians who made promises, saying they would give money for my sports or education — nobody actually gave anything," she says. "Whatever reward money we collected back then [from individuals who extended help and a government award that came with a cash prize], we put it all into our house, rebuilding it. We had a brick house before, but it only had bare walls. Now we have completed it, added a toilet, a bathroom, and a running water connection. By doing all that, the house has finally become livable," she says.
paras.zh: “政客们做出承诺，说他们会为我的体育或教育提供资金，但实际上没有人提供任何东西，”她说。 “无论我们当时从提供帮助的个人和带有现金奖励的政府奖励中筹集到多少钱，我们都会把它全部投入到我们的房子里，重建它。我们以前有一座砖房，但它只有光秃秃的墙壁。现在我们已经完成了它，增加了厕所、浴室和自来水连接。通过所有这些，房子终于变得适合居住了，”她说。

paras.en: This is no small achievement. An estimated 300,000 people are homeless in the state of Bihar in spite of government programs. For a family living in poverty, having a home can make a huge difference in the fight for survival.
paras.zh: 这是一个不小的成就。尽管政府实施了相关计划，但比哈尔邦估计仍有 30 万人无家可归。对于一个生活贫困的家庭来说，拥有一个家可以对生存的斗争产生巨大的影响。

paras.en: For Kumari's family, making their house livable meant securing something that burst of fame had failed to deliver on — a more stable place from which to build their lives.
paras.zh: 对于库玛丽的家人来说，让他们的房子变得宜居意味着获得一些名气未能带来的东西——一个更稳定的地方来建立他们的生活。

paras.en: Mohan Paswan passed away of a heart attack in May 2021, just months after his daughter brought him home. Kumari says she felt heartbroken. After his passing, financial security has been precarious for the family.
paras.zh: 2021 年 5 月，莫汉·帕斯万 (Mohan Paswan) 因心脏病去世，就在他女儿带他回家几个月后。库玛丽说她感到心碎。他去世后，这个家庭的经济保障一直岌岌可危。

paras.en: At the moment, her mother works as a cook. Her meager income supports Kumari and her three siblings at home (an older sister has married and moved out).
paras.zh: 目前，她的母亲是一名厨师。她微薄的收入养活了库玛丽和她的三个兄弟姐妹（其中一个姐姐已经结婚并搬走了）。

paras.en: "There are days when we go to sleep hungry," she says. "Our brother-in-law used to help us earlier, but now he also has a child, a wife and his father to take care of. He works a small job in the city — how much can he really do? So now he isn't able to help us much."
paras.zh: “有时候我们会饿着肚子睡觉，”她说。 “以前姐夫还帮过我们，现在他还有孩子、妻子和父亲要照顾。他在城里打点小工，能做多少？所以现在他帮不了我们多少。”

paras.en: Still she holds out hope for a better future.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，她仍对更美好的未来抱有希望。

paras.en: "Once my education is fully complete, only then will I be able to do something else. Only then can I prepare for things and look for a job," Kumari says.
paras.zh: “一旦我完全完成学业，我才能做其他事情。只有这样我才能为事情做好准备并寻找工作，”库玛丽说。

paras.en: But she has yet to pass the final exam required to complete Class 12, her final year of secondary school. That's an important credential to apply to university or qualify for certain jobs. It's a stepping stone to a better life, especially for disadvantaged students.
paras.zh: 但她尚未通过完成中学最后一年 12 年级所需的期末考试。这是申请大学或获得某些工作资格的重要凭证。这是通往更美好生活的垫脚石，特别是对于贫困学生而言。

paras.en: Finding time for her studies has been a challenge. Kumari's day begins at 7 a.m. She cooks and cares for her younger siblings after her mother rushes off to work. "I give my brothers breakfast for school and get things ready for my sister. Then, I clean the house, mop the floors, do the dishes, wash clothes by hand, take a bath," she says.
paras.zh: 寻找时间学习对她来说是一个挑战。库玛丽的一天从早上 7 点开始。母亲赶去上班后，她负责做饭并照顾弟弟妹妹。 “我给我的兄弟们准备上学的早餐，并为我的妹妹准备好东西。然后，我打扫房子，拖地，洗碗，手洗衣服，洗澡，”她说。

paras.en: By the time she can turn her attention to her studies, she says it feels as if she has already done a gazillion chores. "There are days when I sleep because of the sheer exhaustion of it all."
paras.zh: 她说，当她能把注意力转向学习时，感觉好像她已经做了无数的家务活。 “有时候我会因为这一切感到精疲力竭而睡觉。”

paras.en: Whatever the future holds, she is determined to stay in their native village rather than seeking employment in the big city, as her father did. His experience showed her how precarious day labor can be — he had no savings and no medical support after his injury.
paras.zh: 无论未来如何，她决心留在家乡，而不是像她父亲那样到大城市找工作。他的经历向她展示了日工是多么不稳定——他没有积蓄，受伤后也没有医疗支持。

paras.en: Kumari is firm about living in their native village. "Whatever I do, I want to do from here," she says.
paras.zh: 库玛丽坚定地想要住在自己的家乡。 “无论我做什么，我都想从这里开始，”她说。

paras.en: She says she still loves cycling as much as ever. She loves the wind in her hair, the feeling of going somewhere, of feeling free. That's what the bike represents to her. But she doesn't have the time to do it as much these days as she's bogged down by household chores and small but persistent everyday worries. She can't just cycle for the joy of it or train as a competitive sport. She only cycles to do errands for the family.
paras.zh: 她说她仍然像以前一样热爱骑自行车。她喜欢风吹过头发的感觉，喜欢去某个地方的感觉，喜欢自由的感觉。这就是自行车对她的意义。但现在她没有那么多时间做这件事，因为她被家务活和日常琐事和小而持久的担忧所困扰。她不能只是为了享受骑自行车的乐趣或将其作为一项竞技运动进行训练。她只骑自行车为家人办事。

paras.en: With her own progress on hold, the family has quietly set their hopes on her younger sister who will take her 12th grade exams in mid-2027. If she manages to pass and get into a good college, their prospects will improve once she graduates and starts working.
paras.zh: 由于她自己的进度被搁置，家人悄悄地将希望寄托在她将于 2027 年年中参加 12 年级考试的妹妹身上。如果她能够通过考试并进入一所好大学，那么一旦她毕业并开始工作，他们的前景就会改善。

paras.en: But Kumari hasn't given up. "When you're poor, fame doesn't help. Only education can help you out of your difficulties. Otherwise, life becomes a never-ending obstacle course," Kumari says.
paras.zh: 但库玛丽并没有放弃。 “当你贫穷时，名声并没有什么帮助。只有教育才能帮助你摆脱困境。否则，生活就会变成永无止境的障碍，”库玛丽说。

paras.en: Kamala Thiagarajan is a freelance journalist based in Madurai, South India. She reports on global health, science and development and has been published in The New York Times, The British Medical Journal, the BBC, The Guardian and other outlets. You can find her on X: @Kamal_t.
paras.zh: 卡玛拉·蒂亚加拉詹 (Kamala Thiagarajan) 是印度南部马杜赖的一名自由记者。她报道全球健康、科学和发展，并在《纽约时报》、《英国医学杂志》、BBC、《卫报》和其他媒体上发表文章。您可以在 X 上找到她：@Kamal_t。

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
articles.author: Ava Pukatch

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世本周将接受肺部手术

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV announced Sunday that he would have surgery this week to remove a "localized nodule" in his lung.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日宣布，他将于本周接受手术，切除肺部的“局部结节”。

paras.en: Leo said the nodule was found at a "very early stage" with doctors recommending surgery.
paras.zh: 利奥说，这个结节是在“非常早期”发现的，医生建议进行手术。

paras.en: "Following their advice, I have therefore decided to undergo an operation to remove it," Leo said during his weekly Sunday noon blessing in St. Peter's Square.
paras.zh: “因此，根据他们的建议，我决定接受手术将其移除，”利奥在圣彼得广场每周日中午的祝福中说道。

paras.en: The surgery is due to occur at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, which is the primary location for popes to receive medical attention.
paras.zh: 手术将在罗马的杰梅利医院进行，该医院是教皇接受医疗护理的主要地点。

paras.en: Leo has had no known previous health problems.
paras.zh: Leo 以前没有已知的健康问题。

paras.en: "I thank you for your spiritual closeness and entrust myself to your prayers," Leo said to the crowds on Sunday.
paras.zh: 利奥周日对人群说：“我感谢你们的精神上的亲密，并将自己托付给你们的祈祷。”

paras.en: According to the American Cancer Society, a lung nodule is a small abnormal area, less than or equal to 3 cm, found during a CT scan of the chest or abdomen. These tests are often conducted as routine screenings for "trauma, heart disease, non-cancer related lung disease, or lung infection."
paras.zh: 根据美国癌症协会的说法，肺结节是在胸部或腹部 CT 扫描过程中发现的小于或等于 3 厘米的小异常区域。这些测试通常作为“创伤、心脏病、非癌症相关肺部疾病或肺部感染”的常规筛查进行。

paras.en: Most lung nodules are benign. The American Cancer Society said these nodules are "more often the result of old infections, scar tissue, or other causes" and that tests are needed to confirm it is not cancerous. He later posted the message about his surgery on social media.
paras.zh: 大多数肺结节是良性的。美国癌症协会表示，这些结节“更常见的是旧有感染、疤痕组织或其他原因造成的”，需要进行测试以确认其不是癌性的。随后，他在社交媒体上发布了有关手术的消息。

paras.en: The Vatican did not disclose whether the nodule was cancerous.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈没有透露该结节是否癌变。

paras.en: Vatican spokesperson Matteo Bruni said in a statement that "the operation is scheduled for the first days of this week and the estimated post-operative recovery time will be about one week."
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈发言人马泰奥·布鲁尼在一份声明中表示，“手术计划于本周头几天进行，预计术后恢复时间约为一周。”

paras.en: Leo's next major international trip is scheduled for early November to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru. It's unclear if the surgery would affect his travels.
paras.zh: Leo 的下一次重要国际旅行定于 11 月初前往乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁。目前尚不清楚手术是否会影响他的旅行。

paras.en: During his papacy, Leo has been outspoken about peace throughout the world. He spent part of his Sunday address renewing calls for peace in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 在担任教皇期间，利奥一直对全世界的和平直言不讳。他在周日的讲话中重申了对乌克兰和平的呼吁。

paras.en: "I make a heartfelt appeal to the parties to the conflict to allow the safe transport of grain across the Black Sea," Leo said. "The daily bread of millions of people cannot be held hostage by war."
paras.zh: 利奥说：“我衷心呼吁冲突各方允许安全穿越黑海运输粮食。” “数百万人的日常面包不能被战争劫持。”

paras.en: On Saturday, the Pope also called for the death penalty to be abolished, saying on X that it is "inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person."
paras.zh: 周六，教皇还呼吁废除死刑，并在 X 上表示死刑“不可接受，因为这是对人的不可侵犯和尊严的攻击”。

paras.en: "The common good can be safeguarded and the requirements of justice can be met without recourse to capital punishment: effective systems of detention have been developed that protect citizens while at the same time do not completely deprive those who are guilty of the possibility of redemption," Leo said.
paras.zh: 利奥说：“公共利益可以得到保障，正义的要求也可以在不诉诸死刑的情况下得到满足：有效的拘留制度已经发展起来，可以保护公民，同时不完全剥夺那些有罪的人获得救赎的可能性。”
