paras.en: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency had expanded its guidance on Saudi airspace, noting the Houthis' ability to strike targets deeper inside the kingdom, including Riyadh, and a "greater focus on aviation infrastructure."
paras.zh: 欧盟航空安全局扩大了对沙特领空的指导，指出胡塞武装有能力打击沙特境内更深处的目标，包括利雅得，并且“更加关注航空基础设施”。

paras.en: The missile and drone attacks and interception efforts "create an increased risk of misidentification of civil aircraft," it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，导弹和无人机的攻击和拦截工作“增加了误认民用飞机的风险”。

paras.en: Two regional officials said Houthi attacks on the Riyadh airport on Thursday damaged three planes. The officials spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't authorized to brief the media. The Saudi national carrier said one of its aircraft was damaged while it was on the ground, with no passengers on board.
paras.zh: 两名地区官员表示，胡塞武装周四对利雅得机场发动袭击，造成三架飞机受损。这些官员要求匿名，因为他们无权向媒体通报情况。沙特国家航空公司表示，其一架飞机在地面时受损，机上没有乘客。

articles.title: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
articles.author: Henry Larson

paras.en: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
paras.zh: 贝叶挂毯的伦敦之旅激发了爱好者们重演黑斯廷斯战役的热情

paras.en: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.
paras.zh: 近千年前发生的黑斯廷斯战役的重演吸引了英国的大批爱好者。

paras.en: The Battle of Hastings is as famous for the Brits as the American Revolution is for us. The artwork that depicts that battle of almost a millennium ago this week, the Bayeux Tapestry, has been displayed in the British Museum for the first time. And this weekend, the reenactment of that gruesome conquest is drawing big crowds. NPR's Henry Larson reports.
paras.zh: 黑斯廷斯战役对于英国人来说就像美国革命对于我们来说一样著名。本周，描绘近千年前那场战斗的艺术品《贝叶挂毯》首次在大英博物馆展出。这个周末，那场可怕的征服的重演吸引了大批观众。 NPR 的亨利·拉尔森报道。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED ANNOUNCER: Look at the speed of these warriors. Give...
paras.zh: 身份不明的播音员：看看这些战士的速度。给...

paras.en: HENRY LARSON, BYLINE: Archers, armored infantry and mounted knights charge each other in gallant fashion, much like they did in the 11th century near England's southern coast.
paras.zh: 亨利·拉尔森连线：弓箭手、装甲步兵和骑兵以英勇的方式互相冲锋，就像他们在 11 世纪英格兰南部海岸附近所做的那样。

paras.en: CLIVE HART: I started off in the Saxon shield wall on the front line. I was promoted to the cavalry, as it were, and I've been riding in the Norman cavalry ever since.
paras.zh: 克莱夫·哈特：我从前线的撒克逊盾墙开始。可以说，我被提升为骑兵，从那时起我就一直在诺曼骑兵中服役。

paras.en: LARSON: Clive Hart is a writer and a reenactor in the U.K. He was there this weekend on the fields of East Sussex.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：克莱夫·哈特是英国的一位作家和重演演员。这个周末他去了东萨塞克斯郡的田野。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED ANNOUNCER: They gird their loins.
paras.zh: 身份不明的播音员：他们束紧腰。

paras.en: HART: Wearing chainmail or mail armor, riding with a shield and stabbing Saxons with a spear.
paras.zh: 哈特（HART）：穿着链甲或链甲，手持盾牌骑马，用长矛刺杀撒克逊人。

paras.en: LARSON: The Norman Conquest transformed the Western world, replacing the Anglo-Saxon rulers of England with French ones, the Normans. Everything changed.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：诺曼征服改变了西方世界，法国诺曼人取代了英格兰的盎格鲁撒克逊统治者。一切都变了。

paras.en: OLIVIA SWARTHOUT: Language, law, culture, everything.
paras.zh: OLIVIA SWARTHOUT：语言、法律、文化，一切。

paras.en: LARSON: Olivia Swarthout is a medieval enthusiast in London. She runs the social media account Weird Medieval Guys.
paras.zh: 拉森：奥利维亚·斯沃索特 (Olivia Swarthout) 是伦敦的一位中世纪爱好者。她运营着社交媒体帐户“Weird Medieval Guys”。

paras.en: SWARTHOUT: The old is completely, I would say, done away with, and the new is - it's very different. It's very French.
paras.zh: SWARTHOUT：我想说，旧的已经完全废除了，而新的则非常不同。这是非常法国式的。

paras.en: LARSON: The victory of Norman King William the Conqueror was memorialized forever in a 230-foot-long embroidery that would come to be known as the Bayeux Tapestry. For almost its entire life, it sat in France. But this year, the French government loaned it to the British Museum.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：诺曼国王征服者威廉的胜利被永远纪念在 230 英尺长的刺绣中，这幅刺绣后来被称为贝叶挂毯。它几乎一生都位于法国。但今年，法国政府将其借给了大英博物馆。

paras.en: SWARTHOUT: There's a real sense that this is a once-in-a-lifetime event for people.
paras.zh: SWARTHOUT：对于人们来说，这是一次千载难逢的事件。

paras.en: LARSON: Tapestry fever is sweeping the U.K., and the Hastings reenactors are reaping the rewards. English Heritage, which puts on the reenactment every year, says they haven't sold this many tickets in a decade.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：挂毯热正在席卷英国，黑斯廷斯重演者正在收获回报。每年都会举办重演活动的英国遗产协会表示，他们已经十年没有售出这么多门票了。

paras.en: LARSON: Medieval piping duo Myal Pyper welcome the crowds. But how does the battle go?
paras.zh: 拉尔森：中世纪风笛二人组 Myal Pyper 欢迎观众。但战斗进展如何呢？

paras.en: MARK GRIFFIN: The Normans come up the hill and start hitting the Saxons.
paras.zh: 马克·格里芬：诺曼人爬上山，开始攻击撒克逊人。

paras.en: LARSON: Mark Griffin has been attending the event since 1985. He recorded the battle sounds you've been hearing.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：马克·格里芬自 1985 年以来一直参加这一活动。他录制了你听到的战斗声音。

paras.en: GRIFFIN: Normans and Saxons look very similar. So as the Saxon line needs to start getting depleted, yes, a few people need to lie down on the ground. But a lot of them just say, right, I'm coming over, and you suddenly turn round and start fighting the person you have just been standing next to on the other side.
paras.zh: 格里芬：诺曼人和撒克逊人看起来非常相似。因此，随着撒克逊人的线需要开始耗尽，是的，一些人需要躺在地上。但很多人只是说，好吧，我过来，然后你突然转过身来，开始与刚刚站在另一边的人打架。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED ANNOUNCER: The chief (ph) is down. I repeat, the chief...
paras.zh: 身份不明的播音员：负责人（ph）下线了。我再说一遍，队长……

paras.en: LARSON: The battle goes poorly for the Saxons, as you'd expect. English King Harold is shot in the eye with an arrow, William the Conqueror rides away victorious, and a booing crowd starts packing up. But for those who care deeply, desperately about this history, the best moments happen on the outskirts, says horseman Clive Hart.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：正如你所预料的那样，撒克逊人的战斗进行得很糟糕。英国国王哈罗德的眼睛被箭射中，征服者威廉凯旋而去，起哄的人群开始收拾行李。但对于那些深切、迫切地关心这段历史的人来说，最好的时刻发生在郊区，骑手克莱夫·哈特说。

paras.en: HART: There can be nothing modern in your field of vision, and all you can see in front of you is mail shirts jingling, shields tapping on wooden saddles, horses swishing their legs and snorting. And in that moment, you're in 1066 country, and you're marching off to battle.
paras.zh: 哈特：在你的视野中不可能有任何现代的东西，你面前所能看到的只有锁子甲叮当作响、盾牌敲击木马鞍、马匹甩着腿、喷着鼻息。在那一刻，你身处 1066 个国家，你即将踏上战场。

paras.en: LARSON: Both Hart, the cavalry reenactor, and Swarthout, the Bayeux tapestry enthusiast - they've spent large portions of their lives looking back at the past, willing it to take on some living form.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：骑兵重演者哈特和贝叶挂毯爱好者斯沃索特——他们一生中大部分时间都在回顾过去，希望它能呈现出某种鲜活的形式。

paras.en: SWARTHOUT: Knowing that that was placed there almost 1,000 years ago by human hands, the hands of humans who had lived through it and experienced the fallout is - yeah, it's just incredible.
paras.zh: SWARTHOUT：知道那是大约 1000 年前由人类亲手放置在那里的，经历过它并经历过其后果的人类之手是 - 是的，这真是令人难以置信。

paras.en: LARSON: And if they focus their gaze just right on the handwoven embroidery of the tapestry, or they listen for the chain mail jingling on the back of a horse, the history's alive. It's right there. You can reach out and touch it. Henry Larson, NPR News.
paras.zh: 拉尔森：如果他们的目光正好集中在挂毯上的手工刺绣上，或者他们倾听马背上的锁子甲叮叮当当的声音，那么历史就活着。它就在那里。你可以伸手去触摸它。亨利·拉尔森，美国国家公共广播电台新闻。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
paras.zh: 沙特当局称，利雅得机场袭击造成 12 人死亡、300 多人受伤

paras.en: CAIRO (AP) — The latest attack on the international airport in Saudi Arabia's capital of Riyadh killed 12 people and injured over 300 others, civil aviation authorities said early Sunday, with some in critical condition.
paras.zh: 开罗（美联社）——民航当局周日早些时候表示，沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得国际机场最近发生的袭击事件造成 12 人死亡、300 多人受伤，其中一些人伤势严重。

paras.en: The attack was the deadliest in any Gulf Arab country since the start of the Iran war, whose fronts have expanded to include the recent surge in fighting between the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen and Saudi-backed government forces there.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是自伊朗战争爆发以来海湾阿拉伯国家最严重的一次袭击，伊朗战争的战线已经扩大到最近伊朗支持的也门胡塞武装与沙特支持的政府军之间的战斗激增。

paras.en: The statement, which did not assign blame for the attack, said the dead included four Saudi citizens as well as two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese. It said the injured were being treated at several hospitals.
paras.zh: 该声明没有指出此次袭击的责任，但表示死者包括四名沙特公民、两名孟加拉国公民、一名巴勒斯坦人、一名美国公民、一名埃及人、一名约旦人、一名叙利亚人和一名苏丹人。据称，伤者正在几家医院接受治疗。

paras.en: The attack — the latest of several in the past week on King Khalid International Airport that killed four people — is expected to increase Saudi pressure on allies including the United States to provide military support for the kingdom.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是过去一周哈立德国王国际机场发生的几起袭击事件中的最新一起，造成四人死亡，预计将加大沙特对包括美国在内的盟友施加的压力，要求其向沙特提供军事支持。

paras.en: Shortly after the attack on Saturday afternoon, President Donald Trump said he was evaluating whether the U.S. should join Saudi strikes against the Houthis. "We may. We're going to look at it," Trump said. "We just found out about the recent attack. So we'll make a decision. We move very quickly."
paras.zh: 周六下午袭击事件发生后不久，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他正在评估美国是否应该加入沙特对胡塞武装的打击。 “我们可能会。我们会考虑一下，”特朗普说。 “我们刚刚发现最近发生的袭击事件。所以我们会做出决定。我们行动非常快。”

paras.en: A missile struck an airport complex housing terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights, a regional official said, speaking on condition of anonymity because they weren't authorized to speak to the media.
paras.zh: 一名地区官员表示，一枚导弹击中了机场综合大楼，该机场设有 3 号和 4 号国内航班航站楼。该官员要求匿名，因为他们无权接受媒体采访。

paras.en: The surge in attacks, including against other Saudi airports, military facilities and oil infrastructure, has come in the week since a Saudi-led coalition launched a major military offensive against the Houthis. There was no immediate statement from the rebels, who earlier Saturday accused Saudi Arabia of striking Sanaa International Airport in the Houthi-held Yemeni capital. The rebels at times take days to claim responsibility.
paras.zh: 自沙特领导的联军对胡塞武装发动大规模军事攻势以来，本周袭击事件激增，其中包括针对沙特其他机场、军事设施和石油基础设施的袭击。叛军没有立即发表声明，周六早些时候，叛军指责沙特阿拉伯袭击了胡塞武装控制的也门首都萨那国际机场。叛乱分子有时需要数天时间才声称对此事负责。

paras.en: Riyadh airport operations were suspended
paras.zh: 利雅得机场暂停运营

paras.en: Saudi civil aviation authorities earlier said airport operations were suspended. An official notice to aviators said the suspension was through midnight. The airport had a heavy police presence, with all entrances blocked, and lights around the complex were dimmed.
paras.zh: 沙特民航当局早些时候表示，机场运营已暂停。给飞行员的官方通知称，停飞将持续到午夜。机场有大量警察驻守，所有入口都被封锁，机场周围的灯光也很暗。

paras.en: Flights diverted elsewhere, the Flightradar24 tracker said. Countries including the United States, Britain, Germany, Australia and Canada warned citizens to avoid the airport. Statements later turned to condolences.
paras.zh: Flightradar24 追踪器称，航班改道至其他地方。美国、英国、德国、澳大利亚和加拿大等国警告公民避免前往机场。随后的声明转为哀悼。

paras.en: Later on Saturday, the Saudi-led coalition said a projectile had fallen near King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and a Houthi-launched ballistic missile had been intercepted in Al-Kharj governorate, southeast of Riyadh.
paras.zh: 周六晚些时候，沙特领导的联军表示，一枚弹丸落在达曼法赫德国王国际机场附近，胡塞武装发射的弹道导弹在利雅得东南部的哈吉省被拦截。

paras.en: The attacks on Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, have rattled markets and the region. And yet the Saudi energy ministry hours after the latest one was still promoting a major international energy conference set to begin in Riyadh on Sunday.
paras.zh: 全球最大石油出口国沙特阿拉伯遭受的袭击震惊了市场和该地区。然而，在最新一次会议发生数小时后，沙特能源部仍在推动将于周日在利雅得召开的大型国际能源会议。

paras.en: Fighting between the Houthis and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces has escalated, with the Saudi-led coalition providing air support for government forces attempting to reverse recent Houthi gains along Yemen's Red Sea coast. Those gains gave the rebels better surveillance of shipping on a corridor that is a crucial alternative to the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran has been attacking ships.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府军之间的战斗不断升级，沙特领导的联军为政府军提供空中支援，试图扭转胡塞武装最近在也门红海沿岸的攻势。这些成果使叛军能够更好地监视走廊上的航运，该走廊是霍尔木兹海峡的重要替代通道，伊朗一直在霍尔木兹海峡袭击船只。

paras.en: Though the Houthis have told the AP and others they are only targeting Saudi shipping as part of a blockade in retaliation for one imposed on them, concerns about wider attacks persist. The Houthis previously attacked other ships after the war in Gaza began, calling it solidarity with Palestinians. A U.S. bombing campaign sharply limited that.
paras.zh: 尽管胡塞武装告诉美联社和其他人，他们只是针对沙特航运作为封锁的一部分，以报复对他们实施的袭击，但对更广泛袭击的担忧仍然存在。加沙战争开始后，胡塞武装此前曾袭击过其他船只，称其是为了声援巴勒斯坦人。美国的轰炸行动极大地限制了这一点。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has run low on interceptors, officials say
paras.zh: 官员称沙特阿拉伯拦截弹已所剩无几

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is running low on missile interceptors and has asked France, Britain, Pakistan and Egypt to deploy air defense support to the region, regional officials told the AP last month, with one noting that the U.S. has seen its own stock dwindle during the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 地区官员上个月告诉美联社，沙特阿拉伯的导弹拦截器数量不足，并已要求法国、英国、巴基斯坦和埃及向该地区部署防空支持，其中一位官员指出，在与伊朗的战争期间，美国的库存不断减少。

paras.en: Officials have said U.S. assistance has included intelligence sharing, target identification and planning for the latest offensive against the Houthis.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，美国的援助包括情报共享、目标识别以及针对胡塞武装的最新攻势的规划。

paras.en: Earlier Saturday, Saudi Arabia said its foreign minister and Omani counterpart spoke by phone about the importance of "supporting diplomatic solutions to de-escalate tensions" in the region. Oman, which lies across the Strait of Hormuz from Iran, has played a mediator role at times in the region.
paras.zh: 周六早些时候，沙特阿拉伯表示，其外交部长和阿曼外长通过电话谈到了“支持外交解决方案以缓解该地区紧张局势”的重要性。阿曼与伊朗隔霍尔木兹海峡相望，有时在该地区发挥调解人的作用。

paras.en: The Houthis this week warned global airlines "for the last time" about the potential consequences of operating in Saudi airspace, which they described as a theater for their military operations.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装本周“最后一次”警告全球航空公司在沙特领空开展业务的潜在后果，他们称沙特领空是其军事行动的战场。

paras.en: Before the latest attack, Air India, FlyDubai, Lufthansa Group and Pakistan International Airlines were among airlines suspending flights to and from Riyadh and other Saudi airports for varying periods.
paras.zh: 在最近一次袭击之前，印度航空、迪拜航空、汉莎航空集团和巴基斯坦国际航空等航空公司都在不同时期暂停了往返利雅得和其他沙特机场的航班。

paras.en: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency had expanded its guidance on Saudi airspace, noting the Houthis' ability to strike targets deeper inside the kingdom, including Riyadh, and a "greater focus on aviation infrastructure."
paras.zh: 欧盟航空安全局扩大了对沙特领空的指导，指出胡塞武装有能力打击沙特境内更深处的目标，包括利雅得，并且“更加关注航空基础设施”。

paras.en: The missile and drone attacks and interception efforts "create an increased risk of misidentification of civil aircraft," it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，导弹和无人机的攻击和拦截工作“增加了误认民用飞机的风险”。

paras.en: Two regional officials said Houthi attacks on the Riyadh airport on Thursday damaged three planes. The officials spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't authorized to brief the media. The Saudi national carrier said one of its aircraft was damaged while it was on the ground, with no passengers on board.
paras.zh: 两名地区官员表示，胡塞武装周四对利雅得机场发动袭击，造成三架飞机受损。这些官员要求匿名，因为他们无权向媒体通报情况。沙特国家航空公司表示，其一架飞机在地面时受损，机上没有乘客。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Saudi authorities warned the public this week that "filming, publishing or sharing information related to countering missiles and drones and their impact sites exposes you to legal liability."
paras.zh: 与此同时，沙特当局本周警告公众，“拍摄、发布或分享与对抗导弹和无人机及其影响地点相关的信息会让你承担法律责任。”

paras.en: Anna reported from Jerusalem. Associated Press writers Victoria Eastwood in Cairo, Collin Binkley in Washington and Sally Abou AlJoud in Beirut contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 安娜从耶路撒冷报道。美联社记者开罗的维多利亚·伊斯特伍德、华盛顿的科林·宾克利和贝鲁特的莎莉·阿布·阿尔乔德为本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它拥有市场上最长的 0% 年利率优惠期之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。
