articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Trump says he'd 'love' to have Sen. John Fetterman as a Republican amid growing speculation

paras.en: President Donald Trump praised Sen. John Fetterman, D-Pa., as a "great guy" on Saturday, saying he would welcome the Pennsylvania Democrat into the Republican Party.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周六称赞宾夕法尼亚州民主党参议员约翰·费特曼是一个“伟大的人”，并表示他欢迎这位宾夕法尼亚州民主党人加入共和党。

paras.en: Trump was asked by a reporter after stepping off Air Force One at Joint Base Andrews whether he had spoken to Fetterman — who has repeatedly broken with Democrats during the current session of Congress — about becoming a Republican and whether he would welcome such a switch.
paras.zh: 特朗普在安德鲁斯联合基地走下空军一号后，被一名记者问到，他是否曾与在本届国会会议期间多次与民主党决裂的费特曼谈过成为共和党人，以及他是否欢迎这样的转变。

paras.en: "I'd love to see it. I think he's great," Trump responded.
paras.zh: “我很想看到它。我认为他很棒，”特朗普回答道。

paras.en: "It's going to be hard for him to get the nomination as a Democrat, but I'd love to have him as a Republican," he continued.
paras.zh: “他作为民主党人获得提名会很困难，但我希望他成为共和党人，”他继续说道。

paras.en: Trump described Fetterman as a "great guy" with "magnificent parents," whom he said he had spoken with previously.
paras.zh: 特朗普形容费特曼是一个“伟大的人”，拥有“伟大的父母”，他说他之前曾与他们交谈过。

paras.en: "He's a very solid person," Trump added. "He's smart and all that, but he's got great common sense."
paras.zh: “他是一个非常踏实的人，”特朗普补充道。 “他很聪明，而且很有常识。”

paras.en: Trump also suggested that switching parties could benefit Fetterman politically.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，更换政党可能会给费特曼带来政治上的好处。

paras.en: "If you look at the polls, he does better as a Republican than he does as a Democrat," he said.
paras.zh: “如果你看看民意调查，你会发现他作为共和党人的表现比作为民主党人表现得更好，”他说。

paras.en: Trump's comments come as Fetterman has repeatedly broken with Democrats on key issues, including the Iran war and immigration, although he continues to vote with his party the vast majority of the time.
paras.zh: 特朗普发表此番言论之际，费特曼在包括伊朗战争和移民在内的关键问题上多次与民主党决裂，尽管他在绝大多数时间里仍然支持民主党投票。

paras.en: Since joining the Senate in 2023, Fetterman has voted with Senate Democrats nearly 90% of the time. During the current session of Congress, however, that figure has fallen to just under 81%, Fox News Digital previously reported.
paras.zh: 自2023年加入参议院以来，费特曼近90%的时间都投票给参议院民主党人。然而，据福克斯数字新闻此前报道，在本届国会会议期间，这一数字已降至略低于 81%。

paras.en: Fetterman's occasional breaks with his party have fueled speculation in recent months about whether he might eventually become a Republican. He has also reportedly used Republican fundraising platforms to solicit donations and maintains a close friendship with Sen. Katie Britt, R-Ala.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，费特曼偶尔与党派决裂引发了人们对他是否最终可能成为共和党人的猜测。据报道，他还利用共和党筹款平台筹集捐款，并与阿拉巴马州共和党参议员凯蒂·布里特保持着密切的友谊。

paras.en: Last month, Fetterman recorded a video introducing Sen. Dave McCormick, R-Pa., at the Republican Midterm Convention.
paras.zh: 上个月，费特曼录制了一段视频，介绍宾夕法尼亚州共和党参议员戴夫·麦考密克在共和党中期大会上的情况。

paras.en: He also mistakenly referred to himself as a lifelong Republican during an appearance at the Texas Tribune's TribFest last month.
paras.zh: 上个月，他在德克萨斯论坛报 TribFest 上露面时，还错误地称自己是终身共和党人。

paras.en: An attendee at the event asked why Fetterman did not run as an independent.
paras.zh: 活动的一位与会者询问费特曼为什么不以独立人士身份参选。

paras.en: "Because I'm a lifelong Republican," he said, before realizing his mistake. "I guarantee you that will break through. That will get clipped."
paras.zh: “因为我一生都是共和党人，”他在意识到自己的错误之前说道。 “我向你保证，这将会突破。那将会被削减。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital has reached out to Fetterman's office for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道已联系费特曼办公室征求意见。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Alex Miller and Anders Hagstrom contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的亚历克斯·米勒和安德斯·哈格斯特罗姆为本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Kirby Smart has entered his most dangerous era after Georgia’s aggressive win over Alabama

paras.en: TUSCALOOSA, AL- Don't tell Georgia or Alabama that Saturday night's game in Tuscaloosa was meaningless because of the current college football playoff format.
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马州塔斯卡卢萨 - 不要告诉佐治亚州或阿拉巴马州，周六晚上在塔斯卡卢萨举行的比赛由于当​​前的大学橄榄球季后赛形式而毫无意义。

paras.en: After a week full of drama surrounding Hurricane Isaias and whether we would see these two teams take the field on time, fans were treated to a heavyweight showdown inside Bryant Denny Stadium on Saturday in front of a soaked crowd watching from the stands.
paras.zh: 经过一周围绕伊萨亚斯飓风的戏剧性事件以及我们能否看到这两支球队准时上场，周六，球迷们在布莱恩特丹尼体育场内观看了一场重量级对决，观众席上湿透了，观众在看台上观看比赛。

paras.en: We did not need any extra hype for this one. The theatrical movies that schools release before kickoff were not going to do anything that the Bulldogs and Tide couldn’t do when they arrived around 5:40 p.m. EST on Saturday afternoon.
paras.zh: 我们不需要对此进行任何额外的宣传。学校在开赛前放映的院线电影不会做斗牛犬队和潮汐队在下午 5:40 左右到达时做不到的事情。美国东部时间周六下午。

paras.en: This was about Kirby Smart trying to buck the regular season trend against Alabama, while Kalen DeBoer looked to put his team back into the perceived national spot that some wanted to argue they had fallen out of.
paras.zh: 这是关于柯比·斯马特（Kirby Smart）试图在对阵阿拉巴马州的比赛中扭转常规赛的趋势，而卡伦·德波尔（Kalen DeBoer）则希望让他的球队重新回到被一些人认为他们已经跌落的国家地位。

paras.en: What you got was two teams trading haymakers for a first half that ended with DeBoer going for a touchdown with just seconds remaining on the clock, taking a 14-10 lead into the locker room.
paras.zh: 上半场两队互交白卷，德波尔在比赛还剩几秒时触地得分，以 14-10 领先进入更衣室。

paras.en: This came after Georgia had found its way out of its own end of the field on two occasions for 10 points.
paras.zh: 在此之前，乔治亚队曾两次在本方球场外拿下 10 分。

paras.en: Hurricane doesn’t put a damper on heavyweight fight in Tuscaloosa
paras.zh: 飓风并没有阻碍塔斯卡卢萨的重量级拳击比赛

paras.en: A late-arriving crowd inside a a misty Bryant Denny Stadium watched two coaches trying to outmaneuver each other for four quarters, while Keelon Russell and Gunner Stockton traded shots on offense.
paras.zh: 在雾蒙蒙的布莱恩特丹尼体育场内，迟到的人群观看了两位教练在四个季度中试图智取对方的比赛，而基隆·拉塞尔和枪手斯托克顿则在进攻中互相投篮。

paras.en: What more could you ask for on a day filled with so much drama around college football?
paras.zh: 在大学橄榄球充满戏剧性的一天里，你还能要求什么呢？

paras.en: Heck, in the fourth quarter alone this evening, Georgia missed a field goal that would have given it the lead against Alabama, while Kentucky missed a 26-yard chip shot that would have tied the game with LSU.
paras.zh: 哎呀，仅在今晚的第四节，佐治亚州就错失了一个本可以领先阿拉巴马州的射门，而肯塔基州错失了一个 26 码的切球，本可以与路易斯安那州立大学扳平比分。

paras.en: There were plenty of times in this game tonight where Georgia felt like the better football team, in all facets. But then, when you have such dynamic team like Alabama that can score on you within seconds, no lead seemed safe.
paras.zh: 在今晚的这场比赛中，很多时候格鲁吉亚队在各个方面都感觉自己是一支更好的球队。但是，当你拥有像阿拉巴马这样充满活力的球队，可以在几秒钟内得分时，任何领先似乎都是安全的。

paras.en: In reality, we were watching two of the best teams in college football in Tuscaloosa, and it doesn’t matter that they both come from the SEC. You can add Ohio State to that list, while taking Texas off of it at the same time.
paras.zh: 事实上，我们正在观看塔斯卡卢萨大学橄榄球中最好的两支球队，而且他们都来自 SEC 并不重要。您可以将俄亥俄州立大学添加到该列表中，同时将德克萨斯州从其中删除。

paras.en: We are reaching that point in the season where the frauds are starting to show themselves, and there wasn’t one on the field in Tuscaloosa. We can talk about Alabama and this team moving past the Saban era until we're blue in the face, and some will still be doing 10 years from now.
paras.zh: 我们已经到了本赛季欺诈行为开始显现的阶段，而塔斯卡卢萨球场上却没有一个人。我们可以谈论阿拉巴马州和这支球队已经超越了萨班时代，直到我们脸色发青，有些人在十年后仍然会这样做。

paras.en: While Georgia would retake the lead with a field goal on the ensuing drive, the officials would become part of the story late in the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 虽然乔治亚队在随后的进攻中凭借射门重新取得领先，但官员们将在第四节末成为故事的一部分。

paras.en: Chaos reigned on Alabama's drive, as Georgia was not called for an obvious pass interference that would have resulted in the Tide extending its drive by 15-yards. But, as the boos reigned down from the Bryant Denny Stadium stands, there was nothing left for the Alabama fans to cheer about after the Bulldogs sacked Keelon Russell on the ensuing play.
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马队的进攻陷入混乱，因为乔治亚队没有被要求进行明显的传球干扰，而这会导致潮汐队将其进攻距离延长15码。但是，当科比·丹尼体育场看台上响起嘘声时，在斗牛犬队在接下来的比赛中解雇了基隆·拉塞尔后，阿拉巴马州的球迷没有什么可以欢呼的了。

paras.en: In that moment, tacked on with a personal foul against Dijon Lee that resulted in Georgia being able to take a knee and run the clock out, which once led to Kalen DeBoer being the most animated we've seen him during his time at Alabama.
paras.zh: 在那一刻，对第戎·李的个人犯规导致佐治亚州能够单膝跪地并耗尽时间，这一度导致卡伦·德波尔成为我们在阿拉巴马州期间见过的最活跃的人。

paras.en: Georgia is the best team in college football, and Kirby Smart is more dangerous
paras.zh: 佐治亚州是大学橄榄球中最好的球队，柯比·斯马特更危险

paras.en: Until somebody beats them, it's the Dawgs.
paras.zh: 在有人击败他们之前，都是 Dawgs。

paras.en: One way or the other, Kirby Smart has a football team that finds a way to win football games, which is not the case for other teams across the Southeastern Conference, or the sport.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，柯比·斯马特拥有一支能够找到赢得橄榄球比赛的方法的橄榄球队，而东南联盟或这项运动的其他球队则不然。

paras.en: "I didn’t come here to lose," Kirby Smart said after the game.
paras.zh: “我来这里不是为了输球，”科比·斯马特赛后说道。

paras.en: We witnessed a football team fighting through adversity, with the world wondering if Kirby Smart was going to get over some type of perceived hump.
paras.zh: 我们目睹了一支橄榄球队在逆境中奋战，全世界都想知道柯比·斯马特是否能够克服某种类型的困难。

paras.en: The problem for those pushing that message: Kirby Smart really does not care any longer. Following the win, Smart bolted straight for the visitors section, slinging his visor around in the air while the Georgia fans and Kirby's wife waited to embrace his family.
paras.zh: 对于那些宣扬这一信息的人来说，问题是：Kirby Smart 真的不再关心了。获胜后，斯玛特直接冲向游客区，将面罩抛在空中，而佐治亚州的球迷和柯比的妻子则等待拥抱他的家人。

paras.en: "I'd rather make memories with my family, team and coaching staff ... I just wanted to celebrate with my wife..She deserved a kiss for all that she puts up with from me."
paras.zh: “我宁愿和我的家人、球队和教练组一起留下回忆……我只是想和我的妻子一起庆祝……她应该得到一个吻，因为她忍受了我的一切。”

paras.en: We are witnessing a new Kirby Smart, who is not worried about trying to silence critics or whatever is being written about him.
paras.zh: 我们正在见证一个新的柯比·斯玛特，他并不担心试图压制批评者或任何关于他的报道。

paras.en: That's a dangerous man, who seems to be fighting more for the respect from his family and those who encompass the football facility in Athens.
paras.zh: 这是一个危险的人，他似乎更多地是为了家人和雅典足球场周围的人的尊重而奋斗。

paras.en: "Do I wanna win championships? Hell yeah, but I have a lot more respect for them (family and players) to understand that there's a lot more important things in life."
paras.zh: “我想赢得冠军吗？当然是的，但我对他们（家人和球员）更加尊重，明白生活中有很多更重要的事情。”

articles.title: Delaware neighborhood on edge after masked men with apparent weapons knock on doors of homes

paras.en: Cameras in a Delaware neighborhood caught at least two masked men knocking on doors late Friday night, including one carrying an apparent rifle, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，周五深夜，特拉华州一个社区的摄像头拍到至少两名蒙面男子敲门，其中一人明显携带步枪。

paras.en: Images released by the New Castle County Police Department show a man wearing a tactical-style vest and holding what appears to be a rifle while knocking on a home's front door.
paras.zh: 纽卡斯尔县警察局发布的图像显示，一名男子穿着战术背心，拿着疑似步枪的东西敲着一户人家的前门。

paras.en: A separate image shows another individual approaching a front door wearing a black vest and mask.
paras.zh: 另一张图片显示另一个人穿着黑色背心和面具接近前门。

paras.en: According to police, officers were called to the 1200 block of Canvasback Drive in Mallard Pointe, New Castle, around 10:50 p.m. Friday following a report of a suspicious person.
paras.zh: 据警方称，晚上 10 点 50 分左右，警察被叫到纽卡斯尔 Mallard Pointe Canvasback Drive 1200 街区。周五接到可疑人员报告后。

paras.en: Residents told police that a man wearing a black hockey-style mask and tactical-style vest approached homes while carrying what appeared to be a rifle.
paras.zh: 居民告诉警方，一名戴着黑色曲棍球面具、穿着战术背心的男子拿着疑似步枪的东西走近民宅。

paras.en: The man allegedly knocked on doors before running away, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，这名男子在逃跑前曾敲门。

paras.en: Authorities said four men were also seen heading eastbound on Mallard Road — two on bicycles and two on foot.
paras.zh: 当局表示，还看到四名男子沿着 Mallard Road 向东行进，其中两人骑自行车，两人步行。

paras.en: Officers and a K-9 unit conducted a search of the neighborhood and nearby properties but could not locate the individuals.
paras.zh: 警察和 K-9 部队对社区和附近的房产进行了搜查，但未能找到这些人。

paras.en: Although police have not confirmed whether the weapons were real firearms, they said they believe the weapons may have been airsoft-style guns.
paras.zh: 尽管警方尚未证实这些武器是否是真枪，但他们表示相信这些武器可能是气枪式枪支。

paras.en: Anyone with information about the incident or home security footage from the surrounding area is urged to call 911 or the department's non-emergency number at 302-573-2800.
paras.zh: 任何有关于该事件或周边地区家庭安全录像信息的人请拨打 911 或该部门的非紧急电话 302-573-2800。

articles.title: ‘My body is still peaking’: Eliud Kipchoge wins first marathon in three years
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: Marathon’s greatest competitor, Eliud Kipchoge, has sent a message to the next generation declaring that he’s not done yet.
paras.zh: 马拉松最伟大的竞争对手埃鲁德·基普乔格（Eliud Kipchoge）向下一代发出了一条信息，宣称他还没有完成。

paras.en: The 41-year-old Kenyan revelled in his Melbourne Marathon debut on Sunday, breaking the race record and delighting thousands of fans at the MCG finish.
paras.zh: 这位 41 岁的肯尼亚选手在周日的墨尔本马拉松比赛中表现出色，打破了比赛纪录，并在 MCG 终点让成千上万的粉丝感到高兴。

paras.en: Beating the old race mark by two seconds, his two hours nine minutes and 10 seconds over a new course gave Kipchoge his first marathon win in three years.
paras.zh: 基普乔格在新赛道上以 2 小时 9 分 10 秒的成绩超越了旧比赛纪录 2 秒，这是他三年来首次赢得马拉松比赛。

paras.en: Jimmy Whelan, a former Australian professional cyclist, was with the two-time Olympic champion and former world record-holder until about 30km. Then Kipchoge went up a gear and dominated to the finish.
paras.zh: 前澳大利亚职业自行车运动员吉米·惠兰 (Jimmy Whelan) 与这位两届奥运会冠军、前世界纪录保持者一起直到约 30 公里。然后基普乔格加速并主导比赛直至终点。

paras.en: Looking as though he has just done a training run, Kipchoge then spent well over half an hour celebrating with fans along the MCG boundary fence.
paras.zh: 基普乔格看起来好像刚刚完成了一次训练，然后沿着MCG边界围栏与球迷们一起庆祝了半个多小时。

paras.en: He was mobbed by media at the finish and took the chaos in his stride.
paras.zh: 比赛结束时，他被媒体包围，但他从容应对混乱。

paras.en: “The crowd is so wonderful – I’ve never seen a crowd like this,” he said. “Melbourne is really, really a sporting city.
paras.zh: “人群太棒了——我从来没有见过这样的人群，”他说。 “墨尔本确实是一座体育城市。

paras.en: “I believe that my body is still peaking – still able to compete with the next generation. The oldest athlete is still competing but I am happy to run with the gen Zs.”
paras.zh: “我相信我的身体仍处于巅峰状态，仍然能够与下一代竞争。最年长的运动员仍在竞争，但我很高兴与 Z 世代一起跑步。”

paras.en: “I [increased] the pace after 30km, to see whether I can run well and beat the [race record]. My plan went well.”
paras.zh: “30公里后我[增加]配速，看看我是否能跑好并打破[比赛记录]。我的计划进行得很顺利。”

paras.en: Kipchoge had said repeatedly over the last few days that his Melbourne visit was more than just another race. It is the third leg in his world tour, where he will run a marathon on each continent, including Antarctica.
paras.zh: 基普乔格过去几天多次表示，他的墨尔本之行不仅仅是另一场比赛。这是他世界巡回赛的第三站，他将在包括南极洲在内的各大洲进行马拉松比赛。

paras.en: He has also done some community work while in Melbourne and is acutely aware of the city’s rich sporting heritage.
paras.zh: 他在墨尔本期间还做过一些社区工作，并敏锐地意识到这座城市丰富的体育遗产。

paras.en: “The experience is awesome – the culture of Melbourne is wonderful,” he said.
paras.zh: “这种体验太棒了——墨尔本的文化很棒，”他说。

paras.en: “The last four days, I’ve seen myself, sport can do wonder. It was four-in-one – with the tennis, finishing at the cricket, the Olympics were here in 1956, running on the Formula One track.
paras.zh: “过去四天，我看到了自己，体育可以创造奇迹。它是四合一的——网球、板球、1956 年奥运会，在一级方程式赛道上举行。

paras.en: “I will come back to Melbourne to watch the tennis, the Formula One next year, to see people of Melbourne playing cricket. This is the best track ever.”
paras.zh: “明年我会回到墨尔本观看网球比赛、一级方程式赛车，看墨尔本人打板球。这是有史以来最好的赛道。”

paras.en: Kipchoge could have finished a few seconds quicker but was waving to the crowd on the half-lap inside the MCG to the finish.
paras.zh: 基普乔格本来可以快几秒钟完赛，但他在 MCG 内的半圈内向观众挥手致意。

paras.en: This is his second visit to Australia. The Kenyan finished ninth in the 2025 Sydney Marathon.
paras.zh: 这是他第二次访问澳大利亚。肯尼亚人在 2025 年悉尼马拉松比赛中获得第九名。

paras.en: Australia’s Thomas Do Canto was runner-up in 2:10:35 and Whelan was fifth. New Zealand’s Camille French won the women’s race in 2:28:25, with Australia’s Sinead Diver next in 2:28.49.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚选手托马斯·杜坎托(Thomas Do Canto)以2小时10分35秒的成绩获得亚军，惠兰获得第五名。新西兰选手卡米尔·弗伦奇 (Camille French) 以 2 小时 28 分 25 秒的成绩夺得女子组冠军，澳大利亚跳水选手西尼德 (Sinead Diver) 以 2 小时 28.49 秒的成绩夺得冠军。

paras.en: The Australian Seth O’Donnell and the New Zealander Georgie Gregec won the half-marathon titles.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚选手赛斯·奥唐纳（Seth O’Donnell）和新西兰选手乔治·格雷格（Georgie Gregec）夺得半程马拉松冠军。

paras.en: Earlier on Sunday, a woman was taken to hospital after she was struck by a car near Flinders Street station, about 200 metres from the marathon route.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，一名妇女在距离马拉松路线约 200 米的弗林德斯街车站附近被一辆汽车撞倒，被送往医院。

paras.en: Reports suggest police officers in the vicinity drew their weapons after the car, which was seen driving erratically, hit the woman about 10.45am, before performing a U-turn and driving away.
paras.zh: 报道称，上午 10 点 45 分左右，这辆行驶不规律的汽车撞到了这名女子，随后掉头开走，附近的警察拔出了武器。

paras.en: The woman was taken to Royal Melbourne hospital and her condition is not known.
paras.zh: 该女子被送往皇家墨尔本医院，目前情况尚不清楚。

articles.title: Two Carlton players treated in hospital after offseason night out
articles.author: Ben Smee

paras.en: An off-season night out for Carlton football club teammates ended with two players admitted to hospital for treatment on Sunday morning, in what the club says are “separate circumstances”.
paras.zh: 卡尔顿足球俱乐部队友的休赛期之夜以周日早上两名球员入院接受治疗而告终，俱乐部称这是“不同情况”。

paras.en: The club released a statement on Sunday confirming that players Lachie Cowan, 21, and Will Hayward, 27, had been treated and discharged, after reports in several media outlets about the aftermath of an off-season night out.
paras.zh: 在多家媒体报道休赛期夜晚外出的后果后，俱乐部于周日发表声明，确认 21 岁的球员拉奇·考恩 (Lachie Cowan) 和 27 岁的威尔·海沃德 (Will Hayward) 已接受治疗并出院。

paras.en: Guardian Australia understands both players were both part of a larger group that had been socialising on Saturday evening.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报了解到，这两名球员都是周六晚上进行社交活动的更大群体的一部分。

paras.en: The club statement said Cowan had “received medical treatment and underwent observation, before being discharged a short time later” but did not provide any more information about the circumstances.
paras.zh: 俱乐部声明称考恩“接受了治疗并接受观察，不久后出院”，但没有提供有关情况的更多信息。

paras.en: Hayward was also admitted to hospital later on Sunday morning, after returning home.
paras.zh: 海沃德回家后也于周日上午晚些时候入院。

paras.en: “Will Hayward experienced a minor cut to the head after a fall, and admitted himself to hospital where he received stitches before being discharged,” Carlton said.
paras.zh: 卡尔顿说：“威尔·海沃德摔倒后头部受了轻微割伤，入院接受缝针后出院。”

paras.en: Neither player is understood to be seriously unwell or hurt.
paras.zh: 据了解，两名球员都没有严重不适或受伤。

paras.en: “The club has been in regular contact with both players, with priority for their wellbeing and both players have now received the necessary care relating to their separate circumstances.”
paras.zh: “俱乐部一直与这两名球员保持定期联系，优先考虑他们的健康，两名球员现在都根据各自的情况得到了必要的照顾。”

paras.en: Ambulance Victoria said paramedics responded to an incident at inner-suburban South Yarra at about 5.15am on Sunday.
paras.zh: 维多利亚救护车部门表示，周日凌晨 5 点 15 分左右，医护人员对南亚拉内城区发生的一起事件做出了反应。

paras.en: A man in his 20s was taken by ambulance to the Alfred hospital in stable condition, Ambulance Victoria said.
paras.zh: 维多利亚救护车表示，一名 20 多岁的男子被救护车送往阿尔弗雷德医院，目前情况稳定。

paras.en: Players throughout the league are on leave as trade period rolls on until Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 随着交易期持续到周三晚上，整个联盟的球员都在休假。

articles.title: Ben Roberts-Smith attends Canberra event honouring Australian troops who served in Afghanistan
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: Anthony Albanese has honoured Australian troops who served in Afghanistan, using the 25th anniversary of the country’s involvement in the conflict to describe their heroism as a fight for “who we are as a people”.
paras.zh: 安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 向在阿富汗服役的澳大利亚军人致敬，并利用该国卷入这场冲突 25 周年之际，形容他们为“我们作为一个民族”而奋斗的英雄主义。

paras.en: The prime minister joined hundreds of veterans, family members and dignitaries at a commemoration of the start of the campaign in Canberra on Sunday, with nation’s most decorated living soldier and accused war criminal Ben Roberts-Smith among the crowd at the Australian War Memorial.
paras.zh: 周日，总理与数百名退伍军人、家人和政要一起参加了在堪培拉举行的战役开始纪念活动，澳大利亚战争纪念馆的人群中有全国获得勋章最多的在世士兵和被指控的战犯本·罗伯茨·史密斯。

paras.en: “In New York, fires were still burning at Ground Zero from the September 11 attacks a month earlier. The world felt upended,” Albanese said of the start of Operation Slipper.
paras.zh: “在纽约，一个月前 9 月 11 日袭击造成的‘归零地’大火仍在燃烧。世界感觉被颠覆了，”阿尔巴尼斯谈到“拖鞋行动”的开始时说道。

paras.en: “Though it would change so devastatingly a year later in Bali, it was not yet directly our fight.
paras.zh: “尽管一年后巴厘岛的情况发生了如此毁灭性的变化，但这还不是我们直接的战斗。

paras.en: “Yet Australia did what is so resolutely in our nature. We went to support our friend and ally.
paras.zh: “然而，澳大利亚却做了我们本性如此坚决的事情。我们去支持我们的朋友和盟友。

paras.en: “We went because we saw what was at stake, and we went on the principle that September 11 was an attack on a way of life that belonged just as much to us.”
paras.zh: “我们去是因为我们看到了利害攸关的事情，我们坚持的原则是，9 月 11 日是对同样属于我们的生活方式的攻击。”

paras.en: He said the more than 35,000 defence force members deployed over the following two decades did so because the very freedoms “that are at the heart of who we are as a people and a nation were under threat”.
paras.zh: 他说，在接下来的二十年里部署了超过 35,000 名国防军成员，因为“我们作为一个民族和一个国家的核心自由受到了威胁”。

paras.en: Roberts-Smith, who denies the allegations against him, attended the event alongside family members and supporters, as well as former prime ministers John Howard, Tony Abbott and Scott Morrison.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨-史密斯否认对他的指控，他与家人和支持者以及前总理约翰·霍华德、托尼·阿博特和斯科特·莫里森一起出席了此次活动。

paras.en: The governor general, Sam Mostyn, and the opposition leader, Angus Taylor, were also present in the bright sunshine.
paras.zh: 总督萨姆·莫斯廷和反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒也在明媚的阳光下出席。

paras.en: Roberts-Smith was awarded Australia’s highest military honour – the Victoria Cross – for his service in Afghanistan, but now faces accusations he murdered five unarmed detainees during his deployment.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨-史密斯因在阿富汗服役而被授予澳大利亚最高军事荣誉——维多利亚十字勋章，但现在面临着他在部署期间谋杀五名手无寸铁的被拘留者的指控。

paras.en: The former Special Air Service regiment corporal sat alongside his partner, Sarah Matulin, after a judge agreed to vary his bail conditions to allow him to visit Canberra.
paras.zh: 在法官同意改变他的保释条件以允许他访问堪培拉后，这位前特种空勤团下士坐在他的搭档莎拉·马图林旁边。

paras.en: Deployments to the Middle East continued until withdrawal from Afghanistan in 2021.
paras.zh: 继续向中东部署，直至 2021 年从阿富汗撤军。

paras.en: US troops left a few months later after signing an agreement with the Taliban, who swiftly returned to power and reintroduced authoritarian control, including strict suppression of women and girls’ rights.
paras.zh: 几个月后，美军在与塔利班签署协议后撤离，塔利班迅速重新掌权并重新实行独裁控制，包括严格压制妇女和女童的权利。

paras.en: Some 47 Australian personnel died as a result of their service and 263 were wounded, while thousands more allied soldiers were killed.
paras.zh: 大约 47 名澳大利亚人员因服役死亡，263 人受伤，另有数千名盟军士兵阵亡。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of civilians were also estimated to have been killed during the war.
paras.zh: 据估计，还有数万名平民在战争中丧生。

paras.en: Despite the controversy over Australia’s military involvement in Afghanistan and its legacy, the troops who served on the ground remain intensely proud of what they achieved.
paras.zh: 尽管澳大利亚在阿富汗的军事介入及其遗留问题存在争议，但在当地服役的部队仍然对他们所取得的成就感到非常自豪。

paras.en: Soldier Mathew Bell was deployed in 2012, aged 24, with his infantry battalion to a forward operating base in Afghanistan’s “badlands” west of Tarinkot.
paras.zh: 2012 年，24 岁的士兵马修·贝尔 (Mathew Bell) 随步兵营被部署到塔林科特以西阿富汗“荒地”的一个前沿作战基地。

paras.en: More than a decade after he returned to Australia, Bell remembers his unit’s work with a sense of honour and accomplishment.
paras.zh: 返回澳大利亚十多年后，贝尔怀着荣誉感和成就感回忆起部队的工作。

paras.en: “We changed that little part of Afghanistan, that little part of the world for good,” the former lance corporal, now 38, said.
paras.zh: “我们永远改变了阿富汗的这一小部分，世界的这一小部分，”这位现年 38 岁的前一等兵说道。

paras.en: Bell said girls were able to attend school, medical services were rolled out to villages and “there was freedom”.
paras.zh: 贝尔说，女孩能够上学，医疗服务已推广到村庄，“有自由”。

paras.en: “Not the oppression we’re seeing now under the Taliban government,” the father of two said.
paras.zh: “这不是我们现在在塔利班政府统治下看到的压迫，”两个孩子的父亲说。

paras.en: “Our role was essentially to go out on either vehicle-mounted patrols or foot patrols, out among the local population through the desert, through the green zone, keeping the Taliban at bay.
paras.zh: “我们的作用本质上是进行车载巡逻或徒步巡逻，在当地居民中穿过沙漠、穿过绿区，将塔利班拒之门外。

paras.en: “It was a hot area. Once you stepped over that line in the sand, like, that was Taliban territory.”
paras.zh: “那是一个炎热的地区。一旦你跨过沙子里的那条线，那就是塔利班的领土了。”

paras.en: One of Bell’s close mates was badly wounded in a roadside bomb explosion and on more than one occasion, his section was pinned down by sniper fire.
paras.zh: 贝尔的一位亲密战友在一次路边炸弹爆炸中受重伤，他所在的部队不止一次被狙击手火力压制。

paras.en: Services were also held at the Anzac Memorial in Sydney’s Hyde Park, at Melbourne’s Shrine of Remembrance and other sites around the country.
paras.zh: 仪式还在悉尼海德公园的澳新军团纪念馆、墨尔本纪念神殿和全国各地的其他地点举行。

paras.en: Australians who served in the Afghanistan War were deployed in various roles and missions contributing to reconstruction efforts, democratic governance, training and humanitarian aid.
paras.zh: 在阿富汗战争中服役的澳大利亚人被部署担任各种角色和任务，为重建工作、民主治理、培训和人道主义援助做出了贡献。

paras.en: Operation Slipper was followed between 2015 and 2021 by Operation Highroad and the Kabul airlift in August 2021.
paras.zh: 继“拖鞋行动”之后，2015 年至 2021 年又开展了“公路行动”和 2021 年 8 月的“喀布尔空运”行动。

articles.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US

paras.en: Four people have died and hundreds of thousands are without power after Hurricane Isaias battered parts of the southern US with powerful winds and heavy rain.
paras.zh: 飓风伊萨亚斯以强风和暴雨袭击美国南部部分地区，造成四人死亡，数十万人断电。

paras.en: Officials reported two deaths each in the states of Alabama and Florida, which included people who were killed when trees fell on their houses.
paras.zh: 官员们报告说，阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州各有两人死亡，其中包括因树木倒塌压倒房屋而丧生的人。

paras.en: An estimated 500,000 people in total were without power in several states as of Saturday evening, according to tracker PowerOutage.
paras.zh: 据 PowerOutage 追踪公司统计，截至周六晚间，多个州估计共有 50 万人断电。

paras.en: Isaias made landfall in Florida late on Friday with maximum sustained winds of 105mph (168km/h) before being downgraded to a post-tropical cyclone.
paras.zh: 伊萨亚斯于周五晚些时候在佛罗里达州登陆，最大持续风速为 105 英里/小时（168 公里/小时），随后被降级为后热带气旋。

paras.en: The storm felled trees and ripped the roofs off buildings. Alabama, Florida and Georgia all declared states of emergency ahead of its arrival, while both Florida and Alabama issued mandatory evacuation orders to thousands of people.
paras.zh: 暴风雨砍倒了树木，掀掉了建筑物的屋顶。阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和佐治亚州在飓风抵达前均宣布进入紧急状态，佛罗里达州和阿拉巴马州都向数千人发布了强制疏散令。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Hurricane Simon is bearing down on Mexico's Pacific coast and has strengthened to category four. It is expected to make landfall sometime overnight.
paras.zh: 与此同时，飓风西蒙正在袭击墨西哥太平洋海岸，并已增强至四级。预计它将在一夜之间登陆。

paras.en: Tropical Storm Rachel, also in the Pacific Ocean, is expected to hit southern California later on Saturday.
paras.zh: 同样位于太平洋的热带风暴雷切尔预计将于周六晚些时候袭击南加州。

paras.en: Two deaths related to Isaias were reported in Florida's Escambia County. A woman was killed when a tree fell on her house, local Sheriff Chip Simmons said.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州埃斯坎比亚县报告了两起与伊萨亚斯有关的死亡事件。当地警长奇普·西蒙斯 (Chip Simmons) 表示，一棵树倒在一名妇女的房子上，导致一名妇女死亡。

paras.en: Joey Williams told NewsNation his wife had died in the storm. He said they went outside to snap pictures of the damage but, when they went back into their home, a tree fell through the roof and trapped them.
paras.zh: 乔伊·威廉姆斯告诉 NewsNation，他的妻子在风暴中丧生。他说，他们出去拍了受损情况的照片，但当他们回到家时，一棵树从屋顶掉下来，把他们困住了。

paras.en: "I was able to squeeze out. My wife didn't make it," Williams told the outlet.
paras.zh: “我能够挤出来，但我的妻子却没能成功，”威廉姆斯告诉媒体。

paras.en: Simmons later reported that a man had died from carbon monoxide poisoning after running a generator in a garage that was not properly ventilated. Four other people who were in the same house were taken to hospital.
paras.zh: 西蒙斯后来报告称，一名男子在通风不良的车库中运行发电机后死于一氧化碳中毒。同屋的另外四人被送往医院。

paras.en: Officials had to rescue people in vehicles that became submerged by floodwaters. The Florida National Guard shared pictures of a truck stuck in a flood ditch, saying soldiers "stopped, swam to the vehicle and pulled its occupants to safety".
paras.zh: 官员们不得不营救被洪水淹没的车辆中的人员。佛罗里达州国民警卫队分享了一辆卡车被困在洪水沟里的照片，称士兵们“停下来，游向车辆并将车内人员拉至安全地带”。

paras.en: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said flooding was a continued risk and warned of a "very hazardous situation".
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯表示，洪水是持续存在的风险，并警告称“情况非常危险”。

paras.en: In neighbouring Alabama, a sheriff was injured when a tree fell on him as he was responding to a car crash.
paras.zh: 在邻近的阿拉巴马州，一名警长在处理车祸时被一棵树倒下砸中受伤。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, we have also learned that two Alabamians have lost their lives," Governor Kay Ivey said in a post on X, without giving further details on the circumstances of the deaths.
paras.zh: 州长凯·艾维在 X 上发帖称：“不幸的是，我们还获悉有两名阿拉巴马人丧生。”但他没有提供有关死亡情况的更多细节。

paras.en: She also said officials were concerned about "spinoff tornadoes" in the state from the strong winds and heavy rain.
paras.zh: 她还表示，官员们担心强风和大雨会在该州引发“龙卷风”。

paras.en: "As we approach the weekend and any travel plans, make sure you have reliable information as conditions develop," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“随着周末和任何旅行计划的临近，请确保您在情况发展时获得可靠的信息。”

paras.en: In Charleston, South Carolina, officials asked people to stay home on Saturday night as high tide is expected to reach 7.5ft (2.3m).
paras.zh: 在南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿，官员要求人们周六晚上呆在家里，因为预计高潮将达到 7.5 英尺（2.3m）。

paras.en: "After dark, floodwater is much harder to see and it's impossible to judge how deep it is from behind the wheel," the city said.
paras.zh: 该市表示：“天黑后，洪水就更难看见，而且无法从方向盘后面判断洪水有多深。”

paras.en: The storm is expected to continue to weaken as it travels to the north-east, but the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (Noaa) warned that the Carolinas and Georgia could see floods from up to 10 inches (25cm) of rainfall.
paras.zh: 预计风暴向东北方向移动时将继续减弱，但国家海洋和大气管理局 (Noaa) 警告称，卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州可能会出现高达 10 英寸（25 厘米）的降雨量的洪水。

paras.en: Hurricane Isaias was the first hurricane in the Atlantic's hurricane season, which largely has been delayed due to El NiÃ±o conditions in the Pacific.
paras.zh: 飓风伊萨亚斯是大西洋飓风季节的第一场飓风，该季节在很大程度上由于太平洋的厄尔尼诺现象而被推迟。

articles.title: Inside the room: What it was like to be with Blackpink's Lisa as race scandal erupted

paras.en: What's it like to be the main character of an online scandal?
paras.zh: 成为网络丑闻的主角是什么感觉？

paras.en: That's one of the questions raised in a new documentary about Lisa Manobal â one quarter of K-pop phenomenon Blackpink and a breakout star of TV show The White Lotus.
paras.zh: 这是一部关于丽莎·马诺巴尔 (Lisa Manobal) 的新纪录片中提出的问题。丽莎·马诺巴尔是韩国流行音乐现象 Blackpink 的四分之一成员，也是电视节目《白莲花》中的突破明星。

paras.en: The film captures an unfolding controversy, as leaked videos show Blackpink using racial slurs when they were teenage trainees in the K-pop system.
paras.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了一场正在展开的争议，泄露的视频显示 Blackpink 在韩国流行音乐体系中还是青少年练习生时使用种族歧视言论。

paras.en: The clips, which emerged last year, showed the band covering US rap songs during rehearsals. Explicit language, including the n-word, was left uncensored.
paras.zh: 去年出现的这些剪辑显示乐队在排练时翻唱美国说唱歌曲。露骨的语言，包括n字，未经审查。

paras.en: The scandal blew up while Lisa was rehearsing for a pivotal performance at the Coachella Festival in 2025.
paras.zh: 当丽莎正在为 2025 年科切拉音乐节的重要演出排练时，丑闻爆发。

paras.en: Offended and upset, some fans demanded an apology - but the band's record label, forbade the members from issuing a statement.
paras.zh: 一些粉丝感到被冒犯和不安，要求道歉，但乐队的唱片公司禁止成员发表声明。

paras.en: With Lisa's team in crisis mode, documentarian Sue Kim followed Lisa into her dressing room.
paras.zh: 丽莎的团队陷入危机，纪录片导演苏·金跟着丽莎走进她的更衣室。

paras.en: "I said, 'Look, I know this is new. I know you guys are wildly confused and hurt, but this is your time to say whatever you want to say - even if you're just processing your thoughts and telling us what you're feeling," Kim tells the BBC.
paras.zh: “我说，‘听着，我知道这是新鲜事。我知道你们非常困惑和受伤，但现在是时候说出你们想说的话了——即使你们只是在处理自己的想法并告诉我们你们的感受，”金告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: The film-maker "honestly expected her to say no".
paras.zh: 电影制片人“真诚地希望她说不”。

paras.en: Instead, Lisa lay down on a sofa and spoke from the heart.
paras.zh: 相反，丽莎躺在沙发上，说出了心里话。

paras.en: "It's bad," the singer says in the documentary, with a mixture of shame and nerves.
paras.zh: “这很糟糕，”这位歌手在纪录片中说道，语气中夹杂着羞耻和紧张。

paras.en: Lisa explains she was "15 or 16" when the videos were shot and "didn't know that [word] was sensitive because I'm from Thailand and my first language is not English".
paras.zh: 丽莎解释说，拍摄视频时她“15 岁或 16 岁”，“不知道这个词很敏感，因为我来自泰国，我的母语不是英语”。

paras.en: Having only heard the term in rap music, she was unaware of its offensive history.
paras.zh: 她只在说唱音乐中听说过这个词，并不知道它的攻击性历史。

paras.en: "Now I would never ever do that because, now, I've got education," she says. "Now I know better.
paras.zh: “现在我永远不会这样做，因为现在我已经接受了教育，”她说。 “现在我更了解了。

paras.en: It is a vulnerable and human response - and nothing like the scripted PR apology you might expect. (Lisa has since apologised publicly, external in an interview with Variety, although some people remained unconvinced, external).
paras.zh: 这是一种脆弱的、人性化的反应——与你想象中的有脚本的公关道歉完全不同。 （丽莎此后在接受 Variety 采访时公开道歉，尽管有些人仍然不相信，外部）。

paras.en: Kim says Lisaâs in-the-moment reaction is "one of the most important scenes" in her documentary, Always Lalisa, which hits cinemas on Monday, 12 October.
paras.zh: Kim 表示，Lisa 的即时反应是她的纪录片《Always Lalisa》中“最重要的场景之一”，该纪录片将于 10 月 12 日星期一在电影院上映。

paras.en: "There was no premeditation on Lisa's part, there was no media training," she adds.
paras.zh: “丽莎没有预谋，也没有接受媒体培训，”她补充道。

paras.en: "I asked her one question and she just talked for an hour, and everything came out, and it's all stream of consciousness.
paras.zh: “我问了她一个问题，她只说了一个小时，一切就都出来了，而且都是意识流。

paras.en: "And what you see with Lisa in that moment is so genuine, it's impossible not to feel compassion for her."
paras.zh: “那一刻你在丽莎身上看到的一切是如此真诚，不可能不对她感到同情。”

paras.en: The incident overshadowed what was supposed to be a triumphant launch for Lisa's debut solo album, Alter Ego.
paras.zh: 这一事件给丽莎首张个人专辑《Alter Ego》的成功发行蒙上了阴影。

paras.en: In the film, the singer receives death threats, but presses ahead with public appearances while safety concerns are "spinning in my head".
paras.zh: 在影片中，这位歌手收到了死亡威胁，但在安全问题“在我脑海中盘旋”的同时，仍坚持公开露面。

paras.en: "To a certain extent I have to take [criticism] and compromise," she says, exhausted, "but sometimes, it's too much".
paras.zh: “在某种程度上，我必须接受（批评）和妥协，”她精疲力竭地说，“但有时，这太过分了”。

paras.en: In a world of sanitised celebrity profiles, Kim's portrayal of upheaval and discomfort is unusual. She asks Lisa about bad reviews, and captures the star being scolded by her vocal coach for lack of effort.
paras.zh: 在名人资料被净化的世界里，金对动荡和不安的描述是不寻常的。她向丽莎询问差评，并捕捉到这位明星因缺乏努力而被声乐教练责骂的镜头。

paras.en: That said, the documentary was commissioned by the film division of the star's record label (which also made the recent, and much less revealing, Oasis documentary), so it is still ultimately a marketing product.
paras.zh: 也就是说，这部纪录片是由这位明星唱片公司的电影部门委托制作的（该部门还制作了最近的、不太暴露的绿洲纪录片），因此它最终仍然是一种营销产品。

paras.en: Even the most abrasive moments are calibrated to present Lisa in a good light - but the director credits the star with ensuring the film was not a mere puff piece.
paras.zh: 即使是最粗暴的时刻也经过精心设计，以更好地展现丽莎——但导演相信这位明星确保了这部电影不仅仅是一个吹捧的作品。

paras.en: "You never know when you meet an artist how transparent they'll be. And I have to give all credit to Lisa because she allowed us almost total access," Kim says.
paras.zh: “你永远不知道当你遇到一位艺术家时，他们会多么透明。我必须把所有的功劳都归功于丽莎，因为她允许我们几乎完全接触，”金说。

paras.en: "And when I showed her the film, she never asked me to remove a single scene. That's exceptional."
paras.zh: “当我给她看这部电影时，她从未要求我删除任何场景。这很特别。”

paras.en: The film's main storyline is about Lisa taking a break from K-pop to pursue crossover success in the Western music market.
paras.zh: 影片的主要故事情节是关于丽莎脱离韩国流行音乐，在西方音乐市场寻求跨界成功的故事。

paras.en: When we meet her, she is one of the world's most famous women, with millions of record sales and brand deals with Louis Vuitton and Bvlgari.
paras.zh: 当我们见到她时，她是世界上最著名的女性之一，拥有数百万张唱片销量记录，并与路易威登和宝格丽签订了品牌协议。

paras.en: But she is trapped by a K-pop system that forbids her from drinking alcohol and having adult relationships.
paras.zh: 但她被韩国流行音乐制度所困，禁止她饮酒和建立成人关系。

paras.en: "I don't want my dating to be the thing to hurt Blackpink's popularity," she says in the film. "But when I turned 25, I realised that this is not how you're supposed to live your life."
paras.zh: “我不希望我的约会损害 Blackpink 的受欢迎程度，”她在影片中说道。 “但当我25岁的时候，我意识到这不是你应该过的生活。”

paras.en: As a result, Lisa makes an early decision to cut ties with Korean entertainment company YG, who discovered her as a teenager, and signs a new deal with RCA Records in the US.
paras.zh: 因此，Lisa 很早就决定与青少年时期发现她的韩国娱乐公司 YG 断绝关系，并与美国 RCA 唱片公司签署了新协议。

paras.en: "Knowing her as I do, that took an immense amount of courage," says Kim.
paras.zh: “像我一样了解她，这需要巨大的勇气，”金说。

paras.en: "In general, she is a very kind, sweet person - and sometimes personalities like that, they don't want to rock the boat.
paras.zh: “总的来说，她是一个非常善良、可爱的人——有时像这样的性格，他们不想破坏现状。

paras.en: "Having been trained in the K-pop system from an early age, she grew acclimatised to obedience. Declaring that she wants a break is such a disruption to that way of life that I can only imagine it must have been building inside her for years."
paras.zh: “从小就接受韩国流行音乐体系的训练，她逐渐习惯了服从。宣称她想要休息一下对这种生活方式的破坏如此之大，我只能想象它一定已经在她内心建立了多年。”

paras.en: The potential rewards for going solo were phenomenal â but so were the risks.
paras.zh: 单打独斗的潜在回报是惊人的，但风险也是惊人的。

paras.en: In the film, we see Lisa struggling to assert herself in the recording studio, and tearfully battling nerves over her singing voice.
paras.zh: 在影片中，我们看到丽莎在录音室里努力维护自己的地位，并泪流满面地与紧张的歌声作斗争。

paras.en: At the age of 25, she is still curiously child-like. The fierce independence of her solo single New Woman sounds more like aspiration than fact.
paras.zh: 25岁的她，依然保持着童心。她的个人单曲《New Woman》中强烈的独立性听起来更像是一种愿望，而不是事实。

paras.en: Kim says that began to change as they filmed.
paras.zh: 金说，随着他们拍摄，情况开始发生变化。

paras.en: "I saw a person who was very tentative and unsure of herself slowly starting to unfold her wings. Making mistakes, but also getting back up on the horse."
paras.zh: “我看到一个非常试探和不确定自己的人慢慢地开始展开她的翅膀。犯了错误，但也重新站起来。”

paras.en: Kim locates an inner confidence in early home videos of Lisa competing in talent shows, drawing parallels between that precocious seven-year-old and the young woman who is gradually reclaiming her agency.
paras.zh: 金在丽莎参加选秀节目的早期家庭视频中找到了内心的自信，将那个早熟的七岁女孩与逐渐夺回自己的代理权的年轻女子进行了比较。

paras.en: She doggedly pursues a role in the third season of hit TV drama The White Lotus, self-taping an audition that wins her the role of kind-hearted wellness coach Mook Sornsin.
paras.zh: 她顽强地追求在热门电视剧《白莲花》第三季中扮演一个角色，并通过自录试镜赢得了善良的健康教练穆克·索恩辛 (Mook Sornsin) 的角色。

paras.en: On set, she shrugs off the restrictive moral code of her pop career.
paras.zh: 在片场，她摆脱了流行音乐事业中限制性的道德准则。

paras.en: "Lisa threw more parties than anyone else," notes the show's executive producer in an interview.
paras.zh: “丽莎举办的派对比其他任何人都多，”该节目的执行制片人在接受采访时指出。

paras.en: "And the defining characteristic of a Lisa party is tequila shots."
paras.zh: “丽莎派对的标志性特征就是龙舌兰酒。”

paras.en: Kim did not partake in the hedonism. In fact, the film-maker and her crew were regularly falling sick as they tried to keep up with Lisa's ridiculous schedule.
paras.zh: 金没有参与享乐主义。事实上，这位电影制片人和她的工作人员在努力跟上丽莎荒唐的日程安排时经常生病。

paras.en: "But when we premiered the film in Toronto, Lisa found me and she brought bottles of tequila, and that was like the perfect christening of the film," she laughs.
paras.zh: “但是当我们在多伦多首映这部电影时，丽莎找到了我，她带来了几瓶龙舌兰酒，这就像这部电影的完美洗礼，”她笑着说。

paras.en: The movie ends in June 2025 as Lisa returns to Seoul and rejoins Blackpink. As she unpacks her bags, she is clearly conflicted.
paras.zh: 电影于 2025 年 6 月结束，丽莎返回首尔并重新加入 Blackpink。当她打开行李时，她显然很矛盾。

paras.en: "It's bittersweet, and I think that's OK," says Kim.
paras.zh: “这是苦乐参半，但我认为没关系，”金说。

paras.en: "I don't think people should take it as like, 'Oh, she hates Blackpink'. It's more that she was reflecting on this year of freedom and worrying that she wouldn't be able to retain that. And that's a very astute fear to have."
paras.zh: “我认为人们不应该这样认为，‘哦，她讨厌 Blackpink’。更多的是，她在反思今年的自由，并担心自己无法保留这种自由。这是一种非常敏锐的恐惧。”

paras.en: In the year since, Lisa has already wrapped up her Blackpink duties and started phase two of her solo career with the single Sawadika. Kim says she is not surprised.
paras.zh: 今年以来，丽莎已经结束了 Blackpink 的工作，并以单曲《Sawadika》开始了她的独唱生涯的第二阶段。金说她并不感到惊讶。

paras.en: "Spending the year away from the K-pop system in the US really opened her horizons," the director says.
paras.zh: “远离美国韩国流行音乐体系的一年确实开阔了她的视野，”导演说。

paras.en: "She was exposed to a different kind of entertainment system where they're not held to a vow of chastity. If two star performers link up, it's almost like they get more power.
paras.zh: “她接触到了一种不同的娱乐系统，他们没有贞洁的誓言。如果两个明星表演者联系在一起，几乎就像他们获得了更多的权力。

paras.en: "That gave her a sense of like, 'Oh, I could have a different life. I might not lose my career if I want to get married and have children'.
paras.zh: “这给了她一种感觉，‘哦，我可以过不同的生活。如果我想结婚生子，我可能不会失去我的事业’。”

paras.en: "So I think part of the reason why Lisa's interested in continuing her solo career is that it might give her a little bit more personal freedom to be who she is."
paras.zh: “所以我认为丽莎有兴趣继续她的独唱生涯，部分原因是这可能会给她更多的个人自由，让她做自己。”

articles.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has said he thinks "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president" as he responded to Volodymyr Zelensky's criticism of the US diesel deal with Russia.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在回应弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基对美国与俄罗斯柴油协议的批评时表示，他认为“乌克兰是时候选出一位新总统了”。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president warned a new deal to release millions of tonnes of Russian diesel into the US would provide Moscow with money to continue its war against his nation, calling it a gift to Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统警告称，一项向美国释放数百万吨俄罗斯柴油的新协议将为莫斯科提供继续针对乌克兰的战争的资金，并称这是送给俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的礼物。

paras.en: Trump told reporters outside the White House on Saturday that Zelensky "wants to make problems for the world" by continuing to authorise attacks on Russian refineries.
paras.zh: 特朗普周六在白宫外对记者表示，泽连斯基继续授权袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，“想给世界制造问题”。

paras.en: Trump said his Ukrainian counterpart ought to "stop" before suggesting Ukraine should "get a new leader who can make a deal".
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，乌克兰总统在建议乌克兰应该“找到一位能够达成协议的新领导人”之前应该“停下来”。

paras.en: Since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022 the country has been under martial law, meaning elections are suspended.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯于 2022 年入侵乌克兰以来，该国一直处于戒严状态，这意味着选举被暂停。

paras.en: Global fuel supplies, including diesel, have been severely limited by the war against Iran launched by the US and Israel, which led to the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil products usually flows.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列对伊朗发动的战争导致包括柴油在内的全球燃料供应受到严重限制，该战争导致霍尔木兹海峡实际上被关闭，世界上约五分之一的石油产品通常流经该海峡。

paras.en: Russia - a major producer - and Ukraine have recently intensified their strikes on each other's energy infrastructure and transport facilities, further straining energy markets.
paras.zh: 主要生产国俄罗斯和乌克兰最近加大了对彼此能源基础设施和运输设施的打击力度，进一步加剧了能源市场的紧张。

paras.en: "We said, 'you can do whatever you want to Russia, don't hit the refineries', because that's a world problem that's caused," Trump continued.
paras.zh: “我们说，‘你可以对俄罗斯为所欲为，不要攻击炼油厂’，因为这是一个世界问题，”特朗普继续说道。

paras.en: "He could have made many deals and for some reason, he never does."
paras.zh: “他本可以达成很多交易，但出于某种原因，他从未这样做。”

paras.en: Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev described Trump's intervention as "iconic and historic", saying that Ukraine "needs leadership actually focused on peace".
paras.zh: 普京的特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫将特朗普的干预描述为“标志性的和历史性的”，并表示乌克兰“需要真正关注和平的领导”。

paras.en: The US president confirmed on Friday that an agreement had been reached with Moscow to suspend sanctions on Russian diesel exports until 7 April.
paras.zh: 美国总统周五证实，已与莫斯科达成协议，暂停对俄罗斯柴油出口的制裁，直至 4 月 7 日。

paras.en: Zelensky reacted by saying it would allow Moscow to raise new funds to source new military equipment to continue the war.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基回应称，这将允许莫斯科筹集新资金来采购新的军事装备以继续战争。

paras.en: He also accused Moscow of taking the deal "to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they keep dropping bombs on cities" following deadly new strikes on Zaporizhzhia.
paras.zh: 他还指责莫斯科接受这项协议“意味着他们可以继续战斗，意味着他们在扎波罗热遭受新的致命袭击后继续向城市投掷炸弹”。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president spoke to several allies on Saturday to discuss the latest developments, calling for "real decisions to protect lives in Ukraine" and to protect European security.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统周六与几个盟友通话，讨论最新事态发展，呼吁“做出真正的决定，保护乌克兰的生命”并保护欧洲安全。

paras.en: A Downing Street spokesperson said UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham had spoken to Zelensky and offered his "complete solidarity".
paras.zh: 唐宁街发言人表示，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆已与泽连斯基通话，并表示“完全声援”。

paras.en: The pair had agreed Russia should acquiesce to "an immediate energy ceasefire" and end its attacks on shipping in the Black Sea, the spokesperson said, as "this would immediately release more energy and food supplies into the global market".
paras.zh: 发言人表示，两国同意俄罗斯应默许“立即能源停火”并结束对黑海航运的攻击，因为“这将立即向全球市场释放更多能源和粮食供应”。

paras.en: News of the US-Russia diesel deal was also met with criticism by EU's foreign affairs chief Kaja Kallas, who echoed Zelensky in saying that suspending sanctions "provides Moscow with more revenues to wage war", adding: "This is not the time to ease pressure on Russia, and Europe won't."
paras.zh: 美俄柴油协议的消息也遭到了欧盟外交事务负责人卡亚·卡拉斯的批评，他赞同泽连斯基的说法，称暂停制裁“为莫斯科提供了更多的收入来发动战争”，并补充道：“现在不是减轻对俄罗斯压力的时候，欧洲也不会。”

paras.en: She said European foreign ministers intended to approve the biggest set of sanctions on Russia since the start of its full-scale invasion on Monday.
paras.zh: 她表示，欧洲外长打算批准自周一全面入侵俄罗斯以来对俄罗斯实施的最大规模制裁。

paras.en: The deal with Russia is the latest effort from Trump to lower fuel prices in the US ahead of the midterm elections, after months spent grappling with the political consequences of the Iran war.
paras.zh: 与俄罗斯达成的协议是特朗普在中期选举前降低美国燃油价格的最新举措，此前几个月他一直在努力应对伊朗战争的政治后果。

paras.en: That conflict, which began in February, has sent the cost of petrol and in particular diesel skyrocketing, which has soured his standing with the American public who have been stung by the higher pump prices and knock-on effects that led to across-the-board inflation.
paras.zh: 这场始于二月份的冲突导致汽油价格，尤其是柴油价格飙升，这损害了他在美国公众中的地位，美国公众因汽油价格上涨和导致全面通胀的连锁反应而受到刺痛。

paras.en: The average price of diesel is currently $6.28 (Â£4.74) a gallon, according to the AAA â up from last month's $5.94 average, and $3.68 last year.
paras.zh: 根据 AAA 的数据，目前柴油的平均价格为每加仑 6.28 美元（4.74 英镑），高于上个月的平均价格 5.94 美元，去年的平均价格为每加仑 3.68 美元。

paras.en: Under the deal, Russia would release an initial 300,000 tonnes of diesel "to the American and global marketplace" followed by an additional 500,000 tonnes in November.
paras.zh: 根据协议，俄罗斯将首先向“美国和全球市场”释放 30 万吨柴油，随后在 11 月份再释放 50 万吨。

paras.en: A further million would follow, Trump wrote on Truth Social, and then another 3m tonnes "within a short period of time" â but he noted that this delivery will be "based on the condition of their diesel refineries".
paras.zh: 特朗普在《Truth Social》上写道，接下来还将交付 100 万吨，然后“在短时间内”再交付 300 万吨——但他指出，这次交付将“基于柴油炼油厂的状况”。

paras.en: In the past 10 months, Russia experienced two waves of severe fuel shortages across the country due to Ukrainian drones strikes on its oil refineries.
paras.zh: 过去10个月，由于乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，俄罗斯全国范围内经历了两波严重燃料短缺。

paras.en: Diesel production in Russia dropped by an estimated 30%, according to the International Energy Agency.
paras.zh: 据国际能源署称，俄罗斯的柴油产量估计下降了 30%。

paras.en: Trump had already called for new elections in Ukraine last December, external, saying Ukrainian voters should have the choice to replace Zelensky.
paras.zh: 去年12月，特朗普已在外部呼吁乌克兰举行新的选举，称乌克兰选民应该有选择取代泽伦斯基的机会。

paras.en: Since the war broke out in 2022 Ukraine has been under martial law, meaning elections are suspended.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年战争爆发以来，乌克兰一直处于戒严状态，这意味着选举被暂停。

articles.title: Why are dengue cases surging in Florida this year? An 'unlucky' combination of factors, experts say
articles.author: Olivia Ferrari

paras.en: Cases of dengue fever are surging in Florida, spurring several counties to declare a state of emergency.

The state has seen 497 reported cases so far this year. Of those, 252, or about 51%, were caught locally, rather than brought to the state by travelers. The Florida Department of Health confirmed one woman's death from dengue fever in early September, marking the state's first known dengue death in almost a century.

Prior to the past few years, most dengue cases reported in Florida were the result of travel. In other words, people caught the disease in other countries and then traveled to Florida, where their case was then diagnosed. At 245, the number of travel-related cases reported this year is not unusually high, Caroline Waddell, a public health researcher at the University of Florida, told Live Science in an email. However, the number of cases caught from local mosquitoes is more than five times higher than at this point in the year compared with any of the previous four years, she said.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Why are local dengue cases especially high this year? Live Science spoke with experts to find out.

Dengue fever is caused by the virus Orthoflavivirus denguei, which spreads from mosquitoes to people through the pests' bites; it doesn't spread from person to person. Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes transmit the virus to humans, and the same species can also carry the viruses behind yellow fever, Zika and chikungunya.

About 100 million to 400 million dengue infections happen annually worldwide, with about 800 cases reported in the U.S. historically, although that number has increased recently. Only about 1 in 4 people exposed to the dengue virus develop symptoms, which can include fever, headache, body aches, nausea and rash. About 1 in 20 cases become severe, and immunocompromised people, children, older adults and pregnant people are especially susceptible to these serious infections.

Severe symptoms can include abdominal pain, vomiting, difficulty breathing and bleeding of the gums or nose. The most severe forms of the infection can lead to leaky blood vessels, severe bleeding, shock, organ dysfunction and death. There is no specific treatment for dengue, so care focuses on managing symptoms and maintaining patients' vital signs.

Dengue has escalated as a global health concern in the past few decades. Between 2000 and 2019, global cases of dengue increased tenfold; between 1990 and 2021, dengue-related deaths doubled. Scientists say this surge is likely driven by climate change, since rising temperatures expand Ae. aegypti mosquitoes' range, in turn exposing more people to the insects' bites. Plus, warmer conditions speed up mosquitoes' life cycles and the dengue virus's replication rate, thereby boosting transmission.
International travel also factors into these rising case counts. In 2023, dengue spikes around the world were attributed to the resurgence of global travel following the COVID-19 pandemic.
As the global picture has worsened, dengue cases in the U.S. have also increased.

Nearly 3,800 cases were reported in 2024 — an increase of more than 300% above the annual average for the previous 10 years. The uptick was tied to a rise in travel-associated cases, reflecting the wider global surge, as well as to warming temperatures that brought dengue-carrying mosquitoes to new regions of the U.S.

Each year, Florida experiences dengue outbreaks in the southernmost parts of the state, such as Miami and the Florida Keys, Panpim Thongsripong, a disease ecologist at the University of Florida, told Live Science. Historically, outbreaks in Miami typically totaled around 50 or fewer cases. But then a 2019 outbreak resulted in over 200 cases, and from 2022 to 2024, outbreak totals have ranged from about 500 to 675 cases.

The outbreak currently unfolding in Florida centers on Hillsborough County, which is farther north and includes Tampa. This is unusual, Thongsripong said, as this region of the state normally sees just a few sporadic cases. Hillsborough County has reported 223 of the state's 252 locally acquired cases this year, and it's where the one dengue-related death took place.

Florida's health department regularly traps mosquitoes and tests them for viruses. So far this year, 20 pools of mosquitoes have tested positive for dengue across seven counties, and 19 of those positive pools were sampled from the greater Tampa area. In 2025, only four mosquito pools throughout the state tested positive, and in 2023, one mosquito pool did.

"Finding positive mosquito pools is rare in Florida because dengue is not endemic to the state," said Keira Lucas, deputy executive director of the Collier Mosquito Control District. "In many ways, it can be like looking for a needle in a haystack," she told Live Science.

Routine mosquito trapping is a relatively inefficient method for detecting viruses, though, Lucas said. As such, detecting dengue-positive mosquito pools may indicate that a large amount of transmission is already unfolding. "Since approximately 75% of dengue infections are asymptomatic, the virus can circulate within a community without being readily detected for some time," Lucas explained.
In addition to Hillsborough, neighboring Pasco and Pinellas counties have declared local states of emergency over dengue.
So what's driving the unusual dengue activity this year?

In the past, Florida's local dengue outbreaks tended to be concentrated in the South, which saw moderate rainfall, warmer temperatures and more travel-related dengue cases compared with the rest of the state, according to a 2022 study in the journal Insects. With the outbreak concentrated farther north this year, that could suggest changing climatic patterns are making additional parts of the state especially hospitable to mosquitoes and the virus. That wouldn't necessarily explain why Tampa is seeing more local cases than Miami this year, but it could nonetheless be a factor in the overall trend.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For the virus to persist in local mosquitoes, dengue still needs to be reintroduced periodically through travel-related cases. Because the virus is not yet endemic to the state, it doesn't regularly circulate in local mosquitoes; however, a somewhat predictable "dengue season" has been emerging that coincides with upticks in international travelers carrying the virus to Florida.

This year, though, the high number of locally acquired dengue cases suggests a shift from predominantly imported infections toward outbreaks spurred by local Florida mosquitoes. Scientists hypothesize that climate change could increase local transmission in Florida even more in the future.

This year, Florida has also been enduring its most intense drought in over a decade. In theory, that might be expected to limit mosquito populations because the pests need water to breed, Lucas said. However, when it's dry, people tend to run their sprinklers more, creating mosquito breeding grounds when puddles form or containers fill up, she noted. This could bring mosquitoes closer to people, as it creates opportunities for them to breed.

Ae. aegypti mosquitoes are especially well adapted to living alongside humans, as they prefer to breed in human-made containers. Droughts can also drive dehydrated mosquitoes to bite more as they hunt for fluids.
"It's almost like an unlucky [combination]," Thongsripong said. "Everything coming together at the right time and right place, and boom, you have the conditions for an outbreak to occur."

The true number of dengue cases may be even higher than reported, Waddell said. The cases captured in the data include infected individuals who went to a doctor to get tested. Because many infections are mild or asymptomatic, additional people may have contracted the virus but never got counted.

It's too early to definitively say what factors have increased Florida's dengue cases this year, Thongsripong said, as scientists are still gathering information. Despite the unknowns, she thinks the health and housing infrastructure in the U.S. will stop dengue from becoming too dangerous here.

To get dengue under control, it's key for government-level mosquito control efforts to coordinate and for the public to be aware of the virus, Lucas said. The mosquito control district coordinates with the health department for the latest data to best target where to spray larvicide, which kills mosquito offspring before they can bite people, she said.
- The super El Niño could cause torrential rainstorms. Americans may need to stock up on food to prepare, experts say.
- 'Mpox has not disappeared': Why the infectious disease is still spreading in the US and may be here to stay
- Infectious diseases will seed new ground as the planet warms — here's where they'll spread

It's important for people to use mosquito repellent when going outside, Thongsripong said, as well as to empty water from objects that can collect water and become a mosquito breeding ground, such as pets' water bowls, plant saucers, buckets or discarded tires.
Due to this year's strong El Niño, Florida is expecting a rainier winter, which could mean even more mosquitoes than usual, Lucas noted. That, in turn, could fuel additional dengue cases.
"Cases with September onsets are still being reported," Waddell said, "so we're not out of the woods."
This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.

Olivia Ferrari is a New York City-based freelance journalist with a background in research and science communication. Olivia has lived and worked in the U.K., Costa Rica, Panama and Colombia. Her writing focuses on wildlife, environmental justice, climate change, and social science.
